local controller = newclass('PuzzleEventController')

function controller:init(quest_controller)
	self.quest_controller = quest_controller

	local file_path_prefix = 'Quest/Main/QueenCastle/TrialOfWisdom/PuzzleEvents/'

	local script_file_names = {
		file_path_prefix .. 'PuzzleEvent1.lua',
		file_path_prefix .. 'PuzzleEvent2.lua',
		file_path_prefix .. 'PuzzleEvent3.lua'
	}

	self.event_scripts = self:load_scripts(script_file_names)
end

function controller:load_scripts(file_names)
	local scripts = {}

	for i = 1, #file_names do
		local script = get_or_create_global_table(file_names[i])
		if script ~= nil then
			table.insert(scripts, script(self))
		end
	end

	return scripts
end

function controller:on_pre_load()
	for i = 1, #self.event_scripts do
		-- 좀 더 직관적인 Nullable Call 방식은 없을까???

	end
end

	for i = 1, #self.event_scripts do

		lua_helper.call_nullable(self.event_scripts[i], 'enter', self.event_scripts[i])
	end
end

function controller:start()
	for i = 1, #self.event_scripts do
		-- 좀 더 직관적인 Nullable Call 방식은 없을까???
		lua_helper.call_nullable(self.event_scripts[i], 'start', self.event_scripts[i])
	end
end

function controller:exit()
	for i = 1, #self.event_scripts do
		-- 좀 더 직관적인 Nullable Call 방식은 없을까???
		lua_helper.call_nullable(self.event_scripts[i], 'exit', self.event_scripts[i])
	end

	self.quest_controller = nil
end

function controller:dispose()
	for i = 1, #self.event_scripts do

		lua_helper.call_nullable(self.event_scripts[i], 'dispose', self.event_scripts[i])
	end

-- 첫번째 퍼즐 이벤트에 대한 스크립트
local puzzle_event = newclass('PuzzleEvent1')

function puzzle_event:init(event_controller)
	self.scene_version = scene_util.default_version
	self.event_controller = event_controller

	self.available_stage_name = 'queencastle_1_2'

	self.event_state = {
		none = 0,
		puzzle_started = 1,
		puzzle_ended = 2
	}

	self.current_event_state = self.event_state.none

	-- 캐릭터
	self.get_knight = function()
		return user_util.get_knight_character('knight_female', 'knight_male')
	end

	self.get_knight_mirror = function()
		return user_util.get_knight_character('knight_female_mirror', 'knight_male_mirror')
	end

	-- 필드 오브젝트
	self.get_puzzle_key = function()
		return get_field_object('wisdom_puzzle_key_1')
	end

	self.get_puzzle_key_switch = function()
		return get_field_object('wisdom_puzzle_key_switch_1')
	end

	self.get_puzzle_enter_door = function()
		return get_field_object('wisdom_puzzle_enter_door_1')
	end

	self.get_puzzle_exit_door = function()
		return get_field_object('wisdom_puzzle_exit_door_1')
	end

	-- 마커
	self.get_puzzle_player_center_pos = function()
		return field:GetMarker('wisdom_puzzle_player_center_1').position
	end

	self.get_puzzle_npc_center_pos = function()
		return field:GetMarker('wisdom_puzzle_npc_center_1').position
	end

	self.get_puzzle_camera_pos = function()
		return field:GetMarker('wisdom_puzzle_camera_pos_1').position
	end

	self.get_puzzle_key_spawn_pos = function()
		return field:GetMarker('wisdom_puzzle_key_spawn_pos_1').position
	end

	-- 이펙트
	self.get_reset_fx = function()
		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_reset_object')
	end

	-- 퀘스트 마커
	self.quest_marker_name = 'wisdom_puzzle'

	self.puzzle_enter_door_name = 'wisdom_puzzle_enter_door_1'
	self.puzzle_exit_door_name = 'wisdom_puzzle_exit_door_1'

	self.puzzle_key_zone_name = 'wisdom_puzzle_key_zone_1'

	self.puzzle_start_event_zone_name = 'wisdom_puzzle_start_event_zone_1'

	self.puzzle_subtitle_zone_name = 'wisdom_subtitle_zone_1'

	-- 현재는 테스트용
	self.puzzle_enter_zone_name = 'wisdom_test_zone_1'

	-- 캐릭터 틴트 키
	self.character_tint_key_list = {
		veiled = 'veiled'
	}

	-- 입장 자막을 보았는지에 대한 체크 플래그
	self.is_subtitle_triggered = false

	--region typing_text
	self.typing_text_obj = nil
	self.typing_text = nil
	self.typing_text_asset_bundle_name = 'ui/prologue'
	self.typing_text_asset_name = 'typing_text'
	--endregion

	self.knight_state = { idle = 1, walk = 2 }
	self.current_knight_state = self.knight_state.idle
end

function puzzle_event:on_pre_load()
	-- 자막 로드
	self.res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()

	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
			self.res_holder, self.typing_text_asset_bundle_name, self.typing_text_asset_name, function(prefab)
				self.typing_text_obj = CS.NGUITools.AddChild(stage.UIRoot.gameObject, prefab).gameObject
				self.typing_text = self.typing_text_obj:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UITypingText))

				self.typing_text.Widget:SetAnchor(stage.UIRoot.gameObject, 1, 90, 1, 110)
				self.typing_text.Widget.topAnchor.relative = 0
				self.typing_text.Widget:UpdateAnchors()
				self.typing_text.Label.fontSize = 32
				self.typing_text.Label.color = unity_class.color.white
			end)

	self.typing_text_obj:SetActive(false)
end

function puzzle_event:start()
	-- 퍼즐키 초기 셋팅
	local puzzle_key = self.get_puzzle_key()
	puzzle_key.Position = self.get_puzzle_key_spawn_pos()
	puzzle_key.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')

	local shadow_transform = puzzle_key.Transform:Find("shadow")
	shadow_transform.localPosition = vector(0, -20 + 0.03, 0)
end

function puzzle_event:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.SwitchOnOffEvent), 'on_switch_on_off_event')
	self.get_reset_fx()
end

--region event
function puzzle_event:on_event(e)
end

function puzzle_event:on_switch_on_off_event(e)
	local switch_fo = self.get_puzzle_key_switch()

	if (not self.puzzle_key_spawned) and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.SwitchObject, switch_fo) and e.IsTurningOn then
		self.puzzle_key_spawned = true
		start_coroutine(self.key_spawn, self, 1)
	end

	return false
end

function puzzle_event:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
		if self.current_event_state  == self.event_state.none then
			if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, e.FieldObject, self.puzzle_start_event_zone_name) then
				self.current_event_state = self.event_state.puzzle_started
				sp_util.start_scene(self.puzzle_start, self)
				return true
			end
		end

		if (not self.is_subtitle_triggered) and
				type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, e.FieldObject, self.puzzle_subtitle_zone_name) then
			self.is_subtitle_triggered = true
			sp_util.start_scene(self.show_subtitle, self)
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end
--endregion

function puzzle_event:exit()
	self.current_event_state = self.event_state.none
	self.event_controller = nil

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.SwitchOnOffEvent))

	if self.typing_text_obj ~= nil then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.typing_text_obj)
		self.typing_text_obj = nil
		self.typing_text = nil
	end

	if self.res_holder then
		self.res_holder:Dispose()
		self.res_holder = nil
	end
end

function puzzle_event:dispose()
end

function puzzle_event:puzzle_start()
	local knight = self.get_knight()
	local knight_mirror = self.get_knight_mirror()
	local puzzle_key = self.get_puzzle_key()

	-- 문 닫힘
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create(self.puzzle_enter_door_name, false))
	-- 0.7초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.7)

	-- 거울속 캐릭터 틴트 처리
	self:mirror_setup()

	-- 퀘스트 마커 설정
	quest_marker_util.show(self.event_controller.quest_controller,
			self.quest_marker_name, self.get_puzzle_exit_door(), true)

	-- 퍼즐 업데이트 시작
	start_coroutine(self.puzzle_update, self)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
end

function puzzle_event:puzzle_update()
	local knight = self.get_knight()
	local knight_mirror = self.get_knight_mirror()

	local knight_prev_pos = knight.Position

	while self.current_event_state ~= self.event_state.puzzle_ended and
			self.current_event_state ~= self.event_state.none do
		local knight_current_pos = knight.Position
		-- 플레이어의 이전 좌표와 현재 좌표가 다르다면 방향 벡터를 구해서
		-- 거울속 세계의 npc에게 작용시킨다.
		if knight_current_pos ~= knight_prev_pos then
			-- 가공 전 벡터
			local vec = knight_prev_pos - knight_current_pos
			local speed = vector_util.distance(knight_prev_pos, knight_current_pos)
			--local knight_mirror_pos = knight_mirror.Position
			-- -1을 곱해줘야 반대 벡터가 완성
			local dir = vector_util.normalized(vec)
			knight_mirror.Direction = vector_util.to_direction(dir)
			CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameStageLogic.ExecuteMove(
					knight_mirror,
					dir,
					speed)

			if self.current_knight_state == self.knight_state.idle then
				self.current_knight_state = self.knight_state.walk
				character_util.set_anim(knight_mirror, { name = 'walk' })
			end
		else
			if self.current_knight_state == self.knight_state.walk then
				self.current_knight_state = self.knight_state.idle
				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(knight_mirror)
			end
		end
		knight_prev_pos = knight_current_pos
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function puzzle_event:key_spawn(duration)
	local key = self.get_puzzle_key()
	local height = stage_util.get_height(key.Position)

	key.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')

	local shadow_transform = key.Transform:Find("shadow")
	shadow_transform.localPosition = vector(0, -20 + 0.03, 0)

	-- 낙하 계산
	local free_fall = CS.CalculatorFreeFall(0.5, 20, 3)
	local end_pos = vector(key.Position.x, 0, key.Position.z)

	local time_passed = 0
	local start_angle = 0
	local end_angle = 1080
	local is_bounce = false
	local bounce_num = 0

	local rotate_duration = free_fall:GetTotalTime()

	while not free_fall:IsDone() do
		free_fall:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
		local cur_y = free_fall:GetDistance()

		if not is_bounce and cur_y < 0 then
			key.Position = vector(end_pos.x, 20 + height + cur_y, end_pos.z)
		else
			if not is_bounce then
				is_bounce = true
			end

			key.Position = vector(end_pos.x, height + cur_y, end_pos.z)
		end

		shadow_transform.localPosition = vector(0, -key.Position.y + height + 0.03, 0)

		if time_passed < rotate_duration then
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

			local cur_angle = CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(
					time_passed, start_angle, end_angle - start_angle, rotate_duration)

			key.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, cur_angle, 0)
		else
			key.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 0, 0)
		end

		if bounce_num < free_fall:NumBounced() then
			bounce_num = bounce_num + 1

			music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_small_key_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'object' })
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	key.Holdable = CS.Oak.Holdable()
	key.Position = end_pos
	shadow_transform.localPosition = vector(0, 0.03, 0)
	key.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 0, 0)

	start_coroutine(self.check_door_opened, self)
end

function puzzle_event:check_door_opened()
	local key = self.get_puzzle_key()
	local keydoor = self.get_puzzle_exit_door()

	while key.ActiveState == active_state('enabled') do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()

	camera_util.move_async(keydoor.Position, 1)

	while keydoor.ActiveState == active_state('enabled') do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.current_event_state = self.event_state.puzzle_ended

	-- 카메라 귀환 시키기
	camera_util.resize_to_default(1)
	camera_util.move_async(self.get_knight().Position, 1, { end_target = self.get_knight() })

	-- 퀘스트 마커 제거
	quest_marker_util.remove(self.quest_marker_name)

	party_util.reset_controllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()
end

function puzzle_event:mirror_setup()
	local knight = self.get_knight()
	local knight_mirror = self.get_knight_mirror()
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(knight_mirror, 0, 0)
	scene_util.set_direction(knight_mirror, 'left')

	-- 카메라를 가운데로 이동
	camera_util.move(self.get_puzzle_camera_pos(), 1.5)
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(5.5, 1.5)
	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	-- 거울속 캐릭터 좌표 셋팅
	local diff = self.get_puzzle_player_center_pos() - knight.Position
	-- 거울로 스폰 시키기 위해 x만 반전시켜준다.
	diff = vector(-diff.x, diff.y, diff.z)

	local goal_pos = self.get_puzzle_npc_center_pos() - diff
	knight_mirror.Position = goal_pos

	-- 거울속 기사에게 이펙트 생성
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_teleport_01')
	self.get_reset_fx():Instantiate(knight_mirror.Position)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(knight_mirror, 1, 1)

	-- 히트 박스를 설정해야 ExecuteMove가 제대로 된다.
	knight_mirror.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(0.45, 0.5, 0.45))
	wait_for_sec(1)
end

function puzzle_event:show_subtitle()
	wait_for_sec(2)

	-- 미래의 용사, 지혜의 시련에 온 것을 환영합니다.
	self.typing_text_obj:SetActive(true)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_03')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_broadcast_01')
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)
	coroutine.yield(self.typing_text:SetTypedText('qc_trial_of_wisdom_s1_1', 1000, 0.05, 3.0))

	-- 아래 자막 : 이 시련에서는 지혜를 활용하여 굳게 닫힌 길을 열어야 합니다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_03')
	coroutine.yield(self.typing_text:SetTypedText('qc_trial_of_wisdom_s1_2', 1000, 0.05, 3.0))

	-- 아래 자막 : 자신이 용사의 지혜를 가지고 있다는 것을 증명하십시오.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_03')
	coroutine.yield(self.typing_text:SetTypedText('qc_trial_of_wisdom_s1_3', 1000, 0.05, 3.0))
	self.typing_text_obj:SetActive(false)
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)

	party_util.reset_controllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()
end

return {
	create = function()
		return puzzle_event
	end
}

			if self.current_knight_state == self.knight_state.idle then

				self.current_knight_state = self.knight_state.idle
				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(knight_mirror)
			end
		end
		knight_prev_pos = knight_current_pos
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

function puzzle_event:puzzle_end()

local puzzle_event = newclass('PuzzleEvent3')

function puzzle_event:init(event_controller)
	self.scene_version = scene_util.default_version
	self.event_controller = event_controller

	self.available_stage_name = 'queencastle_1_2'

	self.event_state = {
		none = 0,
		puzzle_started = 1,
		puzzle_ended = 2,
		puzzle_stop = 3
	}

	self.current_event_state = self.event_state.none

	-- 캐릭터
	self.get_knight = function()
		return user_util.get_knight_character('knight_female', 'knight_male')
	end

	self.get_knight_mirror = function()
		return user_util.get_knight_character('knight_female_mirror', 'knight_male_mirror')
	end

	-- 필드 오브젝트
	self.get_brazier = function()
		return get_field_object('wisdom_puzzle_holdup_brazier_2_2')
	end

	-- 마커
	self.get_puzzle_player_center_pos = function()
		return field:GetMarker('wisdom_puzzle_player_center_3').position
	end

	self.get_puzzle_npc_center_pos = function()
		return field:GetMarker('wisdom_puzzle_npc_center_3').position
	end

	self.get_puzzle_camera_pos = function()
		return field:GetMarker('wisdom_puzzle_camera_pos_3').position
	end

	-- 이펙트
	self.get_reset_fx = function()
		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_reset_object')
	end

	-- 퀘스트 마커
	self.quest_marker_name = 'wisdom_puzzle_3'

	self.puzzle_enter_door_name = 'wisdom_puzzle_enter_door_3'
	self.puzzle_exit_door_name = 'wisdom_puzzle_exit_door_3'

	self.puzzle_start_event_zone_name = 'wisdom_puzzle_start_event_zone_3'

	self.knight_state = { idle = 1, walk = 2 }
	self.current_knight_state = self.knight_state.idle
end

function puzzle_event:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DoorOpenedEvent), 'on_door_opened_event')

	self.get_reset_fx()
end

--region event
function puzzle_event:on_event(e)
end

function puzzle_event:on_door_opened_event(e)
	if self.current_event_state == self.event_state.puzzle_started and
			e.DoorHandleName == self.puzzle_exit_door_name then
		self.current_event_state = self.event_state.puzzle_ended
		sp_util.start_scene(self.puzzle_end, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function puzzle_event:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
		if self.current_event_state  == self.event_state.none then
			if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, e.FieldObject, self.puzzle_start_event_zone_name) then
				self.current_event_state = self.event_state.puzzle_started
				sp_util.start_scene(self.puzzle_start, self)
				return true
			end
		end
	end
	return false
end

--endregion

function puzzle_event:exit()
	self.current_event_state = self.event_state.none
	self.event_controller = nil
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DoorOpenedEvent))
end

function puzzle_event:dispose()
end

function puzzle_event:puzzle_start()
	-- 문 닫힘
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create(self.puzzle_enter_door_name, false))
	-- 0.7초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.7)

	-- 거울 세팅
	self:mirror_setup()

	-- 퀘스트 마커 설정
	quest_marker_util.show(self.event_controller.quest_controller,
			self.quest_marker_name, get_field_object(self.puzzle_exit_door_name), true)

	-- 퍼즐 업데이트 시작
	start_coroutine(self.puzzle_update, self)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
end

function puzzle_event:puzzle_update()
	local knight = self.get_knight()
	local knight_mirror = self.get_knight_mirror()

	local knight_prev_pos = knight.Position

	while self.current_event_state ~= self.event_state.puzzle_ended and
			self.current_event_state ~= self.event_state.none do
		local knight_current_pos = knight.Position
		-- 플레이어의 이전 좌표와 현재 좌표가 다르다면 방향 벡터를 구해서
		-- 거울속 세계의 npc에게 작용시킨다.
		if knight_current_pos ~= knight_prev_pos then
			-- 가공 전 벡터
			local vec = knight_prev_pos - knight_current_pos
			local speed = vector_util.distance(knight_prev_pos, knight_current_pos)
			--local knight_mirror_pos = knight_mirror.Position
			-- -1을 곱해줘야 반대 벡터가 완성
			local dir = vector_util.normalized(vec)
			knight_mirror.Direction = vector_util.to_direction(dir)
			CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameStageLogic.ExecuteMove(
					knight_mirror,
					dir,
					speed)

			if self.current_knight_state == self.knight_state.idle then
				self.current_knight_state = self.knight_state.walk
				character_util.set_anim(knight_mirror, { name = 'walk' })
			end
		else
			if self.current_knight_state == self.knight_state.walk then
				self.current_knight_state = self.knight_state.idle
				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(knight_mirror)
			end
		end
		knight_prev_pos = knight_current_pos
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function puzzle_event:puzzle_end()
	-- 퀘스트 마커 제거
	quest_marker_util.remove(self.quest_marker_name)

	-- 카메라 귀환 시키기
	camera_util.resize_to_default(1)
	camera_util.move(self.get_knight().Position,
			1, { target = self.get_knight(), end_target = self.get_knight() })

	-- 거울 가디언 화로 던지기
	local knight_mirror = self.get_knight_mirror()
	local brazier = self.get_brazier()
	command_util.execute_throw(knight_mirror, brazier,
			direction_util.to_vector3(knight_mirror.Direction),
			knight_mirror.Position, 4, false)
end

function puzzle_event:mirror_setup()
	local knight = self.get_knight()
	local knight_mirror = self.get_knight_mirror()
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(knight_mirror, 0, 0)
	scene_util.set_direction(knight_mirror, 'left')

	-- 카메라를 가운데로 이동
	camera_util.move(self.get_puzzle_camera_pos(), 1.5)
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(6.5, 1.5)
	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	-- 화로를 holdup 시켜주자.
	local brazier = self.get_brazier()
	command_util.execute_holdup(knight_mirror, brazier, knight_mirror.Position, 0)

	-- 거울속 캐릭터 좌표 셋팅
	local diff = self.get_puzzle_player_center_pos() - knight.Position
	-- 거울로 스폰 시키기 위해 x만 반전시켜준다.
	diff = vector(-diff.x, diff.y, diff.z)

	local goal_pos = self.get_puzzle_npc_center_pos() - diff
	knight_mirror.Position = goal_pos

	-- 거울속 기사에게 이펙트 생성
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_teleport_01')
	self.get_reset_fx():Instantiate(knight_mirror.Position)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(knight_mirror, 1, 1)
	-- 히트 박스를 설정해야 ExecuteMove가 제대로 된다.
	knight_mirror.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(0.45, 0.5, 0.45))
	wait_for_sec(1)
end

return {
	create = function()
		return puzzle_event
	end
}

		while self.typing_text.Progress < 1 do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		sfx:Stop()

	end)

	yield_return_func(self.typing_text.SetTypedText, self.typing_text, param)
end

function local_class:set_npc_by_data(npcs_data)

		local npc = get_character(npc_name)

		if npc ~= nil then
			character_util.set_active_state(npc, 'enabled')
			character_util.set_position(npc, data.pos)
			character_util.set_direction(npc, data.dir)
			scene_util.set_anim_loop(npc, data.anim)
			scene_util.set_emotion_loop(npc, data.emo)
		end
	end
end

	stage.BattleManager:AddToNoAssassination(fo)
end

function local_class:remove_from_no_assassinate(fo)
	stage.BattleManager:RemoveFromNoAssassination(fo)
end

function local_class:convert_assassinate(fo)
	character_util.convert_to_monster(fo)
	fo.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.MonsterAssassinateDamagedBehaviour.Create()
	fo.DamagedBehaviour.DeathCount = 1
	fo.DamagedBehaviour.ShowDamageNumber = false
	fo.DamagedBehaviour.ApplyOtherDamage = false
	fo.FieldObjectController.DontFight = true
	fo.DamagedBehaviour.DeathType = CS.Oak.DeathType.Prostrate
end

function local_class:convert_npc(fo)
	character_util.convert_to_npc(fo)
	fo.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.NPCCharacterDamagedBehaviour.Create();
end

--뒤통수 90도만 암살 가능
function local_class:able_to_assassinate(fo)
	local dir = vector_util.to_direction(fo.Position - user_party.Leader.Position)
	if dir == fo.Direction then
		self:remove_from_no_assassinate(fo)
	else
		self:add_to_assassinate(fo)
	end
end

function local_class:release_holdup(character)
	local breakable_obj = nil
	if lua_helper.type_compare(character.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentActionState, CS.Oak.CharacterHoldUpState) then
		breakable_obj = character.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentActionState.HoldTarget
		if breakable_obj ~= nil then
			character_util.release_hold_object(character, breakable_obj)
			message_system:Send(breakable_obj, CS.Oak.GimmickResetEvent.Instance)
		end
	end
end

--npc 부활
function local_class:revive_npc()
	for idx = #self.dead_invader_list, 1, -1 do
		local fo = self.dead_invader_list[idx]
		if fo ~= nil then
			local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
			heal_info.type = CS.Oak.HealType.Normal
			heal_info.heal = fo.CharacterStatsBehaviour.MaxHP
			heal_info.isRevive = true
			heal_info.sender = fo
			heal_info.target = fo
			heal_info.skipEffect = true

			command_util.execute_heal(heal_info)

			table.remove(self.dead_invader_list, idx)
		end
	end
end

--우주에 던져 버리는 연출
function local_class:falling_routine(character, fade_type, call_back)
	local start_pos = self.get_falling_pos(1)
	local end_pos = self.get_falling_pos(2)

	character_util.set_direction(character, 'right')
	character_util.set_direction(character, 'right')
	character_util.set_anim(character, { name = 'idle', loop = false })
	character_util.set_position(character, start_pos)

	camera_util.move_async(start_pos + vector(8.5, 0, 0), 0)

	if fade_type == 'none' then
		screen_util.fade_in_async(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	elseif fade_type == 'circular' then
		screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0, 'linear')
	end

	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(function()
			character_util.spine_rotate(character, 450, 6)
			character_util.move_to_async(character, end_pos, 6)
		end),
		util.cs_generator(function()
			wait_for_sec(3)
			call_back()
		end)
	})

	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	character_util.remove_anim(character)
	character_util.spine_rotate(character, 0, 0)
	camera_util.return_to_leader(0)
end

function local_class:set_amb_ship_loop_sound()
	if self.amb_ship_loop_sound == nil then
		self.amb_ship_loop_sound = music_player_util.play_sfx(
				{ sfx_name = '01_amb_ship_02', loop = true, fade_in_time = 1, type_priority = 'loop', player_priority = 'default' })
	end
end

function local_class:release_amb_ship_loop_sound()
	if self.amb_ship_loop_sound ~= nil then
		self.amb_ship_loop_sound:Stop()
	end
	self.amb_ship_loop_sound = nil

	self.get_intro_enter_zone = 'sub_among_intro_enter_zone'
	self.get_change_enter_zone = 'sub_among_change_enter_zone'

	--door name
	self.door_1_name = 'among_door_1'
	self.door_2_name = 'among_door_2'

	--marker
	self.get_intro_invader_pos = function(number)
		return field:GetMarker('among_invader_pos_' .. number).position
	end
	self.get_intro_hazmat_pos = function(number)
		return field:GetMarker('among_hazmat_pos_' .. number).position
	end

	-- npc
	self.get_intro_invader = function(number)
		return get_character('among_invader_' .. number)
	end
	self.get_intro_hazmat = function(number)
		return get_character('among_hazmat_' .. number)
	end
	--fx
	self.fx_dead = function()
		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_dead')
	end

	--field object
	self.get_wall_hazmat = function()
		return get_field_object('among_wall_hazmat')
	end
	self.get_tesla = function()
		return get_field_object('among_tesla')
	end

	--item
	self.hazmat_suit = nil
	self.hazmat_suit_number = 20780

	--연출용 변수
	self.door_open = false

end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	quest_util.load_pool_resource('FX_dead')
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TeslaCoilOnOffEvent), 'on_tesla_coil_on_off_event')

	self:pre_setting()
	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create(self.door_2_name))
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TeslaCoilOnOffEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_wall_hazmat(1)) and
			self.current_state == self.section_state.interact then
		self.current_state = self.section_state.done
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.intro_interact_event, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.get_intro_enter_zone) and
			self.current_state == self.section_state.none then
		self.current_state = self.section_state.enter
		start_coroutine(self.intro_enter_zone_routine, self)
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.get_change_enter_zone) and
			self.current_state == self.section_state.enter then
		self.current_state = self.section_state.interact
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(self.change_enter_zone_routine, self)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_tesla_coil_on_off_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.CoilObject, self.get_tesla()) and not self.door_open then
		self.door_open = true
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create(self.door_1_name, false))
	end
end

--endregion

--존 진입 시 서브 이벤트 실행
function local_class:intro_enter_zone_routine()
	local yellow = self.get_intro_invader(1)
	local green = self.get_intro_invader(2)

	--인베이더1 (right, idle, cast) : 오늘이 드디어 그날이구나…!
	character_util.play_speech_action(yellow, { name = 'cast' }, nil, { key = 'qs_among_pre_1', skip = false })

	--인베이더1 (right, idle, cast2) : 볼트님께서 만들라고 지시하신 물건이 완성되는 날!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
	character_util.play_speech_action(yellow, { name = 'cast2' }, nil, { key = 'qs_among_pre_2', skip = false })

	--인베이더2 (left, idle, release) : 곧 회의 시간이니까, 빨리 연구소로 가자고!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	character_util.play_speech_action(green, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' }, nil, { key = 'qs_among_pre_3', skip = false })

	--대화를 마친 인베이더1,2 NPC가 루트를 따라 위쪽으로 이동.
	character_util.remove_anim(yellow)
	character_util.remove_anim(green)
	wp_util.move(yellow, yellow.Position + vector(0, 0, 7), 4, nil, { last_direction = 'right' })
	wp_util.move_async(green, green.Position + vector(0, 0, 7), 4, nil, { last_direction = 'left' })

	character_util.set_position(yellow, self.get_intro_hazmat_pos(1))
	character_util.set_position(green, self.get_intro_hazmat_pos(2))
	character_util.set_anim(yellow, { name = 'eat' })
	character_util.set_anim(green, { name = 'eat' })
end

function local_class:change_enter_zone_routine()
	local yellow = self.get_intro_invader(1)
	local green = self.get_intro_invader(2)
	local hazmat_yellow = self.get_intro_hazmat(1)
	local hazmat_green = self.get_intro_hazmat(2)

	local eat_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true})

	camera_util.move_async(self.get_intro_hazmat_pos(2) + vector(0.5, 0, -1.5), 1)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	eat_sfx:Stop()

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_explosion_01' })
	self.fx_dead():Instantiate(self.get_intro_hazmat_pos(1))
	self.fx_dead():Instantiate(self.get_intro_hazmat_pos(2))

	character_util.set_position(yellow, vector(999, 0, 999))
	character_util.set_position(green, vector(999, 0, 999))
	character_util.set_position(hazmat_yellow, self.get_intro_hazmat_pos(1))
	character_util.set_position(hazmat_green, self.get_intro_hazmat_pos(2))

	wait_for_sec(1)

	--인베이더1 (right, idle, idle) : 근데 우리가 제일 늦게 가는 건 아니겠지?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(hazmat_yellow, { key = 'qs_among_pre_4', skip = true })

	--인베이더2 (left, idle, bomb_idle) : 걱정 마. 안 봐도 화이트 그놈이 제일 늦을 거라고.
	character_util.play_speech_action(hazmat_green, { name = 'bomb_idle' }, nil, { key = 'qs_among_pre_5', skip = true })

	--인베이더2 (right, idle, release) : 저기 끝에 있는 캐비닛에 아직 방호복도 들어있던데?
	character_util.set_direction(hazmat_green, 'right')
	character_util.play_speech_action(hazmat_green, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' }, nil, { key = 'qs_among_pre_6', skip = true })

	--인베이더2 left 방향 전환.
	character_util.set_direction(hazmat_green, 'left')
	--인베이더1 (right, idle, cross_arm) : 하긴! 화이트 걘 워낙에 둔하니까!
	character_util.play_speech_action(hazmat_yellow, { name = 'cross_arm' }, nil, { key = 'qs_among_pre_7', skip = true })

	wp_util.move(hazmat_yellow, {
		self.get_intro_hazmat_pos(1) + vector(0, 0, -1.5),
		self.get_intro_hazmat_pos(1) + vector(-10, 0, -1.5)
	}, 4)
	wp_util.move_async(hazmat_green, {
		self.get_intro_hazmat_pos(2) + vector(0, 0, -1.5),
		self.get_intro_hazmat_pos(2) + vector(-10, 0, -1.5)
	}, 4)

	character_util.set_position(hazmat_yellow, vector(999, 0, 999))
	character_util.set_position(hazmat_green, vector(999, 0, 999))

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create(self.door_2_name))

	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

	quest_icon_util.set_substage_icon(self.get_wall_hazmat())
end

--인터렉트 시 스크린 플레이 후 서브 스테이지 해금
function local_class:intro_interact_event()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local hazmat = self.get_wall_hazmat()

	party_util.align_party(self.get_wall_hazmat(), 'down', 1, 'linear')

	quest_icon_util.remove(hazmat)
	hazmat.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

	local eat_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true})

	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'left')
	character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'eat' })

	wait_for_sec(2)

	eat_sfx:Stop()

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_air_spin_02')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_popup_01')

	self.hazmat_suit = drop_item_util.create_item({
		itemid = self.hazmat_suit_number,
		pos = self.get_wall_hazmat().Position,
		notforinven = true,
		showoncharacter = true,
		sprscale = 0.7,
		lootstate = 'dontfindlooter'
	})

	drop_item_util.throw_item(self.hazmat_suit, leader.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0))

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_hit_npc_01')

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	self.hazmat_suit.ConsumeTarget = leader
	self.hazmat_suit:Fly()

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.remove_anim(leader)

	--아이템 습득
	--title: 백작의 손톱
	--subtitle: 사악한 힘의 상징
	--desc: 이제 사악한 기운이 서린 물체를 파괴할 수 있을 것 같습니다!
	screen_util.item_get_event(
			'qs_invader_hazmat_suit',
			'qs_among_hazmat_title',
			'qs_among_hazmat_sub',
			'qs_among_hazmat_desc'
	)

	--인베이더 방호복을 획득했다. 또한 연구실로 가는 통로를 알아냈다.
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'qs_among_pre_8' })

	--서브 스테이지 오픈.
	stage_util.new_stage_theatre_show({
		substage_name = self.controller.unlock_stage_name,
		substage_open_string_key = 'qs_among_pre_9'
	})

	yield_return_func(quest_util.activate_quest, self.controller)
end

function local_class:pre_setting()

	local invader_count = 2
	for i = 1, invader_count do
		character_util.set_position(self.get_intro_invader(i), self.get_intro_invader_pos(i))
	end
end

return local_class

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), 'on_damage_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_zone_leave_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_custom_stage_event')

	self:pre_setting()

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	self:init_mall_box_list()

	self.controller:set_amb_ship_loop_sound()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))

	self:patrol_refresh(false)
	self.caution_patrol = false
	self.box_control = false

	self.red_eat_sfx = self.release_sfx(self.red_eat_sfx)
	self.yellow_eat_sfx = self.release_sfx(self.yellow_eat_sfx)
	self.violet_eat_sfx = self.release_sfx(self.violet_eat_sfx)

	--attack range 제거
	if not is_unity_null(self.f_escape_range) then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.f_escape_range)
	end
	self.f_escape_range = nil

	if not is_unity_null(self.g_escape_range) then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.g_escape_range)
	end
	self.g_escape_range = nil


	--item 제거
	if self.box_item_list ~= nil then
		for i = 1, #self.box_item_list do
			drop_item_util.dispose_item(self.box_item_list[i])
			self.box_item_list[i] = nil
		end
		self.box_item_list = nil
	end

	if self.yellow_potion ~= nil then
		drop_item_util.dispose_item(self.yellow_potion)
		self.yellow_potion = nil
	end

	if self.blue_potion ~= nil then
		drop_item_util.dispose_item(self.blue_potion)
		self.blue_potion = nil
	end

	if self.red_potion ~= nil then
		drop_item_util.dispose_item(self.red_potion)
		self.red_potion = nil
	end

	if self.black_potion ~= nil then
		drop_item_util.dispose_item(self.black_potion)
		self.black_potion = nil
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false

function local_class:on_stage_end_event(e)

end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.get_indigo_dead_zone_name) then
		self.indigo_dead_zone = true
		return true
	end

	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.get_violet_dead_zone_name) then
		self.violet_dead_zone = true
		return true
	end

	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.get_left_room_zone_name) and self.lock_on then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.back_meet_room, self, 'left')
		return true
	end

	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.get_right_room_zone_name) and self.lock_on then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.back_meet_room, self, 'right')
		return true
	end

	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.get_down_room_zone_name) and self.lock_on then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.back_meet_room, self, 'down')
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, user_party.Leader, self.get_indigo_dead_zone_name) then
		self.indigo_dead_zone = false
		return true
	end

	if type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, user_party.Leader, self.get_violet_dead_zone_name) then
		self.violet_dead_zone = false
		return true

	end
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if e.Params[0] == 'among_patrol' then
		if e.Sender == self.get_among_invader(6) then
			start_coroutine(self.caution_patrol_routine, self, e.Sender)
		end
		if e.Sender == self.get_among_invader(7) then
			start_coroutine(self.caution_patrol_routine, self, e.Sender)
		end
	end
	return true
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_meet_room_lever(1)) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.lever_push_routine, self, 1, 'up')
		return true
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_meet_room_lever(2)) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.lever_push_routine, self, 2, 'up')
		return true
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_meet_room_lever(3)) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.lever_push_routine, self, 3, 'down')
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_damage_event(e)
	local require_damage_type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Assassinate

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.sender, user_party.Leader) and
			e.Info.type & require_damage_type == require_damage_type then

		table.insert(self.dead_invader_list, e.Info.target)
		--A,B
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, self.get_among_invader(1)) then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.assassinate_trash, self, e.Info.target, self.get_among_invader(2))
		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, self.get_among_invader(2)) then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.assassinate_trash, self, e.Info.target, self.get_among_invader(1))
			--C,D,E
		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, self.get_among_invader(3)) then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.assassinate_express, self, e.Info.target, self.get_among_invader(4), self.get_among_invader(5), self.yellow_box)
		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, self.get_among_invader(4)) then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.assassinate_express, self, e.Info.target, self.get_among_invader(3), self.get_among_invader(5), self.green_box)
		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, self.get_among_invader(5)) then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.assassinate_express, self, e.Info.target, self.get_among_invader(3), self.get_among_invader(4), self.blue_box)
			--G,
		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, self.get_among_invader(6)) then
			start_coroutine(self.assassinate_clear, self, e.Info.target, self.get_among_invader(7))
			--F
		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, self.get_among_invader(7)) then
			start_coroutine(self.assassinate_clear, self, e.Info.target, self.get_among_invader(6))
		end

	end
end

function local_class:back_meet_room(dir)
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local invader_1 = nil
	local invader_2 = nil
	local invader_distance = vector(0, 0, 0)
	local back_distance = vector(0, 0, 0)

	local invader_1_bubble_key = 'qs_among_s2_1'
	local invader_2_bubble_key = 'qs_among_s2_2'
	local voice_key_1 = ''
	local voice_key_2 = ''

	if dir == 'left' then
		invader_1 = self.get_among_invader(1)
		invader_2 = self.get_among_invader(2)
		invader_distance = vector(5, 0, 0)
		back_distance = vector(2, 0, 0)
		voice_key_1 = invader_1_bubble_key
		voice_key_2 = invader_2_bubble_key
	elseif dir == 'right' then
		invader_1 = self.get_among_invader(6)
		invader_2 = self.get_among_invader(7)
		invader_distance = vector(-5, 0, 0)
		back_distance = vector(-2, 0, 0)
		voice_key_1 = invader_1_bubble_key .. '_navy'
		voice_key_2 = invader_2_bubble_key .. '_purple'
	elseif dir == 'down' then
		invader_1 = self.get_among_invader(4)
		invader_2 = self.get_among_invader(5)
		invader_distance = vector(0, 0, 2)
		back_distance = vector(0, 0, 2)
		voice_key_1 = invader_1_bubble_key .. '_green'
		voice_key_2 = invader_2_bubble_key .. '_blue'
	end

	character_util.remove_anim(invader_1)
	character_util.remove_anim(invader_2)

	wp_util.move(invader_1, invader_1.Position + invader_distance, 4)
	wp_util.move_async(invader_2, invader_2.Position + invader_distance, 4)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	--(right, idle, release) : 화이트! 왜 아직도 전원에 불이 안 들어온 거야!
	character_util.play_speech_action(invader_1, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' }, nil,
			{ key = invader_1_bubble_key, override_key = voice_key_1, skip = true })

	--(right, idle, release) : 빨리 가서 레버 당겨!
	character_util.play_speech_action(invader_2, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' }, nil,
			{ key = invader_2_bubble_key, override_key = voice_key_2, skip = true })

	wp_util.move(invader_1, invader_1.Position - invader_distance, 4)
	wp_util.move_async(invader_2, invader_2.Position - invader_distance, 4)

	wp_util.move_async(leader, leader.Position + back_distance, 4)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)
end

function local_class:lever_push_routine(number, dir)
	local fo = self.get_meet_room_lever(number)
	local leader = user_party.Leader

	quest_marker_util.remove('s2_lever_' .. number)
	fo.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

	local align_pos = vector(0, 0, 0)

	if dir == 'up' then
		align_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Bounds.center + vector(0, 0, -0.1))
	elseif dir == 'down' then
		align_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Bounds.center + vector(0, 0, 0.1))
	end

	party_util.align_party(align_pos, dir, 0.5)

	character_util.set_animation_n_times(leader, { name = 'attack' })
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gear_02')
	local animator = fo:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))

	animator:Play('push')

	wait_for_sec(0.2)
	character_util.remove_emotion(leader)
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_mayreel_charge_01')
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.PowerSourceTurnOnEvent.Create('meet_room_power_source_' .. number))

	self.lever_count = self.lever_count + 1
	if self.lever_count == 3 then
		start_coroutine(self.first_assassinate_routine, self)
		self.lock_on = false
	end
end

--발각 루틴
function local_class:caution_patrol_routine(invader)
	local leader = user_party.Leader

	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	self.caution_pause = true

	character_util.remove_anim(invader)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_notice_01')
	character_util.look_at(invader, leader)
	character_util.look_at(leader, invader)
	character_util.normal_jump(invader, true)
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(invader, nil, 'notice')

	character_util.stop(invader)

	local navy_key = ''

	--(up, idle, release) : 이봐, 화이트! 방금 위쪽에 무슨 소리 안 들렸어?
	if invader == self.get_among_invader(6) then
		navy_key = '_navy'
		character_util.play_speech_action(invader, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' }, nil, 'qs_among_s2_21')
	elseif invader == self.get_among_invader(7) then
		character_util.play_speech_action(invader, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' }, nil, 'qs_among_s2_20')
	end

	--(up, idle, idle) : 뭔가 퍽! 하고 큰소리가 난 것 같은데…
	character_util.play_speech_action(invader, { name = 'idle' }, nil,
			{ key = 'qs_among_s2_22', override_key = 'qs_among_s2_22' .. navy_key, skip = true })

	--(up, idle, release) : 무슨 일이 생긴 걸지도 몰라. 같이 가보자!
	character_util.play_speech_action(invader, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' }, nil,
			{ key = 'qs_among_s2_23', override_key = 'qs_among_s2_23' .. navy_key, skip = true })

	scene_util.nod_the_head(leader, 2)

	character_util.nod_twice(leader)

	invader.Direction = vector_util.to_direction(self.guard_wp[self.wp_count] - invader.Position)
	character_util.set_anim(invader, { name = 'walk', loop = true })

	local leader_dir = vector_util.to_direction(self.guard_wp[self.wp_count] - user_party.Leader.Position)
	local temp_pos = self.wp_count - 1 ~= 0 and self.guard_wp[self.wp_count - 1] or invader.Position
	local invader_dir = vector_util.to_direction(self.guard_wp[self.wp_count] - temp_pos)

	local count = self.wp_count
	if leader_dir ~= invader_dir then
		if count < self.wp_count then
			count = count + 1
		end
	end

	local wp = table_util.duplicate(self.guard_wp)

	if self.last_dir == 'down' then
		wp[4] = wp[4] + vector(0, 0, -1)
	elseif self.last_dir == 'right' then
		wp[4] = wp[4] + vector(1, 0, 0)
	end

	self.screen_on = true
	self.caution_pause = false

	quest_util.set_custom_state(self.quest_progress, 'invader_patrol', 1)

	self:hazmat_move_routine(leader, wp, 3, self.last_dir, count)
end

--암살 실패 A,B
function local_class:assassinate_trash(dead_invader, other_invader)
	local leader = user_party.Leader

	local bubble_key = 'qs_among_s2_3'
	local voice_key = ''

	--생존 인베이더가 레드 일 경우
	if other_invader == self.get_among_invader(1) then
		voice_key = bubble_key .. '_red'
	elseif other_invader == self.get_among_invader(2) then
		voice_key = bubble_key .. '_orange'
	end

	self.caution_patrol = false
	self:patrol_refresh(false)

	if self.visible_range ~= nil then
		self.visible_range:Hide()
		self.visible_range = nil
	end
	coroutine.yield()

	character_util.look_at(other_invader, leader)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_notice_01')
	character_util.show_emoticon(other_invader, nil, 'notice')

	character_util.set_anim(dead_invader, { name = 'dead', loop = false, sfx_name = '01_hit_tentacle_01' })
	wait_for_sec(2)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
	character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'embarrassed' })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_siren_oneshot_01')
	character_util.set_anim(other_invader, { name = 'release', loop = true, sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(other_invader,
			{ key = bubble_key, override_key = voice_key, skip = true })

	self:reset_assassinate()
end

--암살 실패 C,D,E

	local bubble_key = 'qs_among_s2_3'
	local voice_1_key = ''

	character_util.show_emoticon(other_invader_1, nil, 'notice')

			{ key = bubble_key, override_key = voice_2_key, skip = true })

--암살 성공 F,G
function local_class:assassinate_clear(dead_invader, other_invader)
	--region 암살 성공 시 루틴용 초기화
	local indigo_pos = self.get_indigo_start_pos()
	local violet_pos = self.get_violet_start_pos()
	local guard_pos = indigo_pos
	self.wp_count = 1

	self.guard_wp = {
		indigo_pos + vector(0, 0, 8),
		indigo_pos + vector(8, 0, 8),
		indigo_pos + vector(8, 0, 14),
		violet_pos
	}
	self.visible_range = self.g_escape_range
	self.last_dir = 'right'

	if dead_invader == self.get_among_invader(6) then
		guard_pos = violet_pos
		self.guard_wp = {
			violet_pos + vector(-2, 0, 0),
			violet_pos + vector(-2, 0, -6),
			violet_pos + vector(-10, 0, -6),
			indigo_pos
		}
		self.last_dir = 'down'
		self.visible_range = self.f_escape_range
	end

	self.patrol_on[6] = false
	self.patrol_on[7] = false
	self.caution_patrol = true
	--endregion

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	character_util.set_anim(dead_invader, { name = 'dead', loop = false, sfx_name = '01_hit_tentacle_01' })

	character_util.set_position(other_invader, guard_pos)

	other_invader.FieldObjectController = CS.Oak.WayPointGuardCharacterController.Create(other_invader, 'among_patrol', 3, 360)

	self:add_to_assassinate(other_invader)
	self.visible_range:Show(0)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_event_qs_05')

	--async
	self:hazmat_move_routine(other_invader, self.guard_wp, 3, self.last_dir, 1)

	if self.caution_patrol then
		local camera_pos = nil
		if self.last_dir == 'down' then
			camera_pos = self.guard_wp[4] + vector(0, 0, -2)
		elseif self.last_dir == 'right' then
			camera_pos = self.guard_wp[4] + vector(2, 0, 0)
		end

		if not self.screen_on then
			field_ui_manager:Hide()
			party_util.stop_and_disable_control()
		end

		camera_util.move_async(camera_pos, 1)

		if self.screen_on then
			self:clear(other_invader)
		else
			if other_invader == self.get_among_invader(6) and self.violet_dead_zone then
				self:fail(other_invader)
			elseif other_invader == self.get_among_invader(7) and self.indigo_dead_zone then
				self:fail(other_invader)
			else
				self:clear(other_invader)
			end
		end
	end

end

	party_util.reset_controllers()

function local_class:clear(invader)
	character_util.stop(invader)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
	character_util.set_anim(invader, { name = 'embarrassed' })
	if invader == self.get_among_invader(6) then
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(invader, { key = 'qs_among_s2_19', skip = true })
	elseif invader == self.get_among_invader(7) then
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(invader, { key = 'qs_among_s2_14', skip = true })
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_in_teleport_01')

	self.controller:fade_out_amb_ship_loop_sound()

	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(1, 'linear')

	--클리어 후 초기화
	self:release_holdup(get_party_leader())
	self.visible_range:Hide()
	self.visible_range = nil
	self.box_control = false

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0)

	if invader == self.get_among_invader(6) then
		self.get_among_invader(7).Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
		quest_util.set_custom_state(self.quest_progress, 'alive_invader', 1)
	elseif invader == self.get_among_invader(7) then
		self.get_among_invader(6).Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
		quest_util.set_custom_state(self.quest_progress, 'alive_invader', 2)
	end

	self:patrol_refresh(false)
	coroutine.yield()

	local invader_count = 7
	for i = 1, invader_count do
		self:add_to_assassinate(self.get_among_invader(i))
		character_util.remove_anim(self.get_among_invader(i), true)
		speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(self.get_among_invader(i))
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	self:clear_box_all()

	yield_return_func(quest_util.progress_section, self.controller)
end

function local_class:reset_assassinate()
	local leader = user_party.Leader
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_01')
	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(1, 'linear')

	self:release_holdup(leader)
	camera_util.return_to_leader(0)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'down')
	character_util.set_position(leader, self.get_meet_room_start_pos())

	self:revive_npc()

	local invader_count = 7
	for i = 1, invader_count do
		character_util.remove_anim(self.get_among_invader(i), true)
	end

	--암살 재시작
	start_coroutine(self.first_assassinate_routine, self)

	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(1, 'linear')
	self:clear_box_all()
end

--웨이포인트 가드 일회용 무브 루틴
function local_class:hazmat_move_routine(fo, waypoint, speed, last_dir, start_waypoint)
	local waypoint_count = start_waypoint

	fo.Direction = vector_util.to_direction(waypoint[waypoint_count] - fo.Position)
	character_util.set_anim(fo, { name = 'walk' })

	while self.caution_patrol do
		if not self.caution_pause then
			local magnitude = unity_class.time.deltaTime * speed
			local diff = waypoint[waypoint_count] - fo.Position
			local dir = vector_util.normalized(diff)
			local diffMagnitude = diff.magnitude

			if magnitude < diffMagnitude then
				fo.Position = fo.Position + (dir * magnitude)
			else
				fo.Position = waypoint[waypoint_count]
				waypoint_count = waypoint_count + 1
				self.wp_count = waypoint_count

				if waypoint_count > #waypoint then
					character_util.set_direction(fo, last_dir)
					break
				end

				fo.Direction = vector_util.to_direction(waypoint[waypoint_count] - fo.Position)
			end

		end
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	character_util.remove_anim(fo)
end

function local_class:first_assassinate_routine()
	--region 암살 루틴 진행 전 초기화
	self:set_npc_by_data(self.among_s2_patrol_invader_data)

	start_coroutine(self.red_patrol_routine, self)
	start_coroutine(self.orange_patrol_routine, self)

	start_coroutine(self.green_patrol_routine, self)
	start_coroutine(self.blue_patrol_routine, self)
	start_coroutine(self.indigo_patrol_routine, self)
	start_coroutine(self.violet_patrol_routine, self)
end

	--region 패트롤 루프 관련 캐싱
	local invader_red = self.get_among_invader(1)
	local invader_orange = self.get_among_invader(2)

	local speed = 3

	local red_up_wp = {
		trash_get_pos_red + vector(2, 0, 0),
		trash_get_pos_red + vector(2, 0, -1),
		trash_get_pos_red + vector(7.5, 0, -1),
		trash_throw_pos_red + vector(3.5, 0, -1),
		trash_throw_pos_red + vector(0, 0, -1),
		trash_throw_pos_red
	}

	local red_down_wp = {
		trash_throw_pos_red + vector(3.5, 0, 0),
		trash_get_pos_red + vector(7.5, 0, -1),
		trash_get_pos_red + vector(-2, 0, -1),
		trash_get_pos_red + vector(-2, 0, 0),
		trash_get_pos_red
	}

	local time_passed = 0

	local invader_state = {
		down_wp = 1,
		talk = 2,
		talk_end = 3,
		up_wp = 4,
		eat = 5,
		eat_end = 6,
		dir = 7,
		dir_end = 8
	}

	local current_state = invader_state.talk

	local move_done_generator = function(wp_count)
		return function(wp_index)
			if wp_index == wp_count - 1 then
				current_state = current_state + 1
				time_passed = 0
			end
		end
	end

	self.red_wait = false

	local talk_func = function()
		if self.patrol_on[1] then
			character_util.set_anim(invader_red, { name = 'cross_arm' })
			self.set_patrol_sfx('01_rustle_01', false, invader_red)
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(invader_red, { key = 'qs_among_s2_4', skip = false, dialogue = false })
		end

		if self.patrol_on[1] then
			character_util.remove_anim(invader_red)
		end

		if self.patrol_on[2] then
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(invader_orange, { key = 'qs_among_s2_5', skip = false, dialogue = false })
		end

		self.orange_wait = false
		self.red_wait = false
	end

	local dir_func = function()
		self.set_patrol_sfx('01_rustle_01', false, invader_red)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(invader_red, { key = 'qs_among_s2_6', skip = false, dialogue = false })
		self.orange_wait = false
		self.red_wait = false
	end

	--endregion

	while self.patrol_on[1] do
		if current_state == invader_state.talk then
			self.red_wait = true
			if self.orange_wait then
				start_coroutine(talk_func, self)
				current_state = invader_state.talk_end
			end
		elseif current_state == invader_state.talk_end then
			if not self.red_wait then
				character_util.remove_anim(invader_red)
				current_state = invader_state.up_wp
				wp_util.move(invader_red, red_up_wp, speed, nil,
						{ last_direction = 'left', callback = move_done_generator(#red_up_wp) })
			end
		elseif current_state == invader_state.eat then
			self.red_wait = true
			if self.orange_wait then
				time_passed = 0
				current_state = invader_state.eat_end
				character_util.set_anim(invader_red, { name = 'eat', loop = true })
				if self.red_eat_sfx == nil then
					self.red_eat_sfx = self.set_patrol_sfx('01_typing_01', true, invader_red)
				end
			end
		elseif current_state == invader_state.eat_end then
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			if time_passed > 4 then
				self.red_wait = false
				character_util.remove_anim(invader_red)
				current_state = invader_state.dir
				time_passed = 0
				self.red_eat_sfx = self.release_sfx(self.red_eat_sfx)
			end
		elseif current_state == invader_state.dir then
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			if time_passed > 0.5 then
				self.red_wait = true
				if self.orange_wait then
					current_state = invader_state.dir_end
					character_util.set_direction(invader_red, 'down')
					start_coroutine(dir_func, self)
				end
			end
		elseif current_state == invader_state.dir_end then
			if not self.red_wait then
				character_util.remove_anim(invader_red)
				current_state = invader_state.down_wp
				wp_util.move(invader_red, red_down_wp, speed, nil,
						{ last_direction = 'left', callback = move_done_generator(#red_down_wp) })
			end
		end

		self:able_to_assassinate(invader_red)
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	self.red_eat_sfx = self.release_sfx(self.red_eat_sfx)
	character_util.stop(invader_red)
	character_util.remove_anim(invader_red)
	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(invader_red)
end

		table.insert(self.is_box_used_list, false)

function local_class:get_box_from_pool()
	local mall_box = nil

	for i = 1, #self.box_item_list do
		if not self.is_box_used_list[i] then
			self.is_box_used_list[i] = true
			mall_box = self.box_item_list[i]
			mall_box.SpriteTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one

		end
	end

	return mall_box
end

function local_class:release_box(mall_box)

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(mall_box, self.box_item_list[i]) then
			self.is_box_used_list[i] = false
			mall_box.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
			break
		end
	end
end

function local_class:clear_box_all()

		self.box_item_list[i].Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
		self.is_box_used_list[i] = false
	end
end

function local_class:box_throw_full_routine(mall_box)
	--invader to belt
	local start_position = vector_util.get_x0z(mall_box.Position, 1.1)
	local end_position = vector_util.get_xy0(start_position, -67.5)
	self:mall_box_move_routine(mall_box, { end_position }, 2.5)

	--belt to hale
	start_position = vector_util.get_x0z(mall_box.Position, 1.1)
	end_position = vector_util.get_0yz(start_position, -22)
	self:mall_box_move_routine(mall_box, { end_position }, 2)

	--free fall

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_gatcha_box_02', loop = false, play_pos = mall_box.Position,
								 type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
	self:free_fall_box(mall_box)
end

function local_class:mall_box_move_routine(fo, waypoint, speed)
	local waypoint_count = 1

	while waypoint_count <= #waypoint and self.box_control do
		local magnitude = unity_class.time.deltaTime * speed
		local diff = waypoint[waypoint_count] - fo.Position
		local dir = vector_util.normalized(diff)
		local diffMagnitude = diff.magnitude

		if magnitude < diffMagnitude then
			fo.Position = fo.Position + (dir * magnitude)
		else
			fo.Position = waypoint[waypoint_count]
			waypoint_count = waypoint_count + 1
		end

		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

function local_class:free_fall_box(mall_box)
	-- 떨어지는 연출
	local free_fall = CS.CalculatorFreeFall(0, 2, 1, 0)
	local start_position = mall_box.Position
	local end_position = mall_box.Position + vector(-0.5, -0.8, 0)

	local time_passed = 0
	local duration = CS.CalculatorFreeFall.CalculateDurationIncludingBounces(0, 2, 1, 0)

	while time_passed < duration and not free_fall:IsDone() and self.box_control do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		free_fall:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)

		local progress = time_passed / duration
		mall_box.Position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_position, end_position, progress)
		mall_box.SpriteTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * CS.UnityEngine.Mathf.Clamp01(1.1 - progress)
		mall_box.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * CS.UnityEngine.Mathf.Clamp01(1.1 - progress)
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	mall_box.SpriteTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0.1
	mall_box.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(mall_box.Position, 0)

	self:release_box(mall_box)
end

--endregion

function local_class:patrol_refresh(state)
	for i = 1, #self.patrol_on do
		self.patrol_on[i] = state
	end
end

return local_class

function local_class:on_pre_load()

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), 'on_damage_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_zone_leave_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_custom_stage_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TeslaCoilOnOffEvent), 'on_tesla_coil_on_off_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.SwitchOnOffEvent), 'on_switch_on_off_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ResetSwitchTurnedOnEvent), 'on_reset_switch_turned_on_event')

	local inner_color = CS.UnityEngine.Color32(223, 28, 28, 51)
	local outer_color = CS.UnityEngine.Color32(255, 45, 45, 153)

	local range_pos = vector(-13.5, 0.1, -44.5)
	local range_size = unity_class.vector2(8, 6)

	self.green_escape_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateRect(range_pos, range_size, inner_color, outer_color)
	self.green_escape_range:Hide()

	self:pre_setting()

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.start_routine, self)
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TeslaCoilOnOffEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.SwitchOnOffEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ResetSwitchTurnedOnEvent))

	self:patrol_refresh(false)
	self.control_tesla_on = false
	self.hazmat_move = false
	self.patrol_pause = false

	if self.timer_bar ~= nil then
		field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(fo, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TimerBar)
		self.timer_bar = nil

	end

	if not is_unity_null(self.green_escape_range) then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.green_escape_range)
	end
	self.green_escape_range = nil

	self.red_eat_sfx = self.release_sfx(self.red_eat_sfx)
	self.orange_eat_sfx = self.release_sfx(self.orange_eat_sfx)
	self.green_sleep_sfx = self.release_sfx(self.green_sleep_sfx)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if e.Params[0] == 'among_patrol' then
		if e.Sender == self.get_among_invader(5) and self.current_state == self.section_state.assassinate then
			start_coroutine(self.caution_patrol_routine, self)
		end
	elseif e.Params[0] == 'red_patrol' then
		if e.Sender == self.get_among_invader(1) and self.current_state == self.section_state.press_switch then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.red_attack_routine, self)
		end
	elseif e.Params[0] == 'orange_patrol' or e.Params[0] == 'yellow_patrol' then
		if not self.is_playing then
			self.is_playing = true
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.fusion_detection_routine, self)
		end
	elseif e.Params[0] == 'green_patrol' then
		self.patrol_on[4] = false
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.control_detection_routine, self, e.Sender)
	elseif e.Params[0] == 'blue_patrol' then
		self.patrol_on[5] = false
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.control_detection_routine, self, e.Sender)
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:on_damage_event(e)
	local require_damage_type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Assassinate

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.sender, user_party.Leader) and
			e.Info.type & require_damage_type == require_damage_type then

		table.insert(self.dead_invader_list, e.Info.target)

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, self.get_among_invader(4)) then
			start_coroutine(self.assassinate_green, self)
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.get_elect_zone_name) and
			self.current_state == self.section_state.none then
		self.current_state = self.section_state.elect_room
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.elect_room_routine, self)
		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.get_elect_zone_name) and
			self.current_state == self.section_state.press_switch and not self.tesla_on then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.elect_back_routine, self)
		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.fusion_zone_name) and self.first_contact then
		self.first_contact = false
		start_coroutine(self.fusion_contact, self)
		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.get_green_dead_zone_name) then
		self.green_dead_zone = true
		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.get_screen_zone_name) then
		self.is_screen = false
		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.get_s4_left_name) and
			self.current_state == self.section_state.none then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.back_routine, self, 'left')
		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.get_s4_right_name) and
			self.current_state == self.section_state.none then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.back_routine, self, 'right')
		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.get_s4_up_name) and
			self.current_state == self.section_state.none then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.back_routine, self, 'up')
		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.get_s4_down_name) and
			self.current_state == self.section_state.none then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.back_routine, self, 'down')
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, user_party.Leader, self.get_green_dead_zone_name) then
		self.green_dead_zone = false
		return true
	end
	if type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, user_party.Leader, self.get_screen_zone_name) then
		self.is_screen = true
		return true
	end
end

function local_class:on_tesla_coil_on_off_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.CoilObject, self.get_elect_tesla()) then
		self.tesla_on = e.IsTurningOn
	end
end

function local_class:on_switch_on_off_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Stepper, self.get_push_block()) and e.IsTurningOn and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.SwitchObject, self.get_elect_room_switch()) then
		quest_marker_util.remove(self.quest_marker_name)
	end

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.SwitchObject, self.get_control_switch()) then
		self.control_switch_on = e.IsTurningOn

		if e.IsTurningOn then
			self.time_passed = self.time_max

			if self.control_tesla_on then
				self.timer_bar.BarSprite:SetValue(self.time_max, 0);
			else
				self.control_tesla_on = true
				start_coroutine(self.control_tesla_timer_routine, self, self.get_control_tesla())
				message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.PowerSourceTurnOnEvent.Create('control_room_tesla'))
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_reset_switch_turned_on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.SwitchObject, self.get_reset_switch()) then
		quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.quest_marker_name, self.get_elect_room_switch(), true)
	end
end

function local_class:back_routine(dir)
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local red = self.get_among_invader(1)
	local back_distance = vector(0, 0, 0)

	if dir == 'left' then
		back_distance = vector(2, 0, 0)
	elseif dir == 'right' then
		back_distance = vector(-2, 0, 0)
	elseif dir == 'up' then
		back_distance = vector(0, 0, -2)
	elseif dir == 'down' then
		back_distance = vector(0, 0, 2)
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	--(right, idle, release) : 왜 엉뚱한 데로 가고 있어! 중앙 구역으로 가라고!
	character_util.play_speech_action(red, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' }, nil, 'qs_among_s4_13')

	wp_util.move_async(leader, leader.Position + back_distance, 4)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)
end

function local_class:start_routine()
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	character_util.hide_weapon(leader, true)

	message_system:Send(self.get_push_block(), CS.Oak.GimmickResetEvent.Instance)
	camera_util.move(self.get_center_pos(), 0)

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field' })
	screen_util.fade_in_async(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(1, 'linear')

	timeline_util.play_async(self.director_name, 'qs_among_s4_1')

	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })
	self.controller:set_amb_ship_loop_sound()

	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.quest_marker_name, self.get_elect_pos(2), true)

	self:party_follower_red(self.get_among_invader(1))

	self:second_assassinate_routine()

	character_util.hide_weapon(leader, false)
end

function local_class:second_assassinate_routine()
	self:set_npc_by_data(self.among_s4_patrol_invader_data)
	self.first_contact = true
	self:patrol_refresh(true)
	self.patrol_pause = false
	self.caution_on = false

	start_coroutine(self.orange_patrol_routine, self)
	start_coroutine(self.yellow_patrol_routine, self)
	start_coroutine(self.green_patrol_routine, self)
	start_coroutine(self.blue_patrol_routine, self)
end

--전기실 진입시 연출
function local_class:elect_room_routine()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local red = self.get_among_invader(1)

	character_util.remove_relate_event(red, self.controller)

	--퀘스트 마커 사라짐.
	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.quest_marker_name, self.get_elect_room_switch(), true)

	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(wp_util.move_async, red, self.get_elect_pos(1), 4, nil, { last_direction = 'right' }),
		util.cs_generator(wp_util.move_async, leader, self.get_elect_pos(2), 4, nil, { last_direction = 'left' }),
	})
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--레드 (right, idle, idle) : 자, 화이트. 한번 설명할 테니 잘 들어.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(red, { key = 'qs_among_s4_14', skip = true })

	--레드 (right, idle, release) : 저쪽에 기계 보이지?
	character_util.play_speech_action(red, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' }, nil, 'qs_among_s4_15')

	--가디언 right 방향 전환.
	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'right')

	wait_for_sec(1)

	--레드 (right, idle, release) : 네가 할 일은 저 기계가 작동하도록 전력을 공급하는 거야.
	character_util.play_speech_action(red, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' }, nil, 'qs_among_s4_16')

	--레드 (right, idle, idle) : 내가 기계를 조작할 동안, 넌 스위치를 밟아서 기계가 꺼지지 않게 해줘.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(red, { key = 'qs_among_s4_17', skip = true })

	--가디언 left 방향 전환.
	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'left')

	scene_util.nod_the_head(leader, 2)

	--레드 (right, idle, cross_arm) : 자, 어서 움직여!
	character_util.play_speech_action(red, { name = 'cross_arm' }, nil, 'qs_among_s4_18')

	local red_up_wp = {
		self.get_elect_pos(1) + vector(0, 0, 3),
		self.get_elect_pos(3) + vector(0, 0, 1),
		self.get_elect_pos(3)
	}

	wp_util.move_async(red, red_up_wp, 4, nil, { last_direction = 'left' })

	self.current_state = self.section_state.press_switch

	start_coroutine(self.red_routine, self)
end

--region 인베이더 패트롤
function local_class:red_routine()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local red = self.get_among_invader(1)
	local done = true
	self.patrol_on[1] = true

	character_util.stop(red)

	red.FieldObjectController = CS.Oak.WayPointGuardCharacterController.Create(red, 'red_patrol', 1.5, 360)

	while self.patrol_on[1] do
		if self.tesla_on then
			if done then
				red.FieldObjectController = CS.Oak.WayPointGuardCharacterController.Create(red, 'red_patrol', 1.5, 360)
				character_util.set_direction(red, 'left')
				character_util.set_anim(red, { name = 'eat' })
				speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(red)
				--좋아. 그렇게 계속 밟고 있으라고.
				if self.red_eat_sfx == nil then
					self.red_eat_sfx = self.set_patrol_sfx('01_clang_01', true, red)
				end
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(red, { key = 'qs_among_s4_20', skip = false })
				done = false
			end
		else
			if not done then
				self.red_eat_sfx = self.release_sfx(self.red_eat_sfx)
				character_util.set_anim(red, { name = 'idle' })
				speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(red)
				red.FieldObjectController = CS.Oak.WayPointGuardCharacterController.Create(red, 'red_patrol', 1.5, 360)
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
				--뭐해, 화이트! 기계가 꺼졌잖아! 제대로 밟고 있으라고!
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(red, { key = 'qs_among_s4_21', skip = false })

				done = true
			end
			character_util.look_at(red, leader)
		end

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	self.red_eat_sfx = self.release_sfx(self.red_eat_sfx)
	character_util.remove_anim(red)
	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(red)
end

	character_util.set_anim(orange, { name = 'eat' })

function local_class:green_patrol_routine()
	local green = self.get_among_invader(4)
	character_util.stop(green)

	local invader_state = {
		sleep = 1,
		sleep_end = 2,
		get_up = 3
	}

	local current_state = invader_state.sleep

	local get_up_func = function()
		--블루의 대사와 동시에 그린 NPC한테서도 어택 레인지(거리1.5 , 반경 360) 가 출력되며,
		self.set_patrol_sfx('01_player_popup_01', false, green)

		if self.patrol_on[4] then
			character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(green, { name = 'idle' }, { name = 'idle' })
			wait_for_sec(0.5)
		end

		if self.patrol_on[4] then
			--그린 NPC가 idle 표정 / idle 자세로 바뀐 뒤, left 방향 전환 1회, right 방향 전환 1회 행동.
			self.set_patrol_sfx('01_swing_01', false, green)
			character_util.set_direction(green, 'left')
			wait_for_sec(0.5)
		end

		if self.patrol_on[4] then
			--그린 NPC가 idle 표정 / idle 자세로 바뀐 뒤, left 방향 전환 1회, right 방향 전환 1회 행동.
			self.set_patrol_sfx('01_swing_01', false, green)
			character_util.set_direction(green, 'right')
			wait_for_sec(0.5)
		end

		if self.patrol_on[4] then
			self:hazmat_move_routine(green, { self.get_control_pos(4) + vector(0, 0, -1) }, 3, 'down', 1)
		end

		if self.patrol_on[4] then
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.SwitchOnOffEvent.Create(self.get_control_switch(), true, green))
		end

		if self.patrol_on[4] then
			--그린 (down, idle, idle) : 귀찮게시리… 잠깐만 눈 좀 붙이자고.
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(green, { key = 'qs_among_s4_32', skip = false, dialogue = false })
		end

		if self.patrol_on[4] then
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.SwitchOnOffEvent.Create(self.get_control_switch(), false, green))
			self:hazmat_move_routine(green, { self.get_control_pos(4) }, 3, 'down', 1)
			self.green_wait = false
		end
	end

	self.green_wait = false

	while self.patrol_on[4] do
		if current_state == invader_state.sleep then
			self:remove_from_no_assassinate(green)
			character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(green, { name = 'sleep' }, { name = 'sleep' })
			if self.green_sleep_sfx == nil then
				self.green_sleep_sfx = self.set_patrol_sfx('01_sleep_01', true, green)
			end
			current_state = invader_state.sleep_end
		elseif current_state == invader_state.sleep_end then
			self.green_wait = true
			if self.blue_wait then
				self:add_to_assassinate(green)
				green.FieldObjectController = CS.Oak.WayPointGuardCharacterController.Create(green, 'green_patrol', 1.5, 360)
				self.green_sleep_sfx = self.release_sfx(self.green_sleep_sfx)
				start_coroutine(get_up_func, self)
				current_state = invader_state.get_up
			end
		elseif current_state == invader_state.get_up then
			if not self.green_wait then
				character_util.stop(green)
				current_state = invader_state.sleep
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	self.green_sleep_sfx = self.release_sfx(self.green_sleep_sfx)
end

function local_class:blue_patrol_routine()
	local blue = self.get_among_invader(5)

	local invader_state = {
		eat = 1,
		eat_end = 2,
		shout = 3,
	}
	local current_state = invader_state.eat

	local shout_func = function()
		--블루 (left, idle, release) : 그린! 스위치 안 밟고 뭐해!
		self.set_patrol_sfx('03_dialogue_negative_02', false, blue)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
		character_util.play_speech_action(blue, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' }, nil,
				{ key = 'qs_among_s4_31', skip = false, dialogue = false })
		self.blue_wait = true
	end

	self.blue_wait = false

	character_util.stop(blue)
	blue.FieldObjectController = CS.Oak.WayPointGuardCharacterController.Create(blue, 'blue_patrol', 2, 360)

	while self.patrol_on[5] do
		if current_state == invader_state.eat then
			character_util.set_anim(blue, { name = 'eat' })
			current_state = invader_state.eat_end
		elseif current_state == invader_state.eat_end then
			self.blue_wait = false
			if not self.control_tesla_on then
				if self.current_state == self.section_state.assassinate then
					self.patrol_on[5] = false
					start_coroutine(self.assassinate_control, self)
				else
					start_coroutine(shout_func, self)
					current_state = invader_state.shout
				end
			end
		elseif current_state == invader_state.shout then
			if self.control_tesla_on then
				current_state = invader_state.eat
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

	self.green_escape_range:Show(0)

function local_class:assassinate_control()
	local blue = self.get_among_invader(5)

	if self.is_screen then
		party_util.stop_and_disable_control()
		field_ui_manager:Hide()
		camera_util.move_async(vector(-13.5, 0.1, -43.5), 1)
	end

	blue.FieldObjectController = CS.Oak.WayPointGuardCharacterController.Create(blue, 'among_patrol', 2, 360)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	--블루 (left, idle, idle) : 그린! 계속 그렇게 딴청 피울 거야?
	character_util.set_anim(blue, { name = 'idle' })

	if not self.caution_on then
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(blue, { key = 'qs_among_s4_35', skip = self.is_screen })
	end

	--블루 (left, idle, release) : 이러다간 오늘 내로 작업 마무리 못한다고!
	if not self.caution_on then
		character_util.play_speech_action(blue,
				{ name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' }, nil, { key = 'qs_among_s4_36', skip = self.is_screen })
	end

	local last_dir = 'up'
	local guard_wp = {
		self.get_control_pos(2),
		self.get_control_pos(3)
	}

	--이동 전에 걸릴 경우 대사를 기다려줌
	while self.patrol_pause do
		coroutine.yield()
	end


	--async
	self:hazmat_move_routine(blue, guard_wp, 3, last_dir, 1)

	self.green_escape_range:Hide()

	if not self.caution_pause then
		if self.caution_on then
			self:fail()
		else
			if self.green_dead_zone then
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.detection_fail, self)
			else
				start_coroutine(self.clear, self)
			end
		end
	end
end

	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'down')
end

--웨이포인트 가드 일회용 무브 루틴
function local_class:hazmat_move_routine(fo, waypoint, speed, last_dir, start_waypoint)
	local waypoint_count = start_waypoint
	local stop = true

	fo.Direction = vector_util.to_direction(waypoint[waypoint_count] - fo.Position)
	character_util.set_anim(fo, { name = 'walk' })

	while self.hazmat_move do
		if self.patrol_pause then
			if stop then
				character_util.set_anim(fo, { name = 'idle' })
				stop = false
			end
		else
			if not stop then
				character_util.set_anim(fo, { name = 'walk' })
				stop = true
			end

			local magnitude = unity_class.time.deltaTime * speed
			local diff = waypoint[waypoint_count] - fo.Position
			local dir = vector_util.normalized(diff)
			local diffMagnitude = diff.magnitude

			if magnitude < diffMagnitude then
				fo.Position = fo.Position + (dir * magnitude)
			else
				fo.Position = waypoint[waypoint_count]
				waypoint_count = waypoint_count + 1

				if waypoint_count > #waypoint then
					character_util.set_direction(fo, last_dir)
					break
				end

				fo.Direction = vector_util.to_direction(waypoint[waypoint_count] - fo.Position)
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	character_util.remove_anim(fo)
end

function local_class:patrol_refresh(state)
	for i = 1, #self.patrol_on do
		self.patrol_on[i] = state
	end
end

function local_class:control_tesla_timer_routine(fo)
	self:set_field_timer(fo)

	while self.control_tesla_on do
		if not self.control_switch_on then
			self.time_passed = self.time_passed - unity_class.time.deltaTime
		end
		coroutine.yield()

		if self.time_passed > 0 then
			self.timer_bar.BarSprite:SetValue(self.time_passed, 0)
		else
			field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(fo, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TimerBar)
			self.timer_bar.gameObject:SetActive(false);
			self.timer_bar = nil
			self.control_tesla_on = false
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.PowerSourceTurnOffEvent.Create('control_room_tesla'))
			break
		end
	end
end

--fo에 타이머 달아주기
function local_class:set_field_timer(fo)
	if self.timer_bar == nil then
		local u_dic = field_ui_manager:SetUI(fo, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TimerBar, false)
		self.timer_bar = u_dic[CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TimerBar]
		self.timer_bar.BarSprite:SetWidth(100)
		self.timer_bar.BarSprite:SetMinMax(0, 5);
		self.timer_bar.BarSprite:SetValue(5, 0);
		self.timer_bar.gameObject:SetActive(true);
	end
end
