	character:OnEvent(CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(clms))
	character.OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
end

function local_class:clear()

	self:falling_routine(self.blue, 'none', function()
		self.controller:show_typing_text('qs_among_s5_clear', '03_dialogue_01')
	end)

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0)
	character_util.set_position(self.blue, vector(999, 0, 999))
	wait_for_sec(2)

	yield_return_func(quest_util.progress_section, self.controller)
end

function local_class:fail()
	self:falling_routine(user_party.Leader, 'circular', function()
		self.controller:show_typing_text('qs_among_s5_fail', '03_dialogue_01')
	end)

	self:pre_setting()
	wait_for_sec(2)

	start_coroutine(self.total_scene, self)
end

function local_class:pre_setting()
	local leader = user_party.Leader

	self:set_npc_by_data(self.among_s5_meet_invader_data)

	character_util.set_position(leader, self.get_meet_room_start_pos())
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(leader, { name = 'idle', loop = true }, { name = 'idle' })
	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'down')

	self.current_choose_name = 'first_1'
end

function local_class:search_branch(number, branch_data, handler)
	local branch_name = 'talk_branch_' .. number
	for name, data in pairs(branch_data) do
		if branch_name == name then
			return data.branch(handler)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:mafia_branch_scene(data, choose_list)
	local branch_number = ''
	local branch_data = nil

	while self.is_playing do
		branch_data = choose_list[self.current_choose_name]
		branch_number = branch_number .. choose_util.play_choose_event(branch_data)

		self:search_branch(branch_number, data, self)

		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

return local_class

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	screen_util.preload_tutorial_spine()
	timeline_util.load_playable('qs_among_s6_1')
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), 'on_damage_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TeslaCoilOnOffEvent), 'on_tesla_on_off_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_zone_leave_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_touch_event')

	self.red = self.get_among_invader(1)
	self.orange = self.get_among_invader(2)
	self.yellow = self.get_among_invader(3)

	self.red_attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(unity_class.vector3.zero, 2)
	self.red_attack_range:Hide()

	self:pre_setting()

	timeline_table.register_action(self.qte_sound_key, self.qte_tap_sound, self)

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.start_routine, self)
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TeslaCoilOnOffEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))

	timeline_table.unregister_action(self.qte_sound_key)

	self.red = nil
	self.orange = nil
	self.yellow = nil

	self.qte_is_start = false
	self.last_patrol_check = false
	self.range_check = false

	if self.game_pad_handler then
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self.game_pad_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadEvent))
		self.game_pad_handler = nil
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_touch_event(e)
	if not self.qte_is_start then
		return false
	end

	if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.Tap then
		if self.touch_sound_able then
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_clang_01')

			self.qte_tap_count = self.qte_tap_count + 1

			if self.qte_tap_count > 7 then
				self.qte_is_start = false
			end
		end
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_tesla_on_off_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.CoilObject, self.get_dark_room_tesla()) and
			self.current_state == self.section_state.last then
		self.tesla_on = e.IsTurningOn

		if not e.IsTurningOn then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.black_out_routine, self)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_damage_event(e)
	local require_damage_type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Assassinate

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.sender, user_party.Leader) and
			self.current_state == self.section_state.last and
			e.Info.type & require_damage_type == require_damage_type then

		table.insert(self.dead_invader_list, e.Info.target)

		if self.tesla_on then
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, self.red) then
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.last_assassinate_fail, self, self.red, self.orange, self.yellow)
			elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, self.orange) then
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.last_assassinate_fail, self, self.orange, self.red, self.yellow)
			elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, self.yellow) then
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.last_assassinate_fail, self, self.yellow, self.orange, self.red)
			end
		else
			start_coroutine(self.last_assassinate_clear, self, e.Info.target)
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, user_party.Leader, self.dark_room_event_zone) and
			self.current_state == self.section_state.last then
		if self.tesla_on then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.day_get_out_routine, self)
			return true
		else
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.night_get_out_routine, self)
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:last_assassinate_fail(dead_invader, other_invader_1, other_invader_2)
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	self.last_patrol_check = false
	coroutine.yield()

	character_util.set_anim(dead_invader, { name = 'dead', loop = false, sfx_name = '01_hit_tentacle_01' })
	character_util.look_at(other_invader_1, leader)
	character_util.set_anim(other_invader_1, { name = 'idle' })
	character_util.look_at(other_invader_2, leader)
	character_util.set_anim(other_invader_2, { name = 'idle' })

	camera_util.move_async(self.get_way_pos(11), 0.5)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_notice_01')
	character_util.show_emoticon(other_invader_1, nil, 'notice')
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(other_invader_2, nil, 'notice')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
	character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'embarrassed' })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_siren_oneshot_02')

	local bubble_key = 'qs_among_s6_31'
	local voice_1_key = ''
	local voice_2_key = ''

	if dead_invader == self.red then
		voice_1_key = bubble_key .. '_orange'
		voice_2_key = bubble_key .. '_yellow'
	elseif dead_invader == self.orange then
		voice_1_key = bubble_key .. '_red'
		voice_2_key = bubble_key .. '_yellow'
	elseif dead_invader == self.yellow then
		voice_1_key = bubble_key .. '_orange'
		voice_2_key = bubble_key .. '_red'
	end

	--(up, idle, release) : 범인이다!!
	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(character_util.play_speech_action, other_invader_1, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' }, nil,
				{ key = bubble_key, skip = true, override_key = voice_1_key, lower_priority = true }),
		util.cs_generator(character_util.play_speech_action, other_invader_2, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' }, nil,
				{ key = bubble_key, skip = true, override_key = voice_2_key }),
	})

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_01')
	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(1, 'linear')

	wait_for_sec(1)
	camera_util.return_to_leader(0)
	character_util.remove_anim(leader)
	self:revive_npc(self.dead_invader_list)
	start_coroutine(self.third_assassinate_routine, self)

	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(1, 'linear')
end

function local_class:last_assassinate_clear(dead_invader)
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()
	self.last_patrol_check = false

	self:revive_npc(self.dead_invader_list)

	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(self.red)
	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(self.orange)
	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(self.yellow)

	coroutine.yield()

	self:dark_kill_routine(dead_invader)

	wp_util.move_async(leader, self.get_way_pos(21), 2.5, nil, { last_direction = 'right' })

	character_util.set_position(leader, self.get_way_pos(21))
	character_util.set_position(self.orange, self.get_way_pos(19))
	character_util.set_position(self.red, self.get_way_pos(20))
	character_util.set_position(self.yellow, self.get_way_pos(18))

	character_util.set_anim(self.orange, { name = 'eat' })
	character_util.set_anim(self.red, { name = 'idle' })
	character_util.set_anim(self.yellow, { name = 'prostrate' })
	character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'idle' })

	character_util.set_direction(self.orange, 'right')
	character_util.set_direction(self.red, 'right')
	character_util.set_direction(self.yellow, 'right')
	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'right')

	camera_util.move_async(self.red.Position, 2)

	--(말풍선 박스) 오렌지 : 여깄다! 전등 레버 찾았어!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.orange, { key = 'qs_among_s6_40', skip = true })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gear_02')
	self:toggle_dark_room_tint(false, 0)
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, { 'among_lever_push' }))

	self.get_dark_room_lever().Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

	wait_for_sec(0.7)

	character_util.set_direction(self.orange, 'left')
	character_util.set_anim(self.orange, { name = 'idle' })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(self.orange, nil, 'notice')

	--옐로우 (left, idle, release) : 옐로우!! 레드… 너!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	character_util.play_speech_action(self.orange, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' }, nil, 'qs_among_s6_41')

	--레드 (down, idle, embarrassed) : 뭐, 뭐야?! 옐로우가 왜 여기에…!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
	character_util.set_direction(self.red, 'down')
	character_util.set_anim(self.red, { name = 'embarrassed' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.red, { key = 'qs_among_s6_42', skip = true })

	--선택지창 출력
	--『레드가 옐로우를 죽였다!!』(brutal)
	choose_util.play_choose_event({ { 'qs_among_s6_choose_1', 'mercy' } })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_02')

	character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'embarrassed' })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_in_teleport_01')
	self.controller:fade_out_amb_ship_loop_sound()
	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(1, 'linear')

	character_util.set_position(self.yellow, vector(999, 0, 999))
	camera_util.return_to_leader(0)
	character_util.remove_anim(leader)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	yield_return_func(quest_util.progress_section, self.controller)
end

function local_class:dark_kill_routine(dead_invader)
	local other_1 = nil
	local other_2 = nil

	if dead_invader == self.red then
		other_1 = self.orange
		other_2 = self.yellow
	elseif dead_invader == self.orange then
		other_1 = self.red
		other_2 = self.yellow
	elseif dead_invader == self.yellow then
		other_1 = self.red
		other_2 = self.orange
	end

	local dead_sound_func = function()
		wait_for_sec(2)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_hit_tentacle_01')
	end

	start_coroutine(dead_sound_func, self)
	--레드 (idle, idle, idle) : [shout] 으아아악!!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_villain_scream_03')
	character_util.set_anim(dead_invader, { name = 'dead', loop = false })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(dead_invader, { key = 'qs_among_s6_37', skip = true, bubble_type = 'shout' })

	--오렌지 (idle, idle, idle) : 뭐, 뭐야?! 무슨 일이야!!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(other_1, { key = 'qs_among_s6_38', skip = true })

	--옐로우 (idle,idle, idle) : 빨리 누가 불 좀 켜봐!!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(other_2, { key = 'qs_among_s6_39', skip = true })
end

--불끄는 연출
function local_class:black_out_routine()
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_blackout_01')
	self:toggle_dark_room_tint(true, 1)
	quest_marker_util.remove(self.quest_marker_name)

	character_util.set_direction(get_party_leader(), 'left')

	camera_util.move_async(self.get_way_pos(11), 1)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')

	character_util.remove_anim(self.red)
	character_util.remove_anim(self.orange)
	character_util.remove_anim(self.yellow)

	--레드,오렌지,옐로우 NPC가 각 루트를 따라 움직이고 자리에 멈춰선다.
	wp_util.move(self.orange, {
		self.get_way_pos(17) + vector(-3, 0, 0),
		self.get_way_pos(17),
	}, 4, nil, { last_direction = 'right' })

	wp_util.move(self.yellow, {
		self.get_way_pos(18) + vector(0, 0, -2),
		self.get_way_pos(18),
	}, 4, nil, { last_direction = 'left' })

	wp_util.move_async(self.red, {
		self.get_way_pos(16) + vector(0, 0, 1),
		self.get_way_pos(16),
	}, 4, nil, { last_direction = 'down' })

	--레드 (left, idle, idle) : 뭐야?! 갑자기 왜 불이 꺼진 거지?!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.red, { key = 'qs_among_s6_34', skip = true })

	--오렌지 (right, idle, release) : 아무것도 안 보여!! 누가 빨리 불 좀 켜봐!!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	character_util.play_speech_action(self.orange, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' }, nil, 'qs_among_s6_35')

	--옐로우 (left, idle, embarrassed) : 저리 가! 다 가까이 오지 마!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.yellow, { key = 'qs_among_s6_36', skip = true })

	--카메라가 원래대로 플레이어에게로 포커스.
	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

	start_coroutine(self.dark_talk, self)
end

function local_class:dark_talk()
	self.last_patrol_check = true

	while self.last_patrol_check do
		if self.last_patrol_check then
			--레드 (left/right 번갈아가며, idle, idle) : 뭐야?! 갑자기 왜 불이 꺼진 거지?!
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.red, { key = 'qs_among_s6_34', skip = false })
		end

		if self.last_patrol_check then
			--오렌지 (right, idle, release) : 아무것도 안 보여!! 누가 빨리 불 좀 켜봐!!
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
			character_util.play_speech_action(self.orange,
					{ name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' }, nil, { key = 'qs_among_s6_35', skip = false })
		end

		if self.last_patrol_check then
			--옐로우 (left, idle, embarrassed) : 저리 가! 다 가까이 오지 마!
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.yellow, { key = 'qs_among_s6_36', skip = false })
		end
	end
end

--밝을때 도망칠 경우
function local_class:day_get_out_routine()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local talker_1 = nil
	local talker_2 = nil
	local dir = ''

	local voice_1_key = ''
	local voice_2_key = ''

	if leader.Position.x > 18 then
		talker_1 = self.orange
		talker_2 = self.yellow

		voice_1_key = '_orange'
		voice_2_key = '_yellow'

		character_util.set_direction(talker_1, 'down')
		character_util.set_direction(talker_2, 'down')
		dir = 'up'
	else
		talker_1 = self.red
		talker_2 = self.orange

		character_util.set_direction(talker_1, 'left')
		character_util.set_direction(talker_2, 'left')
		dir = 'right'
	end

	character_util.set_anim(talker_1, { name = 'idle' })
	character_util.set_anim(talker_2, { name = 'idle' })

	character_util.set_direction(leader, dir)
	character_util.normal_jump(leader, true)

	--레드 (left, idle, release) : 화이트! 너 작업하다 말고 어딜 가려는 거야!
	character_util.play_speech_action(talker_1, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' }, nil,
			{ key = 'qs_among_s6_32', skip = true, override_key = 'qs_among_s6_32' .. voice_1_key })

	--오렌지 (left, idle, release) : 네가 범인이었군, 화이트!!

function local_class:third_assassinate_routine()
	self:release_holdup(get_party_leader())
	self.range_check = true
	self.third_patrol_check = true

	if self.current_state == self.section_state.down_wp then
		start_coroutine(self.down_patrol, self)
	elseif self.current_state == self.section_state.up_wp then
		start_coroutine(self.up_patrol, self)
	elseif self.current_state == self.section_state.last then
		start_coroutine(self.last_patrol, self)
	end
end

function local_class:down_patrol()
	--region 변수 초기화
	local orange_relate = vector(-1, 0, 1)
	local yellow_relate = vector(-1, 0, 0)

	local red_down_wp = {
		self.get_way_pos(2),
		self.get_way_pos(3)
	}
	local orange_down_wp = {
		self.get_way_pos(2) + orange_relate,
		self.get_way_pos(3) + orange_relate
	}
	local yellow_down_wp = {
		self.get_way_pos(2) + yellow_relate,
		self.get_way_pos(3) + yellow_relate
	}
	--endregion

	coroutine.yield()

	--스크린플레이
	self:down_intro_routine()

	start_coroutine(self.move_attack_range_by_npc, self, self.red)

	--0.7초 대기
	local time_passed = 0
	while self.third_patrol_check do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		if time_passed > 0.7 then
			break
		end
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	--행진 시작
	if self.third_patrol_check then
		wp_util.move(self.red, red_down_wp, 2.5, nil, { last_direction = 'left' })
		wp_util.move(self.orange, orange_down_wp, 2.5, nil, { last_direction = 'right' })
		wp_util.move_async(self.yellow, yellow_down_wp, 2.5, nil, { last_direction = 'right' })
	end

	self.range_check = false

	if self.third_patrol_check then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.down_qte_routine, self)
	else
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.down_fail_routine, self)
	end
end

function local_class:down_qte_routine()
	wp_util.move_async(get_party_leader(), self.get_way_pos(3) + vector(0, 0, 1), 4, nil, { last_direction = 'down' })

	-- 게임패드 연결중 일 경우 게임패드 이벤트도 구독
	if CS.Oak.Game.Instance.InputManager.GamepadEnabled then
		self.game_pad_handler = {
			callback = function(_, e)
				if e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.AButtonDown or
						e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.BButtonDown or
						e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.XButtonDown or
						e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.YButtonDown then
					message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.TouchEvent.Create(CS.Oak.TouchEventType.Tap, unity_class.vector2.zero))
					return true
				end
				return false
			end
		}
		message_system:Subscribe(self.game_pad_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadEvent), 'callback')
	end

	timeline_util.play_async(self.director_name, 'qs_among_s6_1')

	if self.game_pad_handler then
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self.game_pad_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadEvent))
		self.game_pad_handler = nil
	end

	self.current_state = self.section_state.up_wp

	self:third_assassinate_routine()
end

function local_class:up_finish_routine()

		util.cs_generator(wp_util.move_async, self.orange, self.get_way_pos(11) + vector(-1, 0, -1), 3, nil, { last_direction = 'up' }),
		util.cs_generator(wp_util.move_async, get_party_leader(), self.get_way_pos(11) + vector(1, 0, -1), 3, nil, { last_direction = 'up' }),
		util.cs_generator(wp_util.move_async, self.yellow, self.get_way_pos(11) + vector(0, 0, -1), 3, nil, { last_direction = 'up' })
	})

	--레드 (down, idle, cross_arm) : 흠… 좋아. 대열을 벗어난 놈은 없군.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.play_speech_action(self.red, { name = 'cross_arm' }, nil, 'qs_among_s6_27')

	--레드 (left/right 번갈아가며, idle, idle) : 이쪽 구역은 기계가 흩어져 있으니까…

		util.cs_generator(function()
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
			character_util.set_direction(self.red, 'left')
			wait_for_sec(0.5)
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
			character_util.set_direction(self.red, 'right')
			wait_for_sec(0.5)
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
			character_util.set_direction(self.red, 'left')
			wait_for_sec(0.5)
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
			character_util.set_direction(self.red, 'right')
		end),
		util.cs_generator(function()
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.red, { key = 'qs_among_s6_28', skip = true })
		end)
	})

	--레드 (down, idle, release) : 각자 하나씩 맡아서 작업하자고.

	character_util.play_speech_action(self.red, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' }, nil, 'qs_among_s6_29')

		self:able_to_assassinate(self.orange)
		self:able_to_assassinate(self.yellow)

		end

function local_class:move_attack_range_by_npc(character)
	local npc = character
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local distance = 0

	self.red_attack_range:Show(0)

	while self.range_check do
		attack_range_util.setup_by_position(self.red_attack_range, npc.Position, 0.1)

		coroutine.yield()

		distance = vector_util.get_x0z(leader.Position - npc.Position).magnitude
		if distance > 2 then
			self:stop_routine()
			self.third_patrol_check = false
			break
		end
	end

	self.red_attack_range:Hide()
end

function local_class:stop_routine()

	for i = 1, invader_count do

	end

function local_class:toggle_dark_room_tint(darken, duration)
	local dark_room_tint_key = 'dark_room_light_off_key'

	if darken then
		field:Tint(dark_room_tint_key, unity_class.color.black, duration)

		character_util.add_color(self.red, self.red.Name, unity_class.color.black, 1, duration)
		character_util.add_color(self.orange, self.orange.Name, unity_class.color.black, 1, duration)
		character_util.add_color(self.yellow, self.yellow.Name, unity_class.color.black, 1, duration)
	else
		field:RemoveTint(dark_room_tint_key, duration)

		character_util.remove_color(self.red, self.red.Name, duration)
		character_util.remove_color(self.orange, self.orange.Name, duration)
		character_util.remove_color(self.yellow, self.yellow.Name, duration)
	end
end

function local_class:qte_tap_sound()
	self.qte_is_start = true
	local time_passed = 0

	while self.qte_is_start do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if time_passed > 0.65 then
			time_passed = 0
			self.touch_sound_able = true
		end

		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

return local_class

function local_class:show_action_tap_routine()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local orange = self.get_among_invader(2)

	self:convert_assassinate(orange)
	self:able_to_assassinate(orange)

	character_util.set_position(leader, self.get_meet_room_pos(1) + vector(0, 0, 1))
	character_util.set_position(orange, self.get_meet_room_start_pos() + vector(0, 0, 1))
	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'right')
	character_util.set_direction(orange, 'left')

	wait_for_sec(1)

	screen_util.fade_in_async(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(1, 'linear')

	--오렌지 (left, idle, idle) : 드디어… 진짜 범인을 내쫓았어…!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(orange, { key = 'qs_among_s7_29', skip = true })

	--오렌지 (left, idle, cast2) : 우린 살았어! 살아남았다고!!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	character_util.set_direction(orange, 'right')
	character_util.play_speech_action(orange, { name = 'cast2' }, nil, 'qs_among_s7_30')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	--오렌지 (right, idle, victory_extra) : 만세! 이제 둘이서 작업 마무리만 하면…!
	character_util.set_anim(orange, { name = 'victory_extra', loop = true, sfx_name = '01_small_jump_01' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(orange, { key = 'qs_among_s7_31', skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim(orange)

	self:able_to_assassinate(orange)

	local manual_touch_state = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState.Create(user_party.Leader, false)
	manual_touch_state:DisableControls(CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(CS.Oak.DisabledControls.All) ~ (CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Assassination)))

	local state_change_event = CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(manual_touch_state)
	message_system:SendSync(get_party_leader().FieldObjectController, state_change_event)

	coroutine.yield()

	field_ui_manager:Show()

	-- 액션 버튼만 띄움
	field_ui_manager:HideTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.PartyState)
	field_ui_manager:HideTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ClassButton
			| CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TeamCombinationButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.SkillButton
			| CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ModeChangeButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.RoleButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.DPad,
			get_party_leader())

	field_ui_manager:ShowTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton)

	CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance:Hide()
	stage.FieldUIMiniMap:Hide()

	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowActionTap(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton, 1)

	character_util.spine_set_attachment(leader, '[base]weapon1', 'head_crusher')
	character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'sword_idle' })

	local wait_check = false
	local touch_handler = {
		callback = function(_, e)
			if CS.Oak.InputManager.IsPC and e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.TouchDown then
				wait_check = true
				return true
			end

			return false
		end
	}

	message_system:Subscribe(touch_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'callback')

	while not wait_check and
			not lua_helper.type_compare(user_party.Leader.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentState, CS.Oak.CharacterAssassinateState) do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	if CS.Oak.InputManager.IsPC then
		local assassinate_cmd = CS.Oak.AssassinateCommand.Create(user_party.Leader, orange)
		command_util.publish_cmd(user_party.Leader.Owner, assassinate_cmd)
		coroutine.yield()

		while not lua_helper.type_compare(user_party.Leader.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentState, CS.Oak.CharacterAssassinateState) do
			coroutine.yield()
		end
	end

	character_util.remove_anim(leader)

	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.CloseTutorialSpine()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(touch_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))

	field_ui_manager:ShowTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.PartyState)
	field_ui_manager:ShowTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ClassButton
			| CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TeamCombinationButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.SkillButton
			| CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ModeChangeButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.RoleButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.DPad,
			get_party_leader())
	CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance:Show()
	stage.FieldUIMiniMap:Show()

	field_ui_manager:Hide()

	while lua_helper.type_compare(user_party.Leader.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentState, CS.Oak.CharacterAssassinateState) do

	end

	coroutine.yield()

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'ondemand/v2_49_queenship/audio:bgm_queenship_assassin', state = 'event', mix = 0 })

	character_util.set_anim(orange, { name = 'dead', loop = false, sfx_name = '01_hit_tentacle_01' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(orange, { key = 'qs_among_s7_34', skip = false })

	wait_for_sec(2)

	character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'victory_get', loop = false, sfx_name = '01_stage_intro_jump_01' })

	wait_for_sec(2)

	--연구소에 있는 모든 인베이더 연구원들을 처리했다.
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'qs_among_s7_33' })

	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	character_util.spine_set_attachment(leader, '[base]weapon1', 'empty')
	character_util.remove_anim(leader)
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	camera_util.move_async(get_field_object('meet_room_door_3').Position, 1)

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('meet_room_door_3', false))
	wait_for_sec(2.5)
	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

	yield_return_func(quest_util.complete_quest, self.controller, 0, true, false, false, false)
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local library_door_1 = self.get_library_door(1)
	local storage_door = self.get_storage_door()
	local lever = self.get_library_lever()
	local report = self.get_report()
	local bed = self.get_bed()

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, library_door_1) then
		if self.is_get_library_key then
			-- 서재 1 문 개방
			message_system:Send(library_door_1, CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('library_key', false))
			library_door_1.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
		else
			--열쇠가 필요합니다.
			timeline_util.play(self.director_name, 'qs_camilla_s1_3')
		end

	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, storage_door) then
		if self.is_get_storage_key then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_storage_door, self)
		else
			--문 : 승인받지 않은 접근입니다.
			timeline_util.play(self.director_name, 'qs_camilla_s1_2')
		end
	end

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, lever) and
			self.is_library_lever_on == false then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.trigger_library_lever, self)
	end

	for i = 1, 5 do
		local bookshelf = self.get_bookshelf(i)
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, bookshelf) then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_bookshelf, self, i)
		end
	end

	for i = 1, 2 do
		local foreshadowing = self.get_foreshadowing(i)
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, foreshadowing) then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_foreshadowing, self, i)
		end
	end

	for i = 1, 4 do
		local capsule = self.get_capsule(i)
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, capsule) then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_capsule, self, i)
		end
	end

	for i = 1, 2 do
		local newspaper = self.get_newspaper(i)
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, newspaper) then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_newspaper, self, i)
		end
	end

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, report) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_report, self)
	end

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, bed) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_bed, self)
	end

end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	--플레이어가 지나갈 때마다 횃불이 2개씩 켜진다.
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
		for i = 1, 4 do
			if e.Zone.Name == (self.brazier_zone .. i) and
			not self.is_brazier_zone_enter[i] then
				local brazier_left = self.get_entrance_brazier(i)
				local brazier_right = self.get_entrance_brazier(i + 4)
				command_util.execute_burn(nil, brazier_left, true)
				command_util.execute_burn(nil, brazier_right, true)
				self.is_brazier_zone_enter[i] = true
				music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_catch_fire_01')
			end
		end
	end

	if self.is_magnet_door_open == false then
		for i = 1, 4 do
			local metal_push_block = self.get_metal_push_block(i)
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, metal_push_block) and
					e.Zone.Name == (self.metal_block_zone) and
					e.FullEnter then
				self.is_enter_metal_block[i] = true
				-- 처음으로 철제 블록이 들어오면 문부수기 시작
				if self.is_cracking_magnet_door == false then
					self.is_cracking_magnet_door = true
					start_coroutine(self.crack_magnet_door, self)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if self.is_magnet_door_open == false then
		for i = 1, 4 do
			local metal_push_block = self.get_metal_push_block(i)
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, metal_push_block) and
					e.Zone.Name == (self.metal_block_zone) then
				self.is_enter_metal_block[i] = false
				self.is_first_enter_metal_block = true
			end
		end
	end
end

--받은얘 책장
--보낸얘 브레이커블
-- 연출 진행
function local_class:on_damage_event(e)

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, self.get_bookshelf(7)) then
		for i = 1, 2 do
			local breakable = self.get_library_breakable(i)
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.sender, breakable) then
				if self.shelf_knock_back_count == 0 then
					start_coroutine(self.move_storage_key_item, self)
				elseif self.shelf_knock_back_count == 1 then
					start_coroutine(self.drop_storage_key_item, self)
				else
					return
				end
				self.shelf_knock_back_count = self.shelf_knock_back_count + 1
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:drop_storage_key_item()
	local storage_key = self.storage_key_item
	local storage_key_end_pos = self.get_storage_key_end_pos().position
	local bookshelf = self.get_bookshelf(7)

	bookshelf:Shake(0.1, 0.15)

	storage_key:Shake(0.2, 0.2)
	storage_key:SetSortingLayer(false)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_air_spin_01')
	drop_item_util.throw_item(storage_key, storage_key_end_pos, { ground_offset = 0 })
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	storage_key.ConsumeTarget = user_party.Leader

end

	local storge_key_pos_org = self.get_storage_key_pos().position + vector(0, 2.3, 0)
	local bookshelf = self.get_bookshelf(7)

	drop_item_util.move_item_async(storage_key, storge_key_pos_org + vector(0, 0, -0.5), { duration = 0.15 })

function local_class:crack_magnet_door()
	local smoke_pos = self.get_magnet_door_pos().position
	local gate_destroy_sfx = nil
	while self.is_cracking_magnet_door do
		local count = 0
		local metal_blocks = {}
		local magnet_breakable = self.get_magnet_breakable()
		for i = 1, 4 do
			if self.is_enter_metal_block[i] == true then
				count = count + 1
			end
			table.insert(metal_blocks, self.get_metal_push_block(i))
		end
		if count == 0 then
			self.is_cracking_magnet_door = false

			-- sfx 재생시 종료
			if not gate_destroy_sfx == nil then
				gate_destroy_sfx:Stop()
				gate_destroy_sfx = nil
			end

			return
		elseif count == 1 and self.is_first_enter_metal_block then
			self.is_first_enter_metal_block = false
			-- 최초 한번만 문 흔들리는 이펙트
			magnet_breakable:Shake(0.04, 0.5)

			-- 최초 한번만 먼지 날리는 이펙트
			self.get_fx_smoke():Instantiate(smoke_pos)

			-- 최초 한번만 sfx 재생
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bounce_iron_01')

			wait_for_sec(0.5)

			-- sfx 재생시 종료
			if not gate_destroy_sfx == nil then
				gate_destroy_sfx:Stop()
				gate_destroy_sfx = nil
			end
		elseif count == 2 then
			-- 문 흔들리는 이펙트
			magnet_breakable:Shake(0.08, 0.5)

			-- 이미 재생 중인지 확인하고 아닐 시 sfx 재생.
			if gate_destroy_sfx == nil then
				gate_destroy_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
					sfx_name = '01_gate_destory_03', loop = true, parent = magnet_breakable,
					type_priority = 'loop', player_priority = 'npc', max_distance = 9 })
			end
			-- 먼지 날리는 이펙트
			self.get_fx_smoke():Instantiate(smoke_pos)
			wait_for_sec(0.5)

		elseif count >= 3 then
			self.is_cracking_magnet_door = false
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.success_crack_magnet_door, self, gate_destroy_sfx)
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- sfx 재생시 종료
	if not gate_destroy_sfx == nil then
		gate_destroy_sfx:Stop()
		gate_destroy_sfx = nil
	end
end

function local_class:success_crack_magnet_door(gate_destroy_sfx)
	--대충 문 흔들리다 문 박살나는 이벤트
	local magnet_breakable = self.get_magnet_breakable()
	local smoke_pos = self.get_magnet_door_pos().position

	-- 이미 재생 중인지 확인하고 아닐 시 sfx 재생.
	if gate_destroy_sfx == nil then
		gate_destroy_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
			sfx_name = '01_gate_destory_03', loop = true, parent = magnet_breakable,
			type_priority = 'loop', player_priority = 'npc', max_distance = 9 })
	end

	magnet_breakable:Shake(0.08, 0.5)
	camera_util.move_async(smoke_pos, 0.5)

	self.get_fx_smoke():Instantiate(smoke_pos)

	for j = 1, 4 do
		magnet_breakable:Shake(0.08, 0.5)
		self.get_fx_smoke():Instantiate(smoke_pos)
		wait_for_sec(0.5)
	end

	-- 문 파괴
	camera_util.shake(0.02, 0.3)
	self.get_fx_destroy():Instantiate(magnet_breakable.Position)
	magnet_breakable.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')

	-- sfx 재생시 종료
	if not gate_destroy_sfx == nil then
		gate_destroy_sfx:Stop()
		gate_destroy_sfx = nil
	end

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_rock_break_03')

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	self.is_magnet_door_open = true

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)

end

function local_class:in_camilla_stage()
	return stage.Name == self.camilla_stage_name
end

return {
	create = function(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
		return local_class(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
	end
}

	self.get_fx_magic_circle = function()

	end

	end

	self.fx_dead = nil

end

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_teleporter()) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.intro_interact_event, self)
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_lever()) and not self.is_lever_on then

	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_paper(1)) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_paper, self)
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_paper(2)) then

function local_class:load_resource()

end

function local_class:on_pre_story_init()

	self.pre_story_section = quest_util.load_section(self, 'PreSection')
end

function local_class:on_init()

		quest_util.load_section(self, 'Section1'),
		quest_util.load_section(self, 'Section2'),
		quest_util.load_section(self, 'Section3'),
		quest_util.load_section(self, 'Section4'),
		quest_util.load_section(self, 'Section5'),
	}

function local_class:on_load_resource_routine()
	self.res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()

	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
			self.res_holder, 'ui/prologue', 'typing_text', function(prefab)
				self.typing_text_go = CS.NGUITools.AddChild(stage.UIRoot.gameObject, prefab)
				self.typing_text = self.typing_text_go:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UITypingText))

	self.current_section = nil

	if self.pre_story_section ~= nil then

	end

		CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Destroy(self.typing_text_go)

	self.typing_text = nil

		self.fx_holder[i]:Dispose()
	end

	timeline_table.unregister_action('talk_end_andras_host')

	timeline_table.unregister_action('talk_end_pymon_host')

	timeline_table.unregister_action('talk_end_crosselle_host')

	return false
end

function local_class:on_stage_loaded()
	if stage.Name ~= 'queenship_substage_crosselle' then
		return
	end

	timeline_table.register_action('talk_andras_host', self.talk_andras_host, self)
	timeline_table.register_action('talk_end_andras_host', self.talk_end_andras_host, self)
	timeline_table.register_action('talk_pymon_host', self.talk_pymon_host, self)
	timeline_table.register_action('talk_end_pymon_host', self.talk_end_pymon_host, self)
	timeline_table.register_action('talk_crosselle_host', self.talk_crosselle_host, self)
	timeline_table.register_action('talk_end_crosselle_host', self.talk_end_crosselle_host, self)

	local is_s4_over = self.quest_progress ~= nil and
			(self.quest_progress.IsComplete or self.quest_progress.InnerProgress > 3)

	if is_s4_over or quest_util.get_custom_state(self.quest_progress, 's4_sub_section_upper_done') == 1 then
		for i = 1, self.s4_pymon_break_appear_count do
			self.get_s4_pymon_break_appear(i).ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
		end

		for i = 1, self.s4_pymon_break_disappear_count do
			self.get_s4_pymon_break_disappear(i).ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
		end

		self:toggle_pymon_wall(true)

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('s4_door_upper'))
	else
		self:toggle_pymon_wall(false)
	end

	if is_s4_over or quest_util.get_custom_state(self.quest_progress, 's4_sub_section_lower_done') == 1 then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('s4_door_lower'))
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('s4_lower_meet_andras_door'))
	end

	local radio_wave_machine = get_field_object('radio_wave_machine')

	if self.quest_progress ~= nil and self.quest_progress.IsComplete then
		radio_wave_machine.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
	else
		animator_util.play(radio_wave_machine, 'on')
	end
end

function local_class:on_stage_start_event(e)
	local is_s4_over = self.quest_progress ~= nil and
			(self.quest_progress.IsComplete or self.quest_progress.InnerProgress > 3)

	if is_s4_over or quest_util.get_custom_state(self.quest_progress, 's4_sub_section_upper_done') == 1 then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.LinkDoorEvent.Create('pink', true, true))
	end

	if is_s4_over or quest_util.get_custom_state(self.quest_progress, 's4_sub_section_lower_done') == 1 then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.LinkDoorEvent.Create('green', true, true))
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:show_typing_text(key, wait)
	 local voice_holder = music_player:PlayDialogue(key)

	if wait then
		yield_return_func(self.typing_text.SetTypedText, self.typing_text,
				game_string:GetStringWithReservedKeywords(key), 1000, 0.05)

		if voice_holder ~= nil then
			-- 대사가 출력 중이면 대기
			while voice_holder.IsUsing do
				coroutine.yield()
			end
		end
	else
		start_coroutine_enumerator(self.typing_text:SetTypedText(
				game_string:GetStringWithReservedKeywords(key), 1000, 0.05))
	end
end

	local andras = self.get_andras()

	character_util.remove_color(crosselle, crosselle.Name, 0.3)

function local_class:toggle_pymon_wall(is_destroyed)
	local wall = self.get_s4_pymon_break_disappear_wall()

	wall.Transform:Find('on').gameObject:SetActive(not is_destroyed)
	wall.Transform:Find('off').gameObject:SetActive(is_destroyed)

	wall.ActiveState = active_state(is_destroyed and 'visible' or 'enabled')

function local_class:align_to_hacking_console(console, set_dir)
	local align_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(console.Bounds.center, console.Position.y) + vector(0, 0, -1)
	local crosselle = get_party_leader()

	local speed = 1
	local speed_base_dur = (align_pos - crosselle.Position).magnitude / speed
	local dur_base_dur = 1

	if speed_base_dur > dur_base_dur then
		wp_util.move_async(crosselle, align_pos, nil, dur_base_dur)
	else
		wp_util.move_async(crosselle, align_pos, speed)
	end

	if set_dir then
		character_util.set_direction(crosselle, 'up')
	end
end

	return vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Bounds.center, fo.Position.y)
end

function local_class:dispose_light_laser_sfx()
	if self.light_laser_sfx ~= nil then
		self.light_laser_sfx:Stop()
		self.light_laser_sfx = nil
	end
end

return {
	create = function(quest_id, cs_controller)
		return local_class(quest_id, cs_controller)
	end
}

local local_class = newclass('QueenShipCrossellePreSection')

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	-- 이 섹션이 유효한 스테이지 이름
	self.available_stage_name = 'queenship_1_4'
	self.stage_ended = false

	self.section_state = {
		before_meet_invaders = 1,
		before_assassinate = 2,
		in_assassinate = 3,
		before_interact = 4,
	}

	self.current_section_state = self.section_state.before_meet_invaders

	self.get_invader = function(index)
		return get_character('sub_crosselle_invader_' .. index)
	end

	self.meet_invaders_zone_name = 'sub_crosselle_pre_meet_invaders'

	self.checking_assassinate = false
	self.on_check_assassinate_routine = false
	self.check_assassinate_zone_name = 'sub_crosselle_pre_check_assassinate'

	self.quest_marker_key = 'sub_crosselle_pre'

	self.eat_loop_sfx = nil

	self.get_door = function()
		return get_field_object('sub_crosselle_pre_door')
	end

	self.in_stage_hacking_acting = false

	self.need_marker_to_invaders = false
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	screen_util.preload_tutorial_spine()
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_zone_leave_event')
	message_system:SubscribeOnce(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent), 'on_stage_end_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_custom_stage_event')

	character_util.set_active_state(self.get_invader(1), 'enabled')
	character_util.set_active_state(self.get_invader(2), 'enabled')
end

function local_class:start()

end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.before_meet_invaders and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.meet_invaders_zone_name) then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.before_assassinate

		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.meet_invaders_scene, self)

		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.check_assassinate_zone_name) then
		self:start_check_assassinate()
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, get_party_leader(), self.check_assassinate_zone_name) then
		self:stop_check_assassinate()

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_door()) then
		e.Target.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create(e.Target.Name, false))
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'stage_4_third_acting_start' then
		self.in_stage_hacking_acting = true
		quest_marker_util.remove(self.quest_marker_key)

	elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == 'stage_4_third_acting_end' then
		self.in_stage_hacking_acting = false
		self:try_show_marker_to_invaders()
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_stage_end_event(e)
	timeline_util.stop(self.controller.director_name)

	self:dispose_eat_loop_sfx()

	return false
end

function local_class:meet_invaders_scene()
	local invader_1 = self.get_invader(1)
	local invader_2 = self.get_invader(2)

	--shout말풍선 : 도어가 완전히 고장났잖아?!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(invader_2, 'qs_crosselle_pre_1', nil,
			{ viewport_pos = vector(0.6, 0.8) })

	party_util.set_direction('up')

	camera_util.move_async((invader_1.Position + invader_2.Position) / 2, 0.7)

	--빨간원(right,idle,idle)(jump1회) : 볼트님이 방해전파발생기까지 가는길을 막으라고 했는데?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	character_util.normal_jump(invader_1, '01_jump_01')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(invader_1, 'qs_crosselle_pre_2')

	--파란원(left,idle,idle)(release 1회) : 일단 임시로 닫힌 척 해두자, 아직 할일이 많아.
	scene_util.set_release_anim(invader_2, false)
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(invader_2, 'qs_crosselle_pre_3')
	character_util.remove_anim(invader_2)

	--빨간원(right,idle,idle)(nod1회) : 그래, 그쪽이 혼나는 것보다는 낫겠지.
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(invader_1, 'qs_crosselle_pre_4')

	start_coroutine(self.invaders_gone, self)

	self.get_door().Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)
end

function local_class:invaders_gone()
	local invader_1 = self.get_invader(1)
	local invader_2 = self.get_invader(2)

	local move_left_count = 2
	local move_done_cb = function(wp_index)
		if wp_index == 0 then
			move_left_count = move_left_count - 1
		end
	end

	--walk 모션 속도 2
	wp_util.move(invader_1, field_util.get_marker_pos('sub_crosselle_pre_invader_move'),
			5, nil, { run = true, callback = move_done_cb })
	wp_util.move(invader_2, field_util.get_marker_pos('sub_crosselle_pre_invader_move'),
			5, nil, { run = true, callback = move_done_cb })

	while move_left_count > 0 do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	self.eat_loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_clang_01', parent = invader_1, loop = true
	, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
	character_util.set_position(invader_1, field_util.get_marker_pos('sub_crosselle_pre_invader_work_1'))
	character_util.set_direction(invader_1, 'right')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(invader_1, 'eat')

	character_util.set_position(invader_2, field_util.get_marker_pos('sub_crosselle_pre_invader_work_2'))
	character_util.set_direction(invader_2, 'left')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(invader_2, 'eat')

	--좌측 공간으로 가면 콘솔에 eat 중인 기술자 뒤에서
	--암살 가능(빨간원 : right,idle,eat , 파란원 : left,idle,eat )
	character_util.convert_to_monster(invader_1)
	invader_1.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.MonsterAssassinateDamagedBehaviour.Create()
	invader_1.DamagedBehaviour.DeathCount = 1
	invader_1.DamagedBehaviour.ApplyAilment = false
	invader_1.DamagedBehaviour.ApplyBombDamage = false
	invader_1.DamagedBehaviour.ApplyOtherDamage = false
	invader_1.FieldObjectController.DontFight = true

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.FieldUITopHPBarIgnoreTargetEvent.Create(invader_1, true))

	character_util.convert_to_monster(invader_2)
	invader_2.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.MonsterAssassinateDamagedBehaviour.Create()
	invader_2.DamagedBehaviour.DeathCount = 1
	invader_2.DamagedBehaviour.ApplyAilment = false
	invader_2.DamagedBehaviour.ApplyBombDamage = false
	invader_2.DamagedBehaviour.ApplyOtherDamage = false
	invader_2.FieldObjectController.DontFight = true

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.FieldUITopHPBarIgnoreTargetEvent.Create(invader_2, true))

	self.need_marker_to_invaders = true

	self:try_show_marker_to_invaders()

function local_class:try_show_marker_to_invaders()
	if self.in_stage_hacking_acting then
		return
	end

	if not self.need_marker_to_invaders then
		return
	end

	local invader_1 = self.get_invader(1)
	local invader_2 = self.get_invader(2)

	--인베이더 기술자들 그리드 넘어가면 서브 퀘스트 마커 좌측 콘솔에 생성
	local marker_pos = (invader_1.Position + invader_2.Position) / 2

	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.quest_marker_key, marker_pos)
end

function local_class:start_check_assassinate()
	if not self.on_check_assassinate_routine and self.current_section_state == self.section_state.before_assassinate then
		self.on_check_assassinate_routine = true
		self.checking_assassinate = true
		start_coroutine(self.check_assassinate_routine, self)
	end
end

function local_class:stop_check_assassinate()
	self.checking_assassinate = false
end

function local_class:check_assassinate_routine()
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	while self.checking_assassinate do
		-- 암살하는게 감지되면 연출 시작
		if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.before_assassinate and
				lua_helper.type_compare(leader.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentState, CS.Oak.CharacterAssassinateState) then
			self.current_section_state = self.section_state.in_assassinate
			self:stop_check_assassinate()

			start_coroutine(self.assassinate_scene, self)
		end

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	self.on_check_assassinate_routine = false
end

function local_class:assassinate_scene()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()

	quest_marker_util.remove(self.quest_marker_key)
	self.need_marker_to_invaders = false

	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local invaders = {
		self.get_invader(1),
		self.get_invader(2),
	}

	while lua_helper.type_compare(leader.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentState, CS.Oak.CharacterAssassinateState) do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	while not invaders[1].FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead and not invaders[2].FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	local is_left_dead = invaders[1].FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead

	if is_left_dead then
		character_util.remove_anim(invaders[1])
	else
		character_util.remove_anim(invaders[2])
	end

	local second_invader = is_left_dead and invaders[2] or invaders[1]
	local second_origin_pos = second_invader.Position

	--이 때 먼저 죽인 인베이더 반대방향 QTE 진행

		lootstate = 'FixLooter', skip_text = true
	})

	map_item.ConsumeTarget = leader

	stage_util.new_stage_theatre_show({

		--인베이더 기술자가 떨군 지도.
		--방해전파 발생기의 위치가 표시되어 있다.
		substage_open_string_key = 'qs_crosselle_pre_5',

		substage_name = 'queenship_substage_crosselle',
	})

	quest_util.activate_quest(self.controller)

	field_ui_manager:Show()
	party_util.reset_controllers()

local local_class = newclass('QueenShipCrosselleSection1')

	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.available_stage_name = 'queenship_substage_crosselle'

	self.section_state = {
		opening = 1,
		before_invader_talk = 2,
		before_find_invaders = 3,
		found_invaders = 4,
	}

	self.current_section_state = self.section_state.opening

		return get_character('s1_invader_talk_' .. index)
	end

	self.invaders_talk_on = false
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
end

function local_class:enter()

end

function local_class:start()

end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.before_invader_talk and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's1_invader_talk') then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.before_find_invaders
		start_coroutine(self.invader_talk_scene, self)

		return true

	elseif self.current_section_state == self.section_state.before_find_invaders and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, get_party_leader()) and e.Zone.Name == 's1_find_invaders' then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.found_invaders
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(self.find_invaders_scene, self)

		return true
	end

	return false

local local_class = newclass('QueenShipCrosselleSection2')

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	-- 이 섹션이 유효한 스테이지 이름
	self.available_stage_name = 'queenship_substage_crosselle'

	self.get_console = function()
		return get_field_object('s2_hacking_console')
	end

	-- 섹션 내 스테이트 Enum
	self.section_state = {
		before_interact_console = 1,
		before_hack = 2,
		interacting_console = 3,
		in_hacking = 4,
		after_failed = 5,
		after_succeed = 6,
	}

	self.current_section_state = self.section_state.before_interact_console

	self.get_invader = function(index)
		return get_character('s2_invader_' .. index)
	end

	self.hacking_failed_count = 0

	self.quest_marker_key = 'crosselle_s2'

	self.hacking_mini_game_name = 'EnemyBallDodgeGame'

	self.hacking_mini_game_data_key = 'substage_crosselle_s2'

	self.in_screenplay = false
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent), 'on_mini_game_end_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')

	self.get_console().Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

	--이에 따라 하단 이벤트들도 C,D 인베이더 없도록 부탁드립니다.
	character_util.set_active_state(get_character('s2_invader_11'), 'disabled')
	character_util.set_active_state(get_character('s2_invader_12'), 'disabled')
end

function local_class:start()
	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.quest_marker_key, self.get_console())
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

	if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.in_hacking then
		mini_game_manager:DisposeMiniGame(self.hacking_mini_game_name)
	end

	self.get_console().Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter and e.Zone.Name == 's2_reset_puzzle_magnet_holdable' then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, get_field_object('s2_console_door_key')) or
				lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, get_field_object('s2_puzzle_magnet_holdable')) then
			message_system:SendSync(e.FieldObject, CS.Oak.GimmickResetEvent.Instance)
			return true
		end

		return false
	elseif not self.in_screenplay and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's2_block_go_down_stairs') then
		self.in_screenplay = true
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(self.try_go_down_stairs, self, e.Zone)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if (self.current_section_state == self.section_state.before_interact_console or
			self.current_section_state == self.section_state.before_hack) and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_console()) then
		local is_first_interact = self.current_section_state == self.section_state.before_interact_console

		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.interacting_console
		start_coroutine(self.try_hack_console, self, is_first_interact)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_mini_game_end_event(e)
	if e.Name ~= self.hacking_mini_game_name or self.current_section_state ~= self.section_state.in_hacking then
		return false
	end

	if e.Success then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.after_succeed
		start_coroutine(self.after_hacking_scene, self)
	else
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.after_failed
		self.hacking_failed_count = self.hacking_failed_count + 1
		start_coroutine(self.hacking_failed_scene, self)
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:try_go_down_stairs(zone)
	local crosselle = get_party_leader()
	--해당 파란존 진입시

	--크로셀 ( right,tired,bomb_idle) : 하… 이런 녀석들쯤 마음 같아서는…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.set_direction(crosselle, 'right')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(crosselle, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(crosselle, 'bomb_idle')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(crosselle, 'qs_crosselle_s2_26')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(crosselle)

	--이 후 뒷걸음치며 (left) 방향 0.5칸 이동
	character_util.set_locked_dir(crosselle, 'right')
	wp_util.move_async(crosselle, vector(zone.Bounds.min.x - 0.5, 0, crosselle.Position.z),
			1, nil, { y_mode = 'floor' })
	character_util.set_direction(crosselle, 'right')
	character_util.reset_locked_dir(crosselle)

	self.in_screenplay = false
end

function local_class:try_hack_console(is_first_interact)
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	character_util.hide_weapon(get_party_leader(), true)

	quest_marker_util.remove(self.quest_marker_key)

	-- 현재 해킹 실패 후 재시도가 아닌 경우에만 아래 이벤트 발동하도록 함
	if self.current_section_state ~= self.section_state.after_failed then
		--해킹콘솔(1) 인터랙트시 해킹콘솔 중앙에 정렬
		local console = self.get_console()
		self.controller:align_to_hacking_console(console)

		if is_first_interact then
			local crosselle = get_party_leader()

			--크로셀(right,idle,eat) 1초 후
			local eat_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_typing_01', loop = true })
			character_util.set_direction(crosselle, 'right')
			scene_util.set_anim_loop(crosselle, 'eat')
			wait_for_sec(1.5)
			character_util.remove_emotion(crosselle)
			eat_sfx:Stop()

			--크로셀(right,idle,question) (...) 이모션
			scene_util.set_question_anim(crosselle, true)
			character_util.show_emoticon_async(crosselle, nil, 'silence')
			character_util.remove_anim(crosselle)

			--크로셀(up,idle,idle) : 이건 방송장비 네요.
			scene_util.set_direction(crosselle, 'up')
			scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(crosselle, 'qs_crosselle_s2_1')

			--크로셀(up,idle,idle) : 방금까지도 사용한 내역이 있어요.
			scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(crosselle, 'qs_crosselle_s2_2')

			--크로셀(right,doyagao,idle)(nod1회) : 방송이라… 좋은 생각이 났군요.
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gatcha_point_01')
			scene_util.set_direction(crosselle, 'right')
			scene_util.set_emotion_loop(crosselle, 'doyagao')
			scene_util.nod_the_head(crosselle, 1)
			scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(crosselle, 'qs_crosselle_s2_3')
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(crosselle)
		end

		character_util.set_direction(get_party_leader(), 'up')
	end

	--해킹을 시작한다. ( 보라색 선택지 )
	--잠시 대기한다. ( 흰색 선택지 )
	local result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		{ 'qs_crosselle_s2_5', 'forced' },
		{ 'qs_crosselle_s2_4', 'normal' },
	})

	if result == 2 then
		--컨트롤 복귀
		--복귀 후 콘솔인터랙트 시 바로 선택지로
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.before_hack

		quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.quest_marker_key, self.get_console())

		character_util.hide_weapon(get_party_leader(), false)

		party_util.reset_controllers()
		field_ui_manager:Show()

		return
	end

	local console_pos = self.controller:get_object_center_pos(self.get_console())

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_qte_action_wind_02')

	camera_util.move(console_pos, 1, { ignorecameragrids = true })
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(2, 1)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	screen_util.fade_out_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(0, 'linear')

	-- 해킹 액팅
	self.current_section_state = self.section_state.in_hacking

	local is_mini_game_load_complete = false

	mini_game_manager:LoadResource(self.hacking_mini_game_name, self.hacking_mini_game_data_key, function()
		is_mini_game_load_complete = true
	end)

	-- 미니게임이 로드 다되면
	while not is_mini_game_load_complete do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	mini_game_manager:StartMiniGame(self.hacking_mini_game_name)
end

function local_class:hacking_failed_scene()
	--해킹액팅(1)
	mini_game_manager:DisposeMiniGame(self.hacking_mini_game_name)

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0)

	--페이드 아웃 / 페이드 인 후
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	self.current_section_state = self.section_state.before_hack

	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.quest_marker_key, self.get_console())

	--컨트롤 풀린 상태로 크로셀로 복귀
	character_util.hide_weapon(get_party_leader(), false)

	party_util.reset_controllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()
end

	scene_util.set_release_anim(invaders[1], nil, true)

	character_util.remove_anim(invaders[1])

	local move_done_count = 0
	local move_done_cb_generator = function(wp_count)

				move_done_count = move_done_count - 1

		end
	end

	--인베이더 3번과 옆에 있는 인베이더가 위로 올라가
	wp_util.move(invaders[5], field_util.get_marker_pos('s2_invader_5_wp_1'), 2.5, nil,

	switch_button.localPosition = vector(0, -0.08, 0)

	while move_done_count > 0 do

	local move_end_x = field_util.get_marker_pos('s2_invader_move_end_center').x
	local invader_wps = {

		{

			field_util.get_marker_pos('s2_invader_group_2_wp_2'),
			field_util.get_marker_pos('s2_invader_group_2_wp_3'),
			field_util.get_marker_pos('s2_invader_group_2_wp_4'),
		},
		{
			field_util.get_marker_pos('s2_invader_group_2_wp_1'),
			field_util.get_marker_pos('s2_invader_group_2_wp_2'),
			field_util.get_marker_pos('s2_invader_group_2_wp_3'),
			field_util.get_marker_pos('s2_invader_group_2_wp_4'),
		},

		{
			field_util.get_marker_pos('s2_invader_5_wp_2'),
			field_util.get_marker_pos('s2_invader_5_wp_3'),
		},
		{
			field_util.get_marker_pos('s2_invader_6_wp_2'),
			field_util.get_marker_pos('s2_invader_6_wp_3'),
		},

		{
			vector(move_end_x, 0, invaders[7].Position.z)
		},
		{
			vector(move_end_x, 0, invaders[8].Position.z)
		},

		{
			field_util.get_marker_pos('s2_invader_group_5_wp_1'),
			field_util.get_marker_pos('s2_invader_group_5_wp_2'),
			field_util.get_marker_pos('s2_invader_group_5_wp_3'),
		},
		{
			field_util.get_marker_pos('s2_invader_group_5_wp_1'),

	wait_for_sec(0.3 / 3.5)
	switch_button.localPosition = vector(0, 0, 0)

	--퇴장 시작후 2초 후

	--크로셀에게 카메라 복귀

local local_class = newclass('QueenShipCrosselleSection4')
local sub_section_base = newclass('QueenShipCrosselleSection4_SubSectionBase')
local sub_section_upper = newclass('QueenShipCrosselleSection4_SubSectionUpper', sub_section_base)
local sub_section_lower = newclass('QueenShipCrosselleSection4_SubSectionLower', sub_section_base)

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	-- 이 섹션이 유효한 스테이지 이름
	self.available_stage_name = 'queenship_substage_crosselle'

	self.cleared_sub_section_count = 0

	self.sub_section = {
		upper = sub_section_upper(self, 's4_sub_section_upper_done'),
		lower = sub_section_lower(self, 's4_sub_section_lower_done'),
	}

	self.hacking_mini_game_name = 'EnemyBallDodgeGame'
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	if not self.sub_section.upper:is_done() then
		self.sub_section.upper:on_pre_load()
	end

	if not self.sub_section.lower:is_done() then
		self.sub_section.lower:on_pre_load()
	end
end

function local_class:enter()
	if not self.sub_section.upper:is_done() then
		self.sub_section.upper:enter()
	end

	if not self.sub_section.lower:is_done() then
		self.sub_section.lower:enter()
	end
end

function local_class:start()
	if not self.sub_section.upper:is_done() then
		self.sub_section.upper:start()
	end

	if not self.sub_section.lower:is_done() then
		self.sub_section.lower:start()
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	if not self.sub_section.upper:is_done() then
		self.sub_section.upper:exit()
	end

	if not self.sub_section.lower:is_done() then
		self.sub_section.lower:exit()
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.sub_section.upper:dispose()
	self.sub_section.upper = nil

	self.sub_section.lower:dispose()
	self.sub_section.lower = nil

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if not self.sub_section.upper:is_done() then
		self.sub_section.upper:on_event(e)
	end

	if not self.sub_section.lower:is_done() then
		self.sub_section.lower:on_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:toggle_other_quest_marker(section_name, on)
	if section_name == 'upper' and not self.sub_section.lower:is_done() then
		self.sub_section.lower:toggle_quest_marker(on)
	elseif section_name == 'lower' and not self.sub_section.upper:is_done() then
		self.sub_section.upper:toggle_quest_marker(on)
	end
end

function local_class:is_both_sub_section_done()
	return self.sub_section.upper:is_done() and self.sub_section.lower:is_done()
end

--region Sub Section Base
function sub_section_base:init(parent_section, data_key)
	self.parent_section = parent_section
	self.controller = parent_section.controller
	self.data_key = data_key

	self.section_done_data_val = 1
end

function sub_section_base:on_pre_load()
end

function sub_section_base:enter()
end

function sub_section_base:start()
end

function sub_section_base:exit()
end

function sub_section_base:dispose()
	self.parent_section = nil
end

function sub_section_base:is_done()
	return quest_util.get_custom_state(self.controller.quest_progress, self.data_key) ==
			self.section_done_data_val
end

function sub_section_base:progress_section(this)
	quest_util.set_custom_state(self.controller.quest_progress, self.data_key,
			self.section_done_data_val)

	this:exit()

	if self.parent_section:is_both_sub_section_done() then
		quest_util.progress_section(self.controller)
	end
end

function sub_section_base:toggle_quest_marker(on)
end

function sub_section_base:on_event(e)
	return false
end

--endregion Sub Section Base

--region Upper Sub Section
function sub_section_upper:init(parent_section, data_key)
	self.super:init(parent_section, data_key)

	self.get_console = function()
		return get_field_object('s4_hacking_console_upper')
	end

	self.section_state = {
		before_interact_console = 1,
		before_hacking = 2,
		interacting_console = 3,
		in_hacking = 4,
		after_failed = 5,
		after_succeed = 6,
		before_meet_pymon = 7,
		meeting_pymon = 8,
	}

	self.current_section_state = self.section_state.before_interact_console

	self.quest_marker_key = 'crosselle_s4_upper'

	self.hacking_mini_game_data_key = 'substage_crosselle_s4_upper'

	self.meet_pymon_zone_name = 's4_upper_meet_pymon'

	self.get_fx_flame_rush_loop = function()
		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_flame_rush_loop')
	end

	self.get_fx_flame_rush_end = function()
		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_flame_rush_end')
	end

	self.get_fx_flame_area = function()
		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_flame_area')
	end

	self.get_fx_lasthit = function()
		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_lasthit')
	end
	self.get_fx_obj_smoke = function()
		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_obj_smoke')
	end
end

function sub_section_upper:on_pre_load()
	self.super:on_pre_load()

	self.get_fx_flame_rush_loop()
	self.get_fx_flame_rush_end()
	self.get_fx_flame_area()
	self.get_fx_lasthit()
	self.get_fx_obj_smoke()
end

function sub_section_upper:enter()
	self.super:enter()

	--위에 해킹콘솔(2)에 메인퀘스트 마커
	self:toggle_quest_marker(true)

	self.get_console().Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent), 'on_mini_game_end_event')
end

function sub_section_upper:start()
	self.super:start()

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.LinkDoorEvent.Create('pink', false, true))
end

function sub_section_upper:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent))

	self.super:exit()
end

function sub_section_upper:dispose()
	self.super:dispose()
end

function sub_section_upper:is_done()
	return self.super:is_done()
end

function sub_section_upper:on_event(e)
	return self.super:on_event(e)
end

function sub_section_upper:on_interact_event(e)
	if (self.current_section_state == self.section_state.before_interact_console or
			self.current_section_state == self.section_state.before_hacking) and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_console()) then
		local is_first_interact = self.current_section_state == self.section_state.before_interact_console

		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.interacting_console
		start_coroutine(self.try_hack_console, self, is_first_interact)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function sub_section_upper:on_mini_game_end_event(e)
	if e.Name ~= self.parent_section.hacking_mini_game_name
			or self.current_section_state ~= self.section_state.in_hacking then
		return false
	end

	if e.Success then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.after_succeed
		start_coroutine(self.after_hacking_scene, self)
	else
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.after_failed
		start_coroutine(self.hacking_failed_scene, self)
	end

	return true
end

function sub_section_upper:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.before_meet_pymon and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.meet_pymon_zone_name) then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.meeting_pymon
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(self.meet_pymon, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function sub_section_upper:toggle_quest_marker(on)
	if on then
		if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.before_meet_pymon then
			quest_marker_util.show(self.controller,
					self.quest_marker_key, field_util.get_marker_pos('s4_upper_meet_pymon_quest_marker'))
		else
			quest_marker_util.show(self.controller,
					self.quest_marker_key, self.get_console())
		end
	else
		quest_marker_util.remove(self.quest_marker_key)
	end
end

function sub_section_upper:try_hack_console(is_first_interact)
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	character_util.hide_weapon(get_party_leader(), true)

	self:toggle_quest_marker(false)
	self.parent_section:toggle_other_quest_marker('upper', false)

	if self.current_section_state ~= self.section_state.after_failed then
		--해킹 콘솔 인터랙트
		--콘솔중앙에 정렬
		local console = self.get_console()

		--복귀 후 콘솔인터랙트 시 바로 선택지로
		if is_first_interact then
			self.controller:align_to_hacking_console(console)

			local crosselle = get_party_leader()

			--크로셀(right,eat,idle) 1초 후
			local eat_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_typing_01', loop = true })
			character_util.set_direction(crosselle, 'right')
			scene_util.set_anim_loop(crosselle, 'eat')
			wait_for_sec(1.5)
			character_util.remove_emotion(crosselle)
			eat_sfx:Stop()

			--크로셀(up,idle,idle)(nod1화) : 회로를 대조해보니 이 제어장치가 맞는 것 같네요.
			scene_util.set_direction(crosselle, 'up')
			scene_util.nod_the_head(crosselle, 1, nil, true)
			scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(crosselle, 'qs_crosselle_s4_1')

			--크로셀(up,idle,idle) : 좋아요, 시작하죠.
			scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(crosselle, 'qs_crosselle_s4_2')
		else
			self.controller:align_to_hacking_console(console, true)
		end
	end

	--해킹을 시작한다. ( 보라색 선택지 )
	--잠시 대기한다. ( 흰색 선택지 )
	local result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		{ 'qs_crosselle_s4_4', 'forced' },
		{ 'qs_crosselle_s4_3', 'normal' },
	})

	--컨트롤 복귀
	if result == 2 then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.before_hacking

		self:toggle_quest_marker(true)
		self.parent_section:toggle_other_quest_marker('upper', true)

		character_util.hide_weapon(get_party_leader(), false)

		field_ui_manager:Show()
		party_util.reset_controllers()

		return
	end

	--해킹액팅(2) 실행
	local console_pos = self.controller:get_object_center_pos(self.get_console())

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_qte_action_wind_02')

	camera_util.move(console_pos, 1, { ignorecameragrids = true })
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(2, 1)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	screen_util.fade_out_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(0, 'linear')

	-- 해킹 액팅
	self.current_section_state = self.section_state.in_hacking

	local is_mini_game_load_complete = false

	mini_game_manager:LoadResource(self.parent_section.hacking_mini_game_name, self.hacking_mini_game_data_key, function()
		is_mini_game_load_complete = true
	end)

	-- 미니게임이 로드 다되면
	while not is_mini_game_load_complete do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	mini_game_manager:StartMiniGame(self.parent_section.hacking_mini_game_name)
end

function sub_section_upper:hacking_failed_scene()
	mini_game_manager:DisposeMiniGame(self.parent_section.hacking_mini_game_name)

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0)

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	self.current_section_state = self.section_state.before_hacking

	self:toggle_quest_marker(true)
	self.parent_section:toggle_other_quest_marker('upper', true)

	character_util.hide_weapon(get_party_leader(), false)

	field_ui_manager:Show()
	party_util.reset_controllers()
end

function sub_section_upper:after_hacking_scene()
	--액팅 성공 시
	local crosselle = get_party_leader()

	mini_game_manager:DisposeMiniGame(self.parent_section.hacking_mini_game_name)

	self.get_console().Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0)

	--페이드인
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	--나레이션 박스
	--보안장치의 일부를 장악했다.
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'qs_crosselle_s4_6' })

	local door_name = 's4_door_upper'
	local door = get_field_object(door_name)

	--해당 빨간 도어를 중심으로 카메라가 이동되어있고
	camera_util.move_async(self.controller:get_object_center_pos(door), 0.7)

	character_util.set_direction(crosselle, 'right')

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create(door_name, false))

	--재생시작 1초 후
	wait_for_sec(2)

	--크로셀에게 카메라 복귀
	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.7)

	--크로셀 (right,sleep_deep,(nod0.5속도)) : 후우…
	local speech_done = false
