		scene_util.set_anim_non_loop(crosselle, 'nod', { scale = 0.5 })
		wait_for_sec(0.6)

		if not speech_done then
			scene_util.set_anim_non_loop(crosselle, 'nod', { scale = 0, mix_duration = 999 })
		end
	end)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(crosselle, 'sleep_deep')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(crosselle, 'qs_crosselle_s4_upper_0_1')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(crosselle)
	speech_done = true

	--크로셀 (right,tired,bomb_idle) : 마신인 제가 이깟 고철에 이렇게까지 익숙해질 줄은…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(crosselle, 'tired')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(crosselle, 'bomb_idle')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(crosselle, 'qs_crosselle_s4_upper_0_2')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(crosselle)

	--크로셀(right,attack,cast) : 이 여자가 제게 순순히 육신의 통제권을 넘길때부터 알아 채야 했는데!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(crosselle, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(crosselle, 'cast')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(crosselle, 'qs_crosselle_s4_upper_0_3')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(crosselle)

	--크로셀 (right,mad,cast2)(shake0.1) : 도대체 하루 20시간을 콘솔을 붙잡고 일하는 마족이 어디에…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_angry_01')
	scene_util.shake(crosselle, 0.02, 0.3)
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(crosselle, 'mad')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(crosselle, 'cast2')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(crosselle, 'qs_crosselle_s4_upper_0_4')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(crosselle)

	--크로셀 숙주 (right,doyagao,bomb_idle) : 크로셀, 좋다고 계약한 건 당신 아닌가요?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_unlock_02')
	self.controller:talk_crosselle_host()
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(crosselle, 'doyagao')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(crosselle, 'bomb_idle')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(crosselle, 'qs_crosselle_s4_upper_0_5')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(crosselle)

	--크로셀 숙주 (right,surprise,cast)(jump1회) : 설마 마신이나 되시는 분이 제대로 확인도 안 하고 계약하신 건 아니겠죠?
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(crosselle, 'surprise')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(crosselle, 'cast')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(crosselle, 'qs_crosselle_s4_upper_0_6')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(crosselle)

	--크로셀 숙주(right,doyagao,bomb_idle) : 통제권을 가지시는만큼 제 일도 가져가시기로 했잖아요?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(crosselle, 'doyagao')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(crosselle, 'bomb_idle')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(crosselle, 'qs_crosselle_s4_upper_0_7')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(crosselle)

	--크로셀 숙주(right,sleep_deep,cross_arm) : 물론 당신이 깨먹은 명품들만큼 당신일이 더 많아지긴 했지만요.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(crosselle, 'sleep_deep')
	scene_util.set_cross_arm_anim(crosselle)
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(crosselle, 'qs_crosselle_s4_upper_0_8')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(crosselle)
	self.controller:talk_end_crosselle_host()

	--크로셀(right,damaged,idle)(shake0.1) 1초
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(crosselle, 'damaged')
	scene_util.shake(crosselle, 0.03, 1)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--크로셀(right,sleep_deep,(nod0.5속도)) : 하아…
	speech_done = false

	start_coroutine(function()
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		scene_util.set_anim_non_loop(crosselle, 'nod', { scale = 0.5 })
		wait_for_sec(0.6)

		if not speech_done then
			scene_util.set_anim_non_loop(crosselle, 'nod', { scale = 0, mix_duration = 999 })
		end
	end)

	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(crosselle, 'sleep_deep')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(crosselle, 'qs_crosselle_s4_upper_0_9')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(crosselle)
	speech_done = true

	--크로셀(right,tired,bomb_idle) : 그래요. 제 실수네요.
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(crosselle, 'tired')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(crosselle, 'bomb_idle')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(crosselle, 'qs_crosselle_s4_upper_0_10')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(crosselle)

	self.current_section_state = self.section_state.before_meet_pymon

	--파란 화살표에 서브 퀘스트 마커
	self:toggle_quest_marker(true)
	self.parent_section:toggle_other_quest_marker('upper', true)

	character_util.hide_weapon(get_party_leader(), false)

	field_ui_manager:Show()
	party_util.reset_controllers()
end

function sub_section_upper:meet_pymon()
	--상단 서브 퀘스트 마커 소멸
	self:toggle_quest_marker(false)

	local crosselle = get_party_leader()

	--빨간존 진입시
	--크로셀(right,attack,idle)(jump1회) (!) 이모션 박스
	scene_util.set_direction(crosselle, 'right')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(crosselle, 'attack')
	character_util.normal_jump(crosselle, '01_player_jump_01')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--해당 파란색 원 위치로 점프(left,attack,idle)
	start_coroutine(function()
		local dodge_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s4_upper_crosselle_dodge')
		local dodge_dur = (crosselle.Position - dodge_pos).magnitude / 5

		scene_util.set_anim_loop(crosselle, 'get')
		character_util.jump(crosselle, 1, dodge_dur)
		character_util.move_to_async(crosselle, dodge_pos, dodge_dur, nil, true)
		character_util.remove_anim(crosselle)
		character_util.set_direction(crosselle, 'right')
	end)

	--점프와 동시에 오른쪽에서 달려오는 파이몬에게 카메라 이동 (속도 3)
	local pymon = self.controller.get_pymon()
	local pymon_appear_start = field_util.get_marker_pos('s4_upper_pymon_appear_start')
	local pymon_appear_end = field_util.get_marker_pos('s4_upper_pymon_appear_end')

	camera_util.move(pymon_appear_end, 0.3)

	character_util.set_position(pymon, pymon_appear_start)

	--전용 이펙트인 (fx_flame_rush) 사용
	local flame_area_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_fire_02', loop = false, parent = pymon })
	local flame_area_effect = self.get_fx_flame_area():Instantiate(pymon.Position,
			unity_class.quaternion.identity, pymon.Transform)

	local flame_loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_fire_01', loop = false, parent = pymon })
	local flame_loop_effect = self.get_fx_flame_rush_loop():Instantiate(pymon.Position,
			unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 180, 0), pymon.Transform)

	--파이몬(left,idle,run) : 우오오오오!!!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_charge_fire_01')

	music_player:PlayDialogue('qs_crosselle_s4_upper_1')

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(pymon, {
		key = 'qs_crosselle_s4_upper_1',
		keep_display = true,
		type_speed = 0,
		dialogue = false,
	})

	local pymon_move_done = false

	--화면 0.1 shake 1초 와 스모크 이펙트
	camera_util.shake(0.1, 99999)

	local break_obj_appear = {}

	for i = 1, self.controller.s4_pymon_break_appear_count do
		break_obj_appear[i] = self.controller.get_s4_pymon_break_appear(i)
	end

	local break_count_left = self.controller.s4_pymon_break_appear_count

	wp_util.move(pymon, pymon_appear_end, 8, nil, { run = true, callback = function(wp_index)
		pymon_move_done = wp_index == 0
		camera_util.cancel_shake()

		flame_loop_effect:Dispose()
		flame_loop_sfx:Stop()
		flame_area_sfx:Stop()

		local rush_end_efttect = self.get_fx_flame_rush_end():Instantiate(pymon_appear_end)
		rush_end_efttect.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 180, 0)

		speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(pymon)
	end })

	--기존 메인에 쓰이는 것과 동일하게 연출 부탁드립니다. (섹션 19 영상)

	--초록존 안에 테이블/의자들과 미는 돌 포함한 오브젝트들 전부 사라짐
	while break_count_left > 0 do
		for i = 1, #break_obj_appear do
			local fo = break_obj_appear[i]
			if fo.ActiveState == active_state('enabled') and fo.Bounds.max.x >= pymon.Position.x - 0.5 then
				fo.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
				camera_util.shake(0.15, 0.2)
				self.get_fx_lasthit():Instantiate(fo.Position + (pymon.Position - fo.Position).normalized)
				self.get_fx_obj_smoke():Instantiate(self.controller:get_object_center_pos(fo))

				if break_count_left == 2 then
					music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_rock_break_02')
				else
					music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_rock_break_03')
				end

				break_count_left = break_count_left - 1
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	--(해당 사라진 오브젝트들은 이벤트 끝난 후 계속 사라진 상태로)

	while not pymon_move_done do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	--스모크 모션 사라진 후
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--파이몬 해당 위치에 서있고 (left,idle,idle)
	--(right)(left)(right) 0.5초간격으로 본 후
	scene_util.look_around(pymon, { 'right', 'left', 'right' }, nil, 0.8)

	--(right,idle,question) 고개숙인상태 유지
	scene_util.set_question_anim(pymon)
	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	--크로셀(tired)표정으로 (right) 상태
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(crosselle, 'tired')

	--해당 모션 (question) 시작될때 왼쪽 크로셀에게 카메라 이동
	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.7)

	--카메라 크로셀에게 도착 후 (left)(right) 후
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(crosselle, 'bomb_idle')
	scene_util.look_around(crosselle, { 'left', 'right' }, nil, 0.8)
	character_util.remove_anim(crosselle)

	--크로셀 (down,tired,idle)(nod 1회 (0.5속도)) : 후우… 다행히 코트는 무사하네요.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.set_direction(crosselle, 'down')
	scene_util.set_anim_non_loop(crosselle, 'nod', { scale = 0.5, remove_after = 1 })
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(crosselle, 'qs_crosselle_s4_upper_2')
	character_util.remove_anim(crosselle)

	--크로셀(tired) 표정으로 파이몬 옆까지 이동
	wp_util.move_async(crosselle, {
		crosselle.Position + vector(0, 0, -1),
		vector(pymon.Position.x - 1.5, 0, crosselle.Position.z - 1),
		pymon.Position + vector(-1.5, 0, 0)
	}, 3, nil, { last_direction = 'right' })

	character_util.remove_emotion(crosselle)

	flame_area_effect:Dispose()

	--도착 후
	--파이몬(right,idle,bomb_idle) : 여기는 또 어디인거지?
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(pymon, 'bomb_idle')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(pymon, 'qs_crosselle_s4_upper_3')
	character_util.remove_anim(pymon)

	--크로셀(right,attack,cross_arm) : 파이몬?
	--대사 동시에 파이몬 (right,attack,idle)(jump1회) (!) 이모션 버블
	local emoticon_start_time = unity_class.time.time
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_notice_01')
	character_util.show_emoticon(pymon, nil, 'notice')
	character_util.normal_jump(pymon, '01_jump_01')

	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(crosselle, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_cross_arm_anim(crosselle)
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(crosselle, 'qs_crosselle_s4_upper_4')
	character_util.remove_anim(crosselle)

	while unity_class.time.time - emoticon_start_time < 2.5 do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	scene_util.set_direction(pymon, 'left')
	wait_for_sec(0.7)

	--파이몬 (left,idle,release) : 오오! 크로셀 다시 만나 반갑군.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	scene_util.set_release_anim(pymon)
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(pymon, 'qs_crosselle_s4_upper_5')
	character_util.remove_anim(pymon)

	--파이몬 (left,idle,question) : 잠깐만… 그러고보니 네가 여기있다는 것은…?
	scene_util.set_question_anim(pymon)
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(pymon, 'qs_crosselle_s4_upper_5_1')
	character_util.remove_anim(pymon)

	--파이몬 (left,idle,cast2) : 이럴수가 내가 함선입구로 돌아와버렸구나!
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(3.5, 0.5)
	camera_util.move(pymon.Position, 0.5)
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(pymon, 'mad')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(pymon, 'cast2')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gatcha_point_01')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(pymon, 'qs_crosselle_s4_upper_5_2')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(pymon)
	camera_util.resize_to_default(0.5)
	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)

	--크로셀 (right,tired,bomb_idle ) : 하아… 파이몬 제가 안으로 들어온 겁니다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(crosselle, 'tired')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(crosselle, 'bomb_idle')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(crosselle, 'qs_crosselle_s4_upper_5_3')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(crosselle)

	character_util.show_emoticon_async(pymon, nil, 'question')

	--파이몬 (left,idle,bomb_idle) : 뭐라고? 자네는 매번 나서지 않고 숨어다니지 않나?
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(pymon, 'bomb_idle')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(pymon, 'qs_crosselle_s4_upper_5_4')
	character_util.remove_anim(pymon)

	--크로셀 (right,attack,bomb_idle) : 제가 숨어있었다고요? 무례하네요.
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(crosselle, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(crosselle, 'bomb_idle')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(crosselle, 'qs_crosselle_s4_upper_6')
	character_util.remove_anim(crosselle)

	--파이몬 (left,idle,idle) : 빙의된 후로 마력에 문제라도 생긴 것인가?
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(pymon, 'qs_crosselle_s4_upper_7')

	--파이몬 (left,tired,dance) : 요새는 어딘가 숨어서 이렇게 뭘 두드리더니 한숨만 쉬지 않던가?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(pymon, 'tired')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(pymon, 'dance')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(pymon, 'qs_crosselle_s4_upper_8')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(pymon)

	--크로셀 (right,tired,idle) (nod 0.5 속도로 고개숙인채 유지) : 하아…
	local speech_done = false
	start_coroutine(function()
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
		scene_util.set_anim_non_loop(crosselle, 'nod', { scale = 0.5 })
		wait_for_sec(0.6)

		if not speech_done then
			scene_util.set_anim_non_loop(crosselle, 'nod', { scale = 0, mix_duration = 999 })
		end
	end)

	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(crosselle, 'tired')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(crosselle, 'qs_crosselle_s4_upper_9')

	speech_done = true

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(crosselle)

	--파이몬 (left,smile,idle)(jump1회) : 맞아! 그런 느낌이였지!
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(pymon, 'smile')
	character_util.normal_jump(pymon, '01_jump_01')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(pymon, 'qs_crosselle_s4_upper_10')
	character_util.remove_emotion(pymon)

	--크로셀(right,tired,bomb_idle) : 걱정은 고맙지만, 그 쪽도 그럴처지는 아니지 않나요?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(crosselle, 'tired')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(crosselle, 'bomb_idle')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(crosselle, 'qs_crosselle_s4_upper_10_1')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(crosselle)

	--파이몬 (left,doyagao,bomb_idle) : 무슨 소리지? 내 활약을 계속 지켜 보지않았는가?
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(pymon, 'doyagao')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(pymon, 'bomb_idle')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(pymon, 'qs_crosselle_s4_upper_11')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(pymon)

	--파이몬 (left,smile,victort_get) : 물론 원래 힘에 비하면 아무것도 아니지만 하하하!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(pymon, 'smile')
	scene_util.set_anim_non_loop(pymon, 'victory_get')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(pymon, 'qs_crosselle_s4_upper_12')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(pymon)

	scene_util.set_anim_loop(pymon, 'cast2')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(pymon, 'qs_crosselle_s4_upper_25')

	character_util.show_emoticon_async(crosselle, nil, 'question')

	--크로셀(right,tired,bomb_idle) : 도대체 그게 무슨… 제가 반대로 알려줬다고요?

	--파이몬(left,idle,idle) : 크로셀 니가 분명히 반대로…
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(pymon, 'qs_crosselle_s4_upper_27')

	--파이몬 ( 숙주 ) (right,tired,release) : 파이몬! 단말기를 거꾸로 들고있잖아…

	--파이몬(left,mad,bow_idle )(jump1회): 이런 엄청난 비밀이 숨어있었다니!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gatcha_point_01')
	character_util.normal_jump(pymon, '01_jump_01')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(pymon, 'mad')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(pymon, 'qs_crosselle_s4_upper_28_1')
	character_util.spine_remove_attachment(pymon, '[base]weapon1')
	character_util.remove_anim(pymon)

	--파이몬(left,smile,victory_get) : 정말 재밌는 수수께끼였다! 크로셀!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(pymon, 'smile')
	scene_util.set_anim_non_loop(pymon, 'victory_get')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(pymon, 'qs_crosselle_s4_upper_29')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(pymon)

	--이때 카메라 파이몬에게 이동
	camera_util.move_async(pymon.Position, 0.3, { end_target = pymon })

	--파이몬 위로 달려서 퇴장 (경로 초록존에 오브젝트들 파괴)
	pymon_move_done = false

	--화면 0.1 shake 1초 와 스모크 이펙트
	local pymon_disappear_end = field_util.get_marker_pos('s4_upper_pymon_disappear_end')

	flame_area_effect = self.get_fx_flame_area():Instantiate(pymon.Position,
			unity_class.quaternion.identity, pymon.Transform)
	flame_loop_effect = self.get_fx_flame_rush_loop():Instantiate(pymon.Position,
			unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, -90, 0), pymon.Transform)

	local break_obj_disappear = {}

	for i = 1, self.controller.s4_pymon_break_disappear_count do
		break_obj_disappear[i] = self.controller.get_s4_pymon_break_disappear(i)
	end

	break_count_left = self.controller.s4_pymon_break_disappear_count

	camera_util.shake(0.1, 99999)

	--파이몬(up,idle,idle) : 하하하하하!!!
	flame_area_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_fire_02', loop = false, parent = pymon })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_lana_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_fire_slash_03')

	music_player:PlayDialogueLowerPriority('qs_crosselle_s4_upper_30')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(pymon, {
		key = 'qs_crosselle_s4_upper_30',
		keep_display = true,
		type_speed = 0,
		dialogue = false,
	})

	wp_util.move(pymon, pymon_disappear_end, 8, nil, { run = true, callback = function()
		pymon_move_done = true
		flame_area_sfx:FadeOut(2)

		camera_util.cancel_shake()
		speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(pymon)
	end })

	--기존 메인에 쓰이는 것과 동일하게 연출 부탁드립니다. (섹션 19 영상)

	--초록존 안에 테이블/의자들과 미는 돌 포함한 오브젝트들 전부 사라짐
	start_coroutine(function()
		character_util.set_direction(crosselle, 'up')
	end)

	while break_count_left > 0 do
		for i = 1, #break_obj_disappear do
			local fo = break_obj_disappear[i]
			if fo.ActiveState == active_state('enabled') and fo.Position.z <= pymon.Position.z + 1 then
				fo.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
				camera_util.shake(0.15, 0.2)
				self.get_fx_lasthit():Instantiate(fo.Position + (pymon.Position - fo.Position).normalized)
				self.get_fx_obj_smoke():Instantiate(self.controller:get_object_center_pos(fo))
				if break_count_left == self.controller.s4_pymon_break_disappear_count then
					music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_rock_break_02')
				end

				break_count_left = break_count_left - 1
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	local break_wall = self.controller.get_s4_pymon_break_disappear_wall()

	while break_wall.Bounds.min.z > pymon.Position.z - 0.5 do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_rock_break_03')
	camera_util.shake(0.25, 0.3)
	self.get_fx_lasthit():Instantiate(break_wall.Position + (pymon.Position - break_wall.Position).normalized)
	self.get_fx_obj_smoke():Instantiate(self.controller:get_object_center_pos(break_wall))

	self.controller:toggle_pymon_wall(true)

	while not pymon_move_done do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	--카메라 그리드에 걸리면 정지
	--파이몬 사라지면 크로셀에게 카메라 복귀
	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

	flame_loop_effect:Dispose()

	--크로셀(down,sleep_deep,idle)(nod 0.5속도 1회) : 후우…
	scene_util.set_direction(crosselle, 'down')

	speech_done = false
	start_coroutine(function()
		scene_util.set_anim_non_loop(crosselle, 'nod', { scale = 0.5 })
		wait_for_sec(0.6)

		if not speech_done then
			scene_util.set_anim_non_loop(crosselle, 'nod', { scale = 0, mix_duration = 999 })
		end
	end)

	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(crosselle, 'sleep_deep')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(crosselle, 'qs_crosselle_s4_upper_31')

	speech_done = true

	character_util.remove_anim(crosselle)

	--크로셀(down,tired,idle): 그냥 다 죽었으면 좋겠네요.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_angry_01')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(crosselle, 'tired')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(crosselle, 'qs_crosselle_s4_upper_32')
	character_util.remove_emotion(crosselle)

	flame_area_effect:Dispose()
	character_util.set_active_state(pymon, 'disabled')

	self.super:progress_section(self)
end

--region Lower Sub Section
function sub_section_lower:init(parent_section, data_key)
	self.super:init(parent_section, data_key)

	self.get_console = function()
		return get_field_object('s4_hacking_console_lower')
	end

	self.get_invader = function(index)
		return get_character('s4_lower_invader_' .. index)
	end

	self.section_state = {
		before_interact_console = 1,
		before_hacking = 2,
		interacting_console = 3,
		in_hacking = 4,
		after_failed = 5,
		after_succeed = 6,
		before_meet_andras = 7,
		meeting_andras = 8,
	}

	self.current_section_state = self.section_state.before_interact_console

	self.quest_marker_key = 'crosselle_s4_lower'

	self.hacking_mini_game_data_key = 'substage_crosselle_s4_lower'

	self.meet_andras_zone_name = 's4_lower_meet_andras'

	self.get_fx_slash_hit = function()
		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_event_demonslayer_dash_hit')
	end

	self.get_fx_dash = function()
		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_event_demonslayer_dash')
	end

	self.get_fx_iceflower = function()
		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_iceflower')
	end
end

function sub_section_lower:on_pre_load()
	self.super:on_pre_load()

	self.get_fx_slash_hit()
	self.get_fx_dash()
	self.get_fx_iceflower()
end

function sub_section_lower:enter()
	self.super:enter()

	--해킹콘솔(3)에 메인퀘스트 마커
	self:toggle_quest_marker(true)

	self.get_console().Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

	for i = 1, 4 do
		local npc = self.get_invader(i)

		character_util.set_active_state(npc, 'enabled')
		scene_util.set_anim_loop(npc, 'sleep')
		scene_util.set_emotion_loop(npc, 'sleep')
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent), 'on_mini_game_end_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
end

function sub_section_lower:start()
	self.super:start()

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.LinkDoorEvent.Create('green', false, true))
end

function sub_section_lower:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

	self.super:exit()
end

function sub_section_lower:dispose()
	self.super:dispose()
end

function sub_section_lower:is_done()
	return self.super:is_done()
end

function sub_section_lower:on_event(e)
	return self.super:on_event(e)
end

function sub_section_lower:on_interact_event(e)
	if (self.current_section_state == self.section_state.before_interact_console or
			self.current_section_state == self.section_state.before_hacking) and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_console()) then
		local is_first_interact = self.current_section_state == self.section_state.before_interact_console

		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.interacting_console
		start_coroutine(self.try_hack_console, self, is_first_interact)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function sub_section_lower:on_mini_game_end_event(e)
	if e.Name ~= self.parent_section.hacking_mini_game_name
			or self.current_section_state ~= self.section_state.in_hacking then
		return false
	end

	if e.Success then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.after_succeed
		start_coroutine(self.after_hacking_scene, self)
	else
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.after_failed
		start_coroutine(self.hacking_failed_scene, self)
	end

	return true
end

function sub_section_lower:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.before_meet_andras and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.meet_andras_zone_name) then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.meeting_andras
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(self.meet_andras, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function sub_section_lower:toggle_quest_marker(on)
	if on then
		if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.before_meet_andras then
			quest_marker_util.show(self.controller,
					self.quest_marker_key, field_util.get_marker_pos('s4_lower_meet_andras_quest_marker'))
		else
			quest_marker_util.show(self.controller,
					self.quest_marker_key, self.get_console())
		end
	else
		quest_marker_util.remove(self.quest_marker_key)
	end
end

function sub_section_lower:try_hack_console(is_first_interact)
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	character_util.hide_weapon(get_party_leader(), true)

	self:toggle_quest_marker(false)
	self.parent_section:toggle_other_quest_marker('lower', false)

	if self.current_section_state ~= self.section_state.after_failed then
		--해킹 콘솔 인터랙트
		--콘솔중앙에 정렬
		local console = self.get_console()

		--복귀 후 콘솔인터랙트 시 바로 선택지로
		if is_first_interact then

			self.controller:align_to_hacking_console(console)

			local crosselle = get_party_leader()

			--크로셀(right,eat,idle) 1초 후
			local eat_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_typing_01', loop = true })

			character_util.set_direction(crosselle, 'right')
			scene_util.set_anim_loop(crosselle, 'eat')
			wait_for_sec(1.5)
			character_util.remove_emotion(crosselle)
			eat_sfx:Stop()

			--크로셀(up,idle,idle)(nod1화) : 회로를 대조해보니 이 제어장치가 맞는 것 같네요.
			scene_util.set_direction(crosselle, 'up')
			scene_util.nod_the_head(crosselle, 1, nil, true)
			scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(crosselle, 'qs_crosselle_s4_1')

			--크로셀(up,idle,idle) : 좋아요, 시작하죠.
			scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(crosselle, 'qs_crosselle_s4_2')
		else
			self.controller:align_to_hacking_console(console, true)
		end
	end

	--해킹을 시작한다. ( 보라색 선택지 )
	--잠시 대기한다. ( 흰색 선택지 )
	local result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		{ 'qs_crosselle_s4_4', 'forced' },
		{ 'qs_crosselle_s4_3', 'normal' },
	})

	--컨트롤 복귀
	if result == 2 then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.before_hacking

		self:toggle_quest_marker(true)
		self.parent_section:toggle_other_quest_marker('lower', true)

		character_util.hide_weapon(get_party_leader(), false)

		field_ui_manager:Show()
		party_util.reset_controllers()

		return
	end

	--해킹액팅(2) 실행
	local console_pos = self.controller:get_object_center_pos(self.get_console())

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_qte_action_wind_02')

	camera_util.move(console_pos, 1, { ignorecameragrids = true })
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(2, 1)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	screen_util.fade_out_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(0, 'linear')

	-- 해킹 액팅
	self.current_section_state = self.section_state.in_hacking

	local is_mini_game_load_complete = false

	mini_game_manager:LoadResource(self.parent_section.hacking_mini_game_name, self.hacking_mini_game_data_key, function()
		is_mini_game_load_complete = true
	end)

	-- 미니게임이 로드 다되면
	while not is_mini_game_load_complete do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	mini_game_manager:StartMiniGame(self.parent_section.hacking_mini_game_name)
end

function sub_section_lower:hacking_failed_scene()
	mini_game_manager:DisposeMiniGame(self.parent_section.hacking_mini_game_name)

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0)

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	self.current_section_state = self.section_state.before_hacking

	self:toggle_quest_marker(true)
	self.parent_section:toggle_other_quest_marker('lower', true)

	character_util.hide_weapon(get_party_leader(), false)

	field_ui_manager:Show()
	party_util.reset_controllers()
end

function sub_section_lower:meet_andras()
	local crosselle = get_party_leader()
	local andras = self.controller.get_andras()

	self:toggle_quest_marker(false)

	local scared_invader = get_character('s4_lower_scared_invader')
	local invaders = {
		self.get_invader(1),
		self.get_invader(2),
		self.get_invader(3),
		self.get_invader(4),
	}

	local right_appear_center = field_util.get_marker_pos('s4_lower_meet_andras_right_appear_center')
	local switch_pos = get_field_object('s4_meet_andras_lower_switch').Position

	--빨간색 존 진입시 이벤트
	--크로셀 (up,idle,idle) 상태
	camera_util.move(switch_pos, 1)
	wp_util.move(crosselle, field_util.get_marker_pos('s4_lower_meet_andras_crosselle_align_1'),
			2, nil, { last_direction = 'up' })

	character_util.set_position(scared_invader, vector(right_appear_center.x, 0, switch_pos.z))

	local move_done_left = 0
	local move_done_cb_generator = function(wp_count)
		return function(wp_index)
			if wp_index == wp_count - 1 then
				move_done_left = move_done_left - 1
			end
		end
	end

	local wait_move_done = function()
		while move_done_left > 0 do
			coroutine.yield()
		end
	end

	--카메라 초록원 인베이더 따라 이동
	--초록원 (qs_solder_normal)(left,scared,idle) : 빨리! 빨리!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(scared_invader, 'scared')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(scared_invader,
			{ key = 'qs_crosselle_s4_lower_1', keep_display = true, type_speed = 0, bubble_direction = 'lt' })

	wp_util.move_async(scared_invader, switch_pos, 5, nil, { run = true, play_sfx = true })

	local door_name = 's4_lower_meet_andras_door'
	local door_open_dur = 1.7
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create(door_name, false))

	local door_open_start_time = unity_class.time.time

	--버튼위에 올라서면 (left,scared,cast)(jump 2회) 도어 열리는 애니메이션
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(scared_invader, 'cast')

	character_util.normal_jump(scared_invader, '01_small_jump_01')
	wait_for_sec(0.3)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_switch_button_01')

	character_util.normal_jump(scared_invader, '01_small_jump_01')
	wait_for_sec(0.3)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_switch_button_01')

	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(scared_invader)

	while unity_class.time.time - door_open_start_time < door_open_dur do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	character_util.remove_anim(scared_invader)

	stage_camera:SetTarget(scared_invader)

	wp_util.move_async(scared_invader,
			field_util.get_marker_pos('s4_lower_meet_andras_scared_invader_align'), 5)
	character_util.remove_emotion(scared_invader)

	--(left,idle,release) shout 말풍선 : 기상!! 기상!!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_count_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_camera_emphasize_01')

	camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.3)
	scene_util.set_release_anim(scared_invader)

	--파란원 인베이더들 (right,seat,idle)
	for i = 1, #invaders do
		character_util.remove_emotion(invaders[i])
		scene_util.set_anim_loop(invaders[i], 'seat', { mix_duration = 0.2 })
	end

	scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(scared_invader, 'qs_crosselle_s4_lower_2')
	character_util.remove_anim(scared_invader)

	--이 후 해당 인베이더 (left,scared,idle) (shake0.1) 지속
	character_util.shake(scared_invader, 0.02, 9999)
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(scared_invader, 'scared')

	--마리오점프로 경로시작위치에 내려오고
	local move_enumerators = {}

	for i = 1, #invaders do
		table.insert(move_enumerators, util.cs_generator(function()
			local npc = invaders[i]
			character_util.mario_jump_new(npc, 'right', 0.5, 0.5)

			character_util.set_locked_dir(npc, 'right')
			scene_util.set_anim_loop(npc, 'get')
			character_util.jump(npc, 0.7, 0.5)
			character_util.move_to_async(npc,
					field_util.get_marker_pos('s4_lower_meet_andras_invader_' .. i .. '_wp_0'), 0.5)
			character_util.remove_anim(npc)

			character_util.reset_locked_dir(npc)

			local wp = i == 2 and {
				field_util.get_marker_pos('s4_lower_meet_andras_invader_' .. i .. '_wp_1'),
			} or {
				field_util.get_marker_pos('s4_lower_meet_andras_invader_' .. i .. '_wp_1'),
				field_util.get_marker_pos('s4_lower_meet_andras_invader_' .. i .. '_wp_2'),
			}

			wp_util.move_async(npc, wp, 3, nil, { last_direction = 'right' })
		end))
	end

	--경로따라 이동 이 후 전원 (right,idle,idle) 상태
	wait_all(move_enumerators)

	--1번 인베이더(right,idle,cast2) : 뭐야, 왜이렇게 호들갑이야?
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(invaders[2], 'bomb_idle')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(invaders[2], 'qs_crosselle_s4_lower_3')
	character_util.remove_anim(invaders[2])

	--2번 인베이더(right,idle,release) : 귀신이라도 본 거야?
	scene_util.set_release_anim(invaders[4])
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(invaders[4], 'qs_crosselle_s4_lower_4')
	character_util.remove_anim(invaders[4])

	--초록원 인베이더 (left,idle,release) : 이럴때가 아니야, 모두 도망쳐야 해!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
	character_util.stop_shake(scared_invader)
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(scared_invader, 'cast2')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(scared_invader,
			{ key = 'qs_crosselle_s4_lower_5', keep_display = true, type_speed = 0, bubble_direction = 'rb' })

	--도어 열리자마자 초록원 인베이더 해당 위치까지 달려가서
	--이 때 크로셀 천천히 해당 위치로 정렬
	local crosselle_align_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s4_lower_meet_andras_crosselle_align_2')
	wp_util.move(crosselle, {
		vector(crosselle_align_pos.x, 0, crosselle.Position.z),
		crosselle_align_pos
	}, 3, nil, { last_direction = 'left', play_sfx = true })

	--대사 시작과 동시에 그리드 밖에서 안드라스 (빨간 원)이
	character_util.set_position(andras, vector(right_appear_center.x, 0, scared_invader.Position.z - 0.01))

	--(smile) 표정으로
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(andras, 'smile')

	--달려와서
	wp_util.move_async(andras, switch_pos, 5, nil, { run = true, play_sfx = true })

	--2번째 위치에서 점프
	local move_dur = 0.6
	local anim_scale = 0.8 / move_dur
	local anim_done_dur = anim_scale

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_twohand_stomp_jump_01')
	scene_util.set_anim_non_loop(andras, 'twohand_attack4', { scale = anim_scale })
	wait_for_sec(0.36666 / anim_scale)

	character_util.move_to_async(andras, scared_invader.Position + vector(1, 0, -0.01), move_dur)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hana_slash_event_01')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(crosselle, 'tired')

	local execute_fade = function(target)
		start_coroutine(function()
			wait_for_sec(1.8)
			character_util.add_color(target, target.Name, unity_class.color.black, 1, 1)
		end)
	end

	--twohand_attak4 로 3번위치 착지 초록원 인베이더 참수애니메이션
	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(scared_invader)
	character_util.remove_emotion(scared_invader)
	scene_util.set_anim_non_loop(scared_invader, 'unique/execute', { sfx_name = '02_hit_big_02' })
	execute_fade(scared_invader)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fly_hit_01')
	self.get_fx_slash_hit():Instantiate(scared_invader.Position + vector(0, 0.4, 0))

	--참수와 동시에 파란원 인베이더 4명(right,scared,idle)(jump1회)(이후 shake 0.1 지속)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_crowd_shout_05')
	for i = 1, #invaders do
		local npc = invaders[i]
		character_util.normal_jump(npc, '01_jump_01')
		scene_util.set_emotion_loop(npc, 'scared')
		character_util.shake(npc, 0.02, 9999)
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	character_util.remove_anim(andras)

	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	--안드라스(left,doyagao,bomb_idle) : 너희들은 내가 귀신으로 보이나 보구나!
	character_util.hide_weapon(andras, true)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_impact_03')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(andras, 'doyagao')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(andras, 'bomb_idle')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(andras, 'qs_crosselle_s4_lower_6')
	character_util.hide_weapon(andras, false)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_equip_weapon_01')
	character_util.remove_anim(andras)

	move_done_left = #invaders

	--남은 인베이더들 그대로 0.5칸 뒷걸음
	for i = 1, #invaders do
		local npc = invaders[i]

		character_util.set_locked_dir(npc, 'right')
		wp_util.move(npc, npc.Position + vector(-0.5, 0, 0), 1, nil, {
			last_direction = 'right', callback = move_done_cb_generator(1)
		})
	end

	wait_move_done()

	for i = 1, #invaders do
		character_util.reset_locked_dir(invaders[i])
	end

	--안드라스 1번위치에서 (left,smile,twohand_attack4)
	move_dur = 0.3
	anim_scale = 0.8 / move_dur
	--local anim_done_dur = anim_scale

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_twohand_stomp_jump_01')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(andras, 'smile')
	scene_util.set_anim_non_loop(andras, 'twohand_attack4', { scale = anim_scale })
	wait_for_sec(0.36666 / anim_scale)

	character_util.move_to_async(andras, andras.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0), move_dur)

	--(fx_iceflower)(하늘색 사각형)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_ice_ridge_03')
	self.get_fx_iceflower():Instantiate(invaders[2].Position + vector(-0.5, 0, 0))

	--전방에 두 인베이더 스핀데드
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_die_villain_01')
	character_util.remove_emotion(invaders[2])
	character_util.stop_shake(invaders[2])
	character_util.remove_emotion(invaders[4])
	character_util.stop_shake(invaders[4])
	character_util.air_spin(invaders[2], { offset = vector(3, 0, 0) })
	character_util.air_spin(invaders[4], { offset = vector(3, 0, 0) })

	--뒤에 (보라색) (하늘색) 인베이더 (right,scared,idle)(jump1회)
	character_util.normal_jump(invaders[1])
	character_util.normal_jump(invaders[3])

	wait_for_sec(2)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_break_window_01')

	--run 위로 이동
	move_done_left = 2

local local_class = newclass('QueenShipCrosselleSection5')

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	-- 이 섹션이 유효한 스테이지 이름
	self.available_stage_name = 'queenship_substage_crosselle'

	-- 섹션 내 스테이트 Enum
	self.section_state = {
		before_destroy_machine = 1,
		before_exit_machine_grid = 2,
		killing_invaders = 3,
		before_try_exit = 4,
		before_battle = 5,
		in_battle = 6,
		after_battle = 7,
	}

	self.current_section_state = self.section_state.before_destroy_machine

	self.quest_marker_key = 'crosselle_s5'

	self.get_machine = function()
		return get_field_object('radio_wave_machine')
	end

	self.get_fx_boss_explosion = function()
		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_explosion_boss')
	end

	self.get_fx_hit = function()
		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit')
	end

	self.get_fx_lasthit = function()
		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_lasthit')
	end

	self.get_fx_fire = function()
		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_field_fire')
	end

	self.get_fx_flamethrower = function()
		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_event_flamethrower')
	end

	self.get_fx_dark_mine_explosion = function()
		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_dark_mine_explosion')
	end

	self.get_fx_crosselle_purple_castloop = function()
		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_crosselle_purple_castloop')
	end

	self.get_fx_smoke = function()
		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_m_taenia_jump_smoke')
	end

	self.in_screenplay = false

	self.battle_group_name = 's5_battle'

	self.get_invader = function(index)
		return get_character('s5_battle_' .. index)
	end

end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	self.get_fx_boss_explosion()
	self.get_fx_hit()
	self.get_fx_lasthit()
	self.get_fx_fire()
	self.get_fx_flamethrower()
	self.get_fx_dark_mine_explosion()
	self.get_fx_crosselle_purple_castloop()
	self.get_fx_smoke()

	screen_util.preload_tutorial_spine()
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent), 'on_camera_grid_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')

	self.get_machine().Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
end

function local_class:start()
	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.quest_marker_key, self.get_machine())
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	for i = 1, #self.fx_holder do
		self.fx_holder[i]:Dispose()
	end

	self.fx_holder = nil
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.before_destroy_machine and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_machine()) then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.before_exit_machine_grid
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(self.destroy_machine_scene, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.before_destroy_machine and not self.in_screenplay and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's5_exit_blocking_before_destroy_machine') then
		self.in_screenplay = true
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(self.try_exit_before_destroy_machine, self, e.Zone)

		return true
	elseif self.current_section_state == self.section_state.before_try_exit and not self.in_screenplay and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's5_exit_blocking_before_battle') then
		self.in_screenplay = true
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(self.try_exit_before_battle, self, e.Zone)

		return true
	elseif self.current_section_state == self.section_state.before_try_exit and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 's5_try_exit') then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.before_battle
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(self.before_battle_scene, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.before_exit_machine_grid and
			type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, 's5_kill_invaders') then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.killing_invaders
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(self.kill_invaders_scene, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.in_battle and e.BattleGroupName == self.battle_group_name then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.after_battle
		start_coroutine(self.after_battle_scene, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:try_exit_before_destroy_machine(zone)
	--초록색존 진입시
	local crosselle = get_party_leader()

	--크로셀(left,tired,idle) : 저 흉물… 그냥 갈 수 없겠네요.
	character_util.set_direction(crosselle, 'left')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(crosselle, 'tired')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(crosselle, 'qs_crosselle_s5_1')

	--0.5칸 (left) 방향 이동
	wp_util.move_async(crosselle, vector(zone.Bounds.min.x - 0.5, 0, crosselle.Position.z), 1.5)

	self.in_screenplay = false
end

function local_class:destroy_machine_scene()

		sfx_name = '01_clang_01', loop = true, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc'

	--크로셀 (right,idle,clap) : 끔찍한 삶이 끝난 걸 축하드려요. 흉측한 기계장치.

	})

	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(crosselle, 'qs_crosselle_s5_2')

	music_player_util.fade_out_sfx(clap_sfx, 0.3)

	--크로셀 (right,idle,bomb_idle) : 다음생에는 꼭 저 같은 설계자에게 태어나시길.
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(crosselle, 'bomb_idle')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(crosselle, 'qs_crosselle_s5_3')
	character_util.remove_anim(crosselle)

	--크로셀 (right,idle,idle) : 이제 빨리 복귀해야겠네요.
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(crosselle, 'qs_crosselle_s5_4')

	--크로셀 (right,tired,bomb_idle) : 이 이상 작전에 차질이 생기면 곤란해요.

function local_class:kill_invaders_scene()

		get_field_object('s4_upper_puzzle_magnet_holdable'),
		get_field_object('s4_lower_puzzle_magnet_holdable'),
		get_field_object('s4_upper_puzzle_brazier_holdable'),
		get_field_object('s2_puzzle_magnet_holdable'),
	}

	for i = 1, #reset_targets do
		message_system:SendSync(reset_targets[i], CS.Oak.GimmickResetEvent.Instance)

	--(마커 소멸)
	quest_marker_util.remove(self.quest_marker_key)

	--그리드 진입시 이벤트 시작
	local move_done_left = 0
	local move_done_cb_generator = function(wp_count)
		return function(wp_index)
			if wp_index == wp_count - 1 then
				move_done_left = move_done_left - 1
			end
		end
	end

	local wait_move_done = function()
		while move_done_left > 0 do
			coroutine.yield()

			field_util.get_marker_pos('s5_kill_invader_crosselle_align'), crosselle_move_speed)

	move_done_left = 1

	--다음 대사 시작하면서 이동 시작 (일반 walk속도의 0.5)

			crosselle_move_speed, nil, { callback = move_done_cb_generator(1) })

				fo.Magnetizable = CS.Oak.NonMagnetizable.Instance
				fo.Electrocutable = CS.Oak.NonElectrocutable.Instance

			get_field_object('s5_kill_invader_spike_tesla_3').Position + vector(0, 0.5, 0))
	tesla_cast_effect.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0.5

	message_system:PublishSync(
			CS.Oak.ConvertWallChangedEvent.Create(CS.Oak.ConvertSwitchFieldObjectBehaviour.ConvertSwitchState.BLUE))

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	start_coroutine(spike_group_move, 3, tesla_cast_effect)

	stop_dialogue('qs_crosselle_s5_15_4')
	stop_dialogue('qs_crosselle_s5_15_5')

	--가시블록에 인베이더들 스핀데드
	start_coroutine(function()
		local dead_order = {
			3, 1, 2, 4
		}

		music_player_util.fade_out_sfx(door_hit_sfx, 0.3)

		for order_index, index in pairs(dead_order) do
			while spike_groups_center_pos[3].x + 2 < spike_invaders[index].Position.x - 0.3  do
				coroutine.yield()
			end

			if order_index == 1 then
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_villain_scream_01')
			end

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_atomic_hit_01')
			camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.2)

			character_util.remove_anim(spike_invaders[index])
			character_util.air_spin(spike_invaders[index], { offset = vector(3, 0, 0) })
		end

		spike_door:CancelShake()
	end)

	--동시에 크로셀(right,idle,idle) 오른쪽으로 걸어가면서 대사
	character_util.remove_anim(crosselle)
	camera_move_dur = 1

	move_done_left = 1
	wp_util.move(crosselle, field_util.get_marker_pos('s5_kill_invader_end'), crosselle_move_speed,
			nil, { callback = move_done_cb_generator(1) })

	--크로셀 : 접근성도 조작감도 쓸만하네요.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(crosselle,
			{ key = 'qs_crosselle_s5_16', type_speed = 0, bubble_direction = 'lt' })

	camera_util.move_async(crosselle.Position + camera_move_dur * crosselle_move_speed * unity_class.vector3.right,
			camera_move_dur, { end_target = crosselle })

	wait_move_done()

	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(crosselle)

	--크로셀(right,deep_sleep,bomb_idle) : 뭐… 인베이더들 치고 노력한 티가 나는 기술력이군요.
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(crosselle, 'sleep_deep')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(crosselle, 'bomb_idle')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(crosselle, 'qs_crosselle_s5_16_1')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(crosselle)

	--해당 서브 퀘스트 마커
	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.quest_marker_key,
			field_util.get_marker_pos('s5_stage_exit_quest_marker') + vector(0, 0, 4))

	self.current_section_state = self.section_state.before_try_exit
end

function local_class:try_exit_before_battle(zone)
	--초록색 존 진입시
	local crosselle = get_party_leader()

	--크로셀 : 여기 더있다간 코트에 역한 냄새가 배갰네요.
	character_util.set_direction(crosselle, 'left')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(crosselle, 'qs_crosselle_s5_17')

	--오른쪽으로 1칸 뒷걸음
	character_util.move_to_async(crosselle, vector(zone.Bounds.max.x + 0.5, 0, crosselle.Position.z),
			nil, 1.5, nil, true)

	self.in_screenplay = false
end

function local_class:before_battle_scene()
	--인베이더 병사들 내려옴 (기본 walk속도) (알파 페이드로 등장)
	local invaders_up = {
		self.get_invader(1),
		self.get_invader(2),
		self.get_invader(3),
		self.get_invader(4),
		self.get_invader(5),
		self.get_invader(6),
	}

	local invaders_left = {
		self.get_invader(7),
		self.get_invader(8),
		self.get_invader(9),
		self.get_invader(10),
		self.get_invader(11),
		self.get_invader(12),
	}

	--상단 파란존 진입시
	local crosselle = get_party_leader()
	local exit_center_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s5_stage_exit_quest_marker')

	--해당 위치까지 정렬
	character_util.set_direction(crosselle, 'up')
	character_util.move_to_async(crosselle, field_util.get_marker_pos('s5_try_exit_stage_align'),
			nil, 3, false, true)

	--shout말풍선 : 거기 서라!!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_count_final_01')
	camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.3)
	scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(invaders_up[1], 'qs_crosselle_s5_18', nil,
			{ viewport_pos = vector(0.5, 0.8) })

	local move_done_left = 0
	local move_done_cb_generator = function(wp_count)
		return function(wp_index)
			if wp_index == wp_count - 1 then
				move_done_left = move_done_left - 1
			end
		end
	end

	local wait_move_done = function()
		while move_done_left > 0 do
			coroutine.yield()
		end
	end

	local invaders_up_pos = {
		exit_center_pos + vector(-0.5, 0, 0),
		exit_center_pos + vector(0.5, 0, 0),
		exit_center_pos + vector(-0.5, 0, 1),
		exit_center_pos + vector(0.5, 0, 1),
		exit_center_pos + vector(-0.5, 0, 2),
		exit_center_pos + vector(0.5, 0, 2),
	}

	for i = 1, #invaders_up do
		local npc = invaders_up[i]

		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(npc, 0, 0)
	end

	local appear_move_speed = 3.5
	local invaders_up_align_z = field_util.get_marker_pos('s5_battle_up_align').z
	local invaders_up_wps = {
		{
			vector(invaders_up_pos[1].x, 0, invaders_up_align_z),
		},
		{
			vector(invaders_up_pos[2].x, 0, invaders_up_align_z),
		},
		{
			vector(invaders_up_pos[3].x, 0, invaders_up_align_z + 1),
			vector(invaders_up_pos[3].x - 1, 0, invaders_up_align_z + 1),
			vector(invaders_up_pos[3].x - 1, 0, invaders_up_align_z),
		},
		{
			vector(invaders_up_pos[4].x, 0, invaders_up_align_z + 1),
			vector(invaders_up_pos[4].x + 1, 0, invaders_up_align_z + 1),
			vector(invaders_up_pos[4].x + 1, 0, invaders_up_align_z),
		},
		{
			vector(invaders_up_pos[5].x, 0, invaders_up_align_z + 1),
			vector(invaders_up_pos[5].x - 2, 0, invaders_up_align_z + 1),
			vector(invaders_up_pos[5].x - 2, 0, invaders_up_align_z),
		},
		{
			vector(invaders_up_pos[6].x, 0, invaders_up_align_z + 1),
			vector(invaders_up_pos[6].x + 2, 0, invaders_up_align_z + 1),
			vector(invaders_up_pos[6].x + 2, 0, invaders_up_align_z),
		},
	}

	move_done_left = #invaders_up + 1 + #invaders_left

	for i = 1, #invaders_up do
		local npc = invaders_up[i]

		character_util.set_position(npc, invaders_up_pos[i])
		character_util.set_direction(npc, 'down')
		wp_util.move(npc, invaders_up_wps[i], appear_move_speed, nil,
				{ callback = move_done_cb_generator(#invaders_up_wps[i]) })
	end

	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(invaders_up[1], 1, 0.5)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(invaders_up[2], 1, 0.5)

	wait_for_sec(1 / appear_move_speed)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_dash_06')

	--따라서 크로셀로 뒷걸음으로 뒤로감 (카메라는 크로셀 따라서)
	local crosselle_align_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s5_battle_crosselle_backstep')
	local crosselle_move_done_cb = move_done_cb_generator(1)
	character_util.set_locked_dir(crosselle, 'up')
	wp_util.move(crosselle, crosselle_align_pos, appear_move_speed, nil, {
		callback = function(wp_index)
			crosselle_move_done_cb(wp_index)

			if wp_index == 0 then
				character_util.reset_locked_dir(crosselle)
			end

		end, last_direction = 'left' })

	--뒤로 가면서 카메라 시야 증가
	local crosselle_move_dur = (crosselle_align_pos - crosselle.Position).magnitude / appear_move_speed
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(5, crosselle_move_dur)

	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(invaders_up[3], 1, 0.5)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(invaders_up[4], 1, 0.5)

	wait_for_sec(1 / appear_move_speed)

	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(invaders_up[5], 1, 0.5)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(invaders_up[6], 1, 0.5)

	--크로셀 해당 중앙위치 도착하면 뒷걸음질 중지 (left,idle,idle)로 변경
	while move_done_left > #invaders_up + #invaders_left do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	--왼쪽에서 인베이더들 무리 나오기 시작 (알파페이드 X)
	local entrance_center_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s5_battle_entrance_center')
	local invaders_left_pos = {
		entrance_center_pos + vector(0, 0, 0.5),
		entrance_center_pos + vector(0, 0, -0.5),
		entrance_center_pos + vector(-1, 0, 0.5),
		entrance_center_pos + vector(-1, 0, -0.5),
		entrance_center_pos + vector(-2, 0, 0.5),
		entrance_center_pos + vector(-2, 0, -0.5),
	}

	local invaders_left_align_x = field_util.get_marker_pos('s5_battle_left_align').x
	local invaders_left_wps = {
		{
			vector(invaders_left_align_x, 0, invaders_left_pos[1].z),
		},
		{
			vector(invaders_left_align_x, 0, invaders_left_pos[2].z),
		},
		{
			vector(invaders_left_align_x - 1, 0, invaders_left_pos[3].z),
			vector(invaders_left_align_x - 1, 0, invaders_left_pos[3].z + 1),
			vector(invaders_left_align_x, 0, invaders_left_pos[3].z + 1),
		},
		{
			vector(invaders_left_align_x - 1, 0, invaders_left_pos[4].z),
			vector(invaders_left_align_x - 1, 0, invaders_left_pos[4].z - 1),
			vector(invaders_left_align_x, 0, invaders_left_pos[4].z - 1),
		},
		{
			vector(invaders_left_align_x - 1, 0, invaders_left_pos[5].z),
			vector(invaders_left_align_x - 1, 0, invaders_left_pos[5].z + 2),
			vector(invaders_left_align_x, 0, invaders_left_pos[5].z + 2),
		},
		{
			vector(invaders_left_align_x - 1, 0, invaders_left_pos[6].z),
			vector(invaders_left_align_x - 1, 0, invaders_left_pos[6].z - 2),
			vector(invaders_left_align_x, 0, invaders_left_pos[6].z - 2),
		},
	}

	for i = 1, #invaders_left do
		local npc = invaders_left[i]

		character_util.set_position(npc, invaders_left_pos[i])
		wp_util.move(npc, invaders_left_wps[i], appear_move_speed, nil,
				{ callback = move_done_cb_generator(#invaders_left_wps[i]) })
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.3)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_dash_06')

	wait_move_done()

	--대열 생성 완료 시, 크로셀이 idle 상태로 left, up, left 순서로 번갈아본 후 대사.
	scene_util.look_around(crosselle, { 'up', 'left' }, nil, 0.8)

	--크로셀 (left, idle, cross_arm) : 다들 화가 많이 난 것 같군요.
	scene_util.set_cross_arm_anim(crosselle, false)
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(crosselle, 'qs_crosselle_s5_19')
	character_util.remove_anim(crosselle)

	--크로셀 (left, idle, question) : 그 흉측한… 아, 방해 전파 발생기였던가? 그거 때문인가요?
	scene_util.set_question_anim(crosselle)
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(crosselle, 'qs_crosselle_s5_20')
	character_util.remove_anim(crosselle)

	--크로셀 (up, idle, staff_shoot x 3): 아님 엉뚱한 곳으로 불러낸 게 분해서일까요?
	scene_util.set_direction(crosselle, 'up')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(crosselle, 'staff_shoot')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(crosselle, 'qs_crosselle_s5_21')
	--크로셀 대사 후 (up, idle, idle) 상태로 대기,
	character_util.remove_anim(crosselle)

	--아래 인베이더 대사 시작과 동시에 ( left, idle, idle )로 변환.
	scene_util.set_direction(crosselle, 'left')

	--좌측 3번 인베이더(right, idle, release x 2) : 전부 저 녀석 짓이었어!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	scene_util.set_release_anim(invaders_left[1])
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(invaders_left[1], 'qs_crosselle_s5_22')
	character_util.remove_anim(invaders_left[1])

	--상단 3번 인베이더 (down, idle, cast2) : 거짓 지령도! 방해 전파 발생기 파괴도!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(invaders_up[1], 'cast2')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(invaders_up[1], 'qs_crosselle_s5_23')
	character_util.remove_anim(invaders_up[1])

	--인베이더들 감싸오면서 카메라 줌 인
	local invaders_approach_dur = 0.5
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(4.75, invaders_approach_dur)

	--이 때 크로셀 (left, sleep_deep, cross_arm)
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(crosselle, 'sleep_deep')
	scene_util.set_cross_arm_anim(crosselle)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_equip_weapon_01')

	move_done_left = #invaders_up + #invaders_left

	for i = 1, #invaders_up do
		local npc = invaders_up[i]

		wp_util.move(npc, npc.Position + vector(0, 0, -0.25), nil, invaders_approach_dur,
				{ callback = move_done_cb_generator(1) })
	end

	for i = 1, #invaders_left do
		local npc = invaders_left[i]

		wp_util.move(npc, npc.Position + vector(0.25, 0, 0), nil, invaders_approach_dur,
				{ callback = move_done_cb_generator(1) })
	end

	wait_move_done()

	--좌측 4번 인베이더 (right, idle, attack x 2) : 살아돌아갈 생각은 말아라!
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(invaders_left[2], 'attack', { sfx_name = '02_sword_short_01' })
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(invaders_left[2], 'qs_crosselle_s5_24')
	character_util.remove_anim(invaders_left[2])

	--이 때 크로셀 (left, sleep_deep, nod x 2)
	character_util.remove_anim(crosselle)
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(crosselle, 'nod', { remove_after = 1 })

	--상단 4번 인베이더 (down, idle, release x 2) : 잔꾀나 쓰는 교활한 자식 같으니!
	scene_util.set_release_anim(invaders_up[2])
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(invaders_up[2], 'qs_crosselle_s5_25')
	character_util.remove_anim(invaders_up[2])

	--모든 인베이더들 감싸오면서 카메라 줌 인
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(4.5, invaders_approach_dur)
	move_done_left = #invaders_up + #invaders_left

	for i = 1, #invaders_up do
		local npc = invaders_up[i]

		wp_util.move(npc, npc.Position + vector(0, 0, -0.25), nil, invaders_approach_dur,
				{ callback = move_done_cb_generator(1) })
	end

	for i = 1, #invaders_left do
		local npc = invaders_left[i]

		wp_util.move(npc, npc.Position + vector(0.25, 0, 0), nil, invaders_approach_dur,
				{ callback = move_done_cb_generator(1) })
	end

	wait_move_done()

	--크로셀 (down, sleep_deep, idle) 상태로
	character_util.remove_anim(crosselle)
	scene_util.set_direction(crosselle, 'down')

	--말줄임표 버블 1초 간 띄운 후,
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(crosselle, nil, 'silence')

	scene_util.set_direction(crosselle, 'left')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(crosselle, 'tired')

	--크로셀(left, tired, idle) : 지금 그냥 가시면,
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(crosselle, 'qs_crosselle_s5_25_1')

	--크로셀(left, tired, cross_arm) : …곱게 보내드리죠.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fade_out_03')
	scene_util.set_cross_arm_anim(crosselle)
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(crosselle, 'qs_crosselle_s5_25_2')
	character_util.remove_anim(crosselle)

	--상단 4번 인베이더 0.5초 쉐이크 하다가 대사.
	scene_util.shake(invaders_up[2], 0.025, 1)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 상단 4번 인베이더 (down, idle, attack x 2) : 누, 누가 겁먹을 줄 알고!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_male_laugh_at_03')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(invaders_up[2], 'attack', { sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(invaders_up[2], 'qs_crosselle_s5_25_3')
	character_util.remove_anim(invaders_up[2])

	--모든 인베이더들 감싸오면서 카메라 줌 인.
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(4.25, invaders_approach_dur)
	move_done_left = #invaders_up + #invaders_left

	for i = 1, #invaders_up do
		local npc = invaders_up[i]

		wp_util.move(npc, npc.Position + vector(0, 0, -0.25), nil, invaders_approach_dur,
				{ callback = move_done_cb_generator(1) })
	end

	for i = 1, #invaders_left do
		local npc = invaders_left[i]

		wp_util.move(npc, npc.Position + vector(0.25, 0, 0), nil, invaders_approach_dur,
				{ callback = move_done_cb_generator(1) })
	end

	wait_move_done()

	--크로셀 (down, sleep_deep, nod(0.5속도)) : 후……
	local speech_done = false
	start_coroutine(function()
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		scene_util.set_anim_non_loop(crosselle, 'nod', { scale = 0.5 })
		wait_for_sec(0.6)

		if not speech_done then
			scene_util.set_anim_non_loop(crosselle, 'nod', { scale = 0, mix_duration = 999 })
		end
	end)

	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(crosselle, 'sleep_deep')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(crosselle, 'qs_crosselle_s5_25_4')

	speech_done = true
	character_util.remove_anim(crosselle)

	--크로셀 (left, tired, idle) : 저는 정말 여러분과 싸우기 싫어요.
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(crosselle, 'tired')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(crosselle, 'qs_crosselle_s5_25_5')

	--인베이더 상단 2, 4, 6 좌측 2, 4 퀘스천 버블.
	local question_invaders = {
		invaders_left[3],
		invaders_left[2],
		invaders_up[3],
		invaders_up[2],
		invaders_up[6],
	}

	for i = 1, #question_invaders do
		character_util.show_emoticon(question_invaders[i], nil, 'question')
	end

	wait_for_sec(2.5)

	--크로셀 (left, attck, gauntlet_combo_attack 2회 ) : 싸우다가 이 코트가 상하기라도 하면…
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(crosselle, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(crosselle, 'bomb_idle')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(crosselle, 'qs_crosselle_s5_25_6')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(crosselle)

	--크로셀 (down, tired, cross_arm ) : 그때부터는 몹시 피곤해지거든요.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	scene_util.set_direction(crosselle, 'down')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(crosselle, 'tired')

function local_class:after_battle_scene()
	local crosselle = get_party_leader()

	for i = 1, 3 do
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateOpenEvent.Create('s5_battlegate_' .. i))
	end

	while crosselle.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	crosselle.CharacterStatsBehaviour:AddStatsOptionRequest(
			self.controller.cs_controller, CS.Oak.CharacterStatsOptions.Invincible)

	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	--전투 끝나면 페이드 아웃
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	wait_for_sec(1)

	--주변에 검은 틴트 처리된 인베이더 시체 배치.
	local invaders = {
		self.get_invader(1),
		self.get_invader(2),
		self.get_invader(3),
		self.get_invader(4),
		self.get_invader(5),
		self.get_invader(6),
		self.get_invader(7),
		self.get_invader(8),
		self.get_invader(9),
		self.get_invader(10),
		self.get_invader(11),
		self.get_invader(12),
	}

	for i = 1, #invaders do
		local npc = invaders[i]
		local marker_name = 's5_after_battle_invader_' .. i

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(npc)

		character_util.set_position(npc, field_util.get_marker_pos(marker_name))
		character_util.set_direction(npc, i % 2 == 1 and 'right' or 'left')
		character_util.add_color(npc, 's5_after_battle', unity_class.color.black, 1, 0)
		scene_util.set_anim_loop(npc, 'prostrate')
		character_util.set_active_state(npc, 'enabled')
	end

	character_util.set_position(crosselle, field_util.get_marker_pos('s5_battle_crosselle_backstep'))
	character_util.set_direction(crosselle, 'right')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(crosselle, 'tired')

	character_util.hide_weapon(crosselle, true)

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	--크로셀 left, right 0.5초씩 번갈아 본 후,
	scene_util.look_around(crosselle, { 'left', 'right' }, nil, 0.7)

	--크로셀 (down, tired, cast) : 저, 저질러 버렸다…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(crosselle, 'cast')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(crosselle, 'qs_crosselle_s5_38')
	character_util.remove_anim(crosselle)

	--0.8초 텀 후, 크로셀 up 방향으로 이동해서 0.7 속도로 걸어감.
	wp_util.move_async(crosselle, crosselle.Position + vector(0, 0, 2), 1.5)

	--2타일 정도 이동했을 때, 숙주 대사와 함께 제자리 멈춤.
	--크로셀 (숙주) (up, idle, bomb_idle) : 이제 코트 수선비용 정도는 얼마나 청구될지 아시죠?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_unlock_02')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	self.controller:talk_crosselle_host()
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(crosselle, 'bomb_idle')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(crosselle, 'qs_crosselle_s5_39')
	character_util.remove_anim(crosselle)
	self.controller:talk_end_crosselle_host()

	--크로셀 (left, attack, idle)(jump1회) : 하, 하지만 이 경우엔…!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	scene_util.set_direction(crosselle, 'left')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(crosselle, 'attack')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(crosselle, 'qs_crosselle_s5_40')
	character_util.remove_emotion(crosselle)

	--크로셀 left, tired, idle 로 변환해 0.5초 텀을 둔 후 다시 up방향 이동.(낙담한 것을 표현하려 함)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(crosselle, 'tired')
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--아래의 대사 3개는 출구로 천천히 걸어가는 상태에서 출력.

			vector(0, 0, -2), nil, 8)

	--이 시점부터 서서히 카메라 줌아웃.
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(5.5, 6)

	--크로셀 (up, idle, walk) : 당신도 알잖아요? 내가 이 코트를 지키려고 얼마나…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(crosselle,
			{ key = 'qs_crosselle_s5_41', skip = false, keep_display = true, type_speed = 0, auto_layout = true })

	self.npc_event_zone_name = 'elevator_npc_passage_event_1'

	--스타피스
	self.star_piece_name = 'elevator_star_piece'
	self.get_star_piece = function()
		return get_field_object(self.star_piece_name)
	end

	self.battle_group_name = 'battle7'

	-- 불타는 이팩트
	self.get_fire_effect = function()
		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_field_fire')
	end

		vector(-1, 0, 2),
		vector(-2, 0, -1),
		vector(1, 0, 0.5)
	}

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	self.get_reset_fx()
	self.get_fire_effect()
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StarPieceGetEvent), 'on_starpiece_get_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_battle_group_eliminated_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BurnEvent), 'on_burn_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ExtinguishEvent), 'on_extinguish_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), 'on_damage_event')

	--스타피스 먹고 탈출 할 경우에 대한 방어 코드
	if star_piece_util.has_star_piece(self.star_piece_name) then
		--npc 비활성화
		for i = 1, 3 do
			local npc = self.get_npc(i)
			character_util.set_active_state(npc, 'disabled')
		end
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.clear_quest, self))

	else
		-- 몬스터 DeathType 변경(전투 끝나고 던지게 하기 위함)
		for i = 1, 9 do
			local monster = self.get_monster(i)
			character_util.set_death_type(monster, 'prostrate')
		end

		--일지 드랍하는 3번 npc 암살 가능하게 변경
		local npc_to_assassinate = self.get_npc(3)
		self:convert_to_assassinate_monster(npc_to_assassinate)
		self.runaway_sfx =  music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_runaway_01', parent = npc_to_assassinate, max_distance = 5, loop = true})
		character_util.shake(npc_to_assassinate , 0.04, 9999)

		character_util.set_death_type(npc_to_assassinate, 'airspin')

		local elevator = self.get_elevator_interact(1)
		elevator.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

		local diary = self.get_diary()
		character_util.set_active_state(diary, 'disabled')

	end
	return true
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StarPieceGetEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BurnEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ExtinguishEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent))

	if self.reset_fx ~= nil then
		self.reset_fx:Dispose()
		self.reset_fx = nil
	end

	for i = 1, #self.fire_fx_table do
		if self.fire_fx_table[i] ~= nil then
			self.fire_fx_table[i]:Dispose()
			self.fire_fx_table[i] = nil
		end
	end
	self.fire_fx_table = nil

	if self.runaway_sfx ~= nil then
		self.runaway_sfx:Stop()
		self.runaway_sfx = nil
	end

end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil

end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_starpiece_get_event(e)
	if star_piece_util.has_star_piece(self.star_piece_name) then
		start_coroutine(self.start_hallucinations, self)
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	if e.BattleGroupName == self.battle_group_name then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.convert_monster_holdable, self))
		return true
	end

	return false
end
function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	for i = 1, 9 do
		local monster = self.get_monster(i)
		if e.FullEnter and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, monster) then
			if e.Zone.Name == self.zone_1_name then

				character_util.release_hold_object(user_party.Leader, monster)
				message_system:SendSync(monster, CS.Oak.GetThrownEndEvent.Instance)
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_character_warp_01')
				self.get_reset_fx():Instantiate(monster.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.5))
				command_util.execute_extinguish(nil, monster)

				if self.count_monster_elevator_inserted < 3 then
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.insert_monster, self, monster))
				else
					sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.reset_elevator_puzzle, self)
				end

				--character_util.move_to(monster, self.get_leader_pos(1).position,0.1)
			end
		end
	end
	if e.FullEnter and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
		if e.Zone.Name == self.npc_event_zone_name and not self.is_see_dialogue then
			self.is_see_dialogue = true
			start_coroutine(self.enter_npc_event_zone, self)
		end
	end

end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_elevator_interact(1)) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_elevator, self)

	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_diary()) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_diary, self, i)

	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_npc(3)) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.item_setting, self, i)
	end
end

function local_class:on_damage_event(e)
	local diary_invader = self.get_npc(3)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, diary_invader) and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.sender, user_party.Leader) then

		--coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.activate_interact_npc_3, self))
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.item_setting, self))
	end
end

function local_class:on_burn_event(e)

	for i = 1, 9 do
		local monster = self.get_monster(i)
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, monster) then
			if self.fire_fx_table[i] == nil then
				music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_catch_fire_01')
				self.fire_fx_table[i] = self.get_fire_effect():Instantiate(monster.Position, unity_class.quaternion.identity, monster.Transform)
			end
		end
	end

end

function local_class:on_extinguish_event(e)

	for i = 1, 9 do
		local monster = self.get_monster(i)
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, monster) then
			if self.fire_fx_table[i] ~= nil then
				self.fire_fx_table[i]:Dispose()
				self.fire_fx_table[i] = nil
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:convert_monster_holdable()

	for i = 1, 9 do
		local monster = self.get_monster(i)
		character_util.convert_to_npc(monster)
		monster.Holdable = CS.Oak.Holdable()
		monster.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.PortableCrashBehaviour()
		monster.CombustibleBehaviour = CS.Oak.CharacterCombustibleBehaviour()
		monster.CombustibleBehaviour.IsAffectedBurn = true

		local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
		heal_info.sender = monster
		heal_info.target = monster
		heal_info.heal = monster.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP
		heal_info.isRevive = true
		heal_info.skipEffect = true

		command_util.execute_heal(heal_info)
		--command_util.execute_burn(user_party_leader, monster, true)
		monster.CombustibleBehaviour.BurnLifeTime = 1
	end
end

function local_class:reset_target_gimmick(target)

end

function local_class:interact_elevator()
	if self.count_monster_elevator_inserted == 3 then
		local leader_pos_end = self.get_leader_pos(2)
		local party_pos_org = self.get_party_pos().position
		local party_pos = {
			party_pos_org + vector(0, 0, 0),
			party_pos_org + vector(0, 0, -1),
			party_pos_org + vector(0, 0, -2)
		}
		local move_duration = 1
		local elevator_interacts = {}
		local elevator_interact_poses = {}
		local elevator_animators = {}

		--몬스터 홀더블 제거
		for i = 1, 9 do
			local monster = self.get_monster(i)
			monster.Holdable = CS.Oak.NonHoldable.Instance
			monster.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.PassCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance
		end

		for i = 1, 2 do
			local elevator_interact = self.get_elevator_interact(i)
			table.insert(elevator_interacts, elevator_interact)
			table.insert(elevator_interact_poses, elevator_interact.Position)
			table.insert(elevator_animators, elevator_interact:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator)))
		end
		character_util.move_to(user_party.Leader, elevator_interact_poses[1] + vector(0.5, 0, -2),
				move_duration, nil, true, true)

		local party_pos_index = 1
		for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
			if i ~= 0 and party_pos[party_pos_index] ~= nil then
				character_util.move_to(user_party[i], party_pos[party_pos_index], move_duration,
						nil, true, true)
				party_pos_index = party_pos_index + 1
			end
		end

		wait_for_sec(move_duration)

		party_util.set_direction('right')
		character_util.set_direction(user_party[0], 'left')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		character_util.nod_twice(user_party[0])

		self.origin_party = {}
		for i = 1, user_party.Count - 1 do
			table.insert(self.origin_party, user_party[i])
		end
		for i = 1, #self.origin_party do
			local party = self.origin_party[i]
			character_util.convert_to_npc(party)
		end

		wait_for_sec(1.0)
		--for i = 1, #self.origin_party do

]]

-- 기존에 존재하던 스테이지2 코드를 전부 DataTable.lua로 이식되었음.
function local_class:init(quest_id, cs_controller)
	self.cs_controller = cs_controller
	self.quest_id = quest_id
	self.quest_progress = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.frog_saved_state_postfix = '_frog_saved'

	-- 여러 스테이지에서 개구리 및 연출 데이터를 가지고 있으므로 내부에 데이터 테이블을 둬서 사용한다.
	self.data_table = nil
	self.current_data = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

	quest_util.dispose_controller(self)

	if self.current_data ~= nil and self.current_data.on_exit ~= nil then
		self.current_data:on_exit(self)
	end

	if self.current_data ~= nil and self.current_data.on_dispose ~= nil then
		self.current_data:on_dispose(self)
	end
	timeline_table.unregister_action('frog/frog_get_scene')

	self.current_data = nil
	self.data_table = nil

	if self.current_section ~= nil then
		self.current_section:exit()
		self.current_section = nil
	end

	if self.pre_story_section ~= nil then
		self.pre_story_section = nil
	end

	if self.post_story_section ~= nil then
		self.post_story_section = nil
	end

	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.sections = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if self.current_data ~= nil and self.current_data.on_event ~= nil then
		self.current_data:on_event(e)
	end

	return quest_util.on_event(self, e)
end

function local_class:on_event_received_routine(_)
	return false
end

function local_class:load_resource()
	return util.cs_generator(quest_util.load_resource, self)
end

end

	self.sections = {

	}

	end

function local_class:on_load_resource_routine()
	self.data_table = get_or_create_global_table('Quest/Main/QueenShip/Frog/DataTable')
	self.current_data = self.data_table[stage.Name]

	timeline_table.register_action('frog/frog_get_scene', self.frog_get_scene, self)

	if self.current_data ~= nil and self.current_data.on_load ~= nil then
		self.current_data:on_load(self)
	end
end

function local_class:on_stage_loaded()
end

function local_class:on_progress_section()
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	return false
end

-- 스테이지 네임을 통해 완료 체크 함수
function local_class:is_complete(stage_name)
	if stage_name == nil then
		stage_name = stage.Name
	end

	local state = quest_util.get_custom_state(self.quest_progress, stage_name..self.frog_saved_state_postfix)

	return state == 1
end

function local_class:complete()
	quest_util.set_custom_state(self.quest_progress, stage.Name..self.frog_saved_state_postfix, 1)

	local can_increase_progress = true

	-- 모든 개구리를 얻었다면 프로그래스를 변경
	table_util.for_each(self.data_table, function(stage_name, stage_data)
		if not self:is_complete(stage_name) then
			can_increase_progress = false
		end
	end)

	-- 모든 개구리를 얻었다는 판정하에 프로그래스를 업데이트.
	if can_increase_progress then
		quest_util.progress_section(self)
	end
end

-- 개구리를 얻는 연출을 공통으로 쓰기 위해 해당 연출은 루아에서 구현.
function local_class:frog_get_scene(frog_get_message)
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'left')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(leader, { name = 'embarrassed' }, { name = 'surprise' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
	wait_for_sec(1)
	-- 개구리가 옷 안으로 들어가버렸다!
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'qs_get_frog_1'})

	character_util.show_emoticon(leader, nil, 'annoyed')
	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'down')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(leader, { name = 'cast' }, { name = 'scared' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_bad_01')
	wait_for_sec(1)
	-- 각 개구리의 특징에 따라 변형되어 출력되는 메시지.
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = frog_get_message})

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
	-- end
end

return {
	create = function(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
		return local_class(quest_id, cs_controller, scene_class)
	end
