local local_class = { }

function local_class:on_load(section)
	self.get_fx_hit = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit') end
	self.get_fx_lasthit = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_lasthit') end
	self.get_fx_laser = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_s_laser_big') end

	self.stage_name = 'queenship_1_2'
	self.frog_name = 'frog_blue'
	self.frog_zone_name = 'frog_check'
	self.thorn_block_name = 'frog_metal_thorn_block'
	self.invisible_wall_name = 'frog_invisible_block'
	self.frog_rock_name_prefix = 'frog_rock_'
	self.frog_rock_marker_name_prefix = 'frog_rock_pos_'
	self.frog_rock_num = 6
	self.thorn_block_radius = 1
	-- 내장 변수
	self.can_interact_frog = false
	self.is_saved_frog = false
	-- on_start 시점에서 write 되는 값들
	self.thorn_block = nil
	self.section = section
	-- 리소스 로드 작업
	self.get_fx_hit()
	self.get_fx_lasthit()
	self.get_fx_laser()
end

function local_class:on_start(section)
	-- 스테이지 시작 시점 작업들
	self.frog = get_character(self.frog_name)
	self.thorn_block = get_field_object(self.thorn_block_name)

	-- 현재 개구리 이벤트가 완료 되었는지에 대한 변수
	local is_complete = section:is_complete()

	if is_complete then
		self.is_saved_frog = true
		stage_util.set_fo_active_state(self.invisible_wall_name, 'disabled')
	else
		for i = 1, self.frog_rock_num do
			--stage_util.set_fo_active_state(self.frog_rock_name_prefix..i, 'disabled')
			local rock_field_object = get_field_object(self.frog_rock_name_prefix .. i)

			rock_field_object.Position = field:GetMarker(self.frog_rock_marker_name_prefix .. i).position
		end

		character_util.set_active_state(self.frog, 'enabled')
		self.frog.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

		self.can_interact_frog = true
		-- 필요한 메세지를 여기서 구독해둔다.
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_zone_leave_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MoveFieldObjectEvent), 'on_move_fo_event')

		quest_icon_util.set_quest_notice(self.frog)

		local invisible_wall = get_field_object(self.invisible_wall_name)
		invisible_wall.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(1, 1, 0.3))
	end
end

function local_class:on_exit(section)
	-- 스테이지를 나가는 작업이기에 구독한 이벤트를 해제
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MoveFieldObjectEvent))
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end
function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local is_complete = self.section:is_complete()

	if not is_complete and type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, self.frog_zone_name) then
		-- 개구리 존에 플레이어가 입장 되었다.
	end
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local is_complete = self.section:is_complete()

	if not is_complete and type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, leader, self.frog_zone_name) then
		-- 개구리 존에서 플레이어가 퇴장하였다.
	end
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	-- 개구리와 인터렉트 체크
	if self.can_interact_frog and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.frog) then
		self.can_interact_frog = false
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(self.frog_interact_scene, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_move_fo_event(e)
	if not self.is_saved_frog and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.thorn_block) then
		local dir = self.thorn_block.Bounds.center - self.frog.Position

		-- 거리 비교 후 결과가 참이면 이벤트 발생
		if dir.magnitude <= self.thorn_block_radius then
			self.is_saved_frog = true
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(self.angry_frog_scene, self)
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:frog_interact_scene()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local frog = self.frog

	quest_icon_util.remove(frog)

	party_util.align_party(frog.Position, 'up', 1)

	start_coroutine(self.frog_jump_action, self)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(frog, nil, 'tease')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_grass_slide_02')
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(frog, 0, 1)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_frog_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_small_jump_01')
	character_util.set_anim(frog, { name = 'jump', loop = false })
	character_util.move_to_async(frog, frog.Position + vector(0, 0, 1),
			0.5,nil, true, false)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
	character_util.jump(leader, 1, 0.5)
	character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'embarrassed' })
	character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'surprise' })

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.set_active_state(frog, 'disabled')

	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'qs_get_frog_1' })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_bad_01')
	character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'cast' })
	character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'scared' })
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(leader, nil, 'annoyed')

	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'qs_get_frog_'..self.stage_name })

	self.frog.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.NPCCrashBehaviour.Instance

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

	stage_util.set_fo_active_state(self.invisible_wall_name, 'disabled')
	self.section:complete()
end

function local_class:angry_frog_scene()
	local frog = self.frog
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	self.get_fx_hit():Instantiate(frog.Position + vector(0, 0.3, 0))
	self.get_fx_lasthit():Instantiate(frog.Position + vector(0, 0.3, 0))

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_big_01')

	camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.3)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_jump_01')
	quest_icon_util.remove(frog)
	character_util.spine_deviate_local(frog, vector(0, 0, 0.3), 0.3, 0.2)
	character_util.spine_pulse_color(frog, CS.Oak.Constants.DamageColor, 1, 1, 1)
	character_util.spine_damage_squish(frog, 1.3, 0.7, 1, 0.3)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_angry_01')
	character_util.show_emoticon(frog, nil, 'angry')

	camera_util.move_async(frog.Position, 1)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 기 모으는 이펙트 추가
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_frog_04')
	character_util.shake(frog, 0.1, 5.5)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_evolution_01')
	camera_util.shake(0.1, 2)

	wait_for_sec(2)

	camera_util.shake(0.3, 2.8)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_light_laser_03')
	local laser = self.get_fx_laser():Instantiate(frog.Position)
	laser.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 90, 0)

	camera_util.move(frog.Position + vector(0, 0, 8), 0.7)

	for i = 1, self.frog_rock_num do
		local cur_rock = get_field_object(self.frog_rock_name_prefix..i)

		local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
		damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Explosion | CS.Oak.DamageType.AffectGimmick
		damage_info.sender = self.frog
		damage_info.target = cur_rock
		damage_info.damage = 100

		command_util.execute_damage(damage_info)

		wait_for_sec(0.1)
	end

	wait_for_sec(2.8 - 0.1 * self.frog_rock_num)

	laser:Dispose()

	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	camera_util.move_async(leader.Position, 1.5, { end_target = leader })

	quest_icon_util.set_quest_cleared(frog)
	character_util.add_listener(frog, self.section)
end

function local_class:frog_jump_action()
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_small_jump_01')
	character_util.jump(self.frog, 1, 0.5)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_small_jump_01')
	character_util.jump(self.frog, 1, 0.5)
end

return {
	create = function()
		return local_class
	end
}

	self.robot_toy_fo = get_field_object(self.robot_toy_fo_name)

	self.belt_box_center_pos = field:GetMarker(self.belt_box_marker_name).position
	self.frog_invader_room_pos = field:GetMarker(self.frog_invader_room_marker_name).position
	self.frog_figure_scene_figure_pos = field:GetMarker(self.frog_figure_scene_figure_marker_name).position
	self.frog_figure_scene_frog_pos_1 = field:GetMarker(self.frog_figure_scene_frog_marker_1_name).position
	self.frog_figure_scene_frog_pos_2 = field:GetMarker(self.frog_figure_scene_frog_marker_2_name).position
	self.frog_figure_scene_invader_pos_1 = field:GetMarker(self.frog_figure_scene_invader_marker_1_name).position
	self.frog_figure_scene_invader_pos_2 = field:GetMarker(self.frog_figure_scene_invader_marker_2_name).position

		character_util.set_active_state(self.invader, 'enabled')
		self.robot_toy_fo.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
		self.robot_toy_fo.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
		self.belt_box_fo.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
		self.can_belt_box_interact = true
		table_util.for_each(self.robot_toy_marker_names, function(number, marker_name)
			local marker_pos = field:GetMarker(marker_name).position
			local item_id = self.robot_toy_2_item_id

			if number == 3 then

-- 여기서부터 이벤트 구독된 콜백 함수
function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == self.invader_first_trigger_zone and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), zone_name) and
			not self.is_triggered_by_invader_first_scene and
			not self.section:is_complete() and
			self.invader.ActiveState == active_state('enabled') then
		-- 여기서 인베이더 첫 조우 연출 재생
		self.is_triggered_by_invader_first_scene = true
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(self.invader_first_meet_scene, self)
		return true
	elseif zone_name == self.invader_room_trigger_zone and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), zone_name) and
			not self.is_triggered_by_invader_talk_scene and
			not self.invader_talk_coroutine_is_alive and
			not self.invader_talk_paused and
			not self.section:is_complete() and
			self.invader.ActiveState == active_state('enabled') then
		-- 여기서 인베이더 방에 입장 talk 연출
		self.is_triggered_by_invader_talk_scene = true
		start_coroutine(self.invader_talk, self)
		return true
	elseif zone_name == self.frog_first_trigger_zone and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), zone_name) and
			not self.section:is_complete() and
			not self.is_triggered_by_frog_first_scene then
		-- 여기서 컨베이어 벨트 방 첫 입장 연출
		self.is_triggered_by_frog_first_scene = true
		start_coroutine(self.frog_green_scene, self)
		return true
	elseif zone_name == self.frog_extra_event_zone_1 and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), zone_name) and
			not self.is_triggered_by_invader_first_scene and
			not self.section:is_complete() and
			self.invader.ActiveState == active_state('enabled') then
		self.is_triggered_by_invader_first_scene = true
		self:extra_event()
		return true
	elseif zone_name == self.frog_extra_event_zone_2 and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), zone_name) and
			not self.section:is_complete() and
			not self.is_triggered_by_frog_first_scene then
		-- 여기서 컨베이어 벨트 방 첫 입장 연출
		self.is_triggered_by_frog_first_scene = true
		start_coroutine(self.frog_green_scene, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == self.invader_room_trigger_zone and
			type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, get_party_leader(), zone_name) and
			self.is_triggered_by_invader_talk_scene then
		self.is_triggered_by_invader_talk_scene = false
	end
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if not self.has_acquired_bot_toy
			and self.drop_item ~= nil and
			self.robot_toy_fo ~= nil and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(self.robot_toy_fo, e.Target) then
		-- 여기서 인베이더가 있는데 인베이더의 생존 여부에 따라 이벤트가 달라진다.
		if self.invader.CharacterStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(self.drop_item_scene, self)
		else
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(self.detected_by_invader, self)
		end

		return true
	end

	if self.can_belt_box_interact and
			self.belt_box_fo ~= nil and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(self.belt_box_fo, e.Target) then
		self.can_belt_box_interact = false
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(self.belt_box_scene, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:play_frog_sfx(sfx_name, loop, repeat_term)
	if loop == nil then
		loop = false
	end

	return music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = sfx_name,
										parent = self.frog,
										loop = loop, type_priority = 'event',
										player_priority = 'npc',
										repeat_term = repeat_term,
										max_distance = 9 })
end

-- 예외 처리하기 위한 이벤트
function local_class:extra_event()
	local invader = self.invader
	local frog = self.frog

	if self.field_robot_toy ~= nil then
		self.field_robot_toy:ConsumeComplete()
		self.field_robot_toy = nil
	end

	invader.Position = self.frog_invader_room_pos
	character_util.set_direction(invader, 'left')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(invader, { name = 'sing' }, { name = 'love' })

	-- 개구리 복원해서 위치 옮겨두기
	character_util.spine_rotate(frog, 0, 0)
	character_util.set_active_state(frog, 'enabled')
	frog.Position = self.frog_start_pos
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(frog)
	character_util.set_direction(frog, 'left')

	-- 여기서 암살 가능한 상태로 변경.
	character_util.convert_to_monster(invader)

function local_class:invader_talk()
	self.invader_talk_paused = false
	self.invader_talk_coroutine_is_alive = true
	while self.is_triggered_by_invader_talk_scene and not self.invader.CharacterStatsBehaviour.IsDead do
		if self.invader_talk_paused then
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		else
			-- 인베이더 : 헤헤~ 소중한 내 보물들…
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.invader, { key = 'qs_frog_queenship_1_6_invader_1' })
			wait_for_sec(10)

		end
	end

	self.invader_talk_coroutine_is_alive = false
end

-- 개구리 벨트 이동이 끝나면 발생할 무한 루프. 외부에서 꺼줘야한다
function local_class:frog_jump_loop_scene()
	local loop_flag = true
	local belt_speed = 3
	local move_speed = 4
	local jump_target_distance_x = 2.25
	local jump_target_pos = self.frog.Position + vector(-jump_target_distance_x, 0, 0)
	self.is_frog_jump_loop = true
	self.frog_loop_end_point = self.frog.Position

	while loop_flag do
		-- 점프중이 아닐때는 x축을 계속 + 해준다.
		-- 여기서 점프!
		if self.frog.Position.x >= self.frog_loop_end_point.x then
			if self.can_frog_jump_loop then
				-- 거리 / 속도 = 시간
				local duration = jump_target_distance_x / move_speed
				local dash_sfx = self:play_frog_sfx('01_small_jump_01', false, 0.25)
				character_util.set_anim(self.frog, { name = 'walk' })
				character_util.jump(self.frog, 0.5, duration)
				character_util.move_to_async(self.frog, jump_target_pos, duration, nil, true, false, false)
				character_util.set_anim(self.frog, { name = 'idle' })
				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.frog)
				dash_sfx:FadeOut(0.1)
			else
				loop_flag = false
			end
		else
			-- 여기선 루프
			local prev_pos = self.frog.Position
			self.frog.Position = vector(prev_pos.x + belt_speed * unity_class.time.deltaTime, prev_pos.y, prev_pos.z)
			character_util.set_anim(self.frog, { name = 'idle' })
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.frog)
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.is_frog_jump_loop = false
end

									loop = false, type_priority = 'event',
									player_priority = 'npc',
									max_distance = 7 })
		character_util.jump_move(self.frog, leader.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0), 4, 0.5, true, 'right')

		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_small_jump_01',

									loop = false, type_priority = 'event',

									max_distance = 7 })

		wait_for_sec(0.2)

		field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'qs_get_frog_1'})

		-- 나레이션 : 로봇 전사 피규어를 좋아하는 초록색 개구리를 획득했다!
		field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'qs_get_frog_queenship_1_6'})
		character_util.shake_and_wakeup(leader, 'left', 2, nil, true)
		self.section:complete()
	else
		-- 장난감을 가지고 있으면 선택지 출력
		if self.has_acquired_bot_toy then
			local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({ { 'qs_frog_queenship_1_6_belt_box_2', 'intellect' }, { 'qs_frog_queenship_1_6_belt_box_3', 'normal' } })

			-- 선택지 1 ) [피규어를 넣는다.] => 개구리 들어가는 연출 시작!
			if choose_result == 1 then
				local box_goal_pos = box_pos + vector(0.25, 0, 0.25)
				self.can_star_piece_appear = true
				character_util.move_to_async(leader, leader.Position + vector(-0.15, 0, 0), nil, 1, true, true)

				-- 가디언 left, idle, throw와 동시에 피규어가 튀어나와 바구니 안에 robot_warrior_figure배치
				local item = drop_item_util.create_item({
					itemid = self.robot_toy_item_id,
					notforinven = true,
					pos = leader.Position,
					sprscale = 0.8,
					lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
					showoncharacter = false,
					skip_text = true
				})

				start_coroutine(function()
					music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_throw_01')
					character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(leader, { name = 'throw' })
					character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'idle' })
				end, self)

				-- 아이템이 사라지는 연출
				drop_item_util.throw_item(item, box_goal_pos)
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_hit_npc_01')
				character_util.move_to_async(leader, leader.Position + vector(0.16, 0, 0), nil, 1, false, true)

				table.insert(self.robot_toys, item)
				self.can_frog_jump_loop = false

				while self.is_frog_jump_loop do
					coroutine.yield(nil)
				end

				-- 개구리의 연출
				character_util.set_direction(self.frog, 'right')
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')

				-- 개구리가 바구니 쪽으로 점프 해야한다.
				self:play_frog_sfx('01_player_jump_01')
				character_util.jump_move(self.frog, box_pos + vector(-0.25, 0, 0), 4, 1, true)
				wait_for_sec(0.5)


				local item_move_duration = 0.5
				local current_time = 0

				drop_item_util.move_item(item, self.frog.Position, { duration = item_move_duration })

				local item_sprite = item.SpriteTransform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
				local shadow_sprite = item.ShadowTransform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
				local item_start_color = item_sprite.TintColor
				local shadow_start_color = shadow_sprite.TintColor

				while current_time < item_move_duration do
					local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime
					current_time = current_time + dt

					local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(current_time / item_move_duration)
					local target_scale = vector(1, 1, 1) - (vector(1, 1, 1) * progress)

					item.SpriteTransform.localScale = target_scale
					item.ShadowTransform.localScale = target_scale

					item_sprite.TintColor = unity_color({ 1, 1, 1, 1 }) * unity_class.mathf.Lerp(item_start_color.a, 1, progress)
					shadow_sprite.Alpha = 0.38 * unity_class.mathf.Lerp(shadow_start_color.a, 1, progress)

					item_sprite:Rebuild()
					shadow_sprite:Rebuild()
					coroutine.yield(nil)
				end

				item.ConsumeTarget = self.frog
				item:ConsumeComplete()
				item = nil

				wait_for_sec(0.5)
				self:play_frog_sfx('01_bad_fairy_01')
				self:play_frog_sfx('01_frog_02')
				character_util.show_emoticon_async(self.frog, nil, 'happy')
				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
			end
			self.can_belt_box_interact = true
		else
			-- 나레이션 : 무엇인가 담을 수 있는 바구니다.
			field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'qs_frog_queenship_1_6_belt_box_1' })
			self.can_belt_box_interact = true
		end
	end
end

return {
	create = function()
		return local_class
	end
}

			pos = self.frog_weapon_pos_list[5],
			lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
			showoncharacter = false,
			skip_text = true
		})

		item_5.SpriteTransform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 45, 0)
		item_5.ShadowTransform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 45, 0)

		self.frog_shoot_rifle = drop_item_util.create_item({
			itemid = 20761,
			notforinven = true,
			pos = self.frog.Position + vector(0, 0, 1),
			lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
			showoncharacter = false,
			skip_text = true
		})

		self.frog_shoot_rifle.SpriteTransform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, -90, 0)

		character_util.set_active_state(self.frog, 'enabled')
		self.frog_rifle.Position = self.frog_rifle_spawn_pos
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_zone_leave_event')

		local spec = CS.Oak.GameDataService.GetData('ProjectileData'):GetSpec('projectile_queenship_frog_bullet')
		local pattern_Info = CS.Oak.ShootPatternInfo()
		pattern_Info.columns = 1
		pattern_Info.spreadDistance = 0
		pattern_Info.parallel = true

				shooter, spec, pattern_Info, CS.Oak.ShootHelperShootEffectType.EachShoot, 0.8)

		notforinven = true,

		lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
		showoncharacter = true,
		skip_text = true
	})

function local_class:on_exit(section)
	self.section = nil
	self.frog = nil
	self.frog_rifle = nil
	self.frog_rifle_spawn_pos = nil
	self.frog_rifle_drop_item = nil
	self.projectile_data = nil
	self.shoot_helper = nil

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MoveFieldObjectEvent))
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	-- npc interact event
	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local is_complete = self.section:is_complete()

	if not is_complete and self.can_interact_frog and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.frog) then
		quest_icon_util.remove(self.frog)
		self.can_interact_frog = false
		self.frog.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
		-- 붉은 개구리 이벤트 실행
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(self.frog_red_scene, self)
		return true
	end

	if self.can_interact_frog_statue and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.frog_statue) then
		-- 동상에 대한 연출
		self.can_interact_frog_statue = false
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(self.frog_statue_scene, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local is_complete = self.section:is_complete()

	if not is_complete and type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, self.frog_event_zone_1_name) then
		self.can_projectile_shot = true
	end
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local is_complete = self.section:is_complete()

	if not is_complete and type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, leader, self.frog_event_zone_1_name) then
		self.can_projectile_shot = false
	end
end

function local_class:on_move_fo_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.frog_rifle) then
		self.frog_rifle_drop_item.Position = self.frog_rifle.Position + vector(0, 0.75, 0)
	end
end

function local_class:projectile_shot_event()
	while not self.section:is_complete() and self.shoot_helper ~= nil do
		if self.can_projectile_shot then
			local frog_position = self.frog.Position
			music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_gun_shoot_04',
										parent = self.frog, loop = false,
										type_priority = 'event',
										player_priority = 'npc',
										max_distance = 9})

			self.shoot_helper:ShootTargetPosition(frog_position + vector(0, 0, 5), vector(0, 0, 1), -1)
			self.shoot_helper:ShootTargetPosition(frog_position + vector(1, 0, 5), vector(0, 0, 1), -1)
			self.shoot_helper:ShootTargetPosition(frog_position + vector(-1, 0, 5), vector(0, 0, 1), -1)
		end
		wait_for_sec(0.33334)
	end
end

function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	if self.shoot_helper == nil then return end

	local target = hit_info.target

	if target ~= nil then
		local direction = vector_util.get_x0z(target.Position - self.frog.Position).normalized
		local knock_direction = vector(0, 0, 1)
		local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
		damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Trap
		damage_info.sender = self.frog
		damage_info.target = target
		damage_info.direction = direction
		damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
		damage_info.knockBackDirection = knock_direction
		damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce
		damage_info.damage = math.floor(target.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP * 0.1)
		damage_info.notMortal = true

		command_util.execute_damage(damage_info)
		self.shoot_helper:OnHit(hit_info)
	end
end

-- 내장 함수
function local_class:frog_red_scene()
	self.shoot_helper = nil
	timeline_util.play_async(self.timeline_director_name, self.frog_red_scene_asset)
	self.section:complete()
end

-- 개구리 석상 상호작용 이벤트
function local_class:frog_statue_scene()
	local frog_statue = get_character(self.frog_statue_name)
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local princess= self.get_princess()
	-- 정렬 시키기
	local center_pos = frog_statue.Position + vector(0, 0, -1.5)
	local leader_pos = center_pos + vector(-0.5, 0, 0)
	local princess_pos = center_pos + vector(0.5, 0, 0)

	character_util.move_waypoint(leader, leader_pos, 2, false, 'stop', 'floor', 'up')
	character_util.move_waypoint(princess, princess_pos, 2, false, 'stop', 'floor', 'up')

	camera_util.move_async(center_pos, 1)

	-- 나레이션 : 수상하게 생긴 동상이다.
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'qs_frog_queenship_1_3_choice_1' })

	-- 나레이션 : 더 가까이서 보시겠습니까?
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'qs_frog_queenship_1_3_choice_2' })

	-- 선택지 : 네 / 아니오
	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({ { 'qs_frog_queenship_1_3_choice_3', 'intellect' }, { 'qs_frog_queenship_1_3_choice_4', 'normal' } })

	if choose_result == 1 then
		-- 기사와 공주 각각 한칸 위로 옮긴다.
		character_util.move_waypoint(leader, center_pos + vector(0, 0, 1), 1, false, 'stop', 'floor', 'up')

		-- 카메라도 한칸 위로 옮김
		camera_util.move_async(center_pos + vector(0, 0, 1), 1)

		-- 나레이션 : 아무 일도 일어나지 않았다.
		field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'qs_frog_queenship_1_3_choice_8' })
	end

	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)
	self.can_interact_frog_statue = true
end

return {
	create = function()
		return local_class
	end
}

		self.invader_start_pos_list[index] = invader.Position
		if not is_complete then
			character_util.set_active_state(self.invaders[index], 'enabled')
		end
	end)

	if is_complete then
		get_field_object(self.frog_paint_box_1_name).ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
		get_field_object(self.frog_paint_box_2_name).ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
		character_util.set_active_state(self.frog, 'disabled')
	else
		-- drop item create (20775)
		self.frog_paint_drop_item = drop_item_util.create_item({
			itemid = 20775,
			notforinven = true,
			pos = self.paint_reset_pos,
			lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
			showoncharacter = true,
			skip_text = true
		})
		self.can_paint_box_scene = true
		get_field_object(self.frog_paint_box_1_name).ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
		get_field_object(self.frog_paint_box_2_name).ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
		local paint_object = get_field_object(self.frog_paint_holdable_object_name)
		paint_object.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.PotDamagedBehaviour()
		paint_object.Position = self.paint_reset_pos
		paint_object.ActiveState = active_state('visible')
		paint_object.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
		self.frog.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
		self.can_have_frog = true
		character_util.set_direction(self.frog, 'right')
		character_util.set_active_state(self.frog, 'enabled')

		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), 'on_field_object_destroyed_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), 'on_damage_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MoveFieldObjectEvent), 'on_move_fo_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')

		self:reset_invaders()
		self.can_frog_alpha_scene = true
		self.frog_paint_drop_item.Position = paint_object.Position + vector(0, 0.15, 0)
		start_coroutine(self.frog_alpha_scene, self)
	end
end

function local_class:on_exit(section)
	if self.frog_paint_drop_item ~= nil then
		self.frog_paint_drop_item:ConsumeComplete()
		self.frog_paint_drop_item = nil
	end

	self:stop_invader_2_equipping_sfx()
	self:dispose_oilbottle_break()
	self.frog = nil
	self.star_piece = nil
	self.frog_event_zone_bounds = nil
	self.frog_hit_event_zone_1_bounds = nil
	self.frog_invader_escape_pos_list = nil
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MoveFieldObjectEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
end

function local_class:on_field_object_destroyed_event(e)
	local destroyed_object = e.FieldObject

	if destroyed_object.Name == self.frog_paint_holdable_object_name then
		local target_pos = destroyed_object.Position
		start_coroutine(function() self:paint_throw_effect(target_pos) end, self)
		destroyed_object.Position = self.paint_reset_pos
		start_coroutine(self.paint_object_scale_event, self)
	end
end

function local_class:paint_object_scale_event()
	local paint_box_1 = get_field_object(self.frog_paint_box_1_name)
	local time = 0
	local duration = 1
	local paint_object = get_field_object(self.frog_paint_holdable_object_name)
	--paint_object.transform.localScale = vector(0, 0, 0)
	paint_box_1.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
	paint_object.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
	self.frog_paint_drop_item.SpriteTransform.localScale = vector(0, 0, 0)
	self.frog_paint_drop_item.ShadowTransform.localScale = vector(0, 0, 0)
	while time < duration do
		local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local percent = math.min(time / duration, 1)
		local target_scale = vector(1, 1, 1) * percent

		self.frog_paint_drop_item.SpriteTransform.localScale = target_scale
		self.frog_paint_drop_item.ShadowTransform.localScale = target_scale
		time = time + dt
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	paint_box_1.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
	paint_object.ActiveState = active_state('visible')

	self.can_paint_box_scene = true
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local is_complete = self.section:is_complete()

	if not is_complete and self.can_have_frog and lua_helper.reference_equals(self.frog, e.Target) then
		self.can_have_frog = false
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(self.frog_result_scene, self)
	end

	if not is_complete and self.can_paint_box_scene then
		local paint_box_1 = get_field_object(self.frog_paint_box_1_name)
		local paint_box_2 = get_field_object(self.frog_paint_box_2_name)

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(paint_box_1, e.Target) or lua_helper.reference_equals(paint_box_2, e.Target) then
			-- 페인트 통 얻는 이벤트
			self.can_paint_box_scene = false
			paint_box_1.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
			start_coroutine(self.get_paint_holdable_object_event, self)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_damage_event(e)
	local is_complete = self.section:is_complete()

	if not is_complete and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.sender, get_field_object(self.frog_paint_holdable_object_name)) then
		local target = e.Info.target

		table_util.for_each(self.invaders, function(index, invader)
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(target, invader) and not self.is_detected_by_invader then
				self.is_detected_by_invader = true
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(self.detected_by_invader, self)
			end
		end)
	end
end

function local_class:on_move_fo_event(e)
	local paint_holdable_object = get_field_object(self.frog_paint_holdable_object_name)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, paint_holdable_object) then
		--self.frog_rifle_drop_item.Position = self.frog_rifle.Position + vector(0, 0.75, 0)
		self.frog_paint_drop_item.Position = paint_holdable_object.Position + vector(0, 0.15, 0)
	end
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local is_complete = self.section:is_complete()

	if not is_complete then
		if not self.frog_invader_talk_1_is_triggered and type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, self.frog_event_zone_1_name) then
			self.frog_invader_talk_1_is_triggered = true
			self.can_invader_talk_scene_1 = true
			self.can_invader_talk_scene_2 = false
			start_coroutine(self.invader_talk_scene_2, self)
		elseif not self.frog_invader_talk_2_is_triggered and type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, self.frog_event_zone_2_name) then
			self.frog_invader_talk_2_is_triggered = true
			self.can_invader_talk_scene_1 = false
			self.can_invader_talk_scene_2 = true
			start_coroutine(self.invader_talk_scene_1, self)
		end
	end
end

-- 내장 함수
function local_class:detected_by_invader()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
	self.can_invader_talk_scene_1 = false
	self.can_invader_talk_scene_2 = false

	self:stop_invader_2_equipping_sfx()
	table_util.for_each(self.invaders, function(index, invader)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(invader)
		character_util.look_at(invader, leader)
	end)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')

	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'right')
	wait_for_sec(0.25)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'left')
	wait_for_sec(0.25)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'right')

	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	-- 화면 위 (shout) : 침입자다!! 잡아!!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.look_at(leader, self.invaders[2])
	character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'surprise' })
	character_util.normal_jump(leader, '01_jump_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.invaders[2], { key = 'qs_frog_queenship_1_5_invader_1', skip = true, bubble_type = 'shout' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_goblin_appear_01')
	camera_util.shake(0.15, 0.15)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	-- 상단 말풍선 종료 후, 인베이더1~4가 가디언 방향으로 prostrate 점프
	-- 점프 시작하면 가디언(흰색2방향, surprise, embarrassed)
	-- 점프 시작하면 슬로우

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(leader, { name = 'embarrassed' }, { name = 'surprise' })
	table_util.for_each(self.invaders, function(index, invader)
		local dir = (leader.Position - invader.Position).normalized
		local target_pos = invader.Position + dir * 2
		self:character_play_sfx(invader, '02_twohand_stomp_jump_01')
		character_util.jump_move(invader, target_pos, 3, 1, false)
	end)

	wait_for_sec(0.25)
	-- 여기서 슬로우
	time_util.mod('frog_detect_event', 0.1)
	wait_for_sec(0.05)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_02')
	screen_util.fade_out_circular(0.15, 'linear')
	wait_for_sec(0.15)
	time_util.unmod('frog_detect_event')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
	party_util.align_party(self.detected_marker_pos, 'up', 0)
	self:reset_invaders()
	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(1, 'linear')

	self.is_detected_by_invader = false
end

function local_class:invader_talk_scene_1()
	-- 어디서 개구리 울음 소리 안 들려...?
	character_util.set_direction(self.invaders[3], 'up')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.invaders[3], { key = 'qs_frog_queenship_1_5_invader_6', skip = false })
	if not self.can_invader_talk_scene_1 then
		return
	end

	self:reset_invaders()
	if not self.can_invader_talk_scene_1 then
		return
	end

	-- 방에 아무도 없는데, 뭐지...
	character_util.set_direction(self.invaders[4], 'down')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.invaders[4], { name = 'idle' }, { name = 'tired' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.invaders[4], { key = 'qs_frog_queenship_1_5_invader_7', skip = false })
	if not self.can_invader_talk_scene_1 then
		return
	end

	self:reset_invaders()
	if not self.can_invader_talk_scene_1 then
		return
	end
end

function local_class:play_invader_2_equipping_sfx()
	if self.equipping_sfx == nil then
		self.equipping_sfx = self:character_play_sfx(self.invaders[2], '03_equipping_01', true, 3)
	end
end

function local_class:stop_invader_2_equipping_sfx()
	if self.equipping_sfx ~= nil then
		self.equipping_sfx:FadeOut(0.1)
		self.equipping_sfx = nil
	end
end

function local_class:invader_talk_scene_2()
	-- 인베이더 1 : 어디서 자꾸 이상한 소리가...
	self:character_play_sfx(self.invaders[1], '01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_direction(self.invaders[1], 'up')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.invaders[1], { key = 'qs_frog_queenship_1_5_invader_8', skip = false })
	if not self.can_invader_talk_scene_2 then
		return
	end

	self:reset_invaders()
	if not self.can_invader_talk_scene_2 then
		return
	end

	character_util.set_direction(self.invaders[2], 'left')
	self:play_invader_2_equipping_sfx()
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.invaders[2], { name = 'eat' }, { name = 'attack' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.invaders[2], { key = 'qs_frog_queenship_1_5_invader_9', skip = false })
	if not self.can_invader_talk_scene_2 then
		return
	end

	self:reset_invaders()
	if not self.can_invader_talk_scene_2 then
		return
	end
end

function local_class:reset_invaders()
	table_util.for_each(self.invaders, function(index, invader)
		character_util.set_position(invader, self.invader_start_pos_list[index])
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(invader)
	end)

	character_util.set_direction(self.invaders[1], 'down')
	character_util.set_anim(self.invaders[1], { name = 'shoot' })
	character_util.set_direction(self.invaders[2], 'left')
	self:play_invader_2_equipping_sfx()
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.invaders[2], { name = 'eat', sfx_name = '03_equipping_01' }, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.set_direction(self.invaders[3], 'up')
	character_util.set_direction(self.invaders[4], 'down')
end

function local_class:frog_result_scene()
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	get_field_object(self.frog_paint_box_1_name).ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
	get_field_object(self.frog_paint_box_2_name).ActiveState = active_state('disabled')

	party_util.align_party(self.frog.Position, 'right', 1)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_frog_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_small_jump_01')
	character_util.jump_move(self.frog, leader.Position, 4, 1, false)
	wait_for_sec(0.2)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_grass_slide_02')
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(self.frog, 0, 0.75)
	wait_for_sec(0.75)
	character_util.set_active_state(self.frog, 'disabled')
	self.section:frog_get_scene('qs_get_frog_queenship_1_5')

	self.section:complete()
end

function local_class:frog_active_event()
	self.frog.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
end

function local_class:frog_alpha_scene()
	while self.can_frog_alpha_scene do
		-- 5초에 한번씩 알파 변화
		self:character_play_sfx(self.frog, '01_frog_03')
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(self.frog, 0.5, 0.3)
		wait_for_sec(0.3)
		if not self.can_frog_alpha_scene then
			return
		end

		wait_for_sec(0.4)
		if not self.can_frog_alpha_scene then
			return
		end

		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(self.frog, 0, 0.3)
		wait_for_sec(0.3)
		if not self.can_frog_alpha_scene then
			return
		end

		wait_for_sec(4)
	end
end

function local_class:dispose_oilbottle_break()
	if self.olibottle_break ~= nil then
		self.olibottle_break:Dispose()
		self.olibottle_break = nil
	end
end

-- 페인트 통 얻는 연출
function local_class:get_paint_holdable_object_event()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local obj = get_field_object(self.frog_paint_holdable_object_name)
	obj.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled
	obj.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour:Heal(10000, false)
	command_util.execute_holdup(leader, obj, leader.Position, nil, true)
	coroutine.yield(nil)
end

function local_class:paint_throw_effect(position)
	local target_pos = vector(position.x, 0, position.z)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_water_splash_02', play_pos = target_pos })

	-- 여기서 bound check
	local is_complete = self.section:is_complete()

	if not is_complete and not self.frog_event_is_triggered and self.frog_hit_event_zone_1_bounds:Contains(target_pos) then
		self.frog_event_is_triggered = true
		self.can_frog_alpha_scene = false
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(self.frog_scene, self)
	end

	self:dispose_oilbottle_break()
	self.olibottle_break = self.get_oilbottle_break():Instantiate(target_pos)
	wait_for_sec(2)
	self.get_oilbottle_break_end():Instantiate(target_pos)
	self:dispose_oilbottle_break()
end

function local_class:frog_scene()
	self.can_invader_talk_scene_1 = false
	self.can_invader_talk_scene_2 = false

	camera_util.move_async(self.frog.Position, 1)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_frog_03')
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(self.frog, 1, 1)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_jump_01')
	self:stop_invader_2_equipping_sfx()
	table_util.for_each(self.invaders, function(index, invader)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(invader)
		character_util.set_direction(invader, 'left')
		character_util.set_emotion(invader, { name = 'surprise' })
		character_util.normal_jump(invader, true)
	end)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 개, 개구리...?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.invaders[1], { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' }, { name = 'scared' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.invaders[1], { key = 'qs_frog_queenship_1_5_invader_2', skip = true })

	-- 어, 언제부터 여기에...
	self:stop_invader_2_equipping_sfx()
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.invaders[2], { name = 'idle' }, { name = 'surprise' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.invaders[2], { key = 'qs_frog_queenship_1_5_invader_3', skip = true })

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 귀, 귀신...
	character_util.set_emotion(self.invaders[1], { name = 'scared' })
	character_util.remove_anim(self.invaders[1])
	character_util.set_direction(self.invaders[1], 'left')
	character_util.move_to(self.invaders[1], self.invaders[1].Position + vector(1, 0, 0), 1, nil, false, true)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.invaders[1], { key = 'qs_frog_queenship_1_5_invader_4', skip = true })

	-- 귀신 개구리다!!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_camera_emphasize_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.invaders[1], { key = 'qs_frog_queenship_1_5_invader_5', skip = true, bubble_type = 'shout' })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_villain_scream_01')
	local dash_sfx = self:character_play_sfx(self.invaders[1], '01_dash_01', true)
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(self.invaders[1], self.frog_invader_escape_pos_list[1], 7, true,
			'stop', 'floor', 'up', false)

	dash_sfx:FadeOut(0.1)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_villain_scream_02')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_02')
	character_util.move_waypoint(self.invaders[2], self.frog_invader_escape_pos_list[2], 7, true,
			'stop', 'floor', 'up', false)

	character_util.move_waypoint(self.invaders[3], self.frog_invader_escape_pos_list[3], 7, true,
			'stop', 'floor', 'up', false)

	character_util.move_waypoint_async(self.invaders[4], self.frog_invader_escape_pos_list[4], 7, true,
			'stop', 'floor', 'up', false)

	table_util.for_each(self.invaders, function(index, invader)
		character_util.set_active_state(invader, 'disabled')
	end)

	character_util.set_direction(self.frog, 'right')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(self.frog, nil, 'sweat')
	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

	self.frog.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
	self.can_have_frog = true
end

function local_class:character_play_sfx(character, sfx_name, loop, max_distance)
	if loop == nil then
		loop = false
	end

	if max_distance == nil then
		max_distance = 9
	end

	return music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = sfx_name,
										parent = character,
										loop = loop, type_priority = 'event',
										player_priority = 'npc',
										max_distance = max_distance })
end

return {
	create = function()
		return local_class
	end
}

	end
	self.get_door_switch_2 = function()
		return get_field_object('frog_door_switch_2')
	end

	self.get_invader_1 = function()
		return get_character('frog_invader_1')
	end
	self.get_invader_2 = function()
		return get_character('frog_invader_2')
	end

	self.event_state = {
		not_started = 1,
		started = 2,
		scene_mode = 3,
		puzzle_mode = 4,
		complete = 5
	}

	self.prev_event_state = self.event_state.not_started
	self.current_event_state = self.event_state.not_started
	self.event_state_callbacks = { }
	self.loop_index = 0

	-- 이걸 통해서 이벤트 스테이트 변경
	self.set_event_state = function(state)
		self.prev_event_state = self.current_event_state
		self.current_event_state = state

		-- 바뀌었을때 해당 이벤트의 콜백이 있다면 발동
		if self.prev_event_state ~= state then
			if self.event_state_callbacks[state] ~= nil then
				self.event_state_callbacks[state]()
			end
		end
	end

end

function local_class:on_start(section)
	self.frog = get_character(self.frog_name)
	self.invader_event_center_pos = field:GetMarker('frog_invader_event_center_pos').position
	self.invader_event_pos_1 = field:GetMarker('frog_invader_event_pos_1').position
	self.invader_event_pos_2 = field:GetMarker('frog_invader_event_pos_2').position

	-- 특정 존의 센터 포지션 가져오기
	self.frog_scene_center_pos = field:GetZone(self.frog_event_zone_3_name).Bounds.center

	-- 문들 캐시 작업
	for i = 1, self.door_type_count do
		self.door_table[i] = { }
		local door_list = self.door_table[i]

		for j = 1, self.door_max_count do
			local door_name = self.door_name_prefix .. i .. '_' .. j
			door_list[j] = door_name
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create(door_name, true))
		end
	end

	-- 해당 부분 다음 섹션에서 개구리가 보이기 때문에 처리 해줘야함.
	local is_complete = section:is_complete()

	if is_complete then
		character_util.set_active_state(self.frog, 'disabled')
	else
		character_util.set_active_state(self.frog, 'enabled')
		character_util.set_active_state(self.get_invader_1(), 'enabled')
		character_util.set_active_state(self.get_invader_2(), 'enabled')
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_zone_leave_event')
	end
end

function local_class:on_exit(section)
	self.door_table = nil
	self.frog = nil
	self.section = nil

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local is_complete = self.section:is_complete()
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	if not is_complete then
		if self.current_event_state == self.event_state.not_started and type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, self.frog_event_zone_1_name) then
			-- 여기가 이벤트 시작 지점
			self.set_event_state(self.event_state.started)
			start_coroutine(self.invader_loop_scene, self)
		end

		if self.current_event_state == self.event_state.started and type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, self.frog_event_zone_2_name) then
			self.set_event_state(self.event_state.scene_mode)
			-- 여기서 트리거존 1번 진입시 실행 연출 재생
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(self.invader_scene, self)
		end

		if self.current_event_state == self.event_state.puzzle_mode and type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, self.frog_event_zone_3_name) then
			self.set_event_state(self.event_state.complete)
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(self.frog_scene, self)
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	return false
end

-- 개구리 스위치를 향해 좌우로 점프하는 용도의 연출 async
function local_class:frog_jump_async(dir, speed, move_duration)
	local dir_name = 'left'
	if dir.x > 0 then
		dir_name = 'right'
	end

	character_util.set_direction(self.frog, dir_name)
	character_util.set_anim(self.frog, { name = 'walk' })

	self:character_play_sfx(self.frog, '01_small_jump_01')

	while move_duration > 0 do
		local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime
		move_duration = move_duration - dt
		CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameStageLogic.ExecuteMove(self.frog, dir, speed * dt)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	character_util.remove_anim(self.frog)
	-- 스위치를 밟을때 소리
	self:character_play_sfx(self.frog, '02_switch_button_01')
end

function local_class:frog_loop_event()
	self.is_frog_loop = true
	-- 플레이어가 올라오게되면 중지 그전까진 3회 좌우 반복
	local run_speed = 7

	while self.current_event_state == self.event_state.puzzle_mode do
		local frog = self.frog

		if self.loop_index == 0 then
			local target_pos = self.get_door_switch_2().Position
			local dir = (target_pos - frog.Position).normalized
			local magnitude = (target_pos - frog.Position).magnitude
			local move_duration = magnitude / run_speed
			self:frog_jump_async(dir, run_speed, move_duration)
			self.loop_index = 1
		elseif self.loop_index == 1 then
			-- 인베이더 2인이 1번 도어에 도착하기 1타일 전, 붉은 점 위치의 개구리가 1번 스위치를 향해 right, idle, jump를 동작하여 1번 스위치에 도착하게 되며, 이에 맞춰 1번 도어가 상승.
			local target_pos = self.get_door_switch_1().Position
			local dir = (target_pos - frog.Position).normalized
			local magnitude = (target_pos - frog.Position).magnitude
			local move_duration = magnitude / run_speed
			self:frog_jump_async(dir, run_speed, move_duration)
			self.loop_index = 0
		end

		wait_for_sec(2)
	end

	self.is_frog_loop = false
end

function local_class:invader_scene()
	-- 인베이더와 문(door)의 거리. 현재는 상수로
	local door_distance = 7
	-- 인베이더가 달리는 이동속도 (초당)
	local run_speed = 7
	-- 달리기 시작했을때 다음 연출이 발동될 wait time
	-- 달리는 속도와 문과의 거리 - 2.5 을 이용해서 시간을 구한다 (door_distance - 2.5 / run_speed)
	local event_wait_time = (door_distance - 2.5) / run_speed
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	self.can_loop_scene = false

	while self.invader_loop_scene_is_running do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
	-- self.loop_index == 1 이면 우측을 바라보고 있음
	-- 반대로 0이면 좌측을 바라보는중
	local invader_1 = self.get_invader_1()
	local invader_2 = self.get_invader_2()
	local frog = self.frog

	--트리거 존 1번 진입 시 실행.
	--진입 시 플레이어, 인베이더 2인 모두 정지한 상태에서 하단의 대사 스크린 기준 플레이어 상단 2타일 위에 출력.
	--상단 대사와 함께 플레이어 일행 up, idle, jump 1회 실행.
	party_util.set_direction('up')
	party_util.jump(0.5, 0.3)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_small_jump_01')

	--인베이더 병사 : [shout] 이, 이제 그만 좀 해!
	self:character_play_sfx(invader_2, '03_dialogue_negative_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(invader_2, { key = 'qs_frog_queenship_1_4_invader_3', bubble_type = 'shout', skip = true })

	--상단 대사 종료되면 하단의 연출 일제히 실행.
	--플레이어 트리거 1 지점에 주황 박스 위치로 이동한 뒤, 통로 안쪽 바라보며 idle, cast.(꼬마 공주 1인 상황 / 기사와 꼬마공주 2인인 상황 모두 대응이 필요하며, 그로 인해 주황색 박스를 2곳 만들었습니다.)

	party_characters = { }
	party_util.for_each(function(index, character)
		party_characters[index] = character
	end)

	primary_move_scene = function()
		character_util.move_to_async(party_characters[1], self.invader_event_pos_1, nil, 4, true, true, true)
		character_util.set_direction(party_characters[1], 'right')
		wait_for_sec(0.05)
		character_util.set_anim(party_characters[1], { name = 'cast' })
	end

	if party_characters[2] ~= nil then
		secondary_move_scene = function()
			character_util.move_to_async(party_characters[2], self.invader_event_pos_2, nil, 4, true, true, true)
			character_util.set_direction(party_characters[2], 'left')
			wait_for_sec(0.05)
			character_util.set_anim(party_characters[2], { name = 'cast' })
		end

		wait_all({
			util.cs_generator(primary_move_scene, self),
			util.cs_generator(secondary_move_scene, self)
		})
	else
		primary_move_scene()
	end

	--카메라 청록색 박스를 중심으로 패닝.
	camera_util.move_async(self.invader_event_center_pos + vector(0, 0, 2), 1)
	party_characters = nil

	-- 연출 두번 더 보여주기
	for i = 1, 3 do
		-- 좌측 바라보면 0, 우측 1
		if self.loop_index == 1 then
			-- 좌측을 바라보고 달리는 상황 (2번 도어로 이동중인 상황에서)
			-- 인베이더 무리 2인 left, attack, run을 사용하여 2번의 도어까지 달려감.
			-- 인베이더 2인이 2번 도어에 도착하기 1타일 전, 붉은 점 위치의 개구리가 2번 스위치를 향해 left, idle, jump를 동작하여 2번 스위치에 도착하게 되며, 이에 맞춰 번 도어가 상승.
			character_util.set_emotion(invader_1, { name = 'attack' })
			character_util.set_emotion(invader_2, { name = 'attack' })
			character_util.move_distance(invader_1, vector(-door_distance, 0, 0), nil, run_speed, true, true, true)
			character_util.move_distance(invader_2, vector(-door_distance, 0, 0), nil, run_speed, true, true, true)
			wait_for_sec(event_wait_time)

			local target_pos = self.get_door_switch_2().Position
			local dir = (target_pos - frog.Position).normalized
			local magnitude = (target_pos - frog.Position).magnitude
			local move_duration = magnitude / run_speed
			self:frog_jump_async(dir, run_speed, move_duration)

			character_util.set_direction(invader_1, 'left')
			character_util.set_emotion(invader_1, { name = 'surprise' })
			character_util.normal_jump(invader_1, '01_jump_01')

			character_util.set_direction(invader_2, 'left')
			character_util.set_emotion(invader_2, { name = 'surprise' })
			character_util.normal_jump_async(invader_2, false)

			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(invader_1)
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(invader_2)

			self.loop_index = 0
		elseif self.loop_index == 0 then
			-- 우측을 바라보고 달리는 상황 (1번 도어로 이동중인 상황에서)
			-- 인베이더 무리 2인 right, attack, run을 사용하여 1번의 도어까지 달려감.
			character_util.set_emotion(invader_1, { name = 'attack' })
			character_util.set_emotion(invader_2, { name = 'attack' })
			character_util.move_distance(invader_1, vector(door_distance, 0, 0), nil, run_speed, true, true, true)
			character_util.move_distance(invader_2, vector(door_distance, 0, 0), nil, run_speed, true, true, true)
			wait_for_sec(event_wait_time)

			-- 인베이더 2인이 1번 도어에 도착하기 1타일 전, 붉은 점 위치의 개구리가 1번 스위치를 향해 right, idle, jump를 동작하여 1번 스위치에 도착하게 되며, 이에 맞춰 1번 도어가 상승.
			local target_pos = self.get_door_switch_1().Position
			local dir = (target_pos - frog.Position).normalized
			local magnitude = (target_pos - frog.Position).magnitude
			local move_duration = magnitude / run_speed

			self:frog_jump_async(dir, run_speed, move_duration)

			character_util.set_direction(invader_1, 'right')
			character_util.set_emotion(invader_1, { name = 'surprise' })
			character_util.normal_jump(invader_1, '01_jump_01')

			character_util.set_direction(invader_2, 'right')
			character_util.set_emotion(invader_2, { name = 'surprise' })
			character_util.normal_jump_async(invader_2, false)

			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(invader_1)
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(invader_2)

			self.loop_index = 1
		end
	end

	-- 연출 종료된 위치에서 중앙 통로를 바라본 채, scared, cast를 실행하는 인베이더 2인과 함께 개구리 down, idle, jump 1회를 실행하며 머리 위로 emoticon_bubble_tease 출력.
	local center_pos = self.invader_event_center_pos
	local look_dir = vector_util.to_direction(center_pos)
	invader_1.Direction = look_dir
	invader_2.Direction = look_dir

	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(invader_1, { name = 'cast' }, { name = 'scared' })
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(invader_2, { name = 'cast' }, { name = 'scared' })

	character_util.set_direction(frog, 'down')
	character_util.normal_jump(frog, true)
	self:character_play_sfx(frog, '01_frog_04')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_frog_04')
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(frog, nil, 'tease')

	-- 인베이더 (side, tired, cast) : 서, 설마… 이렇게까지 날 괴롭히는 거라면…
	character_util.shake(invader_1, 0.05, 3)
	character_util.shake(invader_2, 0.05, 3)
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(invader_1, { name = 'cast' }, { name = 'tired' })
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(invader_2, { name = 'cast' }, { name = 'tired' })
	self:character_play_sfx(invader_1, '01_rustle_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(invader_1, { key = 'qs_frog_queenship_1_4_invader_4', skip = true })

	-- 인베이더 (side, scared, cast) : 귀, 귀신…!
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(invader_1, { name = 'cast' }, { name = 'scared' })
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(invader_2, { name = 'cast' }, { name = 'scared' })
	self:character_play_sfx(invader_1, '01_camera_emphasize_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(invader_1, { key = 'qs_frog_queenship_1_4_invader_5', skip = true })

	-- 인베이더 (side, cry, embarrassed) : [shout]살려줘! 난 죽고싶지 않아!!!
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(invader_1, { name = 'embarrassed' }, { name = 'cry' })
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(invader_2, { name = 'embarrassed' }, { name = 'cry' })
	self:character_play_sfx(invader_1, '01_villain_scream_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(invader_1, { key = 'qs_frog_queenship_1_4_invader_6', skip = true, bubble_type = 'shout' })

	-- 상단 대사와 함께 인베이더 2인 side, cry, embarrassed 상태로 달려가 그대로 C 통로로 톼장하여 사라짐, 이때 트리거 1 지점을 지나갈 때 플레이어 통로 방면을 바라보며 attack, jump 1회 실행.
	-- 센터 -> 아래로 5칸 -> 우측으로 10칸
	center_pos_1 = vector(center_pos.x, 0, invader_1.Position.z)
	center_pos_2 = vector(center_pos.x, 0, invader_2.Position.z)

	move_path_1 = { center_pos_1, center_pos_1 + vector(0, 0, -5), center_pos_1 + vector(10, 0, -5) }
	move_path_2 = { center_pos_2, center_pos_2 + vector(0, 0, -5), center_pos_2 + vector(10, 0, -5) }
	character_util.move_waypoint(invader_1, move_path_1, 7, true, 'stop', 'floor', 'right', true)
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(invader_2, move_path_2, 7, true, 'stop', 'floor', 'right', true)


	character_util.set_active_state(invader_1, 'disabled')
	character_util.set_active_state(invader_2, 'disabled')

	-- 인베이더 2인 완전히 퇴장한 후 컨트롤 플레이어 복귀.
	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

	-- 퍼즐 모드로 변경
	self.set_event_state(self.event_state.puzzle_mode)
	-- 여기서부터 개구리 3초마다 이동 기믹 나오게 변경
	start_coroutine(self.frog_loop_event, self)
end

function local_class:invader_loop_scene()
	-- 인베이더와 문(door)의 거리. 현재는 상수로
	local door_distance = 7
	-- 인베이더가 달리는 이동속도 (초당)
	local run_speed = 7
	-- 달리기 시작했을때 다음 연출이 발동될 wait time
	-- 달리는 속도와 문과의 거리 - 2.5 을 이용해서 시간을 구한다 (door_distance - 2.5 / run_speed)
	local event_wait_time = (door_distance - 2.5) / run_speed

	self.invader_loop_scene_is_running = true
	self.can_loop_scene = true

	-- 주어진 조건이 만족 될 때까지 해당씬이 동작하게 된다.
	while self.can_loop_scene do
		local invader_1 = self.get_invader_1()
		local invader_2 = self.get_invader_2()
		local frog = self.frog

		if self.loop_index == 0 then
			-- 인베이더 무리 2인 right, attack, run을 사용하여 1번의 도어까지 달려감.
			character_util.move_distance(invader_1, vector(door_distance, 0, 0), nil, run_speed, true, true, true)
			character_util.move_distance(invader_2, vector(door_distance, 0, 0), nil, run_speed, true, true, true)
			wait_for_sec(event_wait_time)
			-- 인베이더 2인이 1번 도어에 도착하기 1타일 전, 붉은 점 위치의 개구리가 1번 스위치를 향해 right, idle, jump를 동작하여 1번 스위치에 도착하게 되며, 이에 맞춰 1번 도어가 상승.
			local target_pos = self.get_door_switch_1().Position
			local dir = (target_pos - frog.Position).normalized
			local magnitude = (target_pos - frog.Position).magnitude
			local move_duration = magnitude / run_speed

			self:frog_jump_async(dir, run_speed, move_duration)

			-- 1번 도어가 상승되면 인베이더 2인 right, surprise, jump 1회를 실행한 후, 하단 대사 좌하단에 출력.
			-- 인베이더 병사 (right, attack, release 2회) : [shout] 도, 도대체 뭐야?!
			character_util.set_direction(invader_1, 'right')
			character_util.set_emotion(invader_1, { name = 'surprise' })
			character_util.normal_jump(invader_1, false)

			character_util.set_direction(invader_2, 'right')
			character_util.set_emotion(invader_2, { name = 'surprise' })
			character_util.normal_jump_async(invader_2, false)

			self:character_play_sfx(invader_2, '03_dialogue_negative_02')
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(invader_2, { key = 'qs_frog_queenship_1_4_invader_1', bubble_direction = 'lb', bubble_type = 'shout' })

			character_util.set_animation_n_times(invader_1, { name = 'release', count = 2 })
			character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(invader_2, { name = 'release', count = 2 })

			wait_for_sec(2)

			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(invader_1)
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(invader_2)

			self.loop_index = 1
		elseif self.loop_index == 1 then
			-- 인베이더 무리 2인 left, attack, run을 사용하여 2번의 도어까지 달려감.
			character_util.move_distance(invader_1, vector(-door_distance, 0, 0), nil, run_speed, true, true, true)
			character_util.move_distance(invader_2, vector(-door_distance, 0, 0), nil, run_speed, true, true, true)
			wait_for_sec(event_wait_time)
			-- 인베이더 2인이 2번 도어에 도착하기 1타일 전, 붉은 점 위치의 개구리가 2번 스위치를 향해 left, idle, jump를 동작하여 2번 스위치에 도착하게 되며, 이에 맞춰 번 도어가 상승.
			local target_pos = self.get_door_switch_2().Position
			local dir = (target_pos - frog.Position).normalized
			local magnitude = (target_pos - frog.Position).magnitude
			local move_duration = magnitude / run_speed

			self:frog_jump_async(dir, run_speed, move_duration)

			-- 2번 도어가 상승되면 인베이더 2인 left, surprise, jump 1회를 실행한 후, 하단 대사 우하단에 출력.
			-- 인베이더 병사 (left, attack, release 2회) : [shout] 자, 장난치는 거지?!
			character_util.set_direction(invader_1, 'left')
			character_util.set_emotion(invader_1, { name = 'surprise' })
			character_util.normal_jump(invader_1, false)

			character_util.set_direction(invader_2, 'left')
			character_util.set_emotion(invader_2, { name = 'surprise' })
			character_util.normal_jump_async(invader_2, false)

			self:character_play_sfx(invader_2, '03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(invader_2, { key = 'qs_frog_queenship_1_4_invader_2', bubble_direction = 'rb', bubble_type = 'shout' })

			character_util.set_animation_n_times(invader_1, { name = 'release', count = 2 })
			character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(invader_2, { name = 'release', count = 2 })

			wait_for_sec(2)

			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(invader_1)
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(invader_2)

			self.loop_index = 0
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.invader_loop_scene_is_running = false
end

function local_class:frog_scene()
	while self.is_frog_loop do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- 플레이어 현재 트리거 존 중앙에 down, idle, idle로 정렬.
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	party_util.align_party(self.frog_scene_center_pos + vector(0, 0, -1), 'up', 1)
	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'down')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

	-- 하늘색 개구리 up, idle, idle을 실행한 뒤 0.5초 딜레이
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.frog)
	character_util.set_direction(self.frog, 'up')
	self:character_play_sfx(self.frog, '01_swing_01')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 개구리 플레이어 방향으로 1회 up, idle, jump를 실행하고, 다가오는 타이밍에 맞춰 플레이어 down, surprise, jump 실행.
	self:character_play_sfx(self.frog, '01_small_jump_01')
	character_util.jump_move(self.frog, self.frog.Position + vector(0, 0, 1), 4, 0.5, true, 'up')
	character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'surprise' })
	character_util.normal_jump_async(leader, '01_jump_01')

	-- 이후 개구리 머리 위로 emoticon_bubble_tease 실행.
	character_util.normal_jump(self.frog, '01_small_jump_01')
	self:character_play_sfx(self.frog, '01_frog_04')
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(self.frog, nil, 'tease')

	-- 개구리 up, idle, jump를 플레이어 방향으로 실행하고, 알파 페이드 아웃되며 하늘색 개구리 사라진다. 사라지는 타이밍에 맞춰 플레이어 left, surprise, embarrassed 실행.
	self:character_play_sfx(self.frog, '01_small_jump_01')
	character_util.jump_move(self.frog, leader.Position, 4, 0.5, false)
	wait_for_sec(0.2)
	self:character_play_sfx(self.frog, '01_grass_slide_02')
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(self.frog, 0, 0.75)
	wait_for_sec(0.75)
	character_util.set_active_state(self.frog, 'disabled')

	-- 상단 애니메이션 반복중인 상태에서 나레이션 출력.
	-- 나레이션 박스 : 개구리가 옷 안으로 들어가버렸다!
	-- 나레이션 박스 종료되면 플레이어 down, scared, cast, 이모티콘 annoyed 실행.
	-- 나레이션 박스 : 남의 불행을 즐기는 노란색 개구리를 획득했다!!

	self.section:frog_get_scene('qs_get_frog_queenship_1_4')
	-- 플레이어 컨트롤 복귀.
	self.section:complete()
end

function local_class:character_play_sfx(character, sfx_name, loop, max_distance)
	if loop == nil then
		loop = false
	end

	if max_distance == nil then
		max_distance = 9
	end

	return music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = sfx_name,
										parent = character,
										loop = loop, type_priority = 'event',
										player_priority = 'npc',
										max_distance = max_distance })
end

return {
	create = function()
		return local_class
	end
}

local local_class = newclass('QueenShipFrogSection2')

--[[QuestAttribute

		QuestName = QueenShipFrog @
		Comment = QueenShipFrog 퀘스트/이벤트 섹션 @
		Index = 1 @
]]

-- 해당 섹션은 개구리 퀘스트의 엔딩 섹션.
function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.available_stage_name = 'queenship_1_3'
	self.frog_statue_name = 'frog_statue'
	self.frog_blue_name = 'frog_blue'
	self.frog_sky_name = 'frog_sky'
	self.frog_yellow_name = 'frog_yellow'
	self.frog_red_name = 'frog_red'
	self.frog_green_name = 'frog_green'
	self.director_name = 'qs_frog_s2_1'
	self.substage_field_object_name = 'frog_substage_field_object'
	self.frog_ending_asset_name = 'qs_frog_s2_1_1'
	self.substage_map_dropitem = nil

	self.section_state = {
		none = 1,
		ending_scene = 2,
		clear_scene = 3
	}

	self.current_section_state = self.section_state.none

	-- 이펙트 풀을 가져오는 함수
	self.get_fx_portal = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_obj_event_portal') end
	self.get_fx_portal_wind_up = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_obj_event_portal_wind_up') end
	self.get_fx_explosion = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_explosion_boss')  end

	self.portal_effect = nil
	self.portal_wind_up_effect = nil
	self.portal_open_sfx = nil

	self.get_princess = function() return get_character('princess') end
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	self.get_fx_portal()
	self.get_fx_portal_wind_up()
	self.get_fx_explosion()
end

function local_class:enter()
end

function local_class:start()
	self.controller:on_start()
	-- 스테이지 시작 되었기 때문에 셋팅 시작
	-- 타일맵 수정해야하지만 임시적으로 바꿔준다. (초록 개구리와 남색 개구리의 포지션)
	self.frog_blue_spawn_pos = field:GetMarker('frog_blue_spawn_pos').position
	self.frog_sky_spawn_pos = field:GetMarker('frog_sky_spawn_pos').position
	self.frog_yellow_spawn_pos = field:GetMarker('frog_yellow_spawn_pos').position
	self.frog_red_spawn_pos = field:GetMarker('frog_red_spawn_pos').position
	self.frog_green_spawn_pos = field:GetMarker('frog_green_spawn_pos').position

	local frog_statue = get_character(self.frog_statue_name)
	local frog_blue = get_character(self.frog_blue_name)
	local frog_sky = get_character(self.frog_sky_name)
	local frog_yellow = get_character(self.frog_yellow_name)
	local frog_red = get_character(self.frog_red_name)
	local frog_green = get_character(self.frog_green_name)

	character_util.set_active_state(frog_statue, 'enabled')
	character_util.set_position(frog_blue, vector(0, 0, 0))
	character_util.set_position(frog_sky, vector(0, 0, 0))
	character_util.set_position(frog_yellow, vector(0, 0, 0))
	character_util.set_position(frog_red, vector(0, 0, 0))
	character_util.set_position(frog_green, vector(0, 0, 0))

	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(frog_blue, 0, 0)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(frog_sky, 0, 0)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(frog_yellow, 0, 0)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(frog_red, 0, 0)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(frog_green, 0, 0)

	self.get_substage_field_object = function () return get_field_object(self.substage_field_object_name) end

	frog_statue.Interactable:AddListener(self.cs_controller)
end

function local_class:exit()
	self:stop_portal_ambience_sfx()
	if self.portal_effect ~= nil then
		self.portal_effect:Dispose()
		self.portal_effect = nil
	end

	if self.portal_wind_up_effect ~= nil then
		self.portal_wind_up_effect:Dispose()
		self.portal_wind_up_effect = nil
	end

	if self.drop_item ~= nil then
		self.drop_item:ConsumeComplete()
		self.drop_item = nil
	end

	self.portal_open_sfx = nil

	timeline_table.unregister_action('open_portal')
	timeline_table.unregister_action('close_portal')
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	local frog_statue = get_character(self.frog_statue_name)

	if frog_statue ~= nil then
		frog_statue.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.cs_controller)	
	end
	

	if self.substage_map_dropitem ~= nil then
		self.substage_map_dropitem:ConsumeComplete()
	end

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
	self.substage_map_dropitem = nil
	self.clear_flag = false
	self.section_state = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	-- npc interact event
	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local frog_statue = get_character(self.frog_statue_name)
	local substage_field_object = self:get_substage_field_object()
	if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.none and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, frog_statue) then
		-- statue 연출 시작!
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.ending_scene
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(self.frog_statue_interact_scene, self)
		return true
	elseif self.current_section_state == self.section_state.ending_scene and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, substage_field_object) then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.clear_scene
		substage_field_object.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(self.substage_open_scene, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

-- 개구리 동상 선택지 연출 (상호작용시 나오는 연출)
function local_class:frog_statue_interact_scene()
	local frog_statue = get_character(self.frog_statue_name)
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local princess= self.get_princess()
	-- 정렬 시키기
	local center_pos = frog_statue.Position + vector(0, 0, -1.5)
	local leader_pos = center_pos + vector(-0.5, 0, 0)
	local princess_pos = center_pos + vector(0.5, 0, 0)

	character_util.move_waypoint(leader, leader_pos, 2, false, 'stop', 'floor', 'up')
	character_util.move_waypoint(princess, princess_pos, 2, false, 'stop', 'floor', 'up')

	camera_util.move_async(center_pos, 1)

	-- 나레이션 : 수상하게 생긴 동상이다.
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'qs_frog_queenship_1_3_choice_1' })

	-- 나레이션 : 더 가까이서 보시겠습니까?
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'qs_frog_queenship_1_3_choice_2' })

	-- 선택지 : 네 / 아니오
	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({ { 'qs_frog_queenship_1_3_choice_3', 'intellect' }, { 'qs_frog_queenship_1_3_choice_4', 'normal' } })

	if choose_result == 1 then
		-- 기사와 공주 각각 한칸 위로 옮긴다.
		character_util.move_waypoint(leader, center_pos + vector(0, 0, 1), 1, false, 'stop', 'floor', 'up')

		-- 카메라도 한칸 위로 옮김
		camera_util.move_async(center_pos + vector(0, 0, 1), 1)

		-- 엔딩 연출 재생하도록
		self:ending_scene()
	else
		camera_util.return_to_leader(1)
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.none
	end
end

-- 엔딩씬 연출
function local_class:ending_scene()
	-- 사용되는 캐릭터들
	local frog_statue = get_character(self.frog_statue_name)
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local frog_blue = get_character(self.frog_blue_name)
	local frog_sky = get_character(self.frog_sky_name)
	local frog_yellow = get_character(self.frog_yellow_name)
	local frog_red = get_character(self.frog_red_name)
	local frog_green = get_character(self.frog_green_name)

	local center_pos = frog_statue.Position + vector(0, 0, -1.5)
	local leader_pos = center_pos + vector(-0.5, 0, 0)
	local princess_pos = center_pos + vector(0.5, 0, 0)
	local portal_enter_pos = frog_statue.Position + vector(0, 2, 0)

	character_util.set_active_state(frog_blue, 'disabled')

	local portal_effect = self.get_fx_portal():Instantiate(frog_statue.Position + vector(0, 1.2, 0))
	self.portal_effect = portal_effect

	portal_effect.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.zero

	local open_dur = 1

	field:Tint('exit_portal', unity_color({0.6588, 0.251, 1, 1}), open_dur)
	camera_util.shake(0.2, open_dur)
	self.portal_open_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx(

	self.portal_wind_up_effect = self.get_fx_portal_wind_up():Instantiate(frog_statue.Position)

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_portal_02')
	self.portal_open_sfx:FadeOut(1.5)

	self.portal_effect:Dispose()
	self.portal_wind_up_effect:Dispose()
	self.portal_effect = nil
	self.portal_wind_up_effect = nil
	self.portal_open_sfx = nil
end

--- 포탈 커지는 연출
--- @param transform any 포탈 이펙트 오브젝트의 Transform
--- @param duration number 커지는 시간
--- @param target any 마지막에 세팅될 포탈 사이즈
--- @param y_dif number 커지면서 변할 y 좌표
function local_class:portal_appear(transform, duration, target, y_dif)
	local start_time = unity_class.time.time
	local origin_pos = transform.localPosition

	while unity_class.time.time - start_time < duration do
		local normalized = (unity_class.time.time - start_time) / duration
		transform.localScale = target * normalized

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	transform.localScale = target
end

--- 포탈 작아지면서 사라지는 연출. 끝나고 Dispose 잊지 말기
--- @param transform any 포탈 이펙트 오브젝트의 Transform
--- @param duration number 사라질 시간
function local_class:portal_disappear(transform, duration, y_dif)
	local start_time = unity_class.time.time
	local origin_scale = transform.localScale
	local origin_pos = transform.localPosition

	while unity_class.time.time - start_time < duration do
		local normalized = (unity_class.time.time - start_time) / duration
		transform.localScale = origin_scale * (1 - normalized)

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.zero
end

-- 포탈 앰비언스 sfx 루프 재생
function local_class:play_portal_ambience_sfx(position)
	if self.portal_sfx ~= nil then
		return
	end

	self.portal_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '01_portal_04', play_pos = position, loop = true,
		type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc'
	})
end

-- 포탈 앰비언스 sfx 루프 정지
function local_class:stop_portal_ambience_sfx()
	if self.portal_sfx ~= nil then
		self.portal_sfx:FadeOut(0.2)
	end

	self.portal_sfx = nil
end

function local_class:character_play_sfx(character, sfx_name, loop, max_distance)
	if loop == nil then
		loop = false
	end

	if max_distance == nil then
		max_distance = 9
	end

	return music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = sfx_name,
										parent = character,
										loop = loop, type_priority = 'event',
										player_priority = 'npc',
										max_distance = max_distance })
end

return local_class

function local_class:enter_apple_tree_zone()

	local horse_forest_1 = self.controller.get_horse_forest(1)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(horse_forest_3, { key = 'qs_horse_apple_tree_1', skip = false })

	--말 1 (up, idle, success) 사과 먹을래!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(horse_forest_1, { key = 'qs_horse_apple_tree_2', skip = false })

function local_class:drop_gear()
	local star_piece_forest_pos = self.controller.get_star_piece_pos(2).position
	local star_piece_queenship_pos = self.controller.get_star_piece_pos(1).position
	local gear_vectors = {
		vector(-2, 0, -2),
		vector(-2.5, 0, -1),
		vector(0.5, 0, -3),
		vector(4, 0, 0),
		vector(2, 0, -2)
	}
	local horses_queenship = {}
	local horses_queenship_pos = {}
	local horses_forest = {}
	local horses_forest_pos = {}
	for i = 1, 4 do
		local horse_queenship = self.controller.get_horse_queenship(i)
		local horse_forest = self.controller.get_horse_forest(i)
		table.insert(horses_queenship, horse_queenship)
		table.insert(horses_queenship_pos, horse_queenship.Position)
		table.insert(horses_forest, horse_forest)
		table.insert(horses_forest_pos, horse_forest.Position)
	end
	camera_util.move_async(star_piece_forest_pos, 1.0)

	for i = 1, 5 do
		local gear = self.controller.items_gear[i]
		gear:Shake(0.05, 1)
	end

	wait_for_sec(1.0)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_air_spin_02')

	for i = 1, 5 do
		local gear = self.controller.items_gear[i]
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(
				drop_item_util.throw_item, gear, star_piece_forest_pos + gear_vectors[i], { ground_offset = 0 }))

		local apple = self.controller.items_apple[i]
		local transform = apple.SpriteTransform
		local shadow_transform = apple.ShadowTransform
		local shadow_offset = shadow_transform.position - transform.position

		transform.position = star_piece_queenship_pos + gear_vectors[i]
		shadow_transform.position = transform.position + shadow_offset
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.5)


	--점프 뛰는 효과음 중지
	if self.controller.jump_sfx_2 ~= nil then
		--self.controller.jump_sfx_2:Stop()
		music_player_util.fade_out_sfx(self.controller.jump_sfx_2, 0.2)
		self.controller.jump_sfx_2 = nil
	end
	if self.controller.jump_sfx ~= nil then
		--self.controller.jump_sfx:Stop()
		music_player_util.fade_out_sfx(self.controller.jump_sfx, 0.2)
		self.controller.jump_sfx = nil
	end

	character_util.set_direction(horses_queenship[1], 'left')
	character_util.set_direction(horses_queenship[2], 'down')
	character_util.set_direction(horses_queenship[3], 'right')
	character_util.set_direction(horses_queenship[4], 'right')
	for i = 1, 4 do
		character_util.remove_anim(horses_queenship[i])
		character_util.remove_anim(horses_forest[i])
		character_util.set_emotion(horses_queenship[i], { name = 'confused' })
		character_util.set_emotion(horses_forest[i], { name = 'smile' })
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.move_waypoint(horses_queenship[1],
			{ horses_queenship_pos[1] + vector(-0.5, 0, 0), horses_queenship_pos[1] + vector(-0.5, 0, -1) },
			4, true)
	character_util.move_waypoint(horses_queenship[2],
			{ horses_queenship_pos[2] + vector(-1, 0, 0), horses_queenship_pos[2] + vector(-1, 0, -1) },
			4, true)
	character_util.move_waypoint(horses_queenship[3],
			{ horses_queenship_pos[3] + vector(1, 0, 0), horses_queenship_pos[3] + vector(1, 0, -1) },
			4, true)
	character_util.move_waypoint(horses_queenship[4],
			{ horses_queenship_pos[4] + vector(2, 0, 0) }, 4, true)

	-- 포레스트 말도 이동 시킴
	horses_forest[1].Position = horses_forest_pos[1] + vector(-0.5, 0, -1)
	horses_forest[2].Position = horses_forest_pos[2] + vector(-1, 0, -1)
	horses_forest[3].Position = horses_forest_pos[3] + vector(1, 0, -1)
	horses_forest[4].Position = horses_forest_pos[4] + vector(2, 0, 0)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	for i = 1, 2 do
		character_util.set_direction(horses_queenship[i], 'left')
		character_util.set_anim(horses_queenship[i], { name = 'eat' })
		-- 포레스트 쪽 말도 애니메이션 일치 시킴
		character_util.set_direction(horses_forest[i], 'left')
		character_util.set_anim(horses_forest[i], { name = 'eat' })
	end
	for i = 3, 4 do
		character_util.set_direction(horses_queenship[i], 'right')
		character_util.set_anim(horses_queenship[i], { name = 'eat' })
		-- 포레스트 쪽 말도 애니메이션 일치 시킴
		character_util.set_direction(horses_forest[i], 'right')
		character_util.set_anim(horses_forest[i], { name = 'eat' })
	end
	self.controller.eat_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_eat_01', parent = horses_queenship[3], max_distance = 9, loop = true})


	local talk_sfx_table = {
		'03_dialogue_angry_01',
		'03_dialogue_tipsy_01',
		'03_dialogue_angry_01',
		'03_dialogue_tipsy_01'
	}
	for i = 1, 4 do
		horses_forest[i].Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable()
		horses_forest[i].Interactable.Talk = 'qs_horse_apple_tree_' .. 4 - (i % 2)
		horses_forest[i].Interactable.TalkSfx = talk_sfx_table[i]
		horses_queenship[i].Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable()
		horses_queenship[i].Interactable.Talk = 'qs_horse_apple_tree_' .. 4 - (i % 2)
		horses_queenship[i].Interactable.TalkSfx = talk_sfx_table[i]
	end


	yield_return_func(quest_util.complete_quest, self.controller, 0)

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)

	self.controller.eat_sfx_2 = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_eat_01', parent = horses_forest[3], max_distance = 9, loop = true})
end

return local_class

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')

	local horse_queenship_2 = self.controller.get_horse_queenship(2)

		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(field_ui_util.show_narration_async, { key = 'qs_horse_bucket_4' })
