				self.is_enter_enter_zone == false then
			local horse_forest_3 = self.controller.get_horse_forest(3)
			--말 3 (left, smile, walk4legs) : 냠냠…당근 맛있다, 히힝!!
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(horse_forest_3, { key = 'qs_horse_bucket_1' })
			music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_eat_01', parent = horse_forest_3, max_distance = 9})
			music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_positive_01',  parent = horse_forest_3, max_distance = 9 })

			music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_tipsy_01', parent = horse_forest_2, max_distance = 9})

	if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'quest_clear' then

	elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == 'move_gem_stew' then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.move_gem_stew, self))
	elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == 'layer_gem_stew' then

	local rat = self.controller.items_garbage_rat[2]
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(drop_item_util.alpha_fade_async, pizza, 0, 0.5))
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(drop_item_util.alpha_fade_async, banana, 0, 0.5))
	drop_item_util.alpha_fade_async(rat, 0, 0.5)

	local rat = self.controller.items_garbage_rat[2]

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_zone_leave_event')

	self.star_piece_effect_forest = self.get_star_piece_effect_pool():Instantiate(self.get_star_piece_pos(1).position)

	local get_burningskull_2 = self.controller.get_burningskull_2()
	character_util.set_emotion(burningskull,{ name = 'love' })
	character_util.set_emotion(get_burningskull_2,{ name = 'confused' })

	self.controller.run_sfx_1 = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_dash_01', parent = self.controller.get_burningskull(), max_distance = 9, loop = true})

	return true

		self.star_piece_effect_forest = nil

	return false

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, sign_board_forest) then

	end

function local_class:enter_enter_zone_2()
	--트레이너 B (right, attack, cast2) : 모두 주목!
	--트레이너 B (right, attack, cross_arm) : 너희들 같은 경주마들은 각자 다양한 특색을 가지고 있지.
	--트레이너 B (right, attack, release) : 오늘은 경주마가 달릴 때, 필요한 4가지의 전략을 알려주겠다!

function local_class:lose_race(rival, move_camera, cb)
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	-- 카메라 속도 6으로 라이벌에게로 이동
	if move_camera then
		camera_util.move_async(rival.Position, (stage_camera.LookAtPosition - rival.Position).magnitude / 6)
	end

	-- 라이벌 (right, smile, success), 가디언 (right, damaged, dead(loop x))
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(rival)
	character_util.set_direction(rival ,'right')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(rival, 'smile')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(rival, 'success', { sfx_name = '01_small_jump_01' })

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
	character_util.set_direction(leader, direction_util.to_side_dir(leader.Direction))
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(leader, 'damaged')
	scene_util.set_dead_anim(leader)

	-- StageTitle로 '패배…' 나옴
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_02')
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowStageTitle(game_string:GetString('qs_horse_racing_4'), 2)
	wait_for_sec(2)

	if cb then
		cb()
	end

	-- 2초 대기 후 1초간 페이드 아웃
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	-- 1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 카메라 아무 타일도 안 나오는 곳(ex : -100, 0, 0)으로 옮기고 페이드 인 0초
	camera_util.move_async(vector(300, 0, 300), 0)

	screen_util.fade_in_async(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	local player_choice = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		-- 재도전
		{ 'qs_horse_racing_5', 'mercy' },
		-- 포기한다
		{ 'qs_horse_racing_6', 'brutal' }
	})

	if player_choice == 2 then
		-- 스테이지 종료 처리
		CS.Oak.Game.Instance:StageToLobby()
		return
	end

	-- 1초 대기 후 여기부터 다시 시작
	screen_util.fade_out_async(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
end

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

function local_class:create_audience(dir)
	local create_spec_data = function(count)
		local spec_data = {}
		for i = 1, count do
			spec_data[dir .. '_' .. 'audience_' .. i] = 'qs_invader_warrior'
		end
		return spec_data
	end

	if dir == 'bottom' then
		-- 아랫쪽 npc
		local create_count = 12
		local optimized_npcs = load_util.create_optimized_npcs_async(create_spec_data(create_count))

		local bottom_optimized_npcs = {}
		for i = 1, create_count do
			local npc = optimized_npcs[dir .. '_' .. 'audience_' .. i]
			table.insert(bottom_optimized_npcs, npc)
		end

		return bottom_optimized_npcs

	elseif dir == 'top' then
		-- 윗쪽 npc
		local create_count = 18
		local optimized_npcs = load_util.create_optimized_npcs_async(create_spec_data(create_count))

		local top_optimized_npcs = {}
		for i = 1, create_count do
			local npc = optimized_npcs[dir .. '_' .. 'audience_' .. i]
			table.insert(top_optimized_npcs, npc)
		end

		return top_optimized_npcs
	end
end

function local_class:change_leader(changed_character)

local local_class = newclass('QueenShipHorseRacingPreSection')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = pre @
		QuestName = QueenShipHorseRacing @
		Comment = QueenShipHorseRacing 퀘스트/이벤트 섹션 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	-- npc
	self.get_talking_invader = function(index)
		return get_character('horse_racing_invader_' .. index)
	end

	-- 이펙트
	self.get_fx_hit = function()
		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit')
	end

	-- 기믹
	self.get_trash_can = function()
		return get_field_object('horse_racing_trash_can')
	end

	self.available_stage_name = 'queenship_1_3'

	self.section_state = {
		none = 1,
		show_horse_racing_event = 2,
		interact_trash_can = 3
	}

	self.current_section_state = self.section_state.none

	-- 사용하는 인베이더 수
	self.invader_count = 22

	-- 인베이더 대화 이벤트 수
	self.talking_invader_event_count = 9

	-- 인베이더가 말했는지
	self.is_talk_invader = {}

	self.timeline_hit_leader = 'horse_racing/hit_leader'
	self.timeline_dispose_magi_times = 'horse_racing/dispose_magi_times'
	self.timeline_throw_magi_times = 'horse_racing/throw_magi_times'

	self.interactable_invader = {}

	self.crowd_sfx = nil
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	self.get_fx_hit()
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')

	timeline_table.register_action(self.timeline_hit_leader, self.hit_leader, self)
	timeline_table.register_action(self.timeline_dispose_magi_times, self.dispose_magi_times, self)
	timeline_table.register_action(self.timeline_throw_magi_times, self.throw_magi_times, self)

	self:setting()
	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	self.crowd_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_crowd_buzz_02', loop = true,
												  play_pos = vector(72, 0, -40), type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

	timeline_table.unregister_action(self.timeline_hit_leader)
	timeline_table.unregister_action(self.timeline_dispose_magi_times)
	timeline_table.unregister_action(self.timeline_throw_magi_times)

	for i = 1, #self.interactable_invader do
		character_util.remove_relate_event(self.interactable_invader[i], self.controller)
	end

	if self.crowd_sfx ~= nil then
		music_player_util.stop_sfx(self.crowd_sfx)

	end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--- OnEvent
function local_class:on_event(e)
	for invader, index in pairs(self.interactable_invader) do
		if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, invader) then

			local string_key
			if index % 2 == 0 then
				-- 짝수
				-- 말이 왜 이런데서 돌아다니고 있지?
				string_key = 'qs_horse_racing_pre_22'
			else
				-- 홀수
				-- 뭐야, 말이 왜 여기 있어?
				string_key = 'qs_horse_racing_pre_21'
			end

			music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_negative_02', loop = false,
										 parent = invader, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(invader)
			character_util.look_at(invader, get_party_leader())
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(invader, { key = string_key })
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

--- ZoneEnterEvent
function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_section_state ~= self.section_state.none then
		return false
	end

	for i = 1, self.talking_invader_event_count do
		if not self.is_talk_invader[i] and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 'horse_racing_talk_invader_' .. i) then

			self.is_talk_invader[i] = true

			start_coroutine(self.talk_invader, self, i)

			return true
		end
	end

	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 'horse_racing_show_event') then

		self.current_section_state = self.current_section_state + 1

		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(self.show_pre_event, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

--- InteractEvent
function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local trash_can = self.get_trash_can()
	if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.show_horse_racing_event and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, trash_can) then
		self.current_section_state = self.current_section_state + 1
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(self.open_substage_scene, self, trash_can)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

--- 서브 스테이지 열리는 연출

--- 프리 섹션 이벤트 세팅

--- 존에 들어왔을 때 말하는 인베이더들
function local_class:talk_invader(index)
	if index == 1 then
		local invader_1 = self.get_talking_invader(1)
		local invader_2 = self.get_talking_invader(2)
		local invader_3 = self.get_talking_invader(3)

		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(invader_1, 'qs_horse_racing_pre_1', false)

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(invader_1)

		if self.current_section_state ~= self.section_state.none then
			return
		end

		-- 인베이더 2 : (left, smile, victory_extra) 내가 응원하는 말이 결승점에 도착했을 때의 그 짜릿함!
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_emphasize_01', loop = false,
									 parent = invader_2, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
		scene_util.set_emotion_loop(invader_2, 'smile')
		scene_util.set_anim_loop(invader_2, 'victory_extra')
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(invader_2, 'qs_horse_racing_pre_2', false)

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(invader_2)

		if self.current_section_state ~= self.section_state.none then
			return
		end

		-- 인베이더 3 : (right, attack, cast2) 오늘은 내가 고른 녀석이 이길 거야, 반드시 그럴 거라구!
		scene_util.set_emotion_loop(invader_3, 'attack')
		scene_util.set_anim_loop(invader_2, 'cast2')
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(invader_3, 'qs_horse_racing_pre_3', false)

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(invader_3)

	elseif index == 2 then
		local invader_4 = self.get_talking_invader(4)

function local_class:on_pre_load()

			self.res_holder, 'ondemand/v2_49_queenship/theatres/racing','shader_container')

	-- 자막 로드
	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
			self.res_holder, self.typing_text_asset_bundle_name, self.typing_text_asset_name, function(prefab)
				self.typing_text_obj = CS.NGUITools.AddChild(stage.UIRoot.gameObject, prefab).gameObject

			end)

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_custom_stage_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.SwitchOnOffEvent), 'on_switch_on_off_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')

	for _, data in pairs(self.talking_invader_zone_data) do
		local zone_name = data.name
		self.is_talk_invader[zone_name] = {}

		if data.count == 1 then
			self.is_talk_invader[zone_name] = false
		else
			for _ = 1, data.count do
				table.insert(self.is_talk_invader[zone_name], false)
			end
		end
	end

	-- 미는 테이블 세팅
	local pushing_table = self.get_pushing_table()
	pushing_table.Position = pushing_table.Position + vector(0, 0, 2)

	local ticket_office_invader_index = { 32, 21, 5, 11, 12, 23, 24, 35, 36 }
	for i = 1, #ticket_office_invader_index do
		local invader = self.get_ticket_office_invader(ticket_office_invader_index[i])

		if i > 3 then
			self:add_interactable_invader(invader)
		end
	end

	-- 레이스 NPC 설정
	for i = 1, self.race_runner_num do
		table.insert(self.race_runners, get_character(self.race_runner_name..i))
	end

	-- 카메라를 Perspective로 사용하는 장면이 있어서 전체 Shear를 꺼버림.
	self.shear_prop_id = CS.UnityEngine.Shader.PropertyToID('_Shear')
	self.shear_value = 0.025
	CS.UnityEngine.Shader.SetGlobalFloat(self.shear_prop_id, 0)

	-- 카메라나 Spine이 회전하면서 찌그러지지 않게끔 하기 위해 Shader 변경
	local shader_list = self.shader_container:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.ShaderContainer)).ShaderList
	local shader = shader_list[0]
	self.origin_spine_controller_shader = self.race_runners[1].SpineController.CustomShader

	for i = 1, #self.race_runners do
		self.race_runners[i].SpineController.CustomShader = shader
	end

	timeline_table.register_action('firework', self.controller.firework_scene, self.controller)

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	--배틀게이트 닫힘
	for i = 1, self.battlegate_num do
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateCloseEvent.Create(self.battlegate_name..i, false))
	end

	self:change_3d_sound(false)
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.SwitchOnOffEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	timeline_table.unregister_action('firework')

	for i = 1, #self.interactable_invader do
		character_util.remove_relate_event(self.interactable_invader[i], self.controller)
	end

	if self.ticket_office_loop_sfx then
		music_player_util.stop_sfx(self.ticket_office_loop_sfx)
		self.ticket_office_loop_sfx = nil
	end

	if self.lobby_loop_sfx then
		music_player_util.stop_sfx(self.lobby_loop_sfx)
		self.lobby_loop_sfx = nil
	end

	if self.shader_container then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.shader_container)
		self.shader_container = nil
	end

	if self.typing_text_obj then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.typing_text_obj)
		self.typing_text_obj = nil
		self.typing_text = nil
	end

	if self.res_holder then
		self.res_holder:Dispose()
		self.res_holder = nil
	end

	if self.origin_spine_controller_shader then
		for i = 1, #self.race_runners do
			self.race_runners[i].SpineController.CustomShader = self.origin_spine_controller_shader
		end

		self.origin_spine_controller_shader = nil
	end

	self.race_runners = nil
	self.runner_corners = nil
	self.corner_exceptions = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

	for i = 1, #self.interactable_invader do

		end
	end

	return false

		self.current_section_state = self.current_section_state + 1

		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(self.show_secret_road_event_2, self)

	end

	if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.show_secret_road_event_2 and
		type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 'secret_road_event_3') then

		self.current_section_state = self.current_section_state + 1

		self:change_3d_sound(true)

		-- 인베이더 1 (up, idle, idle) : 조심해, 이 앞에 경비병들이 있으니까.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.get_secret_road_invader(1), { key = 'qs_horse_racing_s1_76' })
		return true
	end

	if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.open_entrance_door and
		type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 'start_race_event') then

		self.current_section_state = self.current_section_state + 1

		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(self.start_race, self)
		return true
	end

	local ticket_office_zone_data = self.talking_invader_zone_data.ticket_office
	for i = 1, ticket_office_zone_data.count do
		if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, ticket_office_zone_data.name .. i) then

			if not self.is_talk_invader[ticket_office_zone_data.name][i] then
				self.is_talk_invader[ticket_office_zone_data.name][i] = true
				start_coroutine(self.talk_invader_in_ticket_office, self, i)
			end

			return true
		end
	end

	local lobby_zone_data = self.talking_invader_zone_data.lobby
	if not self.is_talk_invader[lobby_zone_data.name] and
		type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, lobby_zone_data.name) then

		self.is_talk_invader[lobby_zone_data.name] = true
		start_coroutine(self.talk_invader_in_lobby, self)

		return true
	end

	local stand_room_zone_data = self.talking_invader_zone_data.stand_room
	if not self.is_talk_invader[stand_room_zone_data.name] and
		type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, stand_room_zone_data.name) then

		self.is_talk_invader[stand_room_zone_data.name] = true
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(self.talk_invader_in_stand_room, self)

		return true
	end

	if not self.ticket_office_loop_sfx and type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 'secret_road_event_2') then
		self:change_3d_sound(false)

		return true
	end

	if not self.lobby_loop_sfx and self.current_section_state < self.section_state.open_entrance_door and
		type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 'secret_road_event_3') then

		self:change_3d_sound(true)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

--- CustomStageEvent
function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if self.is_detected then
		return false
	end

	if e.Params[0] == self.detect_event_name then
		self.is_detected = true
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(self.on_detected, self, e.Sender)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

--- SwitchOnOffEvent
function local_class:on_switch_on_off_event(e)
	for i = 1, 2 do
		if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.show_secret_road_event_3 and
			e.IsTurningOn and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.SwitchObject, self.get_switch(i)) and
			self.get_switch(i % 2 + 1).FieldObjectBehaviour.IsPressed then

			self.current_section_state = self.current_section_state + 1

			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(self.open_entrance_door, self)
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

end

--- 인베이더 감시에 걸렸을 때
function local_class:on_detected(finder)
	local detecting_invaders = {}
	for i = 1, 2 do
		local invader = self.get_secret_road_invader(i)
		table.insert(detecting_invaders, invader)
	end

	start_coroutine(self.siren_tint, self)

	party_util.look_at(finder)
	party_util.set_emotion({ name = 'surprise' })
	party_util.set_anim({ name = 'embarrassed' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	-- 누구냐!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_police_01')
	scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(finder, 'qs_horse_racing_s1_12')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_01')
	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(1, 'linear')

	self.stop_siren = true

	-- 파티 리셋 세팅
	party_util.remove_emotion()
	party_util.remove_animation()

	local reset_marker = field:GetMarker('reset_passage')
	party_util.align_party(reset_marker.position, reset_marker.direction, 0, 'linear')

	for i = 1, #detecting_invaders do
		message_system:SendSync(detecting_invaders[i], CS.Oak.StateResetEvent.Instance)
	end

	self.is_detected = false

	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(1, 'linear')
end

-- 사이렌 틴트 연출
function local_class:siren_tint()
	local siren_tint_key = 'siren_tint'

	local tint_duration = 0.5
	local current_time = unity_class.time.time
	local is_tint = false

	self.stop_siren = false

	while not self.stop_siren do
		if unity_class.time.time - current_time > tint_duration then
			current_time = unity_class.time.time

			if is_tint then
				is_tint = false

				field:RemoveTint(siren_tint_key, tint_duration)
			else
				is_tint = true

				field:Tint(siren_tint_key, unity_color({ 1, 0, 0, 0.8 }), tint_duration)
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if is_tint then
		field:RemoveTint(siren_tint_key, 0)
	end
end

--region Race
function local_class:race_setting()
	-- 레이스 처리 종료 플래그
	self.is_race = true
end

function local_class:race()
	start_coroutine(self.race_announce, self)

	-- 러너 달리기까지 대기
	wait_for_sec(2)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_gimmick_door_down_03')

	--배틀게이트 열림
	for i = 1, self.battlegate_num do
		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.BattleGateOpenEvent.Create(self.battlegate_name .. i, false))
		field_object_util.set_active_state(get_field_object(self.battlegate_name .. i), active_state_type.visible)
	end

	-- 러너 달리기까지 대기
	wait_for_sec(2)

	start_coroutine(self.race_camera_move, self)

	-- 애니메이션과 스모크 처리
	for i = 1, #self.race_runners do
		character_util.set_anim(self.race_runners[i], { name = 'run' })
		character_util.set_emotion(self.race_runners[i], { name = 'attack' })

		stage.SmokeManager:SetCharacterSmoke(self.race_runners[i])

		table.insert(self.runner_corners, 1)
	end

	start_coroutine(self.race_runner_1, self)
	start_coroutine(self.race_runner_2, self)
	start_coroutine(self.race_runner_3, self)
	start_coroutine(self.race_runner_4, self)
	start_coroutine(self.race_runner_5, self)
	start_coroutine(self.race_runner_6, self)

	while self.is_race do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- 승리 처리
	local speeds = { 2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2 }
	local poses = { vector(-9, 0, 76.5), vector(-10.5, 0, 75.7), vector(0, 0, 0),
	                vector(-11, 0, 73.7), vector(-12, 0, 76.1), vector(-7.8, 0, 74.2) }

	for i = 1, #self.race_runners do
		if i ~= 3 then
			character_util.set_position(self.race_runners[i], poses[i])
			character_util.set_emotion(self.race_runners[i], { name = 'tired' })
		else
			character_util.set_emotion(self.race_runners[i], { name = 'smile' })
		end

		character_util.set_anim(self.race_runners[i], { name = 'walk' })

		local waypoint_list = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)
		waypoint_list:Add(self.race_runners[i].Position + vector(-8, 0, 0))

		character_util.move_waypoint(self.race_runners[i], waypoint_list, speeds[i],
				false, 'stop', 'floor', 'left')
	end

	wait_for_sec(1)

	character_util.set_anim(self.race_runners[3], { name = 'hold_loop', upper = true, scale = 0.7 })

	wait_for_sec(2)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('event', 0.5, 1)

	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(1, 'linear')

	local is_origin_spine_controller_shader = self.origin_spine_controller_shader

	for i = 1, #self.race_runners do
		if is_origin_spine_controller_shader then
			self.race_runners[i].SpineController.CustomShader = self.origin_spine_controller_shader
		end

		character_util.remove_anim(self.race_runners[i])
		character_util.remove_anim(self.race_runners[i], true)
		character_util.remove_emotion(self.race_runners[i])
	end

	if is_origin_spine_controller_shader then
		self.origin_spine_controller_shader = nil
	end
end

--region Announce
function local_class:race_announce()
	self.typing_text_obj:SetActive(true)

	local play_typed_text = function(string_key, time)
		local stay_time = lua_helper.get_or_default(time, 3)

		local param = CS.TypingTextParam(string_key)
		param.bubbleWidth = 1000
		param.typeSpeed = 0
		param.stayTime = stay_time
		param.dialoguePostDelay = 0

		yield_return_func(self.typing_text.SetTypedText, self.typing_text, param)
	end

	play_typed_text('qs_horse_racing_s1_38')

	wait_for_sec(1)

	play_typed_text('qs_horse_racing_s1_39')

	play_typed_text('qs_horse_racing_s1_40')

	play_typed_text('qs_horse_racing_s1_41')

	wait_for_sec(2)

	play_typed_text('qs_horse_racing_s1_42')

	wait_for_sec(3)

	play_typed_text('qs_horse_racing_s1_43')

	play_typed_text('qs_horse_racing_s1_44')

	wait_for_sec(1)

	play_typed_text('qs_horse_racing_s1_45')

	play_typed_text('qs_horse_racing_s1_46')

	wait_for_sec(1)

	play_typed_text('qs_horse_racing_s1_47')

	play_typed_text('qs_horse_racing_s1_47_1')

	wait_for_sec(1)

	play_typed_text('qs_horse_racing_s1_48')

	play_typed_text('qs_horse_racing_s1_49')

	play_typed_text('qs_horse_racing_s1_49_1')

	play_typed_text('qs_horse_racing_s1_49_2')

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_crowd_arena_exclamation_01' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_negative_01' })

--region Race Runner
-- 러너 달리기 공통 처리
function local_class:race_runner(runner, runner_num, speed_parameter)
	for i = 1, self.constants.race.track_num do
		for j = 1, self.constants.race.corner_num do
			local current_marker_name = self.constants.marker.runner_marker_name_first
					..i..self.constants.marker.runner_marker_name_mid..j..
					self.constants.marker.runner_marker_name_last..runner_num

			local current_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos(current_marker_name)
			local current_dir = field_util.get_marker_dir(current_marker_name)

			local current_speed_table = speed_parameter[i]
			local current_speed = current_speed_table[j]

			local move_param = {}
			self:add_runner_move_param(move_param, runner, current_pos, current_speed, current_speed,
					0, screen_util.get_interpolations('linear'))

			local callback_param = {}

			self:runner_move_by_param({ move = move_param, callback = callback_param }, runner_num)

			-- 외부 입력 corner 값과 기존 값이 달려서 exception 발생한 경우 예외처리
			if self.runner_corners[runner_num] ~= j then
				j = self.runner_corners[runner_num]
			else
				if j < self.constants.race.corner_num then
					self.runner_corners[runner_num] = j + 1
				else
					self.runner_corners[runner_num] = 1
				end
			end

			character_util.set_direction(runner, current_dir)
		end
	end

	self.runner_corners[runner_num] = 1
	character_util.set_direction(runner, 'left')

	local current_speed_table = speed_parameter[5]
	local current_speed = current_speed_table[1]

	local move_param = {}
	self:add_runner_move_param(move_param, runner, vector(-10, 0, runner.Position.z), current_speed,
			screen_util.get_interpolations('linear'))

	local callback_param = {}

	self:runner_move_by_param({ move = move_param, callback = callback_param }, runner_num)
end

-- 러너 이동 파라미터 생성 후 추가
function local_class:add_runner_move_param(
		params, runner, target_pos, speed, interpolations)
	local runner_val = lua_helper.get_or_default(runner, nil)
	local target_pos_val = lua_helper.get_or_default(target_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
	local speed_val = lua_helper.get_or_default(speed, 0)
	local interpolations_val = lua_helper.get_or_default(interpolations, interpolations_constants.linear)

	table.insert(params, { runner = runner_val, target_pos = target_pos_val, speed = speed_val,
	                       interpolations = interpolations_val })
end

-- 러너 기타 파라미터 생성 후 추가
function local_class:add_runner_other_param(params, delay, value, duration)
	local delay_val = lua_helper.get_or_default(delay, 0)
	local value_val = lua_helper.get_or_default(value, nil)
	local duration_val = lua_helper.get_or_default(duration, 0)

	table.insert(params, { delay = delay_val, value = value_val, duration = duration_val })
end

-- 파라미터 받아서 러너 이동
function local_class:runner_move_by_param(data, runner_num)
	-- 이동
	local move = lua_helper.get_value(data, "move", nil)

	-- 콜백
	local callback = lua_helper.get_value(data, "callback", nil)

	if callback ~= nil then
		start_coroutine(self.control_runner_callback, self, callback)
	end

	if move ~= nil then
		self:control_runner_move(move, runner_num)
	end
end

-- 러너 이동
function local_class:control_runner_move(move, runner_num)
	for i = 1, #move do
		local runner = lua_helper.get_value(move[i], "runner", nil)
		local target_pos = lua_helper.get_value(move[i], "target_pos", unity_class.vector3.zero)
		local speed = lua_helper.get_value(move[i], "speed", 0)

		local start_pos = runner.Position

		-- 총 이동 거리
		local added_dist = 0
		local fixed_dist = (target_pos - start_pos).magnitude

		while true do
			-- 강제 포지션 변경 시, 남은 거리 다시 계산
			if self.position_exceptions[runner_num] then
				self.position_exceptions[runner_num] = false

				added_dist = 0
				fixed_dist = (target_pos - runner.Position).magnitude
			end

			-- 코너 변경 예외처리, 반복문 중단시킴
			if #self.corner_exceptions >= runner_num and self.corner_exceptions[runner_num] ~= -1 then
				self.runner_corners[runner_num] = self.corner_exceptions[runner_num]
				self.corner_exceptions[runner_num] = -1

				break
			end

			local cur_speed = speed

			-- 라나 부스트 예외처리
			if self.lana_boost and runner_num == 3 then
				cur_speed = 7
			end

			local cur_move = (target_pos - start_pos).normalized * cur_speed * unity_class.time.deltaTime
			local cur_dist = cur_move.magnitude
			added_dist = added_dist + cur_dist

			if added_dist < fixed_dist then
				runner.Position = runner.Position + cur_move
			else
				-- 총 이동 거리가 정해진 이동 거리 넘어가면 목적지에 도달한 것이므로 target_pos로 고정
				runner.Position = target_pos

				break
			end

			-- 스모크 설치
			stage.SmokeManager:SetDefaultSmokeOnce(runner.Position)

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		if not self.lana_boost then
			runner.Position = target_pos
		end
	end
end

-- 러너 콜백
function local_class:control_runner_callback(callback)
	for i = 1, #callback do
		local delay = lua_helper.get_value(callback[i], "delay", 0)
		local value = lua_helper.get_value(callback[i], "value", nil)

		wait_for_sec(delay)

		if value ~= nil then
			value()
		end
	end
end

-- 러너 방향 복구
function local_class:reset_runner_dir()
	for i = 1, #self.race_runners do
		if self.runner_corners[i] == 1 then
			character_util.set_direction(self.race_runners[i], 'left')
		elseif self.runner_corners[i] == 2 then
			character_util.set_direction(self.race_runners[i], 'up')
		elseif self.runner_corners[i] == 3 then
			character_util.set_direction(self.race_runners[i], 'right')
		else
			character_util.set_direction(self.race_runners[i], 'down')
		end
	end
end

-- 코드를 개떡같이 만들어서 카메라 리셋될 때마다 러너들 위치 적당히 잘 나오는 곳으로 설정해 주는 보완 작업
function local_class:set_runner_position(poses)
	self.position_exceptions = {}

	for i = 1, #poses do

function local_class:add_camera_param(params, delay, value, duration)

	local value_val = lua_helper.get_or_default(value, nil)

	table.insert(params, { delay = delay_val, value = value_val, duration = duration_val })

-- 파라미터 받아서 카메라 이동
function local_class:camera_move_by_param(data)
	-- 카메라 위치
	local pos = lua_helper.get_value(data, "pos", nil)

	-- 연출 시간
	local duration = lua_helper.get_value(data, "duration", 0)

	-- 카메라 크기
	local size = lua_helper.get_value(data, "size", nil)

	-- 카메라 각도
	local angle = lua_helper.get_value(data, "angle", nil)

	-- 카메라 진동
	local shake = lua_helper.get_value(data, "shake", nil)

	-- 콜백
	local callback = lua_helper.get_value(data, "callback", nil)

	if pos ~= nil then
		start_coroutine(self.control_camera_pos, self, pos)
	end

	if size ~= nil then
		start_coroutine(self.control_camera_size, self, size)
	end

	if angle ~= nil then
		start_coroutine(self.control_camera_angle, self, angle)
	end

	if shake ~= nil then
		start_coroutine(self.control_camera_shake, self, shake)
	end

	if callback ~= nil then
		start_coroutine(self.control_camera_callback, self, callback)
	end

	wait_for_sec(duration)
end

-- 카메라 위치 처리
function local_class:control_camera_pos(pos)
	for i = 1, #pos do
		local delay = lua_helper.get_value(pos[i], "delay", 0)
		local value = lua_helper.get_value(pos[i], "value", 0)
		local duration = lua_helper.get_value(pos[i], "duration", 0)

		wait_for_sec(delay)

		camera_util.move_async(value, duration)
	end
end

-- 카메라 사이즈 처리
function local_class:control_camera_size(size)
	for i = 1, #size do
		local delay = lua_helper.get_value(size[i], "delay", 0)
		local value = lua_helper.get_value(size[i], "value", 0)
		local duration = lua_helper.get_value(size[i], "duration", 0)

		wait_for_sec(delay)

		camera_util.resize_by_ratio(value, duration)

		wait_for_sec(duration)
	end
end

-- 카메라 회전 처리
function local_class:control_camera_angle(angle)
	for i = 1, #angle do
		local delay = lua_helper.get_value(angle[i], "delay", 0)
		local value = lua_helper.get_value(
				angle[i], "value", stage_camera.Transform.parent.localRotation.eulerAngles)
		local duration = lua_helper.get_value(angle[i], "duration", 0)

		wait_for_sec(delay)

		local timer = 0
		local start_value = stage_camera.Transform.parent.localRotation.eulerAngles

		while timer < duration do
			timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

			local cur_value = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_value, value, timer / duration)
			stage_camera.Transform.parent.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(cur_value)

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end
end

-- 카메라 진동 처리

		local value = lua_helper.get_value(shake[i], "value", 0)
		local duration = lua_helper.get_value(shake[i], "duration", 0)

		local delay = lua_helper.get_value(callback[i], "delay", 0)

		wait_for_sec(delay)

		if value ~= nil then

	end
end

-- 캐릭터에 perspective camera를 붙이고 따라감
function local_class:perspective_camera_on_character(
		runner, direction, start_delay, sizes, angles, callbacks, duration, end_delay)
	-- 생성
	local instantiate_pos = runner.Position

	if direction == self.constants.perspective_camera.perspective_camera_front then
		instantiate_pos = instantiate_pos + direction_util.to_vector3(runner.Direction) +
				vector(0, self.constants.perspective_camera.perspective_camera_front_y, 0)

		-- 정면이면 러너들 전부 앞 보도록 수정
		for i = 1, #self.race_runners do
			character_util.set_direction(self.race_runners[i], 'down')
		end
	elseif direction == self.constants.perspective_camera.perspective_camera_side then
		instantiate_pos = instantiate_pos + vector(
				0, self.constants.perspective_camera.perspective_camera_side_y,
				self.constants.perspective_camera.perspective_camera_side_minus_z)
	end

	local cur_camera_obj = self.get_camera_obj():Instantiate(
			instantiate_pos, unity_class.quaternion.identity, runner.Transform)

	-- 기본 설정
	local start_size = lua_helper.get_value(sizes, "start",
			self.constants.perspective_camera.perspective_camera_side_fov_min)
	local start_angle = lua_helper.get_value(angles, "start", unity_class.vector3.zero)

	local cur_camera = cur_camera_obj.transform:GetComponentInChildren(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Camera))
	cur_camera.backgroundColor = unity_color(self.constants.perspective_camera.solid_color)
	cur_camera.fieldOfView = start_size
	cur_camera_obj.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(start_angle)

	wait_for_sec(start_delay)

	self:perspective_camera(cur_camera_obj, nil, sizes, angles, callbacks, duration)

	wait_for_sec(end_delay)

	-- 정면이라 방향 변경을 한 경우, 러너의 현재 코너 상태에 맞춰 방향 설정
	if direction == self.constants.perspective_camera.perspective_camera_front then
		self:reset_runner_dir()
	end

	-- 연출 완료되면 카메라 오브젝트 파괴
	cur_camera_obj:Dispose()
end

-- 특정 위치에 perspective camera 생성
function local_class:perspective_camera_on_field(
		instantiate_pos, instantiate_rotation, start_delay, poses, sizes, angles, callbacks, duration, end_delay)
	-- 생성
	local cur_camera_obj = self.get_camera_obj():Instantiate(instantiate_pos)
	cur_camera_obj.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(instantiate_rotation)

	-- 기본 설정
	local start_size = lua_helper.get_value(sizes, "start",
			self.constants.perspective_camera.perspective_camera_side_fov_min)
	local start_angle = lua_helper.get_value(angles, "start", unity_class.vector3.zero)

	local cur_camera = cur_camera_obj.transform:GetComponentInChildren(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Camera))
	cur_camera.backgroundColor = unity_color(self.constants.perspective_camera.solid_color)
	cur_camera.fieldOfView = start_size
	cur_camera_obj.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(start_angle)

	wait_for_sec(start_delay)

	self:perspective_camera(cur_camera_obj, poses, sizes, angles, callbacks, duration)

	wait_for_sec(end_delay)

	-- 연출 완료되면 카메라 오브젝트 파괴
	cur_camera_obj:Dispose()
end

-- perspective 카메라 연출
function local_class:perspective_camera(cur_camera_obj, poses, sizes, angles, callbacks, duration)
	-- 파라미터 받아옴
	local cannot_move = true
	local start_pos
	local end_pos
	local pos_duration
	local pos_interpolations

	if poses ~= nil then
		cannot_move = false

		start_pos = cur_camera_obj.transform.localPosition
		end_pos = lua_helper.get_value(poses, "target", start_pos)
		pos_duration = lua_helper.get_value(poses, "duration", 0)
		pos_interpolations = lua_helper.get_value(poses, "interpolations", interpolations_constants.linear)
	end

	local start_size = lua_helper.get_value(sizes, "start",
			self.constants.perspective_camera.perspective_camera_side_fov_min)
	local end_size = lua_helper.get_value(sizes, "target",
			self.constants.perspective_camera.perspective_camera_side_fov_min)
	local size_duration = lua_helper.get_value(sizes, "duration", 0)
	local size_interpolations = lua_helper.get_value(sizes, "interpolations", interpolations_constants.linear)

	local start_angle = lua_helper.get_value(angles, "start", unity_class.vector3.zero)
	local end_angle = lua_helper.get_value(angles, "target", unity_class.vector3.zero)
	local angle_duration = lua_helper.get_value(angles, "duration", 0)
	local angle_interpolations = lua_helper.get_value(sizes, "interpolations", interpolations_constants.linear)

	local callback_delays = {}
	local callback_values = {}

	if callbacks ~= nil then
		for i = 1, #callbacks do
			table.insert(callback_delays, lua_helper.get_value(callbacks[i], "delay", 0))
			table.insert(callback_values, lua_helper.get_value(callbacks[i], "value", nil))
		end
	end

	local cur_camera = cur_camera_obj.transform:GetComponentInChildren(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Camera))
	local timer = 0

	local callback_timer = 0
	local callback_index = 1

	while timer < duration do
		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		callback_timer = callback_timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if not cannot_move then
			if timer < pos_duration then
				local cur_pos_x = pos_interpolations(timer, start_pos.x, end_pos.x - start_pos.x, pos_duration)
				local cur_pos_y = pos_interpolations(timer, start_pos.y, end_pos.y - start_pos.y, pos_duration)
				local cur_pos_z = pos_interpolations(timer, start_pos.z, end_pos.z - start_pos.z, pos_duration)

				cur_camera_obj.transform.localPosition = vector(cur_pos_x, cur_pos_y, cur_pos_z)
			else
				cur_camera_obj.transform.localPosition = end_pos
			end
		end

		if timer < size_duration then
			local cur_size = size_interpolations(timer, start_size, end_size - start_size, size_duration)
			cur_camera.fieldOfView = cur_size
		else
			cur_camera.fieldOfView = end_size
		end

		if timer < angle_duration then
			local cur_angle_x = angle_interpolations(timer, start_angle.x, end_angle.x - start_angle.x, angle_duration)
			local cur_angle_y = angle_interpolations(timer, start_angle.y, end_angle.y - start_angle.y, angle_duration)
			local cur_angle_z = angle_interpolations(timer, start_angle.z, end_angle.z - start_angle.z, angle_duration)

			cur_camera_obj.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(cur_angle_x, cur_angle_y, cur_angle_z)
		else
			cur_camera_obj.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(end_angle)
		end

		if callback_index <= #callbacks then
			if callback_timer >= callback_delays[callback_index] then
				callback_timer = 0

				local cur_callback = callback_values[callback_index]
				if (cur_callback ~= nil) then
					cur_callback()
				end

				callback_index = callback_index + 1
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end
--endregion

--region Callback

--endregion

--endregion

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('QueenShipHorseRacingSection2')

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)

	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	end

	}

end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)

function local_class:setting()

	local runner_pos_offset = {
		vector(-3.5, 0, 0.5),
		vector(-3.5, 0, -0.5),
		vector(-2.5, 0, 0.5),
		vector(-2.5, 0, -0.5),
		vector(-1.5, 0, 0.5),
		vector(-1.5, 0, -0.5)
	}

	for i = 1, #runner_pos_offset do
		local runner = self.get_runner(i)
		runner.Position = starting_pos + runner_pos_offset[i]
		character_util.set_direction(runner, 'right')
		scene_util.set_emotion_loop(runner, 'smile')
	end

	local trainer_pos_offset = {
		vector(-0.5, 0, 0),
		vector(0.5, 0, 0.5),
		vector(0.5, 0, -0.5)
	}

	for i = 1, #trainer_pos_offset do
		local trainer = self.get_trainer(i)
		trainer.Position = starting_pos + trainer_pos_offset[i]
		character_util.set_direction(trainer, 'left')
	end

	local battle_pos = self.get_trainer_battle_pos()

	local trainer_battle_invader_pos_offset = {
		vector(11, 0, -0.5),
		vector(12, 0, -0.5),
		vector(11, 0, 0.5),
		vector(12, 0, 0.5)
	}

	for i = 1, #trainer_battle_invader_pos_offset do

		character_util.set_direction(battle_invader, 'left')

	scene_util.set_release_anim(trainer)

	local move_duration = 1.5

	local run_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_dash_01', loop = true })
	for i = 1, 4 do
		local invader = self.get_trainer_invader(i)
		wp_util.move(invader, invader.Position + vector(-9, 0, 0),
			nil, move_duration, { run = true })
	end

	wait_for_sec(move_duration + 0.5)
	run_sfx:Stop()
	run_sfx = nil

	self.stop_throw_green_ticket = false

	start_coroutine(self.throw_green_ticket, self)

	wait_for_sec(0.65)

	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(leader, 'damaged')
	scene_util.set_dead_anim(leader)

	local camera = stage_camera
	self.smoke_effect = self.get_smoke_effect():Instantiate(
		camera.Transform.position, unity_class.quaternion.identity, camera.Transform)

	local main_module = self.smoke_effect.transform:GetComponentInChildren(
		typeof(CS.UnityEngine.ParticleSystem)).main

	self.gradient.color = unity_color({ 0.2, 0.6, 0.3, 0 })
	main_module.startColor = self.gradient
	local color = main_module.startColor.color

	local smoke_duration = 0.5
	local time_passed = 0

	local start_alpha = 0
	local end_alpha = 0.6

	self.gas_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_gas_01', loop = true})
	while time_passed < smoke_duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local cur_alpha = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(start_alpha, end_alpha, time_passed / smoke_duration)

		self.gradient.color = unity_color({ color.r, color.g, color.b, cur_alpha })
		main_module.startColor = self.gradient

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	wait_for_sec(1)

	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('s2_bulkhead_door_1'))

	self.gas_sfx:FadeOut(1)
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })

	self.stop_throw_green_ticket = true

	if self.smoke_effect then
		self.smoke_effect:Dispose()
		self.smoke_effect = nil
	end

	self.controller:set_slow_run_speed(true)

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0)

	quest_util.progress_section(self.controller)
end

-- 플레이어한테 그린 티켓 던지는 연출
function local_class:throw_green_ticket()
	while not self.stop_throw_green_ticket do
		local leader = get_party_leader()
		local drugs = {}

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_throw_01')
		for i = 1, 4 do
			local invader = self.get_trainer_invader(i)
			scene_util.set_anim_non_loop(invader, 'release', { remove_after = 0.47 })

			local drug = drop_item_util.create_item(
				{ pos = invader.Position, target = leader.Position, itemid = 20253,
				  notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', sprscale = 0.75, showoncharacter = true })

			local sprite = drug.SpriteTransform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
			if sprite ~= nil then
				sprite.TintColor = unity_color({ 0, 1, 0, 1 })
				sprite:Rebuild()
			end

			table.insert(drugs, drug)
		end

		wait_for_sec(0.65)

		if self.stop_throw_green_ticket then
			return
		end

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_explosion_01')
		-- 가디언에게 맞은 그린 티켓은 FX_dead와 함께 폭발, 가디언 맞으면 damage_squish, red_pulse
		self.get_dead_effect():Instantiate(leader.Position)
		character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(leader)
		character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(leader)

		for i = 1, #drugs do
			drugs[i]:ConsumeComplete()
		end

		wait_for_sec(0.5)
	end
end

return local_class

--- OnEvent
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.meet_trainer and
		type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.get_trainer(1)) then

		self.current_section_state = self.current_section_state + 1

		start_coroutine(self.talk_with_trainer, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

--- ZoneEnterEvent
function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.none and
		type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 's3_meet_trainer') then

		self.current_section_state = self.current_section_state + 1

		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(self.meet_trainer, self)

		return true
	end

	if not self.end_racing and type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 's3_racing_goal') then
		self.end_racing = true
		self.player_win = true
		return true
	end

	local rival = self.get_rival()
	if not self.end_racing and type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, rival, 's3_racing_goal') then
		self.end_racing = true
		return true
	end

	return false
end

--- TouchEvent
function local_class:on_touch_event(e)
	if not self.is_exhaustion and
			(e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.Action1TouchDown or
					(CS.Oak.InputManager.IsPC and e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.TouchDown)) then
		self:change_action(self.leader_action.dash)

		self.player_dash_sfx_1 = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_dash_01', parent = get_party_leader(), loop = true })
		self.player_dash_sfx_2 = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_dash_11', parent = self.get_player_tire(), loop = true })

		return true
	end

	if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.Action1TouchUp or
			(CS.Oak.InputManager.IsPC and e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.TouchUp) then
		self:change_action(self.leader_action.idle)

		if self.player_dash_sfx_1 then
			music_player_util.stop_sfx(self.player_dash_sfx_1)
			self.player_dash_sfx_1 = nil
		end

		if self.player_dash_sfx_2 then
			music_player_util.stop_sfx(self.player_dash_sfx_2)
			self.player_dash_sfx_2 = nil
		end

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:s3_2_setting()
	local training_pos = self.get_training_pos()

	local trainer_1 = self.get_trainer(1)
	trainer_1.Position = training_pos
	character_util.set_direction(trainer_1, 'left')
	character_util.add_listener(trainer_1, self.controller)
	quest_icon_util.set_quest_cleared(trainer_1)

	local trainer_2 = self.get_trainer(2)
	character_util.set_direction(trainer_2, 'left')
	trainer_2.Position = training_pos + vector(1, 0, -0.5)

	local trainer_3 = self.get_trainer(3)
	character_util.set_direction(trainer_3, 'left')
	trainer_3.Position = training_pos + vector(1, 0, 0.5)

	local oni_girl = self.get_oni_girl()
	character_util.set_active_state(oni_girl, 'enabled')
	oni_girl.Position = training_pos + vector(-2, 0, -3)
	character_util.set_direction(oni_girl, 'right')

	local horse = self.get_horse()
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(horse, 'damaged')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(horse, 'walk', { scale = 0.5 })
	scene_util.shake(horse, 0.04, 99999)

	self.get_tire(3):Shake(0.04, 99999)
end

--- 트레이닝 시작
function local_class:talk_with_trainer()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()

	character_util.hide_weapon(get_party_leader(), true)

	local trainer_1 = self.get_trainer(1)
	local tazuna = self.get_trainer(2)
	local lisicho = self.get_trainer(3)

	character_util.remove_relate_event(trainer_1, self.controller)
	quest_icon_util.remove(trainer_1)

	timeline_util.play_async('qs_horse_racing_s3', 'qs_horse_racing_s3_3')

	self:racing_setting()

	camera_util.move_async(self.get_racing_goal_pos(), 0)

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	self.controller:play_blizzard_sfx()

	local racing_pos = self.get_racing_pos()
	camera_util.move_async(racing_pos + vector(2, 0, 0), 7)

	-- 트레이너 (left, attack, idle) : 훈련은 2인 1조로 진행된다!
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(trainer_1, 'attack')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(trainer_1, 'qs_horse_racing_s3_45')

	-- 이사장 (left, attack, cast2) : 먼저 오른쪽 끝의 결승점에 도착한 쪽이 승리!
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(lisicho, 'cast2')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(lisicho, 'attack')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(lisicho, 'qs_horse_racing_s3_46')

	-- 타즈나 (left, smile, sing) : 승리하는 말이 I1 경기에 나가는 티켓을 딸 수 있답니다!
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(tazuna, 'sing')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(tazuna, 'smile')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(trainer_1, 'qs_horse_racing_s3_47')

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(tazuna)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(lisicho)

	-- 트레이너 (left, attack, release) : 진짜 경주라고 생각하고 온 힘을 다해 달리도록!
	scene_util.set_release_anim(trainer_1)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_china_01')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(trainer_1, 'qs_horse_racing_s3_48')

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(trainer_1)

	-- 카메라 1초간 가디언과 라이벌 중앙 위치로 이동
	camera_util.move_async(get_party_leader().Position + vector(0, 0, -1.5), 1)

	local rival = self.get_rival()

	-- 라이벌 (left, tired, cast) : 난…달리는 건 잘 못하는데…
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(rival, 'tired')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(rival, 'cast')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(rival, 'qs_horse_racing_s3_49')

	-- 라이벌 (left, tired, idle) : 장거리 경주마의 자질을 타고났다니까…
	character_util.remove_anim(rival)
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(rival, 'qs_horse_racing_s3_50')

	-- 라이벌 (left,  victory_get, idle) : 화…화이팅…
	scene_util.set_anim_non_loop(rival, 'victory_get')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_intro_jump_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(rival, 'qs_horse_racing_s3_51')
	character_util.remove_anim(rival)

	self:start_racing()
end

function local_class:racing_setting()
	local racing_pos = self.get_racing_pos()

	local leader = get_party_leader()
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'right')
	leader.Position = racing_pos + vector(4, 0, 1.5)

	local rival = self.get_rival()
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(rival)
	character_util.set_direction(rival, 'right')
	rival.Position = racing_pos + vector(4, 0, -1.5)

	local trainer_1 = self.get_trainer(1)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(trainer_1)
	character_util.set_direction(trainer_1, 'right')
	trainer_1.Position = racing_pos + vector(0.5, 0, 0)

	local trainer_2 = self.get_trainer(2)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(trainer_2)
	character_util.set_direction(trainer_2, 'right')
	trainer_2.Position = racing_pos + vector(0, 0, -1)

	local trainer_3 = self.get_trainer(3)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(trainer_3)
	character_util.set_direction(trainer_3, 'right')
	trainer_3.Position = racing_pos + vector(0, 0, 1)

	local player_tire = self.get_player_tire()

		message_system:SendSync(breakable.FieldObjectBehaviour, CS.Oak.GimmickResetEvent.Instance)

--- 경주 시작
function local_class:start_racing()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local rival = self.get_rival()
	local player_tire = self.get_player_tire()
	local rival_tire = self.get_rival_tire()

	self.controller:start_race()

	-- 액션 버튼 UI만 나오도록 설정
	field_ui_manager:HideTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.PartyState)

	field_ui_manager:SetUI(leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton)
	field_ui_manager:ShowTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton)

	local run_button_action = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState.Button1Action.Run
	local action_button = field_ui_manager:GetUIByKey(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton, leader)
	field_ui_manager:GetSingleUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton).OverridenButtonAction = run_button_action
	action_button:RefreshButton(run_button_action, false)

	field_ui_manager:Show()

	CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance:Hide()
	stage.FieldUIMiniMap:Hide()
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, { 'resource_ui_off' }))

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_touch_event')

	-- 초기 스피드 설정
	local rival_speed = self.leader_action.dash.speed / 5 * 3

	-- 스테미나 세팅
	self.current_stamina = self.max_stamina
	self.remaining_recovery_time = self.recovery_cool_time
	self.is_exhaustion = false
	self.gauge_ui.color = self.origin_gauge_ui
	self.stamina_ui:SetActive(true)

	self:change_action(self.leader_action.idle)

	self.end_racing = false

	-- 튜토리얼
	if not self.is_play_tutorial then
		self.is_play_tutorial = true
		CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowActionTap(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton)

		while self.current_leader_action ~= self.leader_action.dash do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.CloseTutorialSpine()
	end

	scene_util.set_anim_loop(rival, 'run')

	-- 이동 루틴
	while not self.end_racing do
		local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime

		self:stamina_update(dt)

		self:check_crash_breakable(leader, self.current_leader_action.speed * dt)
		CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameStageLogic.ExecuteMove(leader, unity_class.vector3.right, self.current_leader_action.speed * dt)
		player_tire.Position = leader.Position + vector(-2, 0, -0.5)
		camera_util.move(leader.Position + vector(0, 0, -1.5), 0)

		self:check_crash_breakable(rival, rival_speed * dt)
		CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameStageLogic.ExecuteMove(rival, unity_class.vector3.right, rival_speed * dt)
		rival_tire.Position = rival.Position + vector(-2, 0, -0.5)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if self.player_dash_sfx_1 then
		music_player_util.stop_sfx(self.player_dash_sfx_1)
		self.player_dash_sfx_1 = nil
	end

	if self.player_dash_sfx_2 then
		music_player_util.stop_sfx(self.player_dash_sfx_2)
		self.player_dash_sfx_2 = nil
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))

	self.stamina_ui:SetActive(false)
	field_ui_manager:GetSingleUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton).OverridenButtonAction = nil
	field_ui_manager:Hide()

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(rival)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

	self:change_action(self.leader_action.idle)

	if self.player_win then
		self:win_race()
	else
		self:lose_race()
	end
end

--- 리더 액션 변경
function local_class:change_action(new_action)
	if self.current_leader_action == new_action then
		return
	end

	local leader = get_party_leader()
	self.current_leader_action = new_action
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(leader, new_action.animation)
end

--- breakable 충돌 체크
function local_class:check_crash_breakable(target, magnitude)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(target, get_party_leader()) and self.current_leader_action ~= self.leader_action.dash then
		return
	end

	local obj_list = CS.Oak.LuaCollisionUtil.GetFieldObjectsCollidedBy(target.Bounds, unity_class.vector3.right * magnitude)

	for i = 0, obj_list.Count - 1 do
		local obj = obj_list[i]
		if lua_helper.type_compare(obj.FieldObjectBehaviour, CS.Oak.HoldableObjectBehaviour) then

			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
			damage_info.sender = obj
			damage_info.target = obj
			damage_info.damage = CS.Oak.DamageConstants.ObjectImpact

			command_util.execute_damage(damage_info)

			table.insert(self.destroyed_breakable, obj)
		end
	end

	obj_list:Dispose()
end

--- 스테미나 관련 업데이트
function local_class:stamina_update(dt)
	if self.current_leader_action == self.leader_action.dash then
		-- 스테미나 소모
		self.remaining_recovery_time = self.recovery_cool_time

		self.current_stamina = math.max(0, self.current_stamina - dt * 33.33)

		if self.current_stamina <= 0 then
			-- 탈진
			self.is_exhaustion = true
			self.gauge_ui.color = unity_class.color.red
			scene_util.set_emotion_loop(get_party_leader(), 'damaged')
			self:change_action(self.leader_action.idle)
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
		end

	elseif self.remaining_recovery_time <= 0 then
		-- 스테미나 회복
		self.current_stamina = math.min(self.max_stamina, self.current_stamina + dt * 50)

		if self.is_exhaustion and self.current_stamina >= self.max_stamina then
			-- 탈진 풀림
			self.is_exhaustion = false
			self.gauge_ui.color = self.origin_gauge_ui
			character_util.remove_emotion(get_party_leader())
		end

	else
		self.remaining_recovery_time = self.remaining_recovery_time - dt
	end

	self.gauge_ui.transform.localScale = vector(self.current_stamina / self.max_stamina, 1, 1)
end

	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(trainer, 'attack')

	character_util.set_direction(tazuna, 'right')

	-- 트레이너 위 경로로 달려감, 동시에 우측 문 열림
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('s3_training_door_1', false))
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('s3_training_door_2', false))
	wait_for_sec(2)

			7, nil, { run = true })

	wp_util.move_async(trainer, trainer.Position + vector(10, 0, 0),

			type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.get_trainer(1)) then

		self.current_section_state = self.current_section_state + 1

		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(self.talk_with_trainer, self)
		return true
	end

	return false

--- ZoneEnterEvent
function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.end_racing or self.current_section_state ~= self.section_state.start_racing then
		return false
	end

	local leader = get_party_leader()

	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 's4_racing_end') then
		self.end_racing = true
		character_util.stop(self.get_rival())
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(leader, 1, 0)

		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(self.win_race, self)
		return true
	end

	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, self.get_rival(), 's4_racing_end') then
		self.end_racing = true
		character_util.stop(self.get_rival())
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(leader, 1, 0)

		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(self.lose_race, self)
		return true
	end

	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 's4_racing_start') then
		self.end_racing = true
		character_util.stop(self.get_rival())
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(leader, 1, 0)

		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(self.exit_training, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

--- 상태 업데이트
function local_class:state_update()
	self.leader_action_time_passed = 0
	self.rival_last_hit_time = 0

	self.leader_last_alpha_time = 0
	self.current_alpha = 1

	self.current_leader_action_state = self.leader_action_state.idle

	while not self.end_racing do
		local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime
		self:leader_action(dt)

		self:rival_action()

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

--- 리더 행동
function local_class:leader_action(dt)
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	self.leader_action_time_passed = self.leader_action_time_passed + dt

	-- 리더 액션 변경
	local change_action_state = function()
		self.leader_action_time_passed = 0
		self.current_leader_action_state = self.current_leader_action_state + 1

		if self.current_leader_action_state > self.leader_action_state.immortal then
			self.current_leader_action_state = self.leader_action_state.idle
		end
	end

	local knock_back_dist = 1
	local knock_back_duration = 0.2
	local alpha_duration = 0.5

	if self.current_leader_action_state == self.leader_action_state.idle then
		-- 기본 상태
		local crashed_spike = self:check_crashed_spike(leader)
		if crashed_spike then
			party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

			self.move_dir = vector_util.to_direction((leader.Position - crashed_spike.Position).normalized)

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_big_01')
			character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(leader)
			character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(leader)
			character_util.set_direction(leader, direction_util.to_side_dir(leader.Direction))
			scene_util.set_emotion_loop(leader, 'damaged')
			scene_util.set_prostrate_anim(leader)

			change_action_state()
		end

	elseif self.current_leader_action_state == self.leader_action_state.knock_back then
		-- 넉백 상태
		local move_dist = (knock_back_dist / knock_back_duration) * dt
		leader.Position = leader.Position + direction_util.to_vector3(self.move_dir) * move_dist

		if self.leader_action_time_passed > knock_back_duration then
			change_action_state()
		end

	elseif self.current_leader_action_state == self.leader_action_state.prostrate then
		-- 넘어진 상태
		if self.leader_action_time_passed > 1 then
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
			character_util.shake(leader, 0.04, 1)
			change_action_state()
		end

	elseif self.current_leader_action_state == self.leader_action_state.shake then
		-- 쉐이크 상태
		if self.leader_action_time_passed > 1 then
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_popup_01')
			character_util.mario_jump_new(leader, leader.Direction)
			change_action_state()
		end

	elseif self.current_leader_action_state == self.leader_action_state.mario_jump then
		-- 마리오 점프 상태
		if self.leader_action_time_passed > 0.3 then
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
			party_util.reset_controllers()
			change_action_state()
		end

	elseif self.current_leader_action_state == self.leader_action_state.immortal then
		-- 무적 상태
		if unity_class.time.time - self.leader_last_alpha_time > alpha_duration then
			self.leader_last_alpha_time = unity_class.time.time

			if self.leader_action_time_passed > 2 then
				self.leader_last_alpha_time = 0
				self.current_alpha = 1
				change_action_state()
			else
				self.current_alpha = (self.current_alpha + 1) % 2
			end

			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(leader, self.current_alpha, alpha_duration)
		end
	end
end

--- 라이벌 행동
function local_class:rival_action()
	local rival = self.get_rival()

	if unity_class.time.time - self.rival_last_hit_time > 2 and self:check_crashed_spike(rival) then
		self.rival_last_hit_time = unity_class.time.time

		character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(rival)
		character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(rival)
	end
end

--- 충돌한 가시 블럭 체크
function local_class:check_crashed_spike(target)
	local obj_list = CS.Oak.LuaCollisionUtil.GetFieldObjectsCollidedBy(target.Bounds, unity_class.vector3.zero)

	local crashed_spike

	for i = 0, obj_list.Count - 1 do
		local obj = obj_list[i]
		if lua_helper.type_compare(obj.FieldObjectBehaviour, CS.Oak.SpikeBehaviour) then
			crashed_spike = obj
		end
	end

	obj_list:Dispose()

	return crashed_spike
end

--- 가시 블럭과 라나의 충돌 체크
function local_class:check_oni_girl_crash_spike()
	local oni_girl = self.get_oni_girl()

	self.stop_check_oni_girl_crash_spike = false

	while not self.stop_check_oni_girl_crash_spike do
		local obj_list = CS.Oak.LuaCollisionUtil.GetFieldObjectsCollidedBy(oni_girl.Bounds, 0.3 * unity_class.vector3.forward)

		for i = 0, obj_list.Count - 1 do
			local obj = obj_list[i]
			if lua_helper.type_compare(obj.FieldObjectBehaviour, CS.Oak.SpikeBehaviour) and not self.crashed_spike[obj] and
				obj.Position.z > oni_girl.Position.z then

				self.crashed_spike[obj] = true
				message_system:SendSync(obj.FieldObjectBehaviour, CS.Oak.SpikeStopEvent.Create(nil))
				self.get_dead_effect():Instantiate(obj.Position)
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_explosion_01')
				start_coroutine(self.fly_spike, self, obj)
			end
		end

		obj_list:Dispose()

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

--- 가시 블럭 날아가는 연출
function local_class:fly_spike(spike)
	local oni_girl = self.get_oni_girl()

	local move_dir = unity_class.vector3.right
	if spike.Position.x < oni_girl.Position.x then
		move_dir = unity_class.vector3.left
	end

	local duration = 0.7
	local time_passed = 0

	local start_pos_x = spike.Position.x
	local end_pos_x = spike.Position.x + 3 * move_dir.x

	local height = 3

	local start_rot_y = 0
	local end_rot_y = 360 * 4

	while time_passed < duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)

		local cur_x = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(start_pos_x, end_pos_x, progress)
		local cur_y = unity_class.mathf.Sin(unity_class.mathf.PI * progress) * height
		spike.Position = vector(cur_x, cur_y, spike.Position.z)

		local cur_rot_y = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(start_rot_y, end_rot_y, progress)
		spike.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, cur_rot_y, 0)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_bounce_iron_03', parent = spike })
end

--- 가시 블럭 리셋
function local_class:reset_spike()
	self.stop_crash_check = true

	for spike, crashed in pairs(self.crashed_spike) do
		if crashed then
			message_system:SendSync(spike.FieldObjectBehaviour, CS.Oak.SpikeResumeEvent.Create(nil))
		end

		message_system:SendSync(spike.FieldObjectBehaviour, CS.Oak.GimmickResetEvent.Instance)
	end
end

return local_class

function local_class:qte_action()
	-- 처음 도전이 아니면 qte 없도록
	if not self.first_try then
		return true
	end

	-- 게임패드 사용중이면 이벤트 핸들러 세팅
	if CS.Oak.Game.Instance.InputManager.GamepadEnabled then
		self.game_pad_handler = {
			callback = function(_, e)
				if e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.AButtonDown or
					e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.BButtonDown or
					e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.XButtonDown or
					e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.YButtonDown then
					message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.TouchEvent.Create(CS.Oak.TouchEventType.Tap, unity_class.vector2.zero))
					return true
				end
				return false
			end
		}
	end

	-- 게임패드 핸들러가 세팅되있다면 게임패드 이벤트 구독
	if self.game_pad_handler then
		message_system:Subscribe(self.game_pad_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadEvent), 'callback')
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_qte_action_wind_02')
	local success = qte_util.tap(1, 3)

	if self.game_pad_handler then
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self.game_pad_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadEvent))
		self.game_pad_handler = nil
	end

	return success
end

		scene_util.set_anim_loop(horse_npc, 'clap')

	scene_util.set_anim_non_loop(rival, 'frustration')

	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'left')

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(rival)

	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(leader, 'tired')
	scene_util.set_anim_non_loop(leader, 'frustration')

	-- FX_reward 화면에 보이게 생성

	local reward_effect = self.get_fx_reward():Instantiate(unity_class.vector3.zero)
	reward_effect.transform.localScale = vector(0.00278, 0.00278, 0.00278)
