local local_class = newclass('QueenShipHorseRacingSection6')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = QueenShipHorseRacing @
		Comment = QueenShipHorseRacing 퀘스트/이벤트 섹션 @
		Index = 5 @
		NextSections = 6 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	-- npc
	self.get_trainer = function(index)
		return get_character('different_trainer_' .. index)
	end

	self.get_rival = function()
		return get_character('s6_rival')
	end

	self.get_oni_girl = function()
		return get_character('runner_3')
	end

	self.get_horse_npc = function(index)
		return get_character('horse_npc_4_' .. index)
	end

	-- 기믹
	self.get_player_training_dummy = function()
		return get_field_object('s6_player_training_dummy')
	end

	self.get_rival_training_dummy = function()
		return get_field_object('s6_rival_training_dummy')
	end

	self.get_oni_girl_training_dummy = function()
		return get_field_object('s6_oni_girl_training_dummy')
	end

	self.get_training_dummy = function(index)
		return get_field_object('s6_training_dummy_' .. index)
	end

	-- 마커
	self.get_training_pos = function()
		return field_util.get_marker_pos('s6_training_pos')
	end

	-- 이펙트
	self.get_fx_hit = function()
		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit')
	end

	self.get_fx_last_hit = function()
		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_lasthit')
	end

	self.available_stage_name = 'queenship_substage_farm'

	self.section_state = {
		none = 1,
		start_training = 2
	}

	self.current_section_state = self.section_state.none

	self.mini_game_loaded = false
	self.mini_game_name = 'RhythmPunch'
	self.mini_game = nil

	-- 미니게임 진행 중인지
	self.is_playing_mini_game = false

	self.is_talk_horse = { false, false }
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	screen_util.preload_tutorial_spine()

	self.get_fx_hit()
	self.get_fx_last_hit()

	timeline_util.load_playable(
		'qs_horse_racing_s6_1'
	)
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_custom_stage_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent), 'on_mini_game_end_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')

	self:setting()
	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	local punch_anim = {
		'gauntlet_left_jap_attack',
		'gauntlet_right_jap_attack'
	}

	for i = 1, 5 do
		local horse_npc = self.get_horse_npc(i)
		local training_dummy = self.get_training_dummy(i)
		local left_dir = true

		if i > 3 then
			left_dir = false
		end

		start_coroutine(self.npc_punch_routine, self, horse_npc, training_dummy, left_dir, 0.5, function()
			music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_hit_big_01', parent = horse_npc })
			scene_util.set_anim_non_loop(horse_npc, punch_anim[2 - (i % 2)],
				{ sfx_name = '02_normal_slash_02' })
		end)
	end

	local oni_girl = self.get_oni_girl()
	local oni_girl_training_dummy = self.get_oni_girl_training_dummy()
	start_coroutine(self.npc_punch_routine, self, oni_girl, oni_girl_training_dummy, false, 0.2, function()
		scene_util.set_emotion_loop(oni_girl, 'burning')
		scene_util.set_anim_non_loop(oni_girl, 'gauntlet_combo_attack2',
			{ sfx_name = '02_energy_fist_01' })
	end)

	local rival = self.get_rival()
	local rival_training_dummy = self.get_rival_training_dummy()
	start_coroutine(self.npc_punch_routine, self, rival, rival_training_dummy, false, 0.5, function()
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_mining_01', parent = rival })
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_hit_big_01', parent = rival })
		scene_util.set_anim_non_loop(rival, 'hammer')
	end)
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

	if self.mini_game then
		mini_game_manager:DisposeMiniGame(self.mini_game_name)
		self.mini_game = nil
	end

	self.stop_npc_punch_routine = true
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--- OnEvent
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.none and
		type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.get_trainer(1)) then

		self.current_section_state = self.current_section_state + 1

		start_coroutine(self.talk_with_trainer, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

--- CustomStageEvent
function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if e:GetParamAt(0) == self.mini_game_name then
		self.start_rival_punch = true

		if e:GetParamAt(1) == 'success' then
			self.current_player_punch = self.mini_game_pattern_success
		else
			self.current_player_punch = self.mini_game_pattern_fail
		end

		return true
	end

	return false
end

--- MiniGameEndEvent
function local_class:on_mini_game_end_event(e)
	if e.Name == self.mini_game_name then
		self.is_playing_mini_game = false

		if e.Success then
			start_coroutine(self.mini_game_success, self)
		else
			start_coroutine(self.mini_game_fail, self)
		end

		return true
	end

	return false
end

--- ZoneEnterEvent
function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_section_state ~= self.section_state.none then
		return false
	end

	local leader = get_party_leader()
	if not self.is_talk_horse[1] and type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 's6_horse_talk_zone_1') then
		self.is_talk_horse[1] = true

		start_coroutine(function()
			-- 말 2 : 하나 둘, 하나 둘!
			local rival = self.get_rival()
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(rival, { key = 'qs_horse_racing_s6_28' })
			wait_for_sec(1)

			if self.current_section_state ~= self.section_state.none then
				return
			end

			-- 말 5 : 잽, 잽, 잽, 펀치, 훅!
			local horse_3 = self.get_horse_npc(3)
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(horse_3, { key = 'qs_horse_racing_s6_29' })
		end)

		return true
	end

	if not self.is_talk_horse[2] and type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 's6_horse_talk_zone_2') then
		self.is_talk_horse[2] = true

		-- 라이트닝 카운터 : 오라오라오라오라!!
		local oni_girl = self.get_oni_girl()
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_china_01', parent = oni_girl })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(oni_girl, { key = 'qs_horse_racing_s6_30' })

		return true
	end

	return false
end

--- 트레이너와 대화
function local_class:talk_with_trainer()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()

	local oni_girl = self.get_oni_girl()
	local rival = self.get_rival()

	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(oni_girl)
	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(rival)
	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(self.get_horse_npc(3))

	local trainer = self.get_trainer(1)
	character_util.remove_relate_event(trainer, self.controller)
	quest_icon_util.remove(trainer)

	timeline_util.play_async('qs_horse_racing_s6', 'qs_horse_racing_s6_1')

	local leader = get_party_leader()
	character_util.hide_weapon(leader, true)

	local training_pos = self.get_training_pos()
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(trainer)
	trainer.Position = training_pos + vector(0, 0, 1)
	character_util.set_direction(trainer, 'up')

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
	leader.Position = self.get_player_training_dummy().Position + vector(1, 0, -0.3)
	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'left')

	self.stop_npc_punch_routine = true

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0)
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(3, 0)

	-- 맨 처음 qte가 ShowTap일 경우 ui가 가운데 나와서 다른 qte 한번 실행 (기존 코드 수정하면 다른 곳에서 사이드 이펙트가 생길 수도 있어서...)
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.QTESwipe('right')
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.CloseTutorialSpine()

	-- 1초 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	for i = 1, 5 do
		local horse_npc = self.get_horse_npc(i)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(horse_npc)
		character_util.set_active_state(horse_npc, 'disabled')
	end

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(oni_girl)
	oni_girl.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(rival)

	-- 1초간 페이드 인
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	self.controller:play_blizzard_sfx()

	-- 튜토리얼 (최초 1번만 나옴)
	-- 트레이너 (up, idle, idle) : 먼저 연습 게임!
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(trainer, 'qs_horse_racing_s6_6')

	-- 트레이너 (up, idle, throw) : 타이밍에 맞춰서 더미를 공격해라!
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(trainer, 'throw', { sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(trainer, 'qs_horse_racing_s6_7')

	character_util.remove_anim(trainer)

	if not self.is_show_pc_narration then
		self.is_show_pc_narration = true
		field_ui_util.show_pc_control_narration('tip_keyboard_touch')
	end

	local player_training_dummy = self.get_player_training_dummy()

	-- 패턴 연출
	local pattern_scene = function(current_pattern)
		for index = 1, #current_pattern do
			local scene = current_pattern[index]
			if scene.camera_resize then
				camera_util.resize_by_ratio(scene.camera_resize, scene.duration)
			end
			camera_util.shake(scene.camera_shake, scene.duration)
			field:Tint(nil, unity_class.color.black, scene.duration, scene.tint)
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(scene.sfx)
			wait_for_sec(scene.duration + scene.wait_time)
		end

		qte_util.tap(1)

		field:RemoveTint(nil, 0.05)
		camera_util.resize_by_ratio(3, 0.05)

		if self.is_playing_bgm then
			self:mini_game_pattern_success(leader, player_training_dummy, true)
		else
			self.is_playing_bgm = true
			self:mini_game_pattern_success(leader, player_training_dummy, true, function()
				scene_util.set_emotion_loop(leader, 'attack')
				scene_util.set_anim_non_loop(leader, 'gauntlet_left_jap_attack', { sfx_name = '02_energy_fist_01' })

				self.controller:stop_blizzard_sfx()
				music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_shaolin_figo', state = 'event', mix = 0 })
			end, true)
		end

		wait_for_sec(1)
	end

	local constants_data = require('minigame/RhythmPunch/RhythmPunchConstants')
	local pattern_list = constants_data.pattern_list

	-- 1번 패턴 2번 반복
	for _ = 1, 2 do
		pattern_scene(pattern_list[1])
	end

	-- 트레이너 (up, idle, nod) : 좋았어, 아주 잘하고 있다.
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(trainer, 'nod')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(trainer, 'qs_horse_racing_s6_8')

	-- 트레이너 (up, idle, cast2) : 이번에는 조금 더 빠른 펀치다.
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(trainer, 'cast2')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(trainer, 'qs_horse_racing_s6_9')

	-- 트레이너 (up, idle, throw) : 집중해서 더미를 공격해!
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(trainer, 'throw')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_china_01')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(trainer, 'qs_horse_racing_s6_10')

	character_util.remove_anim(trainer)

	-- 2번 패턴 2번 반복
	for _ = 1, 2 do
		pattern_scene(pattern_list[2])
	end

	-- 트레이너 (up, idle, clap) : 아주 훌륭해, 바로 실전에 들어가도 되겠어.
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(trainer, 'clap')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_clap_01')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(trainer, 'qs_horse_racing_s6_11')

	-- 가디언 right 바라봄
	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'right')

	-- 라이벌 (left, idle, idle) : 제법인데? 하지만 날 이길 순 없을걸?
	character_util.set_direction(rival, 'left')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(rival, 'qs_horse_racing_s6_12')

	-- 라이벌 (right, attack, hammer) : 나비처럼 날아서 벌처럼 쏘는 이 몸의 권투 실력을 바라보기나 하시지!
	character_util.set_direction(rival, 'right')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(rival, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(rival, 'hammer')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_enhance_hammer_01')
	if not music_player_util.is_voice_available() then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_blacksmith_laugh_01')
	end
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(rival, 'qs_horse_racing_s6_13')

	-- 가디언 left 바라봄, 라이벌 right 바라보고 애니메이션과 이모션 해제
	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'left')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(rival)

	-- 트레이너 (up, idle, idle) : 둘 중에 더미를 더 정확하고 많이 때리는 쪽이 최종적으로 I1 출전권을 받게 된다!
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(trainer, 'qs_horse_racing_s6_14')

	-- 트레이너 (up, idle, cast2) : 꿈의 무대 I1을 향한 마지막 고비다, 있는 힘을 다해 성과를 보여주도록!
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(trainer, 'cast2')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_china_01')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(trainer, 'qs_horse_racing_s6_15')

	self:start_training()
end

function local_class:start_training()
	-- 훈련 시작!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_gun_shoot_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_whistle_01')
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowStageTitle(game_string:GetString('qs_horse_racing_2'), 2)
	wait_for_sec(2)

	self:start_mini_game_routine()
end

--- 미니게임 실행
function local_class:start_mini_game_routine()
	self.mini_game = mini_game_manager:GetOrCreate(self.mini_game_name)
	if not self.mini_game_loaded then
		mini_game_manager:LoadResource(self.mini_game_name, 'queenship', function()
			self.mini_game_loaded = true
		end)
	end

	while not self.mini_game_loaded do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	self.is_playing_mini_game = true

	start_coroutine(self.player_punch_scene, self)
	start_coroutine(self.rival_punch_scene, self)

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_shaolin_figo', state = 'event', mix = 0 })
	mini_game_manager:StartMiniGame(self.mini_game_name)
end

--- 미니게임 패턴 성공 했을 때
function local_class:mini_game_pattern_success(target, training_dummy, left_dir, callback, play_sfx)
	local offset = -1
	if left_dir then
		offset = 1
	end

	character_util.spine_deviate_local(target, vector(-0.3 * offset, 0, 0), 0.15, 0.1)

	if callback then
		callback()
	else
		-- 플레이어 전용
		scene_util.set_emotion_loop(target, 'attack')
		scene_util.set_anim_non_loop(target, 'gauntlet_left_jap_attack', { sfx_name = '02_energy_fist_01' })
		play_sfx = true
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.15)

	local effect_pos = target.Position + vector(-0.8 * offset, 0.5, -0.5)
	self.get_fx_hit():Instantiate(effect_pos)
	self.get_fx_last_hit():Instantiate(effect_pos)

	if play_sfx then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_quiz_o_02')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_big_01')
	end

	self:hit_reaction_dummy(training_dummy, { 30 * offset, 0 }, { 0.1, 0.15 })

	character_util.remove_anim(target)
end

--- 미니게임 패턴 실패 했을 때
function local_class:mini_game_pattern_fail(target, training_dummy, left_dir, callback)
	local offset = -1
	if left_dir then
		offset = 1
	end

	character_util.spine_deviate_local(target, vector(-0.3 * offset, 0, 0), 0.15, 0.1)

	local play_sfx = false

	if callback then
		callback()
	else
		-- 플레이어 전용
		scene_util.set_emotion_loop(target, 'attack')
		scene_util.set_anim_non_loop(target, 'gauntlet_left_jap_attack', { sfx_name = '02_energy_fist_01' })
		play_sfx = true
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.15)

	if play_sfx then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_quiz_x_01')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_hit_comic_01')
	end

	self:hit_reaction_dummy(training_dummy, { 10 * offset, -30 * offset }, { 0.1, 0.1 })

	local effect_pos = target.Position + vector(-0.2 * offset, 0.5, -0.5)
	self.get_fx_hit():Instantiate(effect_pos)
	self.get_fx_last_hit():Instantiate(effect_pos)
	character_util.spine_deviate_local(target, vector(0.3 * offset, 0, 0), 0.15, 0.1)
	character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(target)
	character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(target)
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(target, 'damaged')

function local_class:player_punch_scene()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local player_training_dummy = self.get_player_training_dummy()

	self.current_player_punch = nil

	while self.is_playing_mini_game do
		while not self.current_player_punch and self.is_playing_mini_game do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		if not self.is_playing_mini_game then
			return
		end

		self.current_player_punch(self, leader, player_training_dummy, true)

		self.current_player_punch = nil
	end
end

function local_class:rival_punch_scene()
	local rival = self.get_rival()
	local rival_training_dummy = self.get_rival_training_dummy()

	self.start_rival_punch = false

	-- 펀치 연출
	local punch_scene = {
		self.mini_game_pattern_success,
		self.mini_game_pattern_fail
	}

	-- 라이벌 성공, 실패 패턴 (1 = 성공, 2 = 실패)
	local rival_pattern = {
		1, 1, 1, 1, 1,
		2, 1, 1, 1, 1,
		1, 1, 1, 2, 1,
		2
	}

	for i = 1, #rival_pattern do
		while not self.start_rival_punch and self.is_playing_mini_game do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		if not self.is_playing_mini_game then
			return
		end

		punch_scene[rival_pattern[i]](self, rival, rival_training_dummy, false, function()
			scene_util.set_anim_non_loop(rival, 'hammer')
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_enhance_hammer_01')

	end

--- 더미 반응 연출
function local_class:hit_reaction_dummy(training_dummy, angle, duration)
	local rotate_dummy = function(start_rot_z, end_rot_z, rot_duration)
		local time_passed = 0

		while time_passed < rot_duration do
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

			local cur_rot_z = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(start_rot_z, end_rot_z, time_passed / rot_duration)
			training_dummy.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 0, cur_rot_z)

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		training_dummy.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 0, end_rot_z)
	end

	for i = 1, #angle do
		local start_angle = training_dummy.transform.localRotation.z
		if i > 1 then
			start_angle = angle[i - 1]
		end

		rotate_dummy(start_angle, angle[i], duration[i])
	end
end

local local_class = newclass('QueenShipHorseRacingSection7')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = QueenShipHorseRacing @
		Comment = QueenShipHorseRacing 퀘스트/이벤트 섹션 @
		Index = 6 @
		NextSections = 7 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	-- npc
	self.get_oni_girl = function()
		return get_character('runner_3')
	end

	-- 마커
	self.get_racing_pos = function()
		return field_util.get_marker_pos('s7_racing_pos')
	end

	-- 기믹
	self.get_sneakers_wall = function()
		return get_field_object('s7_sneakers_wall')
	end

	self.available_stage_name = 'queenship_substage_farm'

	self.section_state = {
		none = 1,
		start_racing = 2,
		end_racing = 3,
		talk_with_oni_girl = 4
	}

	self.current_section_state = self.section_state.none

	self.timeline_select_no = 'select_no'

	self.winner = nil

	self.is_drop_sneakers = false

	self.oni_girl_win_count = 0

	self.quest_marker_name = 'horse_racing_s7'
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.PreloadActivityClear()

	timeline_util.load_playable(
		'qs_horse_racing_s7_1',
		'qs_horse_racing_s7_2',
		'qs_horse_racing_s7_3',
		'qs_horse_racing_s7_4'
	)
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), 'on_damage_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')

	timeline_table.register_action(self.timeline_select_no, self.retry_setting, self)

	self:setting()

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	timeline_table.unregister_action(self.timeline_select_no)

	local oni_girl = self.get_oni_girl()
	character_util.remove_relate_event(oni_girl, self.controller)

	if self.sneakers_item then
		self.sneakers_item:ConsumeComplete()
		self.sneakers_item = nil
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--- OnEvent
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.none and
		type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.get_oni_girl()) then

		self.current_section_state = self.current_section_state + 1

		start_coroutine(self.talk_with_oni_girl, self)
		return true
	end

	if self.current_section_state >= self.section_state.start_racing and
		type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.get_oni_girl()) then

		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.talk_with_oni_girl

		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.end_racing, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

--- ZoneEnterEvent
function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.start_racing and
		type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 's7_racing_goal') then

		self.current_section_state = self.current_section_state + 1

		if not self.winner then
			music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_inn', state = 'event' })
			CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowActivityClear()
			self.winner = user_party.Leader
		end

		return true
	end

	return false
end

--- DamageEvent
function local_class:on_damage_event(e)
	if not self.is_drop_sneakers and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, self.get_sneakers_wall()) and
		e.Info.type == CS.Oak.DamageType.Trap | CS.Oak.DamageType.Explosion | CS.Oak.DamageType.AffectGimmick then

		self.is_drop_sneakers = true

		start_coroutine(self.drop_sneakers, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

--- InteractEvent
function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.get_sneakers_wall()) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(function()
			local sneakers_wall = self.get_sneakers_wall()
			sneakers_wall.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
			self.get_sneakers_wall().Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

			if self.sneakers_item then
				self.sneakers_item:ConsumeComplete()
				self.sneakers_item = nil
			end

			screen_util.item_get_event('qs_pegasus_sneakers', 'qs_horse_racing_s7_24',
				'qs_horse_racing_s7_25', 'qs_horse_racing_s7_26')

			self.controller:set_slow_run_speed(false)
		end)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

--- StageEndEvent
function local_class:on_stage_end_event(_)
	return true
end

--- 라나와 대화

	wp_util.move_async(princess, princess.Position + vector(13, 0, 0),
		6, nil, { run = true, last_dir = 'down' })

	princess.Position = self.get_princess_pos(3) + vector(3, 0, 0)

	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

	start_coroutine(self.hide_princess, self)

--- 공주 근처로 가면 공주가 숨는 로직
function local_class:hide_princess()
	local leader = user_party.Leader
	local princess = self.get_princess()
	local sfx_on = true
	local dist = 3.2

	local start_pos = princess.Position
	local end_pos = princess.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0)

	while not self.stop_hide do
		if leader.Position.x < end_pos.x + dist and leader.Position.x > end_pos.x - dist and
				leader.Position.z < end_pos.z + dist and leader.Position.z > end_pos.z - dist then

			if sfx_on then
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_dash_04')
				sfx_on = false
			end

			local sqr_dist = vector_util.sqr_distance(leader.Position, end_pos)
			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(1 - sqr_dist / (dist * dist))

			local cur_x = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(start_pos.x, end_pos.x, progress)
			princess.Position = vector_util.get_0yz(princess.Position, cur_x)
		else
			if not sfx_on then
				sfx_on = true
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

	music_player_util.set_stage_music_clip_async({ name = 'ondemand/v2_49_queenship/audio:bgm_queenship_main', state = 'field' })

	self.controller:change_leader(self.get_knight())
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	timeline_util.play_async('qs_horse_racing_s8', 'qs_horse_racing_s8_2')

	local princess = self.get_princess()

	local waypoint = {
		princess.Position + vector(0, 0, 1.5),
		princess.Position + vector(-4, 0, 1.5),
		princess.Position + vector(-4, 0, 0)
	}

	local waypoint_cb = function(waypoint_index)
		if waypoint_index + 1 == #waypoint then
			character_util.set_direction(princess, 'right')
			scene_util.set_anim_loop(princess, 'eat')
			self.princess_eat_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx(
					{ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01',loop = true, parent = princess })

			princess.OverrideCrashBehaviour = nil

			-- 모두가 깜짝 놀랄 선물을 준비할게!
			self.get_princess().Interactable.Talk = 'qs_horse_racing_s8_49'
		end
	end

	wp_util.move(princess, waypoint, 4, nil, { callback = waypoint_cb })

	princess.OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

	local parent_npc = get_character('qs_horse_npc_1_1')
	music_player_util.play_sfx(
		{ sfx_name = '01_dash_01', parent = parent_npc, loop = true,
		  type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, { self.activate_sack_interactable_event_name }))
end

	field_ui_manager:Hide()

	character_util.hide_weapon(get_party_leader(), true)

	timeline_util.play_async('qs_horse_racing_s8', 'qs_horse_racing_s8_3')

	quest_util.progress_section(self.controller)

	CS.Oak.TeleportPartyStageLogic.Execute(self.stage_exit_name, 'queenship_substage_racetrack', nil, true)
end

	for i = 1, self.race_runner_num do
		if i == 4 then
			table.insert(self.race_runners, get_party_leader())
		else
			table.insert(self.race_runners, get_character(self.race_runner_name..i))
		end
	end

	-- 카메라를 Perspective로 사용하는 장면이 있어서 전체 Shear를 꺼버림.
	self.shear_prop_id = CS.UnityEngine.Shader.PropertyToID('_Shear')
	self.shear_value = 0.025
	CS.UnityEngine.Shader.SetGlobalFloat(self.shear_prop_id, 0)

	-- 카메라나 Spine이 회전하면서 찌그러지지 않게끔 하기 위해 Shader 변경
	local shader_list = self.shader_container:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.ShaderContainer)).ShaderList
	local shader = shader_list[0]
	self.origin_spine_controller_shader = self.race_runners[1].SpineController.CustomShader

	for i = 1, #self.race_runners do
		self.race_runners[i].SpineController.CustomShader = shader
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	start_coroutine(self.opening, self)
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))

	self.stop_crash_wall = true

	if self.smoke_effect then
		self.smoke_effect:Dispose()
		self.smoke_effect = nil
	end

	if self.shader_container then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.shader_container)
		self.shader_container = nil
	end

	if self.typing_text_obj then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.typing_text_obj)
		self.typing_text_obj = nil
		self.typing_text = nil
	end

	if self.res_holder then
		self.res_holder:Dispose()
		self.res_holder = nil
	end

	if self.powerup_effect then
		self.powerup_effect:Dispose()
		self.powerup_effect = nil
	end

	if self.origin_spine_controller_shader then
		for i = 1, #self.race_runners do
			self.race_runners[i].SpineController.CustomShader = self.origin_spine_controller_shader
		end

		self.origin_spine_controller_shader = nil
	end

	if self.clap_sfx then
		self.clap_sfx:FadeOut()
		self.clap_sfx = nil
	end

	self.race_runners = nil
	self.runner_corners = nil
	self.corner_exceptions = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--- OnEvent
function local_class:on_event(_)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_touch_event(e)
	if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.TouchDown then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_switch_button_01')

		self.last_qte_num = self.last_qte_num + 1

		if self.last_qte_num == 10 then
			self.last_qte_complete = true
		end

		return true
	end

	return false
end

--- 섹션 오프닝
function local_class:opening()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()

	screen_util.fade_in_async(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	local leader = user_party.Leader
	character_util.hide_weapon(leader, true)
	leader.Position = field_util.get_marker_pos('horse_racing_9_start')
	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'left')

	for part = 1, 2 do
		for index = 1, 7 do
			local audience = self.get_audience(part, index)
			scene_util.set_emotion_loop(audience, 'attack')
		end
	end

	self.controller:audience_setting(self.bottom_optimized_npcs, 'bottom')
	self.controller:audience_setting(self.top_optimized_npcs, 'top', 6, 12)

	--배틀게이트 닫힘
	for i = 1, self.battlegate_num do
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateCloseEvent.Create(self.battlegate_name..i, false))
	end

	timeline_util.play_async('qs_horse_racing_s9', 'qs_horse_racing_s9_1')

	start_coroutine(function()
		wait_for_sec(5)

		self.clap_sfx =  music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_crowd_clap_01', loop = true })
	end)

	-- 경주
	start_coroutine(self.start_racing, self)

	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
end

--- 레이스 시작
function local_class:start_racing()
	-- 경마 설정
	self:race_setting()

	-- 경마 시작
	local race_result = self:race()

	wait_for_sec(1)

	if race_result then
		self:win_race()
	else
		self:lose_race()
	end
end

--region Race
function local_class:race_setting()
	-- 레이스 처리 종료 플래그
	self.is_race = true

	-- 플레이어 레이스에 참가 (enter 시점에서는 실제 파티 리더라서 재설정함)
	self.race_runners[4] = get_party_leader()
end

function local_class:race()
	start_coroutine(self.race_announce, self)

	-- 러너 달리기까지 대기
	wait_for_sec(2)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_gimmick_door_down_03')

	--배틀게이트 열림
	for i = 1, self.battlegate_num do
		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.BattleGateOpenEvent.Create(self.battlegate_name .. i, false))
		field_object_util.set_active_state(get_field_object(self.battlegate_name .. i), active_state_type.visible)
	end

	-- 러너 달리기까지 대기
	wait_for_sec(2)

	start_coroutine(self.race_camera_move, self)

	-- 애니메이션과 스모크 처리
	for i = 1, #self.race_runners do
		character_util.set_anim(self.race_runners[i], { name = 'run' })
		character_util.set_emotion(self.race_runners[i], { name = 'attack' })

		stage.SmokeManager:SetCharacterSmoke(self.race_runners[i])

		table.insert(self.runner_corners, 1)
	end

	start_coroutine(self.race_runner_1, self)
	start_coroutine(self.race_runner_2, self)
	start_coroutine(self.race_runner_3, self)
	start_coroutine(self.race_runner_player, self)
	start_coroutine(self.race_runner_5, self)
	start_coroutine(self.race_runner_6, self)

	while self.is_race do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	local speeds = { 2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2 }
	local poses = { vector(-9, 0, 76.3), vector(-10.2, 0, 75.7),
	                vector(-10, 0, 73.7), vector(-10.8, 0, 74.8),
	                vector(-12, 0, 76.1), vector(-13.2, 0, 74.2) }

	if self.last_qte_complete then
		-- 승리 처리
		for i = 1, #self.race_runners do
			character_util.set_position(self.race_runners[i], poses[i])

			if i ~= 4 then
				character_util.set_emotion(self.race_runners[i], { name = 'tired' })
			else
				character_util.set_emotion(self.race_runners[i], { name = 'smile' })
			end

			character_util.set_anim(self.race_runners[i], { name = 'walk' })

			local waypoint_list = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)
			waypoint_list:Add(self.race_runners[i].Position + vector(-8, 0, 0))

			character_util.move_waypoint(self.race_runners[i], waypoint_list, speeds[i],
					false, 'stop', 'floor', 'left')
		end

		wait_for_sec(1)

		character_util.set_anim(self.race_runners[4], { name = 'hold_loop', upper = true, scale = 0.7 })
	else
		-- 패배 처리
		poses = { vector(-9, 0, 76.3), vector(-10.2, 0, 75.7),
		          vector(-10.8, 0, 74.8), vector(-10, 0, 73.7),
		          vector(-12, 0, 76.1), vector(-13.2, 0, 74.2) }

		for i = 1, #self.race_runners do
			character_util.set_position(self.race_runners[i], poses[i])

			if i ~= 3 then
				character_util.set_emotion(self.race_runners[i], { name = 'tired' })
			else
				character_util.set_emotion(self.race_runners[i], { name = 'smile' })
			end

			character_util.set_anim(self.race_runners[i], { name = 'walk' })

			local waypoint_list = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)
			waypoint_list:Add(self.race_runners[i].Position + vector(-8, 0, 0))

			character_util.move_waypoint(self.race_runners[i], waypoint_list, speeds[i],
					false, 'stop', 'floor', 'left')
		end

		wait_for_sec(1)

		character_util.set_anim(self.race_runners[3], { name = 'hold_loop', upper = true, scale = 0.7 })
	end

	wait_for_sec(2)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('event', 0.5, 1)

	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(1, 'linear')

	for i = 1, #self.race_runners do
		self.race_runners[i].SpineController.AlwaysUpdateSpine = false

		character_util.remove_anim(self.race_runners[i])
		character_util.remove_anim(self.race_runners[i], true)
		character_util.remove_emotion(self.race_runners[i])
	end

	return self.last_qte_complete
end

--region Camera
function local_class:race_camera_move()
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_qte_action_wind_02')

	-- QTE 1
	local qte_complete = qte_util.tap(1, 0.2, 0.1, false)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_crowd_clap_03')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_npc_runaway_02')

	if qte_complete then
		self.qte_check[self.player_qte_index] = self.qte_state.success
		self.qte_complete_num = self.qte_complete_num + 1

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fade_out_03')

		character_util.set_emotion(self.race_runners[4], { name = 'burning' })
	else
		self.qte_check[self.player_qte_index] = self.qte_state.fail

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_hit_npc_01')

		character_util.set_emotion(self.race_runners[4], { name = 'damaged' })
		character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(self.race_runners[4])
		character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(self.race_runners[4])
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_pvp_start_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_crowd_arena_exclamation_02')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_npc_runaway_02')

	local end_pos = vector(-27, 0, 76)

	local pos_param = {}
	self:add_camera_param(pos_param, 0, end_pos, 4.5)

	local size_param = {}
	self:add_camera_param(size_param, 2, 4, 3)

	local angle_param = {}

	local shake_param = {}
	self:add_camera_param(shake_param, 0, 0.2, 0.3)
	self:add_camera_param(shake_param, 0, 0.01, 4.2)

	local callback_param = {}
	self:add_camera_param(callback_param, 2, function()
		-- QTE 1 스피드 원상복구
		self.player_qte_index = self.player_qte_index + 1

		character_util.set_emotion(self.race_runners[4], { name = 'attack' })
	end)

	self:camera_move_by_param({ pos = pos_param, duration = 4.5, size = size_param,
	                            angle = angle_param, shake = shake_param, callback = callback_param })

	local start_pos = end_pos
	end_pos = vector(-28, 0, 88)

	camera_util.move_async(start_pos, 0)

	pos_param = {}
	self:add_camera_param(pos_param, 0, end_pos, 2)
	self:add_camera_param(pos_param, 0, end_pos + vector(7, 0, 0), 1.2)

	shake_param = {}
	self:add_camera_param(shake_param, 0, 0.01, 3.2)

	callback_param = {}

	self:camera_move_by_param({ pos = pos_param, duration = 3.2, size = size_param,
	                            angle = angle_param, shake = shake_param, callback = callback_param })

	-- 1바퀴 2->3코너 보완
	local set_runner_pos_param = { vector(-20.55, 0, 88.7), vector(-21.72, 0, 87.6),
	                               vector(-22.23, 0, 88.4), vector(-23.2, 0, 87.2),
	                               vector(-25.1, 0, 86.9), vector(-23.9, 0, 89.2) }
	self:set_runner_position(set_runner_pos_param)

	local set_runner_corner_param = { 3, 3, 3, 3, 3, 3 }
	self:set_runner_corner_info(set_runner_corner_param)

	self:perspective_camera_on_character(self.race_runners[4], 'side', 1,
			{ start = self.constants.perspective_camera.perspective_camera_side_fov_min,
			  target = self.constants.perspective_camera.perspective_camera_side_fov_min + 20,
			  duration = 2 },
			{ start = vector(-10, 0, 0), target = vector(-10, 0, 0), duration = 0 },
			{}, 2, 1.5)

	start_pos = self.race_runners[4].Position

	camera_util.move_async(start_pos, 0)
	camera_util.resize_to(5, 0)

	end_pos = vector(18, 0, self.race_runners[4].Position.z)
	local cur_duration = math.abs(end_pos.x - start_pos.x) / 6

	pos_param = {}
	self:add_camera_param(pos_param, 0, end_pos, cur_duration)

	size_param = {}
	self:add_camera_param(size_param, 0, 3.5, cur_duration)

	angle_param = {}
	self:add_camera_param(angle_param, 0.5, vector(50, -5, 0), cur_duration / 2)

	shake_param = {}
	self:add_camera_param(shake_param, 0, 0.01, cur_duration)

	self:camera_move_by_param({ pos = pos_param, duration = cur_duration, size = size_param,
	                            angle = angle_param, shake = shake_param, callback = callback_param })

	-- 1바퀴 3코너 보완
	set_runner_pos_param = { vector(20.9, 0, 88.7), vector(19.8, 0, 87.6),
	                               vector(19.6, 0, 88.4), vector(18.3, 0, 87.2),
	                               vector(16.4, 0, 86.9), vector(17.6, 0, 89.2) }
	self:set_runner_position(set_runner_pos_param)

	set_runner_corner_param = { 3, 3, 3, 3, 3, 3 }
	self:set_runner_corner_info(set_runner_corner_param)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_npc_runaway_02')

	-- 방향 알아서 맞춤
	start_coroutine(self.set_runner_direction_by_frame, self, 'left', 6)

	self:perspective_camera_on_field(vector(31.5, 0.8, 87.5), vector(0, 270, 0),
			1.7,
			{
				start = vector(31.5, 0.8, 87.5),
				target = vector(31.5, 0.8, 75.5),
				duration = 2 },
			{},
			{ start = vector(0, -90, 0), target = vector(0, -90, 0), duration = 0 },
			{}, 2, 2.3)

	-- 2바퀴 1코너 보완
	set_runner_pos_param = { vector(13.0, 0, 76.7), vector(13.4, 0, 74.2),
	                         vector(11.5, 0, 76.4), vector(14.4, 0, 75.8),
	                         vector(15.1, 0, 75.1), vector(14.8, 0, 76.2) }
	self:set_runner_position(set_runner_pos_param)

	set_runner_corner_param = { 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1 }
	self:set_runner_corner_info(set_runner_corner_param)

	self:reset_runner_dir()

	-- 한 프레임 차이로 Perspective 카메라 변경 후에 direction이 돌아가지 않는 문제가 있어서 처리
	start_coroutine(function()
		coroutine.yield(nil)

		local timer = 0
		local duration = 0.5

		while timer < duration do
			timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

			for i = 1, #self.race_runners do
				character_util.set_direction(self.race_runners[i], 'down')
			end

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end)

	callback_param = {}
	self:add_camera_param(callback_param, 0, function()
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_qte_action_wind_02')

		-- QTE 2
		qte_complete = qte_util.swipe('right', 0.2, 0.1, false)

		if qte_complete then
			self.qte_check[self.player_qte_index] = self.qte_state.success
			self.qte_complete_num = self.qte_complete_num + 1

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_aircraft_10')

			character_util.set_emotion(self.race_runners[4], { name = 'smile' })
		else
			self.qte_check[self.player_qte_index] = self.qte_state.fail

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_big_01')

			character_util.set_emotion(self.race_runners[4], { name = 'damaged' })
			character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(self.race_runners[4])
			character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(self.race_runners[4])
		end
	end)

	self:add_camera_param(callback_param, 0.5, function()
		-- QTE 2 실패 시 스피드 원상복구
		if self.qte_check[self.player_qte_index] == self.qte_state.fail then
			self.player_qte_index = self.player_qte_index + 1

			character_util.set_emotion(self.race_runners[4], { name = 'attack' })
		end
	end)

	self:add_camera_param(callback_param, 1, function()
		-- QTE 2 성공 시 스피드 원상복구
		if self.qte_check[self.player_qte_index] == self.qte_state.success then
			self.player_qte_index = self.player_qte_index + 1

			character_util.set_emotion(self.race_runners[4], { name = 'attack' })
		end
	end)

	self:perspective_camera_on_character(self.race_runners[4], 'front', 1,
			{ start = self.constants.perspective_camera.perspective_camera_front_fov_min + 10,
			  target = self.constants.perspective_camera.perspective_camera_front_fov_min + 20,
			  duration = 3 },
			{ start = vector(0, 90, 0), target = vector(0, 90, 0), duration = 0 },
			callback_param, 3, 1)

--region runner Player
function local_class:race_runner_player()
	local runner = self.race_runners[4]
	local runner_num = 4

	local speed = 6
	local qte_speeds = { { 6, 6, 5.8 }, { 6, 6, 5.8 }, { 5.97, 6, 5.8 }, { 6.15, 6, 5.8 }, { 6, 6, 5 } }
	local qte_add_poses = {
		{ unity_class.vector3.zero, unity_class.vector3.zero, unity_class.vector3.zero },
		{ unity_class.vector3.zero, vector(0, 0, -0.1), vector(0, 0, -0.3) },
		{ unity_class.vector3.zero, unity_class.vector3.zero, unity_class.vector3.zero },
		{ unity_class.vector3.zero, unity_class.vector3.zero, unity_class.vector3.zero },
		{ unity_class.vector3.zero, unity_class.vector3.zero, unity_class.vector3.zero }
	}

	-- 직접 처리
	for i = 1, self.constants.race.track_num do
		for j = 1, self.constants.race.corner_num do
			local current_marker_name = self.constants.marker.runner_marker_name_first
					..i..self.constants.marker.runner_marker_name_mid..j..
					self.constants.marker.runner_marker_name_last..runner_num

			local start_pos = runner.Position

			local target_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos(current_marker_name)
			local target_dir = field_util.get_marker_dir(current_marker_name)

			-- 총 이동 거리
			local added_dist = 0
			local fixed_dist = (target_pos - start_pos).magnitude

			while true do
				-- 강제 포지션 변경 시, 남은 거리 다시 계산
				if self.position_exceptions[runner_num] then
					self.position_exceptions[runner_num] = false

					added_dist = 0
					fixed_dist = (target_pos - runner.Position).magnitude
				end

				-- QTE 체크
				local speed_table = qte_speeds[self.player_qte_index]
				speed = speed_table[self.qte_check[self.player_qte_index]]

				local add_pos_table = qte_add_poses[self.player_qte_index]
				local add_pos = add_pos_table[self.qte_check[self.player_qte_index]]

				local cur_move = ((target_pos - start_pos).normalized + add_pos) * speed * unity_class.time.deltaTime
				local cur_dist = cur_move.magnitude
				added_dist = added_dist + cur_dist

				if added_dist < fixed_dist then
					runner.Position = runner.Position + cur_move
				else
					-- 총 이동 거리가 정해진 이동 거리 넘어가면 목적지에 도달한 것이므로 target_pos로 고정
					runner.Position = target_pos

					break
				end

				stage.SmokeManager:SetDefaultSmokeOnce(runner.Position)

				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end

			if j < self.constants.race.corner_num then
				self.runner_corners[runner_num] = j + 1
			else
				self.runner_corners[runner_num] = 1
			end

			character_util.set_direction(runner, target_dir)
		end
	end

	-- 마지막 스퍼트
	self.runner_corners[runner_num] = 1
	character_util.set_direction(runner, 'left')

	start_pos = runner.Position
	target_pos = vector(-10, 0, runner.Position.z)

	added_dist = 0
	fixed_dist = (target_pos - start_pos).magnitude

	while true do
		local qte_add_speed

		if self.last_qte_num > 10 then
			qte_add_speed = 1.2
		else
			qte_add_speed = self.last_qte_num / 10 * 1.2
		end

		local cur_move = (target_pos - start_pos).normalized *
				(speed + qte_add_speed) * unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local cur_dist = cur_move.magnitude
		added_dist = added_dist + cur_dist

		if added_dist < fixed_dist then
			runner.Position = runner.Position + cur_move
		else
			-- 총 이동 거리가 정해진 이동 거리 넘어가면 목적지에 도달한 것이므로 target_pos로 고정
			runner.Position = target_pos

			break
		end

		stage.SmokeManager:SetDefaultSmokeOnce(runner.Position)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end
--endregion

--region Race Runner
-- 러너 달리기 공통 처리
function local_class:race_runner(runner, runner_num, speed_parameter)
	for i = 1, self.constants.race.track_num do
		for j = 1, self.constants.race.corner_num do
			local current_marker_name = self.constants.marker.runner_marker_name_first
					..i..self.constants.marker.runner_marker_name_mid..j..
					self.constants.marker.runner_marker_name_last..runner_num

			local current_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos(current_marker_name)
			local current_dir = field_util.get_marker_dir(current_marker_name)

			local current_speed_table = speed_parameter[i]
			local current_speed = current_speed_table[j]

			local move_param = {}
			self:add_runner_move_param(move_param, runner, current_pos, current_speed, current_speed,
					0, screen_util.get_interpolations('linear'))

			local callback_param = {}

			self:runner_move_by_param({ move = move_param, callback = callback_param }, runner_num)

			-- 외부 입력 corner 값과 기존 값이 달려서 exception 발생한 경우 예외처리
			if self.runner_corners[runner_num] ~= j then
				j = self.runner_corners[runner_num]
			else
				if j < self.constants.race.corner_num then
					self.runner_corners[runner_num] = j + 1
				else
					self.runner_corners[runner_num] = 1
				end
			end

			character_util.set_direction(runner, current_dir)
		end
	end

	self.runner_corners[runner_num] = 1
	character_util.set_direction(runner, 'left')

	local current_speed_table = speed_parameter[4]
	local current_speed = current_speed_table[1]

	local move_param = {}
	self:add_runner_move_param(move_param, runner, vector(-10, 0, runner.Position.z), current_speed,
			screen_util.get_interpolations('linear'))

	local callback_param = {}

	self:runner_move_by_param({ move = move_param, callback = callback_param }, runner_num)
end

-- 러너 이동 파라미터 생성 후 추가
function local_class:add_runner_move_param(
		params, runner, target_pos, speed, interpolations)
	local runner_val = lua_helper.get_or_default(runner, nil)
	local target_pos_val = lua_helper.get_or_default(target_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
	local speed_val = lua_helper.get_or_default(speed, 0)
	local interpolations_val = lua_helper.get_or_default(interpolations, interpolations_constants.linear)

	table.insert(params, { runner = runner_val, target_pos = target_pos_val, speed = speed_val,
	                       interpolations = interpolations_val })
end

-- 러너 기타 파라미터 생성 후 추가
function local_class:add_runner_other_param(params, delay, value, duration)
	local delay_val = lua_helper.get_or_default(delay, 0)
	local value_val = lua_helper.get_or_default(value, nil)
	local duration_val = lua_helper.get_or_default(duration, 0)

	table.insert(params, { delay = delay_val, value = value_val, duration = duration_val })
end

-- 파라미터 받아서 러너 이동
function local_class:runner_move_by_param(data, runner_num)
	-- 이동
	local move = lua_helper.get_value(data, "move", nil)

	-- 콜백
	local callback = lua_helper.get_value(data, "callback", nil)

	if callback ~= nil then
		start_coroutine(self.control_runner_callback, self, callback)
	end

	if move ~= nil then
		self:control_runner_move(move, runner_num)
	end
end

-- 러너 이동
function local_class:control_runner_move(move, runner_num)
	for i = 1, #move do
		local runner = lua_helper.get_value(move[i], "runner", nil)
		local target_pos = lua_helper.get_value(move[i], "target_pos", unity_class.vector3.zero)
		local speed = lua_helper.get_value(move[i], "speed", 0)

		local start_pos = runner.Position

		-- 총 이동 거리
		local added_dist = 0
		local fixed_dist = (target_pos - start_pos).magnitude

		while true do
			-- 강제 포지션 변경 시, 남은 거리 다시 계산
			if self.position_exceptions[runner_num] then
				self.position_exceptions[runner_num] = false

				added_dist = 0
				fixed_dist = (target_pos - runner.Position).magnitude
			end

			-- 코너 변경 예외처리, 반복문 중단시킴
			if #self.corner_exceptions >= runner_num and self.corner_exceptions[runner_num] ~= -1 then
				self.runner_corners[runner_num] = self.corner_exceptions[runner_num]
				self.corner_exceptions[runner_num] = -1

				break
			end

			local cur_speed = speed

			-- 라나 부스트 예외처리
			if runner_num == 3 then
				if self.lana_boost then
					cur_speed = 8
				end
			end

			local cur_move = (target_pos - start_pos).normalized * cur_speed * unity_class.time.deltaTime
			local cur_dist = cur_move.magnitude
			added_dist = added_dist + cur_dist

			if added_dist < fixed_dist then
				runner.Position = runner.Position + cur_move
			else
				-- 총 이동 거리가 정해진 이동 거리 넘어가면 목적지에 도달한 것이므로 target_pos로 고정
				runner.Position = target_pos

				break
			end

			-- 스모크 설치
			stage.SmokeManager:SetDefaultSmokeOnce(runner.Position)

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		if not self.lana_boost then
			runner.Position = target_pos
		end
	end
end

-- 러너 콜백
function local_class:control_runner_callback(callback)
	for i = 1, #callback do
		local delay = lua_helper.get_value(callback[i], "delay", 0)
		local value = lua_helper.get_value(callback[i], "value", nil)

		wait_for_sec(delay)

		if value ~= nil then
			value()
		end
	end
end

-- 러너 방향 복구
function local_class:reset_runner_dir()
	for i = 1, #self.race_runners do
		if self.runner_corners[i] == 1 then
			character_util.set_direction(self.race_runners[i], 'left')
		elseif self.runner_corners[i] == 2 then
			character_util.set_direction(self.race_runners[i], 'up')
		elseif self.runner_corners[i] == 3 then
			character_util.set_direction(self.race_runners[i], 'right')
		else
			character_util.set_direction(self.race_runners[i], 'down')
		end
	end
end

-- 코드를 개떡같이 만들어서 카메라 리셋될 때마다 러너들 위치 적당히 잘 나오는 곳으로 설정해 주는 보완 작업
function local_class:set_runner_position(poses)
	self.position_exceptions = {}

	for i = 1, #poses do
		self.race_runners[i].Position = poses[i]

		table.insert(self.position_exceptions, true)
	end
end

-- 코너 값을 설정해주는 보완 작업 2
function local_class:set_runner_corner_info(corners)
	self.corner_exceptions = {}

	for i = 1, #self.runner_corners do
		if i ~= 4 then
			if corners[i] == self.runner_corners[i] then
				table.insert(self.corner_exceptions, -1)
			else
				-- 입력된 코너 값과 실제 값이 다를 경우 flag를 설정해서 반복문을 탈출시킴
				table.insert(self.corner_exceptions, corners[i])
			end
		end
	end
end

	local angle = lua_helper.get_value(data, "angle", nil)

		local value = lua_helper.get_value(size[i], "value", 0)

-- 카메라 회전 처리
function local_class:control_camera_angle(angle)
	for i = 1, #angle do
		local delay = lua_helper.get_value(angle[i], "delay", 0)
		local value = lua_helper.get_value(
				angle[i], "value", stage_camera.Transform.parent.localRotation.eulerAngles)
		local duration = lua_helper.get_value(angle[i], "duration", 0)

		wait_for_sec(delay)

		local timer = 0
		local start_value = stage_camera.Transform.parent.localRotation.eulerAngles

		while timer < duration do
			timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

			local cur_value = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_value, value, timer / duration)
			stage_camera.Transform.parent.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(cur_value)

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end
end

-- 캐릭터에 perspective camera를 붙이고 따라감
function local_class:perspective_camera_on_character(
		runner, direction, start_delay, sizes, angles, callbacks, duration, end_delay, custom_pos)
	local custom_pos_val = lua_helper.get_or_default(custom_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)

	-- 생성
	local instantiate_pos = runner.Position

	if direction == self.constants.perspective_camera.perspective_camera_front then
		instantiate_pos = instantiate_pos + direction_util.to_vector3(runner.Direction) +
				vector(0, self.constants.perspective_camera.perspective_camera_front_y, 0) + custom_pos_val

		-- 정면이면 러너들 전부 앞 보도록 수정
		for i = 1, #self.race_runners do
			character_util.set_direction(self.race_runners[i], 'down')
		end
	elseif direction == self.constants.perspective_camera.perspective_camera_side then
		instantiate_pos = instantiate_pos + vector(
				0, self.constants.perspective_camera.perspective_camera_side_y,
				self.constants.perspective_camera.perspective_camera_side_minus_z)
	end

	local cur_camera_obj = self.get_camera_obj():Instantiate(
			instantiate_pos, unity_class.quaternion.identity, runner.Transform)

	-- 기본 설정
	local start_size = lua_helper.get_value(sizes, "start",
			self.constants.perspective_camera.perspective_camera_side_fov_min)
	local start_angle = lua_helper.get_value(angles, "start", unity_class.vector3.zero)

	local cur_camera = cur_camera_obj.transform:GetComponentInChildren(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Camera))
	cur_camera.backgroundColor = unity_color(self.constants.perspective_camera.solid_color)
	cur_camera.fieldOfView = start_size
	cur_camera_obj.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(start_angle)

	wait_for_sec(start_delay)

	self:perspective_camera(cur_camera_obj, nil, sizes, angles, callbacks, duration)

	wait_for_sec(end_delay)

	-- 정면이라 방향 변경을 한 경우, 러너의 현재 코너 상태에 맞춰 방향 설정
	if direction == self.constants.perspective_camera.perspective_camera_front then
		self:reset_runner_dir()
	end

	-- 연출 완료되면 카메라 오브젝트 파괴
	cur_camera_obj:Dispose()
end

-- 특정 위치에 perspective camera 생성
function local_class:perspective_camera_on_field(
		instantiate_pos, instantiate_rotation, start_delay, poses, sizes, angles, callbacks, duration, end_delay)
	-- 생성
	local cur_camera_obj = self.get_camera_obj():Instantiate(instantiate_pos)
	cur_camera_obj.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(instantiate_rotation)

	-- 기본 설정
	local start_size = lua_helper.get_value(sizes, "start",
			self.constants.perspective_camera.perspective_camera_side_fov_min)
	local start_angle = lua_helper.get_value(angles, "start", unity_class.vector3.zero)

	local cur_camera = cur_camera_obj.transform:GetComponentInChildren(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Camera))
	cur_camera.backgroundColor = unity_color(self.constants.perspective_camera.solid_color)
	cur_camera.fieldOfView = start_size
	cur_camera_obj.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(start_angle)

	wait_for_sec(start_delay)

	self:perspective_camera(cur_camera_obj, poses, sizes, angles, callbacks, duration)

	wait_for_sec(end_delay)

	-- 연출 완료되면 카메라 오브젝트 파괴
	cur_camera_obj:Dispose()
end

-- perspective 카메라 연출
function local_class:perspective_camera(cur_camera_obj, poses, sizes, angles, callbacks, duration)
	-- 파라미터 받아옴
	local cannot_move = true
	local start_pos
	local end_pos
	local pos_duration
	local pos_interpolations

	if poses ~= nil then
		cannot_move = false

		start_pos = cur_camera_obj.transform.localPosition
		end_pos = lua_helper.get_value(poses, "target", start_pos)
		pos_duration = lua_helper.get_value(poses, "duration", 0)
		pos_interpolations = lua_helper.get_value(poses, "interpolations", interpolations_constants.linear)
	end

	local start_size = lua_helper.get_value(sizes, "start",
			self.constants.perspective_camera.perspective_camera_side_fov_min)
	local end_size = lua_helper.get_value(sizes, "target",
			self.constants.perspective_camera.perspective_camera_side_fov_min)
	local size_duration = lua_helper.get_value(sizes, "duration", 0)
	local size_interpolations = lua_helper.get_value(sizes, "interpolations", interpolations_constants.linear)

	local start_angle = lua_helper.get_value(angles, "start", unity_class.vector3.zero)
	local end_angle = lua_helper.get_value(angles, "target", unity_class.vector3.zero)
	local angle_duration = lua_helper.get_value(angles, "duration", 0)
	local angle_interpolations = lua_helper.get_value(sizes, "interpolations", interpolations_constants.linear)

	local callback_delays = {}
	local callback_values = {}

	if callbacks ~= nil then
		for i = 1, #callbacks do
			table.insert(callback_delays, lua_helper.get_value(callbacks[i], "delay", 0))
			table.insert(callback_values, lua_helper.get_value(callbacks[i], "value", nil))
		end
	end

	local cur_camera = cur_camera_obj.transform:GetComponentInChildren(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Camera))
	local timer = 0

	local callback_timer = 0
	local callback_index = 1

	while timer < duration do
		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		callback_timer = callback_timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		-- Perspective 카메라 처리 중단
		if self.interrupt_perspective_camera then
			break
		end

		if not cannot_move then
			if timer < pos_duration then
				local cur_pos_x = pos_interpolations(timer, start_pos.x, end_pos.x - start_pos.x, pos_duration)
				local cur_pos_y = pos_interpolations(timer, start_pos.y, end_pos.y - start_pos.y, pos_duration)
				local cur_pos_z = pos_interpolations(timer, start_pos.z, end_pos.z - start_pos.z, pos_duration)

				cur_camera_obj.transform.localPosition = vector(cur_pos_x, cur_pos_y, cur_pos_z)
			else
				cur_camera_obj.transform.localPosition = end_pos
			end
		end

		if timer < size_duration then
			local cur_size = size_interpolations(timer, start_size, end_size - start_size, size_duration)
			cur_camera.fieldOfView = cur_size
		else
			cur_camera.fieldOfView = end_size
		end

		if timer < angle_duration then
			local cur_angle_x = angle_interpolations(timer, start_angle.x, end_angle.x - start_angle.x, angle_duration)
			local cur_angle_y = angle_interpolations(timer, start_angle.y, end_angle.y - start_angle.y, angle_duration)
			local cur_angle_z = angle_interpolations(timer, start_angle.z, end_angle.z - start_angle.z, angle_duration)

			cur_camera_obj.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(cur_angle_x, cur_angle_y, cur_angle_z)
		else
			cur_camera_obj.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(end_angle)
		end

		if callback_index <= #callbacks then
			if callback_timer >= callback_delays[callback_index] then
				callback_timer = 0

				local cur_callback = callback_values[callback_index]
				if (cur_callback ~= nil) then
					cur_callback()
				end

				callback_index = callback_index + 1
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.interrupt_perspective_camera = false
end
--endregion

--region Callback
-- 카메라 방향을 고려하여 매 프레임마다 러너의 현재 코너 상태를 받아서 방향을 정함
function local_class:set_runner_direction_by_frame(camera_dir, duration)
	local timer = 0

	while timer < duration do
		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		for i = 1, #self.race_runners do
			local dir = self.runner_corners[i]

			-- 수작업
			if camera_dir == 'left' then
				if dir == 1 then
					character_util.set_direction(self.race_runners[i], 'up')
				elseif dir == 2 then
					character_util.set_direction(self.race_runners[i], 'left')
				elseif dir == 3 then
					character_util.set_direction(self.race_runners[i], 'down')
				else
					character_util.set_direction(self.race_runners[i], 'right')
				end
			elseif camera_dir == 'right' then
				if dir == 1 then
					character_util.set_direction(self.race_runners[i], 'down')
				elseif dir == 2 then
					character_util.set_direction(self.race_runners[i], 'right')
				elseif dir == 3 then
					character_util.set_direction(self.race_runners[i], 'up')
				else
					character_util.set_direction(self.race_runners[i], 'left')
				end
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

-- 러너가 특정 코너 돌 때까지 대기 + Perspective Camera 종료 기능
function local_class:wait_for_runner_change_corner(runner_num, corner, interrupt_perspective_camera)
	while self.runner_corners[runner_num] == corner do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if interrupt_perspective_camera then
		self.interrupt_perspective_camera = true
	end
end

-- 마지막 스퍼트 QTE
function local_class:last_spurt_qte()
	local timescale = 0.25
	local duration = 1.5

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_touch_event')

	time_util.mod('qte_mod', timescale)

	screen_util.show_turbo_tap()

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_qte_action_wind_02')

	local time_passed = 0

	while time_passed < duration do
		coroutine.yield(nil)

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
	end

	self.last_qte_num = 0

	screen_util.close_tutorial_spine()

	time_util.unmod('qte_mod')

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))

	if self.last_qte_complete then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_coop_victory_01')
	else
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_coop_defeat_01')
	end
end

--- 레이스 이겼을 때
function local_class:win_race()
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	local runner_1 = self.get_runner(1)
	local runner_2 = self.get_runner(2)
	local oni_girl = self.get_runner(3)
	local runner_5 = self.get_runner(5)
	local runner_6 = self.get_runner(6)

	local trainer_1 = self.get_trainer(1)
	local trainer_2 = self.get_trainer(2)
	local trainer_3 = self.get_trainer(3)

	-- 단체 움직임 제어용
	local move_done_left = 0
	local move_done_cb = function(wp_count)
		return function(waypoint_index)
			if waypoint_index + 1 == wp_count then
				move_done_left = move_done_left - 1
			end
		end
	end

	local wait_move_done = function()
		while move_done_left > 0 do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end

	local runner_list = {
		runner_1,
		runner_2,
		runner_5,
		runner_6,
		oni_girl
	}

	local trainer_list = {
		trainer_1,
		trainer_2,
		trainer_3
	}

	-- 캐논 세팅
	for i = 1, 8 do
		local cannon = self.get_cannon(i)
		cannon.Position = cannon.Position + vector(59, 0, 0)
	end

	local npc_setting = function(target, pos, dir, emotion)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(target)
		target.Position = pos
		character_util.set_direction(target, dir)
		scene_util.set_emotion_loop(target, emotion)
	end

	-- 라나, 1, 2, 5, 6번 마, 가디언 (right, smile, idle)
	local ending_runner = field_util.get_marker_pos('s9_ending_runner')
	local setting_emotion = 'smile'
	local setting_dir = 'right'

	npc_setting(runner_1, ending_runner + vector(-2, 0, 1.25), setting_dir, setting_emotion)
	npc_setting(runner_2, ending_runner + vector(-1, 0, -0.5), setting_dir, setting_emotion)
	npc_setting(runner_5, ending_runner + vector(-2, 0, 0), setting_dir, setting_emotion)
	npc_setting(runner_6, ending_runner + vector(-2, 0, -1.25), setting_dir, setting_emotion)
	npc_setting(oni_girl, ending_runner + vector(-1, 0, 0.5), setting_dir, setting_emotion)
	npc_setting(leader, ending_runner + vector(0, 0, 0), 'right', setting_emotion)

	-- 메인 트레이너, 인베이더 트레이너 1, 2 (left, idle, idle)
	local ending_trainer = field_util.get_marker_pos('s9_ending_trainer')
	setting_emotion = 'idle'
	setting_dir = 'left'

	npc_setting(trainer_1, ending_trainer + vector(0, 0, 0), setting_dir, 'attack')
	npc_setting(trainer_2, ending_trainer + vector(1, 0, 0.5), setting_dir, setting_emotion)
	npc_setting(trainer_3, ending_trainer + vector(1, 0, -0.5), setting_dir, setting_emotion)

	for i = 1, #self.bottom_optimized_npcs do
		if i ~= 3 and i ~= 5 and i ~= 8 then
			scene_util.set_anim_loop(self.bottom_optimized_npcs[i], 'success')
		end
	end

	for i = 1, #self.top_optimized_npcs do
		scene_util.set_anim_loop(self.top_optimized_npcs[i], 'success')
	end

	-- 카메라 크기 원복
	camera_util.resize_to_default(0)
	camera_util.return_to_leader(0)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 위와 같이 설정하고 1초 대기 후 화면 1초간 페이드 인
	local loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_gatcha_drum_roll_01', loop = true })
	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(1, 'linear')

	-- Shout 말풍선 : 오늘의 우승자, 4번 {플레이어 이름}!!
	music_player_util.stop_sfx(loop_sfx)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_coop_mvp_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gatcha_spotlight_01')
	scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(leader, 'qs_horse_racing_s9_20', nil,
		{ screen_pos = vector(-50, 300) })

	-- 환호 소리와 함께 가디언 success 애니메이션으로 방방 뛰고 나머지 말들은 가디언 보고 박수 쳐줌
	local crowd_buzz_loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx(
		{ sfx_name = '01_crowd_buzz_01', loop = true, volume = 0.5, fade_in_time = 2 })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_crowd_shout_04')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(leader, 'success', { sfx_name = '01_player_jump_01' })

	for i = 1, #runner_list do
		local runner = runner_list[i]
		scene_util.set_anim_loop(runner, 'clap')
	end

	wait_for_sec(2)

	-- 화면 0.3 shake
	camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.3)

	-- Shout 말풍선 : 잠깐!!!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(leader, 'qs_horse_racing_s9_21', nil,
		{ screen_pos = vector(0, -300) })

	-- 말들, 트레이너들 전부 아래 보고 점프, 애니메이션과 이모션 해제
	for i = 1, #runner_list do
		local runner = runner_list[i]
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(runner)
		character_util.set_direction(runner, 'down')
		character_util.normal_jump(runner)
	end

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'down')
	character_util.normal_jump(leader, '01_small_jump_01')

	for i = 1, #trainer_list do
		local trainer = trainer_list[i]
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(trainer)
		character_util.set_direction(trainer, 'down')
		character_util.normal_jump(trainer)
	end

	-- 카메라 3초간 10칸 만큼 아래로 이동해서 관중석 보여줌
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(5, 3)
	camera_util.move_async(leader.Position + vector(0, 0, -9), 3)

	-- 관중 3 (up, attack, cast2) : 라이트닝 카운터가 지다니! 이건 말도 안 돼!!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(self.bottom_optimized_npcs[3], 'qs_horse_racing_s9_22')

	-- 관중 8 (up, attack, attack) : 전재산을 전부 걸었는데! 사기가 분명해!!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(self.bottom_optimized_npcs[8], 'qs_horse_racing_s9_23')

	-- 관중 5 (up, attack, release) : 너희들 전부 짜고 친 거지?
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(self.bottom_optimized_npcs[5], 'qs_horse_racing_s9_24')

	-- 화면 0.3 shake + Shout 말풍선 : 내 돈을 돌려줘!!
	camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.5)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_crowd_shout_07')
	scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(self.bottom_optimized_npcs[3], 'qs_horse_racing_s9_25', nil,
		{ screen_pos = vector(-50, -150) })

	self.controller:audience_setting(self.top_optimized_npcs, 'top')

	-- 관중들 화나서 sprite - banana, cactus, rock을 위 경기장 바닥에 던짐
	-- (스프라이트는 랜덤, 던지는 사람도 랜덤, 딜레이 0 ~ 0.3초, 쓰레기 떨어지는 공간 안에 랜덤 위치)
	-- 스프라이트 바닥에 도달하면 FX_dead 생성되며 사라짐
	-- 쓰레기 던지는 이벤트는 계속 루프
	start_coroutine(self.throw_item_routine, self)

	camera_util.shake(0.2, 999999)

	-- Shout 말풍선(화면 중앙으로부터 조금 아래) : 저 녀석들 잡아!!
	music_player_util.fade_out_sfx(crowd_buzz_loop_sfx, 1)
	local crowd_shout_loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_crowd_shout_01', loop = true, fade_in_time = 1 })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_crowd_shout_06')
	scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(self.bottom_optimized_npcs[3], 'qs_horse_racing_s9_26', nil,
		{ screen_pos = vector(0, 200) })

	-- 마지막 위치 오프셋
	local move_offset = { 4, 3, 3, 3.5, 4 }

	move_done_left = 5
	for i = 1, 5 do
		local npc = self.bottom_optimized_npcs[i]
		-- 관중석 앞의 끝 (점프할 곳)
		local stand_front_pos = vector_util.get_0yz(self.bottom_optimized_npcs[1].Position, npc.Position.x)
		local waypoint = {
			stand_front_pos,
			vector_util.get_x0z(stand_front_pos) + vector(0, 0, 2),
			vector_util.get_x0z(stand_front_pos) + vector(0, 0, 2 + move_offset[i])
		}

		-- 이동 콜백
		local done_cb = move_done_cb(#waypoint)
		local cb = function(waypoint_index)
			done_cb(waypoint_index)

			if waypoint_index + 1 == 1 then
				character_util.jump(npc, 1, 0.3)
			end

			if waypoint_index + 1 == #waypoint then
				scene_util.set_anim_loop(npc, 'success')
			end
		end

		character_util.remove_anim(npc)
		wp_util.move(npc, waypoint, 4, nil, { callback = cb })
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	camera_util.cancel_shake()
	camera_util.move_async(leader.Position + vector(1, 0, 0), 3)

	-- 전부 이동이 끝날 때까지 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	for i = 1, #trainer_list do
		local trainer = trainer_list[i]
		character_util.jump(trainer, 1, 0.5)
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_jump_01')

	-- 트레이너 리더 (down, attack, cast2) : 이게 어떻게 된 일이야!!
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(trainer_1, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(trainer_1, 'cast2')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(trainer_1, 'qs_horse_racing_s9_27')

	-- 트레이너 1 (down, tired, cast) : 관객들이 라이트닝 카운터의 패배를 받아들이지 못하는 것 같습니다…
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(trainer_2, 'tired')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(trainer_2, 'cast')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(trainer_2, 'qs_horse_racing_s9_28')

	-- 트레이너 2 (down, tired, bomb_idle) : 이대로 있다간 큰일이 날지도 모르…
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(trainer_3, 'tired')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(trainer_3, 'bomb_idle')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(trainer_3, 'qs_horse_racing_s9_29')

	-- 트레이너 1, 2 좌측 봄
	character_util.set_direction(trainer_2, 'left')
	character_util.set_direction(trainer_3, 'left')

	-- 트레이너 리더 (right, attack, release) : 빨리 따라와! 일이 더 커지기 전에 생물들부터 챙겨서 목장으로 떠나야겠어!
	character_util.set_direction(trainer_1, 'right')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(trainer_1, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_release_anim(trainer_1)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(trainer_1, 'qs_horse_racing_s9_30')

	-- 트레이너 리더와 1, 2 (left, attack, idle)
	character_util.remove_anim(leader)
	character_util.set_direction(trainer_1, 'left')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(trainer_2, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(trainer_3, 'attack')

	-- 단상 위의 말들과 가디언, 라나 (right, scared, cast)
	for i = 1, #runner_list do
		local runner = runner_list[i]
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(runner)
		character_util.set_direction(runner, 'right')
		scene_util.set_emotion_loop(runner, 'scared')
		scene_util.set_anim_loop(runner, 'cast')
	end

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'right')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(leader, 'scared')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(leader, 'cast')

	-- 트레이너 리더 (right, attack, cast2) : 이 녀석들 얌전히 있어!
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(trainer_1, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(trainer_1, 'cast2')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(trainer_1, 'qs_horse_racing_s9_31')

	-- 트레이너 리더, 1, 2 좌측으로 1칸 이동, 단상 위의 말들과 가디언, 라나 좌측으로 1칸 이동 (속도 1)
	local move_to = function(target)

		local cb = function(waypoint_index)
			if waypoint_index + 1 == 1 then
				character_util.reset_locked_dir(target)
			end
		end

		character_util.remove_anim(target)
		character_util.set_locked_dir(target, 'right')

		wp_util.move(target, target.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0),
			nil, 1, { last_direction = 'right', callback = cb })
	end

	for i = 1, #runner_list do
		move_to(runner_list[i])
	end

	move_to(leader)

	for i = 1, #trainer_list do
		local trainer = trainer_list[i]
		character_util.remove_anim(trainer)
		wp_util.move(trainer, trainer.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0),
			nil, 1)
	end

	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 트레이너 리더 (right, attack, shoot) : 움직이면 육포로 만들어 버릴 테니까…!!
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(trainer_1, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(trainer_1, 'shoot')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(trainer_1, 'qs_horse_racing_s9_32')

	-- 카메라 0.1로 shake 시작
	music_player_util.fade_out_sfx(crowd_shout_loop_sfx, 2)
	local earthquake_loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_earthquake_03', loop = true, fade_in_time = 1 })
	camera_util.shake(0.1, 999999)

	-- 단상 위의 말들과 가디언, 라나, 트레이너 리더와, 1, 2, 관중들 애니메이션, 이모션 초기화, 점프 (1, 0.5)
	local group_action = function(target)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(target)
		character_util.jump(target, 1, 0.5)
	end

	for i = 1, #runner_list do
		group_action(runner_list[i])
	end

	for i = 1, #trainer_list do
		group_action(trainer_list[i])
	end

	group_action(leader)

	-- 트레이너 리더 (left, idle, cast) : 뭐, 뭐야…이게 무슨 진동이야?
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(trainer_1, 'cast')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(trainer_1, 'qs_horse_racing_s9_33')

	-- 트레이너 1 (left, idle, question) : 지진이라던가…?
	scene_util.set_question_anim(trainer_2)
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(trainer_2, 'qs_horse_racing_s9_34')

	-- 트레이너 2 (left, idle, bomb_idle) : 멍청아, 여긴 하늘 위인데 어떻게 지진이 일어나?
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(trainer_3, 'bomb_idle')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(trainer_3, 'qs_horse_racing_s9_35')

	-- 트레이너 1, 2 (left, idle, cast)
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(trainer_2, 'cast')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(trainer_3, 'cast')

	-- 카메라 0.15로 shake
	camera_util.cancel_shake()
	camera_util.shake(0.15, 999999)

	-- 트레이너 리더 (left, idle, cast) : 무슨 동물들이 달려오는 것 같은데…
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(trainer_1, 'qs_horse_racing_s9_36')

	-- 트레이너 리더 (left, idle, question(loop x)) : 설마…
	scene_util.set_question_anim(trainer_1)
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(trainer_1, 'qs_horse_racing_s9_37')

	-- 카메라 1초간 Exit에서 아래로 1칸 내려간 위치로 이동, 카메라 사이즈 2.5로 축소
	local exit = self.get_exit()
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(2.5, 1)
	camera_util.move_async(exit.Position + vector(0, 0, -1), 1)

	-- 단상 위의 말들과 가디언, 라나, 트레이너 리더와, 1, 2, 관중들 전부 애니메이션과 이모션 해제하고 위 봄
	group_action = function(target)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(target)
		character_util.set_direction(target, 'up')
	end

	for i = 1, #runner_list do
		group_action(runner_list[i])
	end

	for i = 1, #trainer_list do
		group_action(trainer_list[i])
	end

	group_action(leader)

	for i = 1, #self.top_optimized_npcs do
		group_action(self.top_optimized_npcs[i])
	end

	for i = 1, #self.bottom_optimized_npcs do
		group_action(self.bottom_optimized_npcs[i])
	end

	-- 2초 대기
	wait_for_sec(2)

	-- Shout 말풍선(화면 중앙) : 지금이야!!!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(trainer_1, 'qs_horse_racing_s9_38', nil,
		{ screen_pos = vector(-50, 0) })

	-- 타임스케일 0.2
	music_player_util.fade_out_sfx(earthquake_loop_sfx, 1)
	camera_util.cancel_shake()
	time_util.mod('s9_slow', 0.4)

	-- Exit 가운데에서 0.2초간 알파 페이드 인 되면서 공주 등장 + 공주 success 애니메이션(loop x, next_anim : run)
	local alpha_setting = function(target, offset)
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(target, 0, 0)
		character_util.set_direction(target, 'down')
		target.Position = exit.Position + offset
	end

	-- 공주 세팅
	local princess = self.get_princess()
	alpha_setting(princess, vector(0, 0, -1))
	character_util.add_color(princess, princess.Name, unity_class.color.black, 1, 0)
	princess.SpineController:ForceUpdateSpines(1)
	camera_util.move_async(princess.Position, 0, { end_target = princess })

	-- 공주 등장
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'ondemand/v2_49_queenship/audio:bgm_queenship_derby', state = 'event', mix = 0 })
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(princess, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(princess, 'hold_loop')
	character_util.jump(princess, 1, 1)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(princess, 1, 0.2)
	character_util.remove_color(princess, princess.Name, 1)
	wp_util.move_async(princess, princess.Position + vector(0, 0, -2), nil, 1)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_crowd_shout_06')
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_crowd_fight_01', fade_out_time = 2 })

	-- 타임스케일 복구
	earthquake_loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_earthquake_03', loop = true, fade_in_time = 1 })
	camera_util.shake(0.05, 999999)
	camera_util.resize_to_default(1)
	time_util.unmod('s9_slow')
	character_util.remove_anim(princess)

	-- 말들 등장 시 위치 오프셋
	local offset = { -0.5, 0.5 }
	for i = 1, 16 do
		alpha_setting(self.horse_optimized_npcs[i], vector(offset[2 - (i % 2)], 0, -1))
	end

	-- 트레이너 리더, 1, 2, 관중들 (surprise, embarrassed)
	group_action = function(target)
		target.SpineController:ForceUpdateSpines(1)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(target)
		scene_util.set_embarrassed_anim(target, false)
	end

	for i = 1, #runner_list do
		group_action(runner_list[i])

function local_class:create_smoke_effect()
	local camera = stage_camera
	self.smoke_effect = self.get_smoke_effect():Instantiate(
		camera.Transform.position, unity_class.quaternion.identity, camera.Transform)

	local main_module = self.smoke_effect.transform:GetComponentInChildren(
		typeof(CS.UnityEngine.ParticleSystem)).main

	self.gradient.color = unity_color({ 0.2, 0.6, 0.3, 0 })
	main_module.startColor = self.gradient
	local color = main_module.startColor.color

	local smoke_duration = 0.5
	local time_passed = 0

	local start_alpha = 0
	local end_alpha = 0.6

	while time_passed < smoke_duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local cur_alpha = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(start_alpha, end_alpha, time_passed / smoke_duration)

		self.gradient.color = unity_color({ color.r, color.g, color.b, cur_alpha })
		main_module.startColor = self.gradient

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	wait_for_sec(1)

	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	if self.smoke_effect then
		self.smoke_effect:Dispose()
		self.smoke_effect = nil
	end
end

function local_class:throw_item_routine()
	local item_id = { 20048, 20570, 20019 }

	local duration = 3
	local routine_duration = duration + 1
	local routine_cur_time = unity_class.time.time

	local cool_time = 0
	local throwing_cur_time = 0

	local trash_list = {}

	local throwing_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s9_throwing_trash_pos')

	while unity_class.time.time - routine_cur_time < routine_duration do

		if unity_class.time.time - routine_cur_time < duration and unity_class.time.time - throwing_cur_time > cool_time then
			throwing_cur_time = unity_class.time.time

			local random_index = random_util.get_random_int(1, #self.bottom_optimized_npcs)

			local random_offset_x = random_util.get_random_int(-40, 20)
			local random_offset_z = random_util.get_random_int(-25, 25)

			local random_item_id = random_util.get_random_int(1, 3)

			local audience = self.bottom_optimized_npcs[random_index]
			scene_util.set_anim_non_loop(audience, 'throw')

			local offset_x = random_offset_x / 10
			local offset_z = random_offset_z / 10
			local target_pos = vector(audience.Position.x + offset_x, 0, throwing_pos.z + offset_z)

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_throw_01')

			local trash_item = drop_item_util.create_item(
				{ pos = audience.Position, target = target_pos, itemid = item_id[random_item_id],
				  notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter' })

			trash_list[trash_item] = unity_class.time.time

			cool_time = random_util.get_random_int(0, 3) / 10
		end

		for trash_item, time in pairs(trash_list) do
			if time and unity_class.time.time - time > 0.65 then
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_explosion_01')
				self.get_dead_effect():Instantiate(trash_item.Position)
				trash_item:ConsumeComplete()
				trash_list[trash_item] = nil
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:throw_green_ticket()
	local drugs = {}

	for i = 1, #self.horse_optimized_npcs do
		local horse_npc = self.horse_optimized_npcs[i]
		scene_util.set_anim_non_loop(horse_npc, 'release', { remove_after = 0.47 })
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_throw_01')

		local drug = drop_item_util.create_item(
			{ pos = horse_npc.Position, target = horse_npc.Position + direction_util.to_vector3(horse_npc.Direction), itemid = 20253,
			  notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', sprscale = 0.75, showoncharacter = true })

		local sprite = drug.SpriteTransform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
		if sprite ~= nil then
			sprite.TintColor = unity_color({ 0, 1, 0, 1 })
			sprite:Rebuild()
		end

		table.insert(drugs, drug)
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.65)

	for i = 1, #drugs do
		drugs[i]:ConsumeComplete()
	end
end

--- 벽에 충돌하는 인베이더 연출
function local_class:crash_wall_invader(target, is_up)
	character_util.set_direction(target, 'down')
	local dir = 1

	if is_up then
		character_util.set_direction(target, 'up')
		dir = -1
	end

	while not self.stop_crash_wall do
		wp_util.move_async(target, target.Position + vector(0, 0, -1 * dir), 4,
			nil, { run = true })

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_big_01')
		self.get_hit_effect():Instantiate(target.Position + vector(0, 0.05, -0.35))

		character_util.jump(target, 0.3, 0.25)
		character_util.move_to_async(target, target.Position + vector(0, 0, 1 * dir), 0.25)

		wait_for_sec(0.5)
	end
end
