	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_zone_leave_event')

	self.item_setting(self)
	self.watcher_setting(self)

	self.get_key_blade().Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
	self.get_enemy_fighter().Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(self.get_enemy_fighter_npc(), CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
	--(4,3,4) -> (4,3,6.2)
	self.get_enemy_fighter().Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(4, 3, 6.2))

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))

	self.item_key_blade = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.enter_zone_1) then
		if not self.is_complete_event_zone[1] then
			self.is_complete_event_zone[1] = true
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.enter_enter_zone_1, self)
		end
		if self.is_captives_party then
			--파티 분열
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
					util.cs_generator(self.convert_party_follower_to_npc, self, 1))
		end
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.enter_zone_2) and
			not self.is_complete_event_zone[2] and
			not self.is_complete_event_zone[3] then
		self.is_complete_event_zone[2] = true
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.enter_enter_zone_2, self))

	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.enter_zone_3) then
		self.is_enter_enter_zone_3 = true
		if not self.is_complete_event_zone[3] and self.is_s1_end then
			self.is_complete_event_zone[3] = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.enter_enter_zone_3, self))
		end
		if not self.is_captives_party and self.is_captives_saved then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
					util.cs_generator(self.convert_npc_to_party_follower, self))
		end
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.enter_zone_4) then
		if self.is_captives_party then
			--파티 분열
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
					util.cs_generator(self.convert_party_follower_to_npc, self, 2))
		end
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.enter_zone_5) then
		if not self.is_captives_party and self.is_captives_saved then
			--파티 분열
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
					util.cs_generator(self.convert_npc_to_party_follower, self))
		end
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.enter_zone_6) and self.npc_zone_enter_event_1_flag then
		self.npc_zone_enter_event_1_flag = false
		start_coroutine(self.npc_zone_enter_event, self, 5)
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.enter_zone_7) and self.npc_zone_enter_event_2_flag then
		self.npc_zone_enter_event_2_flag = false
		start_coroutine(self.npc_zone_enter_event, self, 4)
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.enter_zone_8) and self.npc_zone_enter_event_3_flag then
		self.npc_zone_enter_event_3_flag = false
		start_coroutine(self.npc_zone_enter_event, self, 3)
	end
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
		if e.Zone.Name == self.enter_zone_3 then
			--들어가 있지 않다면 바로 false 로 변경
			self.is_enter_enter_zone_3 = false
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_key_blade()) and not self.is_get_key_blade then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_keyblade, self)
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_enemy_fighter()) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_enemy_fighter, self)
	end
	for i = 1, 5 do
		local captive = self.get_captive(i)
		speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(captive)
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, captive) and
				self.is_captives_saved == false then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.save_captive, self, i)
		end
	end
end

--- CustomStageEvent
function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	--waypointguard를 타임라인 상에서 강제로 move_to를 사용하기 위함
	local move_list = {
		1, 2, 4, 6, 9
	}
	for i = 1, 5 do
		if e.Params[0] == self.watcher_3_move_to_event_name .. move_list[i] then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.watcher_3_move_to, self, move_list[i]))
		end
	end

	if self.is_detected then
		return false
	end

	if e.Params[0] == self.detect_event_name then
		self.is_detected = true
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.on_detected_with_watcher, self, e.Sender)
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:interact_keyblade()
	--탁자 위 아이템 DropItem으로 플레이어가 획득

	local carrot = self.item_key_blade
	carrot.ConsumeTarget = user_party.Leader
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	-- 아이템 획득 연출
	local item_place_holder = CS.Oak.ItemPlaceholder()
	--임시 아이템
	--타이틀 : 전투기 키
	--서브타이틀 : 인베이더 전투기를 작동시키는 열쇠
	--설명 : 이 전투기는 이제 제 겁니다, 제 마음대로 팔 수 있는 겁니다.
	--이후 탁자와 상호작용 불가 (NonInteractable)
	item_place_holder.ItemId = 20347
	yield_return_func(CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ItemGetEvent,
			{ ItemId = 20347, NotForInventory = true },
			'qs_invader_reporter_keyblade_name',
			'qs_invader_reporter_keyblade_sub_name',
			'qs_invader_reporter_keyblade_info'
	)
	self.is_get_key_blade = true
	self.get_key_blade().Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
end

function local_class:save_captive(number)
	local captive_chosen = self.get_captive(number)
	local dir_align = ''
	local leader = user_party.Leader
	--포로에 align 1초, set_quest_notice() 아이콘 제거
	if number % 2 == 0 then
		dir_align = 'left'
	else
		dir_align = 'right'
	end

	for i = 1, 5 do
		local captive = self.get_captive(i)
		quest_icon_util.remove(captive)
	end

	party_util.align_party(captive_chosen.Position, dir_align, 1)

	--나레이션 박스 : 포로를 구출하시겠습니까?
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'qs_invader_reporter_20' })
	local player_choice = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		-- 예.(흰색)
		{ 'qs_invader_reporter_21' },
		-- 아니오.(흰색)
		{ 'qs_invader_reporter_22' }
	})

	--선택지
	if player_choice == 1 then
		--예
		--포로들 (가디언 바라봄, smile, success)
		for i = 1, 5 do
			local captive = self.get_captive(i)
			character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(captive, { name = 'success' }, { name = 'smile' })
		end
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_crowd_clap_02')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
		--해당 포로 : : 구해주셔서 감사합니다!
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(captive_chosen, { key = 'qs_invader_reporter_23', skip = true })

		for follower_index = 1, 5 do
			local captive = self.get_captive(follower_index)
			character_util.remove_relate_event(captive, self.controller)
			character_util.convert_to_following_npc(captive, user_party, true)
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(captive)
		end
		self.is_captives_saved = true
		self.is_captives_party = true
	else
		--아니오
		--set_quest_notice() 다시 띄움
		for i = 1, 5 do
			local captive = self.get_captive(i)
			quest_icon_util.set_quest_notice(captive)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:interact_enemy_fighter()
	--나레이션 : 인베이더가 타고 온 전투기
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'qs_invader_reporter_24' })
	--나레이션 : 붙잡힌 포로들을 탈출시키는 데 쓸 수 있을 것 같다.
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'qs_invader_reporter_25' })

	--if interact_keyblade 했으면
	if self.is_get_key_blade then
		--나레이션 : 전투기 열쇠를 사용하시겠습니까?
		field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'qs_invader_reporter_26' })
		local player_choice = choose_util.play_choose_event({
			-- 예.(흰색)
			{ 'qs_invader_reporter_21' },
			-- 아니오.(흰색)
			{ 'qs_invader_reporter_22' }
		})
		if player_choice == 1 then
			-- 포로 전부 구했는지 여부
			if self.is_captives_saved then
				timeline_util.stop(self.director_name)
				for i = 1, 5 do
					local captive = self.get_captive(i)
					character_util.convert_to_npc(captive)
				end
				wait_for_sec(0.1)
				--플레이어 전투기로부터 바라본 방향 반대로 2칸 떨어진 위치에 Align 1초
				--플레이어 위치에서 포로 1 ~ 5까지 순서대로 연출 (각 연출마다 실행 대기시간 0.5초)
				--1초간 알파 페이드 인 되며 포로 속도 2로 전투기 중앙까지 이동
				--전투기 중앙에서 1초간 알파 페이드 아웃
				--카메라 전투기 중앙으로 1초간 이동
				--전투기에 말풍선 : 가디언 님, 정말 감사합니다! 지상에서 봐요!
				--전투기 0.04 진동 시작, 카메라도 0.15 shake 지속
				--1.5초 대기
				--기자, 안내인 좌측 바라봄
				--카메라 1초간 기자에게 이동
				--기자 (left, surprise, cast) : 뭐, 뭐야? 어떻게 된 거야?
				--기자 점프 (1, 0.5), (left, scared, embarrassed) : 내 전투기! 6년 할부로 산 건데!!
				--전투기 움직이기 시작 (속도 초당 1칸에서 1초간 4로 가속)
				--동시에 기자 달려감 (속도 6)

	-- 진행도
	self.section_state = {
		none = 1,
		crystal = 2
	}

	self.current_section_state = self.section_state.none

	self.taxi = {
		-- 리소스가 불러와졌을때 호출되는 콜백 이벤트
		on_load = function(self, prefab, resource_storage)
		end,

		-- 리소스의 인스턴스가 생성되었을때 호출되는 콜백 이벤트
		on_instantiate = function(self, prefab, instance)
			instance.transform.localPosition =  field_util.get_marker_pos('intro_pos_1_10')
			instance.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 180, 0)
		end,

		-- 리소스의 인스턴스가 파괴되었을때 호출되는 콜백 이벤트
		on_destroy = function(self, instance)
		end,

		rotation = function(self, instance)
			start_coroutine(function()
				local time_passed = 0
				local rotate_time = 0.3
				local start_y_angle = 180
				local end_y_angle = 90
				while time_passed < rotate_time do
					time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
					local cur_y_angle = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(start_y_angle, end_y_angle, (time_passed / rotate_time))
					instance.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, cur_y_angle, 0)

					coroutine.yield()
				end

				instance.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, end_y_angle, 0)
			end)
		end
	}

	-- 크리스탈 처리용
	self.data_storage = nil

	self.get_crystal_socket = function()
		return get_field_object('s1_crystalsocket')
	end

	-- 배터리 데이터 키(절대 변경 불가)

function local_class:crystal_setting()
	local equip_crystal_data = self.data_storage:get_data(self.equip_crystal_key)
	local crystal = self.get_crystal_socket()
	local crystal_data = self.data_storage:get_data(self.crystal_key)

	if equip_crystal_data < 0 then
		equip_crystal_data = 0
	end

	-- 혹시라도 지금까지 진행하면서 크리스탈 정보가 저장이 안되었을 경우 저장이 되도록 세팅
	-- 13챕터 (위쪽), 14챕터 (아래쪽) 크리스탈은 무조건 이 시점에 습득을 했어야 하므로 해당 값으로 저장
	-- 15챕터 이후에 값이 달라진다 하더라도 여기 코드 시점으로 올 수 없음
	if crystal_data ~= (self.equip_crystal.down | self.equip_crystal.up) then
		self.data_storage:set_data(self.crystal_key, self.equip_crystal.down | self.equip_crystal.up)
	end

	-- 장착된 배터리들 애니메이션 변경
	if (self.equip_crystal.down & equip_crystal_data) ~= 0 then
		local animator = crystal:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
		animator:Play('idle')
		return true
	end


	crystal.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

	return false
end

function local_class:crystal_interact()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	local crystal_number = self.equip_crystal.down
	local equip_crystal_data = self.data_storage:get_data(self.equip_crystal_key)
	local crystal_data = self.data_storage:get_data(self.crystal_key)

	if equip_crystal_data < 0 then
		equip_crystal_data = 0
	end

	if crystal_data < 0 then
		crystal_data = 0
	end

	-- 해당 슬롯의 배터리를 장착하지 않은 경우
	if (crystal_number & equip_crystal_data) == 0 and (crystal_number & crystal_data) ~= 0 then
		-- 장착할 건지 나레이션
		field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'demonworld_crystal_room_35' })

		-- 장착 선택지
		local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
			{ 'demonworld_crystal_room_36', 'intellect' }, { 'demonworld_crystal_room_37', 'normal' } })

		-- 배터리 장착
		if choose_result == 1 then
			self.data_storage:set_data(self.equip_crystal_key, equip_crystal_data | crystal_number)
			local crystal = self.get_crystal_socket()
			local animator = crystal:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
			animator:Play('open')
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_battery_02')
			wait_for_sec(2)
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_battery_01')
			wait_for_sec(1.5)
			field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'demonworld_crystal_room_38' })

			local intro_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('intro_pos_2')
			wp_util.move(user_party.Leader, intro_pos, nil, 1, { last_direction = 'down' })
			wp_util.move(get_character('princess_bat'), intro_pos + vector(-1, 0, 0),
					nil, 1, { last_direction = 'down' })
			wp_util.move_async(get_character('sohee'), intro_pos + vector(1, 0, 0),
					nil, 1, { last_direction = 'down' })

		else
			-- 플레이어 공격, 스킬 금지
			local manual_touch_state = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState.Create(user_party.Leader, false)
			manual_touch_state:DisableControls(CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Attack | CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Super)

			local state_change_event = CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(manual_touch_state)
			message_system:SendSync(user_party.Leader.FieldObjectController, state_change_event)

			coroutine.yield(nil)

			field_ui_manager:Show()
			user_party:ResetControllers()

			-- 달리기 할 때 사용하지 못하는 버튼 숨기기
			field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(user_party.Leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.SkillButton
					| CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ClassButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.RoleButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ModeChangeButton
					| CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TeamCombinationButton)

			self.current_section_state = self.section_state.none
			return
		end
	end

	timeline_util.play_async('qs_main_s1', 'qs_main_s1_2')

	self.controller:refresh_weapon(user_party.Leader)
	self.controller:refresh_weapon(get_character('sohee'))
	self.controller:refresh_weapon(get_character('princess_bat'))

	yield_return_func(quest_util.progress_section, self.controller)
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.StageControlStartEvent.Instance)

	field_ui_manager:Show()
	user_party:ResetControllers()
end

function local_class:alarm_loop()
	self.alarm_active = true

	start_coroutine(function()
		while self.alarm_active do
			local fall_count = 3
			local fall_pos_list = { vector(-4, 0, 2), vector(5, 0, -1), vector(-1, 0, -3) }
			for i = 1, fall_count do
				local cur_rock = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_cp11_rock_landslide_brown_small'):Instantiate(
						stage_camera.LookAtPosition + fall_pos_list[i],
						unity_class.quaternion.identity,
						stage_camera.transform)
				cur_rock.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0.8
			end

			wait_for_sec(2)
		end
	end)
end

function local_class:alarm_loop_tint()
	start_coroutine(function()
		while self.alarm_active do
			field:Tint(self.alarm_key, unity_class.color.red, 0.25, 0.5)
			wait_for_sec(0.5)
			if not self.alarm_active then
				break
			end
			field:RemoveTint(self.alarm_key, 0.25)
			wait_for_sec(0.5)
		end
		field:RemoveTint(self.alarm_key, 0)
	end)

end

function local_class:alarm_loop_end()
	self.alarm_active = false
end

function local_class:bomb_fail_routine()
	local bomb_fail_list = { '(3.5, 0, 2.5)', '(4.5, 0, -1)', '(-3.5, 0, 2.5)', '(-6, 0, 3.5)' }

	start_coroutine(function()
		self.bomb_fail_loop = true
		local time_passed = 0

		while self.bomb_fail_loop do

			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

			if time_passed >= 3 then
				time_passed = 0

				message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil,
						{ 'bomb_fail', bomb_fail_list[random_util.get_random_int(1, #bomb_fail_list)], 0, 0.7 }))
			end
			coroutine.yield()
		end
	end)
end

function local_class:police_shot_bullet(police, i)
	local time_passed = 0
	local pattern = { 'shot', 'shot', 'shot', 'shot', 'idle',
					  'shot', 'shot', 'shot', 'shot', 'idle',
					  'shot', 'shot', 'shot', 'shot', 'reload', 'reload' }
	local pattern_index = random_util.get_random_int(1, #pattern)

	self.shot_loop = true
	while self.shot_loop do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		-- 구간을 0.4초 단위로 쪼갬
		if time_passed >= 0.4 then
			time_passed = 0
			pattern_index = pattern_index % #pattern + 1
		end

		if pattern[pattern_index] == 'shot' and time_passed == 0 then
			scene_util.set_anim_loop(police, 'handgun_attack')
			self.shoot_helpers[i]:ShootTargetPosition(police.Position - vector(10, 0, 0.2),
					vector(0, 0, 0.2), -1)
		elseif pattern[pattern_index] == 'idle' and time_passed == 0 then
			scene_util.set_anim_loop(police, 'handgun_idle')
		elseif pattern[pattern_index] == 'reload' and time_passed == 0 then
			scene_util.set_anim_loop(police, 'handgun_reload')
		end
		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

return local_class

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local leader = get_party_leader()

		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.ammi_chase
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(self.invader_ammi_event_3, self)

			self.current_section_state < self.section_state.emp_event then
		-- EMP로 AMMI 격퇴 이벤트
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.done
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(self.ammi_emp_event, self)
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, self.s11_event_zone_name .. 5) and
			self.current_section_state == self.section_state.ammi_chase then
		quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.quest_marker_name, self.get_chase_marker(3), true)
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, self.s11_event_zone_name .. 6) and
			self.current_section_state == self.section_state.ammi_chase then
		quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.quest_marker_name, field:GetMarker('ammi_emp_pos').position, true)
	end

	return false

		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.teleport_party_for_marker, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

-- AMMI 추격 패턴
function local_class:ammi_dash_pattern()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local ammi = self.get_ammi(2)

	local ammi_detection_dist = 9
	local ammi_speed_up_dist = 49
	local obstacle_detection_dist = 3
	local move_speed = 3.5
	local time_passed = 0
	local duration = move_speed / 3
	local move_count = 1

	local is_fast_move = function()
		return move_count % 4 ~= 1
	end

	local waypoint_index = 1

	local waypoints = {
		self.get_chase_marker(2),
		self.get_chase_marker(3),
		self.get_chase_marker(4),
	}

	while self.current_ammi_state ~= self.ammi_state.screenplay do
		local dist_to_player = (leader.Position - ammi.Position).sqrMagnitude
		if dist_to_player < ammi_detection_dist and self.ammi_detection_on then
			self.ammi_detection_on = false
			-- AMMI 에게 잡혔을 때
			waypoint_index = 1
			self:on_detected(ammi)
			return
		else
			if self.current_ammi_state == self.ammi_state.move then
				character_util.set_anim(ammi, {name = 'walk', sfx_name = '01_walk_robot_06'})
				if time_passed < duration then
					local next_wp_diff = waypoints[waypoint_index] - ammi.Position
					local move_dist = unity_class.time.deltaTime * move_speed

					ammi.Direction = vector_util.to_direction(next_wp_diff)

					if next_wp_diff.sqrMagnitude <= move_dist * move_dist then
						ammi.Position = waypoints[waypoint_index]
						waypoint_index = waypoint_index + 1
						if waypoint_index == 4 then
							self.current_ammi_state = self.ammi_state.screenplay
							character_util.set_anim(ammi, {name = 'walk', sfx_name = '01_walk_robot_06'})
							return
						end
					else
						scene_util.set_anim_loop(ammi, 'walk')
						ammi.Position = ammi.Position + next_wp_diff.normalized * move_dist
					end
				else
					character_util.set_anim(ammi, {name = 'walk', sfx_name = '01_walk_robot_06'})
					duration = is_fast_move() and 0.5 or 1.2
					self.current_ammi_state = self.ammi_state.delayed
				end
				for idx = 1, 15 do
					-- 장애물과 부딪혔을 때 장애물 파괴
					local dist_to_ammi = (ammi.Position - self.get_obstacle(idx).Position).sqrMagnitude
					if dist_to_ammi < obstacle_detection_dist * obstacle_detection_dist then
						self:destroy_obstacle(self.get_obstacle(idx))
					end
				end
			elseif self.current_ammi_state == self.ammi_state.delayed then
				character_util.set_anim(ammi, {name = 'walk', sfx_name = '01_walk_robot_06'})
				if time_passed >= duration then
					-- 딜레이와 속도 변화
					move_count = move_count + 1
					if dist_to_player > ammi_speed_up_dist then
						move_speed = is_fast_move() and 11.5 or 3.8
						if self.ammi_chase_fail_count > 3 then
							move_speed = move_speed * 0.7
						end
					else
						move_speed = is_fast_move() and 9.5 or 3.2
						if self.ammi_chase_fail_count > 3 then
							move_speed = move_speed * 0.7
						end
					end
					local move_distance = is_fast_move() and 5 or 3
					duration = move_distance / move_speed
					time_passed = 0

					self.current_ammi_state = self.ammi_state.move
				end
			end
		end

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		-- 오류 방지용 탈출 코드
		if self.current_ammi_state == self.ammi_state.screenplay then
			return
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:on_detected(fo)
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_slowmotion_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_ammi_05')

	local fade_duration = 1
	local wait_duration = 0.5

	-- AMMI 연출용 스테이트
	self.current_ammi_state = self.ammi_state.screenplay

	self.ammi_chase_fail_count = self.ammi_chase_fail_count + 1

	user_party.Leader.CharacterBehaviour:CancelAllBattleActions(true)

	character_util.set_emotion(fo, { name = 'attack' })
	party_util.set_emotion({ name = 'attack', loop = true })

	party_util.look_at(fo)
	character_util.look_at(fo, user_party.Leader)

	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(3.5, 0.5)

	character_util.set_anim(fo, { name = 'attack_ready', loop = false, next_anim = 'attack_ready_loop' })

	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	character_util.spine_deviate_local(fo, direction_util.to_vector3(fo.Direction) * 0.5, 0.3, 0.3)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_ammi_06')

	character_util.set_animation_n_times(fo, { name = 'attack', count = 1 })

	character_util.set_side_direction(user_party.Leader)
	character_util.set_side_direction(user_party[1])

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_01')

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.set_anim(user_party[i], { name = 'dead', loop = false, sfx_name = '01_hit_npc_01' })
		character_util.set_emotion(user_party[i], { name = 'damaged' })
		character_util.spine_pulse_color(user_party[i], CS.Oak.Constants.DamageColor, 1,
				1, 0.5)
		character_util.spine_damage_squish(user_party[i], 1.3, 0.7, 1, 0.2)
	end

	wait_for_sec(1.2)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_impact_05')

	screen_util.fade_out_async(fade_duration, unity_class.color.red, 'linear')

	wait_for_sec(wait_duration)

	-- 장애물 위치 복구
	self:obstacle_pos_setting(true)

	party_util.position_party(field:GetMarker('ammi_leader_reset').position + vector(7, 0, 0),
			'right', 'linear')

	party_util.remove_emotion()
	party_util.remove_animation()

	character_util.set_position_from_marker(fo, 'ammi_leader_reset')

	scene_util.set_direction(fo, 'right', false)

	camera_util.resize_to_default(0)

	screen_util.fade_in_async(fade_duration, unity_class.color.red, 'linear')

	character_util.remove_anim(fo)

	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'qs_main_s11_15_1' })

	-- AMMI 추격용 state 로 변경 후 다시 추격 코루틴 시작
	self.ammi_detection_on = true
	self.current_ammi_state = self.ammi_state.move

function local_class:enter()
	-- 엘리베이터 코어는 얻었지만, 프로그래스가 안넘어 갔을 때 return false 해서 프로그래스를 넘기는 방어 코드
	local custom_keys = require('Quest/Main/QueenShip/Common/CustomDataKeyConstants.lua')
	local common_keys = custom_keys.common

	-- 엘리베이터 코어 키 == 1
	local elevator_core_key = common_keys.core_count

	if stage_progress_util.get_custom_data_int(elevator_core_key, 0) == 1 then
		return false
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TreasureOpenScreenPlayEndEvent), 'on_treasure_open_screen_play_end_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.LinkDoorEvent), 'on_link_door_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent), 'on_camera_grid_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.HoldUpEvent), 'on_hold_up_event')

	timeline_table.register_action('item_holding', self.invader_elevator_core_holding, self)
	timeline_table.register_action('world_map_scene', self.world_map_scene, self)

	self:pre_setting()

	return true

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.LinkDoorEvent.Create('green', false, true))
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TreasureOpenScreenPlayEndEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.LinkDoorEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.HoldUpEvent))

	timeline_table.unregister_action('item_holding')
	timeline_table.unregister_action('world_map_scene')

	self.item_hold_loop = false
	drop_item_util.dispose_item(self.elevator_core_item)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

function local_class:pre_setting()
	for i = 1, 5 do
		character_util.set_position_from_marker(self.get_invader(i), 's12_invader_pos_' .. i)
	end

	self.clear_exit_cache = self.get_clear_exit().Interactable
	self.get_clear_exit().Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create('accel_puzzle_door', true))
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create('s12_invader_block_door_1', true))
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create('s12_invader_block_door_3', true))
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create('s12_chase_puzzle_door', true))
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create('s12_link_green_door', true))
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, self.s12_event_zone_name .. 1) and
			self.current_section_state < self.section_state.event_1 then
		-- 엘리베이터에서 내리는 인베이더 이벤트
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.event_1
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(self.invader_elevator_event_1, self)
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, self.s12_event_zone_name .. 2) and
			self.current_section_state < self.section_state.event_2 then
		-- 엘리베이터 코어를 들고 가는 인베이더
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.event_2
		start_coroutine(self.elevator_core_invader_start, self)
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, self.s12_event_zone_name .. 4) and
			self.current_section_state == self.section_state.event_2 then
		-- 엘리베이터 코어를 들고 가는 인베이더 도망
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.elevator_core_get
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(self.elevator_core_invader_event, self)
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, self.s12_event_zone_name .. 5) then
		quest_marker_util.remove(self.magnet_quest_marker_name)
		if not is_unity_null(self.cached_twinkle_effect) then
			self.cached_twinkle_effect:Dispose()
			self.cached_twinkle_effect = nil
		end
		self.magnet_quest_marker_flag = false
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_clear_exit()) and self.current_section_state < self.section_state.done then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(self.elevator_narration_event, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_treasure_open_screen_play_end_event(e)
	local elevator_core = self.get_elevator_core_box()

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, elevator_core) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(self.elevator_core_get_event, self)
		return true
	end
end

function local_class:on_link_door_event(e)
	if not self.start_grid_enter then
		if e.IsOpen then
			if e.LinkDoorTypeName == 'green' then
				quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.quest_marker_name, self.get_exit(8), true)
			elseif e.LinkDoorTypeName == 'pink' then
				quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.quest_marker_name, self.get_exit(6), true)
			end
		elseif not e.IsOpen then
			if e.LinkDoorTypeName == 'green' then
				quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.quest_marker_name, self.get_link_door_green(), true)
			elseif e.LinkDoorTypeName == 'pink' then
				if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.elevator_core_get and self:link_door_open_check(self.get_link_door_green()) then
					quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.quest_marker_name, self.get_exit(6), true)
				else
					quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.quest_marker_name, self.get_link_door_pink(), true)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)
	local link_door_pink = self.get_link_door_pink()
	local link_door_green = self.get_link_door_green()

	if type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, 'grid_1') then
		if self:link_door_open_check(link_door_pink) and not self:link_door_open_check(link_door_green) then
			-- 분홍 링크도어가 열려 있으면
			quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.quest_marker_name, self.get_exit(6), true)
		elseif self:link_door_open_check(link_door_pink) and self:link_door_open_check(link_door_green) then
			quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.quest_marker_name, self.get_exit(6), true)
		elseif not self:link_door_open_check(link_door_pink) and not self:link_door_open_check(link_door_green) then
			quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.quest_marker_name, link_door_pink, true)
			if self.get_holdable_key().ActiveState == active_state('enabled') then
				quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.holdable_key_quest_marker_name, self.get_holdable_key(), true)
			end
		else
			quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.quest_marker_name, self.get_exit(6), true)
		end
	elseif type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, 'grid_4') or type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, 'ammi_grid') then
		if self:link_door_open_check(link_door_pink) and not self:link_door_open_check(link_door_green) then
			quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.quest_marker_name, self.get_exit(7), true)
		elseif self:link_door_open_check(link_door_pink) and self:link_door_open_check(link_door_green) then
			quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.quest_marker_name, self.get_exit(9), true)
		elseif not self:link_door_open_check(link_door_pink) and self:link_door_open_check(link_door_green) then
			quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.quest_marker_name, self.get_exit(9), true)
		else
			quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.quest_marker_name, self.get_exit(5), true)
		end
	elseif type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, 'grid_2') then
		if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.elevator_core_get and not self:link_door_open_check(link_door_green) then
			quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.quest_marker_name, link_door_green, true)
		elseif self.current_section_state == self.section_state.elevator_core_get and self:link_door_open_check(link_door_green) then
			quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.quest_marker_name, self.get_exit(8), true)
		elseif self.current_section_state == self.section_state.none then
			quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.quest_marker_name, vector(167.5, 0, 103), true)
		end
	elseif type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, 'grid_6') or type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, 'grid_7') then
		quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.quest_marker_name, self.get_exit(1), true)
	elseif type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, 'grid_3') then
		quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.quest_marker_name, self.get_elevator_core_box(), true)
	end

	if type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, 'grid_5') then
		self.start_grid_enter = true
		quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.quest_marker_name, self.get_exit(1), true)
	else
		self.start_grid_enter = false
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_hold_up_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Holder, user_party.Leader) and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_field_object('s12_holdable_key')) then
		quest_marker_util.remove(self.holdable_key_quest_marker_name)
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Holder, user_party.Leader) and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_field_object('elevator_core_puzzle_magnet_1')) then
		if self.magnet_quest_marker_flag then
			quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.magnet_quest_marker_name, get_field_object('s12_magnet_n'), true)
		end
	end
end

-- 엘리베이터에서 내리는 인베이더 이벤트
function local_class:invader_elevator_event_1()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	quest_marker_util.remove(self.quest_marker_name)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5, 2)

	timeline_util.play_async('qs_main_s12_1', 'qs_main_s12_1')

	self:world_map_scene()
end

-- 엘리베이터 코어 아이템을 인베이더 머리에 붙이는 루아콜 용 함수
function local_class:invader_elevator_core_holding()
	start_coroutine(self.item_holding_routine, self)
end

-- 엘리베이터 코어 들고 가는 연출용
function local_class:item_holding_routine()
	local invader_5 = self.get_invader(5)
	self.elevator_core_item = drop_item_util.create_item({ pos = invader_5.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.8),
															itemid = 20749, notforinven = true, showoncharacter = true,
															lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', skip_text = true })

	drop_item_util.alpha_fade_async(self.elevator_core_item, 0, 0)

	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(function()
			drop_item_util.alpha_fade_in_async(self.elevator_core_item, 0.7)
		end),
		util.cs_generator(function()
			-- 엘리베이터 코어 아이템을 인베이더 머리에 붙임
			while self.item_hold_loop do
				self.elevator_core_item.Position = invader_5.Position + vector(0, 0.2, 0.6)

				-- 오류 방지용 탈출 코드
				if not self.item_hold_loop then
					return
				end
				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end
		end)
	})
end

function local_class:world_map_scene()
	local princess = get_character('princess')

	--공주 : (right, idle, question) 엘리베이터?
	scene_util.set_question_anim(princess)
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(princess, 'qs_main_s12_11')
	character_util.remove_anim(princess)

	yield_return_func(self.operator_ui_controller.InitPortrait, self.operator_ui_controller, 'demon_operator')

	self.operator_ui_obj:SetActive(true)

	--크로셀 : 그렇습니다, 이 함선은 여러 개의 엘리베이터로 이루어진 복층 구조입니다.
	yield_return_func(self.operator_ui_controller.SetLabelKeyAsync, self.operator_ui_controller,
			'qs_main_s12_12', -1, 0.05, 2, nil,
			true, 'qs_main_s12_12', true, nil, true, true)
	self.operator_ui_obj:SetActive(false)

	--크로셀 홀로그램 이펙트와 함께 함선 프레임워크 월드맵 화면으로 이동
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	wait_for_sec(1)

	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
			self.res_holder, 'ondemand/v2_49_queenship/worldmap/chapter_15', 'worldmap', function(prefab)
				local worldmap_prefab = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Instantiate(prefab)
				self.worldmap_controller = worldmap_prefab:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.UI.QueenShipWorldMapController)).GetControllerLuaTable
			end)

	self.worldmap_controller:init_controller()

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_contact_01')

	wait_for_sec(0.7)

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	wait_for_sec(1)

	--월드맵 화면에서 엘리베이터가 붉게 표시되서 강조됨
	self.worldmap_controller:ev_on()

	self.worldmap_controller:stage_marker('queenship_1_3')

	wait_for_sec(1)

	self.operator_ui_obj:SetActive(true)

	--크로셀 : 인베이더 함선의 각 층을 연결하는 이동수단이 바로 엘리베이터입니다.
	yield_return_func(self.operator_ui_controller.SetLabelKeyAsync, self.operator_ui_controller,

function local_class:start()

		return
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_custom_stage_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupWaveClearEvent), 'on_battle_group_wave_clear_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_battle_group_eliminated_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectRevivedEvent), 'on_revive_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GameOverEvent), 'on_game_over_event')

	-- 타임라인 매니저에 캐릭터 키 등록
	timeline_util.set_character_key('s13_knight', self.get_knight().Name)

	self:marker_setting()

	start_coroutine(function()

		self:load_inner_section_progress()

		local skip_s1 = false
		if self.cur_inner_section_progress == self.inner_section_progress.s2 then
			skip_s1 = true
		end

		start_coroutine(self.start_event, self, skip_s1)
	end)

end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupWaveClearEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectRevivedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GameOverEvent))

	self.is_siren_tint = false
	self.get_reset_pos = nil

	self.loop_escape = true
	if self.siren_sfx ~= nil then
		self.siren_sfx:FadeOut()
		self.siren_sfx = nil
	end

	if self.computer_sound_sfx ~= nil then
		self.computer_sound_sfx:Stop()
		self.computer_sound_sfx = nil
	end

	if self.equipping_sfx ~= nil then
		self.equipping_sfx:Stop()
		self.equipping_sfx = nil
	end

	if self.stage_3_name == stage.Name then
		return
	end

end

function local_class:dispose()

	self.loop_escape = true
	self.is_siren_tint = false

	if self.computer_sound_sfx ~= nil then
		self.computer_sound_sfx:Stop()
		self.computer_sound_sfx = nil
	end

	if self.equipping_sfx ~= nil then
		self.equipping_sfx:Stop()
		self.equipping_sfx = nil
	end

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent)) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_revive_event(e)
	if e.FieldObject == user_party.Leader and self.siren_sfx ~= nil then
		self:call_siren_event()
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_game_over_event(e)
	self:siren_tint_off()
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.s15_computer())
			and self.interacted == false then
		self.interacted = true
		start_coroutine(self.detected_by_invaders, self)
	end
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) and not self.interacted and not self.battle_state then
		if e.Zone.Name == self.s13_main_computer_enter_zone_name then
			--self.interacted = true
			--start_coroutine(self.detected_by_invaders, self)
			--return true
		elseif e.Zone.Name == self.s13_key_door_up_side_zone_name and
				not self.up_side_invader_ment then
			self.up_side_invader_ment = true
			start_coroutine(self.talk_key_door_invader, self, true)
			return true
		elseif e.Zone.Name == self.s13_key_door_down_side_zone_name and
				not self.down_side_invader_ment then
			self.down_side_invader_ment = true
			start_coroutine(self.talk_key_door_invader, self, false)
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)

	if e:GetParamAt(0) == self.detected_event_key and not self.is_detected then
		self.is_detected = true
		start_coroutine(self.on_detected, self, e.Sender)
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_wave_clear_event(e)
	local current_wave = e.CurrentWave
	local max_wave = e.MaxWaveCount

	local has_next_wave = current_wave < max_wave

	-- 다음 웨이브가 있다면, 소환 후 탈출
	if has_next_wave then
		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.BattleGroupSpawnNextWaveEvent.Create('computer_room_battle_1'))
		self.current_wave = current_wave + 1
		start_coroutine(self.start_second_wave_battle_1, self)
		start_coroutine(self.start_second_wave_battle_2, self)
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)

	if e.BattleGroupName == 'computer_room_battle_1' then
		--sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(self.volt_appear, self)
		party_util.stop_and_disable_control()
		field_ui_manager:Hide()
		start_coroutine(self.volt_appear, self)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:choose_save_princess(knight, princess)

-- 인베이더 병사들 주목 (움직임or방향 전환)
function local_class:invaders_approaching(approaching_action)
	local invader_count = 0
	local group = 1
	for i = 1, self.com_invader_matrix_1 do
		for j = 1, self.com_invader_matrix_2 do
			invader_count = invader_count + 1

function local_class:siren_tint_event()
	local tint_duration = 0.5
	local timer = tint_duration
	local is_tint = false

	self.is_siren_tint = true

	if self.computer_sound_sfx ~= nil then
		music_player_util.fade_out_sfx(self.computer_sound_sfx, 1)
	end

	if self.has_engaged == false then
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_suspense_theme', state = 'event' })
	end

	self.siren_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx(
			{ sfx_name = "01_siren_oneshot_04", loop = true, fade_in_time = 0, type_priority = 'loop' })

	while self.is_siren_tint do
		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if timer >= tint_duration then
			timer = 0

			if is_tint then
				is_tint = false

				field:RemoveTint(self.siren_tint_key, tint_duration)
			else
				is_tint = true

				field:Tint(self.siren_tint_key, unity_color({ 1, 0, 0, 0.8 }), tint_duration)
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if self.siren_sfx ~= nil then
		self.siren_sfx:FadeOut()
	end

	if not self.is_siren_tint and is_tint then
		field:RemoveTint(self.siren_tint_key, tint_duration)
	end
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GetPushedEndEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.HoldUpEvent), 'on_hold_up_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ThrowEvent), 'on_throw_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_zone_leave_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent), 'on_mini_game_end_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ResetSwitchTurnedOnEvent), 'on_reset_switch_turned_on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.SpeechBubbleTypingEndEvent), 'on_typing_end_event')

	self.get_fx_iron_block_shock()
	self.get_fx_dead()
	self.get_fx_rock_cresh()
	self.get_fx_flame_rush_loop()
	self.get_fx_hit()
	self.get_fx_flame_area()

	timeline_table.register_action('call_acting_minigame', self.call_acting_minigame, self)
	timeline_table.register_action('call_retry_acting_minigame', self.call_retry_acting_minigame, self)
	timeline_table.register_action('acting_2_ending_pymon_running', self.acting_2_ending_pymon_running, self)
	timeline_table.register_action('acting_2_ending_pymon_running_end', self.acting_2_ending_pymon_running_end, self)
	timeline_table.register_action('excute_magnet_n', self.excute_magnet_n, self)
	timeline_table.register_action('excute_magnet_s', self.excute_magnet_s, self)
	timeline_table.register_action('retry_camera_zoom', self.retry_interact_acting_console_camera_moving, self)

	-- timneline dropitem module에 무전기 아이템 생성
	--local check = 0
	local timeline_module = timeline_manager:GetModule(typeof(CS.ScreenPlay.DropItemModule))
	if timeline_module ~= nil then
		local radio_item = drop_item_util.create_item({pos = vector(999, 0, 999),
			itemid = 20017, notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', showoncharacter = true})
		timeline_module:RegisterDropItem('radio_1', radio_item)
	end

	local invisible_battle_barricade = self.get_invisible_battle_barricade()

	invisible_battle_barricade.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')

	-- 메인 컴퓨터 3d 사운드 루프 시작
	self.computer_sound_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_amb_computer_01'
	, loop = true, type_priority = 'loop', player_priority = 'default', parent = self.get_s15_computer() })

	-- 크로셀 브리핑 존 체크 리스트 셋팅
	self.crosselle_briefing_check_list[self.crosselle_briefing.zone_1] = false
	self.crosselle_briefing_check_list[self.crosselle_briefing.zone_2] = false
	self.crosselle_briefing_check_list[self.crosselle_briefing.zone_3] = false

	self:pre_init_magnet_thief_scene()

	yield_return_func(CS.ScreenPlay.QueenShipOperatorUIExtensions.LoadOperatorUI, function(operator_ui)
		self.operator_ui_controller = operator_ui
		-- GT-1333 아랍어 대응
		if game_string.IsRTL and self.operator_ui_controller.operatorLabel.transform.localScale.x > 0 then
			local scale = self.operator_ui_controller.operatorLabel.transform.localScale
			scale.x = -scale.x

			self.operator_ui_controller.operatorLabel.transform.localScale = scale
			self.operator_ui_controller.operatorLabel.alignment = CS.TMPro.TextAlignmentOptions.TopRight
		end
	end)
	self.operator_ui_obj = self.operator_ui_controller.gameObject
	self.operator_ui_obj:SetActive(false)

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	local server_rack_dummy = self.get_server_rack_dummy()

	server_rack_dummy.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')

	start_coroutine(function()

		self:load_inner_section_progress()

		if self.cur_inner_section_progress == self.inner_section_progress.s1 then
			self:start_s1_setting()
		elseif self.cur_inner_section_progress == self.inner_section_progress.s2_1 then
			self:start_s2_1_setting()
		elseif self.cur_inner_section_progress == self.inner_section_progress.s2_2 then
			self:start_s2_2_setting(false)
		elseif self.cur_inner_section_progress == self.inner_section_progress.s2_3 then
			self:start_s2_3_setting()
		end
	end)

	-- test
	--self:acting_1_ending_setting()

	--party_util.position_party(vector(12.5,0,-40), 'left', 'linear')
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GetPushedEndEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.HoldUpEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ThrowEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ResetSwitchTurnedOnEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.SpeechBubbleTypingEndEvent))

	timeline_table.unregister_action('call_acting_minigame')
	timeline_table.unregister_action('call_retry_acting_minigame')
	timeline_table.unregister_action('acting_2_ending_pymon_running')
	timeline_table.unregister_action('acting_2_ending_pymon_running_end')
	timeline_table.unregister_action('excute_magnet_n')
	timeline_table.unregister_action('excute_magnet_s')
	timeline_table.unregister_action('retry_camera_zoom')

	if self.minigame then
		mini_game_manager:DisposeMiniGame(self.mini_game_name)
	end
	self.minigame = nil
end

	self.hold_up_magnet_s = false

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent)) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, typeof(CS.Oak.GetPushedEndEvent)) then
		return self:on_get_pushed_end_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.s14_hacking_console(1))
			and self.interacted_object == false then
		self.interacted_object = true
		if not self.interacted_hacking_console_1 then
			self.interacted_hacking_console_1 = true
			start_coroutine(self.hacking_console_1_interactive_event, self)
		else
			start_coroutine(self.hacking_console_reinteractive_event, self, e.Target.Name)
		end
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.s14_hacking_console(2))
			and self.interacted_object == false then
		self.interacted_object = true
		if not self.interacted_hacking_console_2 then
			self.interacted_hacking_console_2 = true
			start_coroutine(self.hacking_console_2_interactive_event, self)
		else
			start_coroutine(self.hacking_console_reinteractive_event, self, e.Target.Name)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_mini_game_end_event(e)
	-- 미니게임 종료
	if e.Name == self.mini_game_name and (self.mini_game_1_play or self.mini_game_2_play) then
		start_coroutine(self.end_mini_game, self, e.Success)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

-- 테스트 용도
function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
		if e.Zone.Name == self.crosselle_briefing_zone and
				self.interacted_object == false then
			self.interacted_object = true
			if self.clear_acting_1 == false then
				start_coroutine(self.party_teleport_1, self)
				--start_coroutine(self.party_teleport_3, self)
			elseif self.clear_acting_2 == false then
				start_coroutine(self.party_teleport_2, self)
			end

			return true
		elseif e.Zone.Name == self.crosselle_briefing_zone_1_name then
			if not self.crosselle_briefing_check_list[self.crosselle_briefing.zone_1] then
				start_coroutine(self.show_crosselle_briefing, self, self.crosselle_briefing.zone_1)
				self.crosselle_briefing_check_list[self.crosselle_briefing.zone_1] = true
				return true
			end
		elseif e.Zone.Name == self.crosselle_briefing_zone_2_name then
			if not self.crosselle_briefing_check_list[self.crosselle_briefing.zone_2] then
				if self.cur_inner_section_progress == self.inner_section_progress.s2_1 then
					start_coroutine(self.show_crosselle_briefing, self, self.crosselle_briefing.zone_2)
					self.crosselle_briefing_check_list[self.crosselle_briefing.zone_2] = true
					return true
				end
			end
		elseif e.Zone.Name == self.crosselle_briefing_zone_3_name then
			if not self.crosselle_briefing_check_list[self.crosselle_briefing.zone_3] then
				start_coroutine(self.show_crosselle_briefing, self, self.crosselle_briefing.zone_3)
				self.crosselle_briefing_check_list[self.crosselle_briefing.zone_3] = true
				return true
			end
		end

		if self.cur_inner_section_progress ~= nil then
			-- 자석 도둑 이벤트 체크
			if self.cur_inner_section_progress <= self.inner_section_progress.s2_1 then
				if e.Zone.Name == self.magnet_thief_event_zone..self.meet_thieves_zone_num
						and self.current_magnet_thief_event_state == self.magnet_thief_event_state.none then
					start_coroutine(self.start_magnet_thief_scene, self)
					return true
				elseif (e.Zone.Name == self.magnet_thief_event_zone..self.away_magnet_s_thief_zone_num..self.away_magnet_s_thief_down_side_zone
						or e.Zone.Name == self.magnet_thief_event_zone..self.away_magnet_s_thief_zone_num..self.away_magnet_s_thief_up_side_zone)
						and self.magnet_s_thief_state == self.thief_invader_state.idle then
					self.magnet_s_thief_state = self.thief_invader_state.run
					start_coroutine(self.run_away_magnet_thief, self, self.magnet_s_thief_num)

					return true
				elseif e.Zone.Name == self.magnet_thief_event_zone..self.away_magnet_n_thief_zone_num
						and self.magnet_n_thief_state == self.thief_invader_state.idle then
					self.magnet_n_thief_state = self.thief_invader_state.run
					start_coroutine(self.run_away_magnet_thief, self, self.magnet_n_thief_num)

					return true
				end
			elseif self.cur_inner_section_progress == self.inner_section_progress.s2_2 then
				if e.Zone.Name == self.magnet_thief_event_zone..self.away_magnet_n_thief_zone_num
						and self.magnet_n_thief_state == self.thief_invader_state.idle then
					self.magnet_n_thief_state = self.thief_invader_state.run
					start_coroutine(self.run_away_magnet_thief, self, self.magnet_n_thief_num)

					return true

				end
			end
		end
	end

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.get_s2_thief_invader(1)) then
		if e.Zone.Name == self.magnet_n_thief_last_event_zone and
				self.magnet_n_thief_state == self.thief_invader_state.run_away_complete and not self.interacted_object then
			self.interacted_object = true
			self.current_magnet_thief_event_state = self.magnet_thief_event_state.get_last_magnet
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.magnet_n_last_event, self)
			return true
		end
	end

	local metal_block_1 = self.get_metal_block(1)
	local metal_block_2 = self.get_metal_block(2)

	if self.cur_inner_section_progress ~= nil and
			self.cur_inner_section_progress < self.inner_section_progress.s2_3 then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, metal_block_1) or
				lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, metal_block_2) then
			if e.Zone.Name == self.metal_block_catapult_zone_1_name or e.Zone.Name == self.metal_block_catapult_zone_2_name then
				self.iron_block_enter_jump_zone = true

				local jump_point_index = self.block_jump_point.up_side
				if e.Zone.Name == self.metal_block_catapult_zone_1_name then
					jump_point_index = self.block_jump_point.up_side
				elseif e.Zone.Name == self.metal_block_catapult_zone_2_name then
					jump_point_index = self.block_jump_point.down_side
				end

				if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, metal_block_1) then
					self.jump_zone_iron_block_num = 1
					self.shoot_up_side_iron_block = true
				elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, metal_block_2) then
					self.jump_zone_iron_block_num = 2
					self.shoot_down_side_iron_block = true
				end

				start_coroutine(self.call_flying_iron_block_func, self, self.jump_zone_iron_block_num, jump_point_index)

				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_magnet_n()) then

-- 액팅 미니게임 시작 함수
function local_class:call_acting_minigame()

	local is_mini_game_load_complete = false
	local acting_area = ''

	if not self.clear_acting_1 then
		acting_area = '_s14_s1'
		self.mini_game_1_play = true
	elseif not self.clear_acting_2 then
		acting_area = '_s14_s2'
		self.mini_game_2_play = true
	else
		acting_area = '_s14_c'
	end

	self.saved_leader_pos = user_party.Leader.Position

	--wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 미니게임 불러옴
	self.minigame = mini_game_manager:GetOrCreate(self.mini_game_name)

	mini_game_manager:LoadResource(self.mini_game_name, stage.Name..acting_area, function()
		is_mini_game_load_complete = true
	end)

	--CS.UnityEngine.Debug.Log('mini game key : '..stage.Name..acting_area)

	-- 미니게임이 로드 다되면
	while not is_mini_game_load_complete do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
	coroutine.yield(nil)

	quest_marker_util.remove(self.controller.quest_marker_name..1)
	quest_marker_util.remove(self.controller.quest_marker_name..2)

	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	-- 미니게임 시작
	mini_game_manager:StartMiniGame(self.mini_game_name)
end

function local_class:end_mini_game(is_success)
	if self.saved_leader_pos ~= nil then
		party_util.position_party(self.saved_leader_pos, 'right', 'linear')
	end

	if is_success then
		start_coroutine(self.success_acting_by_timeline, self)
	else
		start_coroutine(self.failed_acting_by_timeline, self)
	end

	if self.mini_game_1_play then
		self.mini_game_1_play = false
	end

	if self.mini_game_2_play then
		self.mini_game_2_play = false
	end
end

	local magnet_s = self.get_magnet_s()

	character_util.set_active_state(thief_2, 'enabled')

	character_util.set_position(thief_2, self.get_s2_thief_pos(2, 1))

	scene_util.set_direction(thief_2, 'left', false)

	magnet_s.Position = thief_2.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0)

			0.5, nil, false, true)
	character_util.move_to_async(thief_2, self.get_s2_thief_pos(2, 3),

-- 자석 도둑 인베이더들 각각의 장소로 도망
function local_class:run_away_magnet_thief(thief_num)
	local thief_invader = self.get_s2_thief_invader(thief_num)

	if thief_num == 1 then
		wait_for_sec(0.08)
	elseif thief_num == 2 then
		wait_for_sec(0.25)
	end

	scene_util.set_direction(thief_invader, 'right', false)

	if thief_num == 1 then

		--character_util.jump_move(thief_invader,
		--		self.get_s2_thief_pos(1, 3) + vector(3, 0, 0),
		--		6, 2, true, 'right')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')
		self:move_field_object(thief_invader, 0.7, thief_invader.Position, self.get_s2_thief_pos(1, 3) + vector(3, 0, 0), 1.5, false)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_land_01')

		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		local run_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_dash_01', loop = true })

		local wp_pos_1 = thief_invader.Position + vector(5, 0, 0)
		local wp_pos_2 = wp_pos_1 + vector(0, 0, 2)
		local wp_pos_3 = self.get_s2_thief_pos(1, 4)
		wp_util.move_waypoint_async(thief_invader, { wp_pos_1, wp_pos_2, wp_pos_3 },
				8, true, nil,
				nil, 'right', false)

		run_sfx:Stop()

		self.backup_thief_1_hitbox = thief_invader.Hitbox
		thief_invader.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(0.5, 0, 0.5), vector(0.45, 0.75, 0.45))

		self.magnet_n_thief_state = self.thief_invader_state.run_away_complete

	elseif thief_num == 2 then

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')
		self:move_field_object(thief_invader, 0.7, thief_invader.Position, self.get_s2_thief_pos(2, 4), 1.5, false)
		scene_util.set_direction(thief_invader, 'left', false)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_land_01')

function local_class:move_field_object(throw_obj, duration, start_pos, end_pos, height, camera_active)
	local time_passed = 0
	-- 카메라 이동을 실행했는지 체크
	local camera_move_start = false
	local cur_y = 0

	while time_passed < duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if camera_active then
			if time_passed > 0.2 and not camera_move_start then
				camera_move_start = true
				camera_util.move(end_pos, duration - 0.1)
			end
		end

		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)

		cur_y = unity_class.mathf.Sin(unity_class.mathf.PI * progress) * height

		if cur_y <= 0 then cur_y = 0 end

		throw_obj.Position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress) + cur_y * unity_class.vector3.up

		-- loop escape
		if self.loop_escape then
			return
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.moving_magnet_n = false
end

function local_class:check_magnet_n_distance()
	local leader = user_party.Leader
	local thief_1 = self.get_s2_thief_invader(1)
	local magnet_active_distance = self.magnet_n_range_radius

	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(thief_1, 'tired')

	while self.hold_up_magnet_s do
		local diff = (user_party.Leader.Position - thief_1.Position):GetX0z()

		if diff.magnitude < magnet_active_distance and self.magnet_n_thief_state == self.thief_invader_state.run_away_complete then
			self:thief_move_by_one_frame(thief_1, thief_1.Position, leader.Position, 1.5)
			self:show_drag_thief_invader_ment()

			if not self.magnet_effect_on then
				self.magnet_effect_on = true
				-- N극 도둑 인베이더가 들고 있는 자석 이펙트 on
				self.get_magnet_s().Transform:GetChild(2).gameObject:SetActive(true)
				self.get_magnet_n().Transform:GetChild(2).gameObject:SetActive(true)
			end
		else
			self.time_to_be_dragged = 0
			self.dragged_thief_invader_ment_index = 1

			if self.magnet_effect_on then
				self.magnet_effect_on = false
				-- N극 도둑 인베이더가 들고 있는 자석 이펙트 on
				self.get_magnet_s().Transform:GetChild(2).gameObject:SetActive(false)
				self.get_magnet_n().Transform:GetChild(2).gameObject:SetActive(false)
			end
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:thief_move_by_one_frame(fo, pos_from, pos_to, speed)
	local dir = (pos_to - pos_from).normalized

	fo.Direction = vector_util.to_direction(dir)
	local move_result = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameStageLogic.ExecuteMove(
			fo,
			dir,
			speed * unity_class.time.deltaTime)

	if move_result.stopper ~= nil then
		local xComponent = vector(dir.x, 0, 0)
		local zComponent = vector(0, 0, dir.z)
		local rem = ((speed * unity_class.time.deltaTime) - move_result.distance)

		if rem > 0 and xComponent.magnitude > 0 and zComponent.magnitude > 0 then
			local xOverlap = CS.BoundsExtensions.GetXOverap(fo.Bounds, move_result.stopper.Bounds)
			local zOverlap = CS.BoundsExtensions.GetZOverap(fo.Bounds, move_result.stopper.Bounds)
			if xOverlap < zOverlap then
				CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameStageLogic.ExecuteMove(
						fo,
						zComponent.normalized,
						rem * zComponent.magnitude)
			else
				CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameStageLogic.ExecuteMove(
						fo,
						xComponent.normalized,
						rem * xComponent.magnitude)
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:show_drag_thief_invader_ment()
	local thief_1 = self.get_s2_thief_invader(1)

	self.time_to_be_dragged = self.time_to_be_dragged + unity_class.time.deltaTime

	if self.dragged_thief_invader_ment_index <= #self.dragged_thief_invader_ment_info then
		local ment_info = self.dragged_thief_invader_ment_info[self.dragged_thief_invader_ment_index]
		if self.time_to_be_dragged > ment_info.ment_show_time then
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(thief_1, { key = self.s2_string_key..ment_info.string_key_index, skip = false})

			-- 첫번째 멘트 시 사운드 재생
			if self.dragged_thief_invader_ment_index == 1 then
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
			elseif self.dragged_thief_invader_ment_index == 2 then
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
			elseif self.dragged_thief_invader_ment_index == 3 then
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
			end

			self.dragged_thief_invader_ment_index = self.dragged_thief_invader_ment_index + 1
		end
	end
end

function local_class:magnet_n_last_event()
	local leader = user_party.Leader
	local thief_1 = self.get_s2_thief_invader(1)

	self.hold_up_magnet_s = false
	self.clear_s2_magnet_thief_event = true

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	-- 도둑 인베이더 1 자석 놓기
	local magnet
	if thief_1.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentActionState ~= nil and
			lua_helper.type_compare(thief_1.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentActionState, CS.Oak.CharacterHoldUpState) then
		magnet = thief_1.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentActionState.HoldTarget
		if magnet ~= nil then
			character_util.release_hold_object(thief_1, magnet)
		end
	end

	magnet.Position = vector(magnet.Position.x, 1.1, magnet.Position.z)

	self.get_fx_hit():Instantiate(thief_1.Position)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_big_01')

	-- 인베이더 1 : 끄아아아악!!!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(user_party.Leader, { key = self.s2_string_key..5,
													 bubble_type = 'shout', world_pos = thief_1.Position,
													 skip = false})

	-- air spin
	character_util.air_spin(thief_1)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_villain_scream_01')

	self.moving_magnet_n = true
	local magnet_n_end_pos = self.get_reset_magnet_n_pos()
	sp_util.sine_move(magnet, { from = magnet.Position, to = magnet_n_end_pos,
								duration = 0.35, height = 1.25 })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bounce_iron_03')

	-- 자석 이펙트 off
	self.get_magnet_s().Transform:GetChild(2).gameObject:SetActive(false)
	self.get_magnet_n().Transform:GetChild(2).gameObject:SetActive(false)

	-- 자석 리셋 버튼 활성화
	self:enable_magnet_reset_switch()

	self.magnet_s_area_on = false
	self.magnet_s_switch_lock = false
	self.magnet_n_area_on = false
	self.magnet_n_switch_lock = false

	wait_for_sec(1)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'up', false)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 자석 자성 on 이벤트
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.MagnetManualOnOffEvent.Create(self.get_magnet_n(), magnet_manual_active_state['none']))
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.MagnetManualOnOffEvent.Create(self.get_magnet_s(), magnet_manual_active_state['none']))

	self.interacted_object = false

	local update_progress_num = self.inner_section_progress.s2_3
	self:update_inner_section_progress(update_progress_num)

	coroutine.yield(nil)
	coroutine.yield(nil)

	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(user_party.Leader)

	self.magnet_loop = false
end

function local_class:reset_magnet_thief_area_setting(switch_index)
	local invader_moving = false
	if self.shoot_up_side_iron_block and self.magnet_event_iron_block_reset.iron_block_1 == switch_index then
		self.shoot_up_side_iron_block = false
		invader_moving = true
	elseif self.shoot_down_side_iron_block and self.magnet_event_iron_block_reset.iron_block_2 == switch_index then
		self.shoot_down_side_iron_block = false
		invader_moving = true
	end



	if not self.clear_s2_magnet_thief_event and invader_moving then
		local thief_2 = self.get_s2_thief_invader(2)

		self.iron_block_jump_count = self.iron_block_jump_count - 1

		character_util.move_to(thief_2, self.get_s2_thief_pos(2, 4),
				0.5, nil, true, true)
	end
end

end

function local_class:show_magnet_area()
	local magnet_s = self.get_magnet_s()
	local magnet_n = self.get_magnet_n()
	self.magnet_n_zone = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(magnet_n.Position, self.magnet_n_range_radius,
			self.magnet_n_range_light_color, self.magnet_n_range_dark_color)

	self.magnet_s_zone = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(magnet_s.Position, self.magnet_s_range_radius,
			self.magnet_s_range_light_color, self.magnet_s_range_dark_color)

	self.magnet_loop = true

	self.magnet_n_zone:Hide()
	self.magnet_s_zone:Hide()

	while self.magnet_loop do
		magnet_n = self.get_magnet_n()
		magnet_s = self.get_magnet_s()

		--self.magnet_n_zone:SetupByPosition(magnet_n.Position, magnet_n.Position.y)
		attack_range_util.setup_by_position(self.magnet_n_zone, magnet_n.Position, 0)
		--self.magnet_s_zone:SetupByPosition(magnet_s.Position, magnet_s.Position.y)
		attack_range_util.setup_by_position(self.magnet_s_zone, magnet_s.Position, 0)

		if self.magnet_s_area_on and not self.magnet_s_switch_lock then
			self.magnet_s_switch_lock = true
			self.magnet_s_zone:Show(0)
		end

		if self.magnet_n_area_on and not self.magnet_n_switch_lock then
			self.magnet_n_switch_lock = true
			self.magnet_n_zone:Show(0)
		end

		if not self.magnet_s_area_on and not self.magnet_s_switch_lock then
			self.magnet_s_switch_lock = true
			self.magnet_s_zone:Hide(0)
		end

		if not self.magnet_n_area_on and not self.magnet_n_switch_lock then
			self.magnet_n_switch_lock = true
			self.magnet_n_zone:Hide(0)
		end

		-- loop escape
		if self.loop_escape then
			return
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:check_rock_collision()
	local pymon = self.get_pymon()

	local collide_fos = CS.Oak.LuaCollisionUtil.GetFieldObjectsCollidedBy(
			pymon.Bounds.center, pymon.Bounds)

	for i = 0, collide_fos.Count - 1 do
		local fo = collide_fos[i]
		if (fo.EntityGroup & CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle) == CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle and fo.ActiveState ~= active_state('disabled') then
			collide_fos:Dispose()
			fo.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
			self.get_fx_rock_cresh():Instantiate(fo.Position)
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_rock_break_03')
			camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.3)
			return true
		end

	collide_fos:Dispose()
	return false

			self.interacted_object = true
			--start_coroutine(self.main_event, self)
		end
	end

			self.interacted_object = true
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.enter_s15_restricted_area, self)
		elseif e.Zone.Name == self.s15_main_event_zone_name and self.interacted_object == false then
			if not self.s15_in_progress then

	local invader_list = {}
	invader_list[self.attack_invader_index.attacker_1] = self.get_s16_invader(self.attack_invader_index.attacker_1)
	invader_list[self.attack_invader_index.attacker_2] = self.get_s16_invader(self.attack_invader_index.attacker_2)

	self:andras_attack(andras, invader_list[self.attack_invader_index.attacker_3], self.andras_attack_order.dualgun_victory)

function local_class:andras_attack(andras, target, attack_num)
	local ani_scale = 2
	local attack_ani_name = nil
	if attack_num == self.andras_attack_order.two_hand_attack_1 then
		attack_ani_name = 'twohand_attack'
	elseif attack_num == self.andras_attack_order.two_hand_attack_2 then
		attack_ani_name = 'twohand_attack2'
		ani_scale = 2
	elseif attack_num == self.andras_attack_order.dualgun_victory then
		attack_ani_name = 'twohand_attack'
		ani_scale = 2
	end

	camera_util.shake(0.05, 0.3)

	character_util.set_anim(andras, { name = attack_ani_name, scale = ani_scale, sfx = '01_swing_01', loop = false })
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	character_util.stop(target)
	character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(target)
	character_util.air_spin(target)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_ice_ridge_03')
	local effect = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_iceflower'):Instantiate(target.Position)
	effect.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0.5

	-- 3초뒤에 얼음 이펙트가 터지기 때문에 딜레이 줘서 재생 시키기
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_break_window_01', loop = false, delayed_time = 2 })

	-- 3번째 안드라스 이펙트 실행 시점에 볼트 표정 변경
	if attack_num == self.andras_attack_order.dualgun_victory then
		local volt = self.get_magwi()
		character_util.set_emotion(volt, { name = 'surprise' })
		character_util.normal_jump(volt, false)
	end
end

function local_class:destroy_magnet()
	local manual_character = party_manager.UserParty.Leader
	local leader_state = manual_character.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentActionState
	local held = nil
	if lua_helper.type_compare(leader_state, CS.Oak.CharacterHoldUpState) then
		held = manual_character.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentActionState.HoldTarget
	end

	if held then
		command_util.execute_throw(manual_character, held, vector(1, 0, 0),
				manual_character.Position + vector(2, 0, 0), 4, false)
	end
end

function local_class:dispose_shake_sfx()
	if self.shake_sfx ~= nil then
		self.shake_sfx:Stop()
		self.shake_sfx = nil
	end

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('QueenShipMainSection17')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = QueenShipMain @
		Comment = 5스테이지 파이몬과 안드라스의 갈등 시작 @
		Index = 16 @
		NextSections = 17 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	self.available_stage_name = {
		'queenship_1_4',
		'queenship_1_5'
	}
	self.stage_4_name = 'queenship_1_4'

	-- character
	self.get_fx_hit = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit') end

	-- 안드라스와 파이몬 갈등 연출 존 이름
	self.event_zone_name = 's17_conflict_event_zone'

	-- 이벤트 존이름
	self.auto_event_zone_name = 's17_auto_event_'

	-- s17_conflict_event_zone에 들어왔는지?
	self.is_zone_enter = false

	-- 트리거존에 입장시 날라올 인베이더들 + 파이몬이 던지는 인베이더
	self.flying_invader_list = nil

	-- 인베이더 날라가는 연출 보았는지?
	self.is_show_invader_event = { false, false }

	-- 스테이지가 종료 됐는지?
	self.is_stage_end = false
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	if self.stage_4_name == stage.Name then
		return
	end

	self.get_fx_hit()

	-- 타임라인 Playable Load
	timeline_util.load_playable('qs_main_s17_1', 'qs_main_s17_2')
end

function local_class:enter()
	if self.stage_4_name == stage.Name then
		quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.controller.quest_marker_name, get_field_object('clear_exit'), true)

		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_custom_stage_event')
		return
	end

	timeline_table.register_action('pymon_muscle_show', self.pymon_muscle_show, self)

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent), 'on_stage_end_event')

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if self.stage_4_name == stage.Name then
		return
	end

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.directing_start, self))
end

function local_class:exit()
	if self.stage_4_name == stage.Name then
		-- 4스테이지 내 마커 제거
		quest_marker_util.remove(self.controller.quest_marker_name)

		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))
		return
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent))

	timeline_table.unregister_action('pymon_muscle_show')
	self.is_show_invader_event = nil

	-- 동적 생성 npc 제거
	if self.flying_invader_list ~= nil then
		load_util.dispose_dynamic_npcs(self.flying_invader_list)
		self.flying_invader_list = nil
	end

	local andras = self.controller.get_andras()
	character_util.set_position(andras, vector(999, 0, 999))
	character_util.set_active_state(andras, 'disabled')

	local pymon = self.controller.get_pymon()
	character_util.set_position(pymon, vector(999, 0, 999))
	character_util.set_active_state(pymon, 'disabled')

	quest_marker_util.remove(self.controller.quest_marker_name)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.event_zone_name)
			and not self.is_zone_enter then
		self.is_zone_enter = true
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(self.show_conflict_event, self)
		return true
	end

	local auto_event_count = 2
	for i = 1, auto_event_count do
		if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.auto_event_zone_name .. i)
				and self.is_show_invader_event[i] == false then
			self.is_show_invader_event[i] = true
			self:directing_fiying_invader(i)
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_stage_end_event(_)
	self.is_stage_end = true
	return false
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	-- 4스테이지 내 3번째 액팅 실행 시 마커 컨트롤
	if self.stage_4_name == stage.Name then
		if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'stage_4_third_acting_start' then
			quest_marker_util.remove(self.controller.quest_marker_name)
		elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == 'stage_4_third_acting_end' then
			quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.controller.quest_marker_name, get_field_object('clear_exit'), true)
		end
	end
end

--endregion

-- 시작 연출 이벤트
function local_class:directing_start()
	local first_invader_name = 's17_dead_invader_1_'
	local first_dead_count = 8
	for i = 5, first_dead_count do
		local cur_name = first_invader_name .. i
		local dead_invader = get_character(cur_name)
		dead_invader.SpineController.AlwaysUpdateSpine = true
		character_util.add_color(dead_invader, cur_name, unity_class.color.black, 1, 0)
	end

	local invader_name = 's17_dead_invader_'
	local second_dead_count = 5

	for i = 6, second_dead_count do
		local cur_name = invader_name .. i
		local dead_invader = get_character(cur_name)
		dead_invader.SpineController.AlwaysUpdateSpine = true
		character_util.add_color(dead_invader, cur_name, unity_class.color.black, 1, 0)
	end

	-- hp 바 튀는게 보여서 2프레임 쉬고 연출 시작
	coroutine.yield(nil)
	coroutine.yield(nil)

	for i = 5, first_dead_count do
		local cur_name = first_invader_name .. i
		local dead_invader = get_character(cur_name)
		dead_invader.SpineController.AlwaysUpdateSpine = false
	end

	for i = 1, second_dead_count do
		local cur_name = invader_name .. i
		local dead_invader = get_character(cur_name)
		if i < 6 then
			dead_invader.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', 'rail_shot_rifle')
			dead_invader.CustomIdleAnimationName = 'rifle_idle'
			character_util.remove_anim(dead_invader)
			character_util.set_anim(dead_invader, { name = 'rifle_idle' })
		end
		dead_invader.SpineController.AlwaysUpdateSpine = false
	end

	-- s17_1 시작
	timeline_util.play_async('qs_main_s17_1', 'qs_main_s17_1')

	self:pre_setting()
end

function local_class:pre_setting()

	local andras = self.controller.get_andras()

	character_util.set_position(andras, andras_pos)

	self.flying_invader_list = load_util.create_dynamic_npcs_async({

function local_class:directing_fiying_invader(index)

function local_class:first_flying_invader()
	local target_pos = vector(24, 0, -1)
	local invader_1 = self.flying_invader_list['flying_invader_1']
	invader_1.OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance
	character_util.set_direction(invader_1, 'right')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(invader_1)

	character_util.set_position(invader_1, target_pos + unity_class.vector3.back * 7)
	character_util.set_active_state(invader_1, 'enabled')

	yield_return_func(self.flying_invader_routine, self, invader_1, target_pos, 0.4)
	invader_1.OverrideCrashBehaviour = nil
	wait_for_sec(0.4)

	target_pos = vector(26, 0, -2)
	local invader_2 = self.flying_invader_list['flying_invader_2']
	invader_2.OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance

	character_util.set_direction(invader_2, 'left')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(invader_2)

	character_util.set_position(invader_2, target_pos + unity_class.vector3.back * 7)
	character_util.set_active_state(invader_2, 'enabled')
	yield_return_func(self.flying_invader_routine, self, invader_2, target_pos, 0.4)

function local_class:second_flying_invader()
	local target_pos = vector(23, 0, -4)
	local invader = self.flying_invader_list['flying_invader_3']
	invader.OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(invader)
	character_util.set_direction(invader, 'right')
	character_util.set_anim(invader, { name = 'unique/only_head' })
	character_util.set_position(invader, target_pos + unity_class.vector3.back * 7)
	character_util.set_active_state(invader, 'enabled')

	yield_return_func(self.flying_invader_routine, self, invader, target_pos, 0.4)
	invader.OverrideCrashBehaviour = nil
end

function local_class:flying_invader_routine(invader, target_pos, duration)
	local start_pos = invader.Position
	local end_pos = target_pos
	local time_passed = 0

	local is_shake = false
	while time_passed <= duration and not self.is_stage_end do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutQuad(time_passed, 0, 1, duration))
		local cur_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, target_pos, progress)
		character_util.set_position(invader, vector_util.get_x0z(cur_pos), true)

		if progress > 0.98 and not is_shake then
			is_shake = true
			local leader = user_party.Leader
			if (leader.Position - invader.Position).magnitude < 8 then
				camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.15)
			end

			self.get_fx_hit():Instantiate(invader.Position + vector(0, 0.3, -0.1))
			music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_trip_03', loop = false, play_pos = invader.Position })
			character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(invader)
			character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(invader)
			character_util.remove_emotion(invader)
			character_util.jump(invader, 0.25, 0.2)
			wait_for_sec(0.2)
			character_util.add_color(invader, invader.Name, unity_class.color.black, 1, 1)
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	character_util.set_position(invader, end_pos)
end

	-- 다음 섹션으로

	end

	end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 's18_event_zone_1')

		self.current_state = self.section_state.enter_event_grid

	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 's18_event_zone_2')

		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 's18_event_zone_3')
			and self.current_state < self.section_state.choose_kill_invader then
		self.current_state = self.section_state.choose_kill_invader

-- 자동 이벤트 끝내는 함수
function local_class:stop_auto_event()

	if timeline_util.is_playing('qs_main_s18_1') then
		timeline_util.stop('qs_main_s18_1')
	end
