-- 파이몬 자동 이벤트 재생
function local_class:pymon_auto_event()
	-- 혹시 재생중일 수도 있으니 stop 시킨다.
	timeline_util.stop('qs_main_s18_1')
	local pymon = self.controller.get_pymon()
	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(pymon)

	local wait_for_sec_routine = function(time)
		local s = unity_class.time.time
		while unity_class.time.time - s < time do
			if not self.is_play_auto_event then
				break
			end
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end

	if self.is_show_shout == false then
		wait_for_sec_routine(0.25)

		if not self.is_play_auto_event then
			return
		end

		-- 이런 송사리 같은 놈들...!
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(pymon, { name = 'dagger_idle' }, { name = 'attack' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(pymon, { key = self.string_key .. 1, force_sfx = true
		, lower_priority = true })

		if not self.is_play_auto_event then
			return
		end

		-- 언제까지 버틸 수 있나 보자!
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(pymon, { key = self.string_key .. 2, force_sfx = true
		, lower_priority = true })

		if not self.is_play_auto_event then
			return
		end

		self.is_show_shout = true
	end

	while self.is_play_auto_event do
		timeline_util.play_async('qs_main_s18_1', 'qs_main_s18_1')
		wait_for_sec_routine(2)
	end
end

function local_class:invader_auto_event()
	if self.invader_npc_list == nil then
		return
	end

	local duration = 0
	local boss_invader = self.invader_npc_list['invader_soldier_1']
	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(boss_invader)

	while self.is_play_auto_event do
		duration = duration + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		if duration > 10 then
			-- 더 이상 뚫리면 안 된다!
			character_util.set_anim(boss_invader, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(boss_invader,
					{ key = self.string_key .. 3 })

			if self.is_play_auto_event == false then
				break
			end

			-- 목숨 걸고 막아!!
			character_util.set_anim(boss_invader, { name = 'cast2' })
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(boss_invader,
					{ key = self.string_key .. 4, bubble_type = 'shout' })
			character_util.set_anim(boss_invader, { name = 'shoot' })

			duration = 0
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

-- 파이몬이 돌진하는 연출
function local_class:pymon_rush_event()
	self.current_state = self.section_state.broken_wall_pymon

	-- 카메라가 파이몬쪽으로
	self.is_play_auto_event = false
	local pymon = self.controller.get_pymon()

	-- 파이몬 연출 멈춤
	self:stop_auto_event()
	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(pymon)
	coroutine.yield(nil)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5, 2)
	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(camera_util.move_async, field:GetMarker(self.pymon_pos_marker_name .. 1).position
		, 0.5, { end_target = pymon }),
		util.cs_generator(character_util.move_to_async, pymon, field:GetMarker(self.pymon_pos_marker_name .. 1).position
		, nil, 3, false, true)
	})

	-- 격벽 오픈하면 인베이더 병력들 (left, scared jumpx1), 파이몬(가디언 방향, attack, jumpx1)
	local invader_count = 8
	for i = 1, invader_count do
		local invader = self.invader_npc_list['invader_soldier_' .. i]
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(invader)
		character_util.set_emotion(invader, { name = 'scared' })
		character_util.normal_jump(invader, true)

		if i == 1 then
			speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(invader)
		end

	end
	character_util.set_direction(pymon, 'down')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(pymon, { name = 'cast2' }, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.normal_jump(pymon, true)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 기사, 공주 파이몬 아래로 정렬
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		local pos = vector(47.5 - i, 0, -16.5)
		wp_util.move(user_party[i], pos, nil, 0.5, { last_direction = 'up' })
	end
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	timeline_util.play_async('qs_main_s18_1', 'qs_main_s18_2')

	pymon.OverrideCrashBehaviour = nil
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(pymon)
	character_util.set_active_state(pymon, 'disabled')

	for i = 1, invader_count do
		local invader = self.invader_npc_list['invader_soldier_' .. i]
		character_util.set_position(invader, vector(999, 0, 999))
		character_util.set_active_state(invader, 'disabled')
	end

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1, 2)

	self.is_show_shout = false
end

function local_class:show_invader_shout()
	if self.invader_npc_list == nil then
		return
	end

	camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.2)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_male_shout_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.invader_npc_list['invader_soldier_1']
	, { key = self.string_key .. 4, world_pos = vector(49, 0, -15.5), lower_priority = true
			, bubble_type = 'shout', bubble_direction = 'ct', scale = 1.4 })
end

function local_class:show_trapped_invader_shout()
	-- 5초간격으로 도와달라고 외치는 연출 시작
	if self.current_state == self.section_state.show_trapped_invader then
		start_coroutine(self.start_trapped_invader_auto_event, self)
	end
end

function local_class:start_trapped_invader_auto_event()
	if self.is_play_auto_event then
		return
	end

	self.is_play_auto_event = true

	-- 누가 문 좀 열어줘!!
	if self.is_show_shout == false then
		local release_invader = self.get_andras_invader(3)
		character_util.remove_anim(release_invader)
		character_util.set_anim(release_invader, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })

		local invader = self.get_andras_invader(1)
		speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(invader)

		camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.2)

		local target_pos = vector(55, 0, -29)
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_sadness_02', play_pos = target_pos })
		
		-- 보이스 재생
		music_player:PlayDialogue('qs_main_s18_0')
		
		-- 누가 문 좀 열어줘!!
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(invader, { key = self.string_key .. 0, bubble_type = 'shout'
		, world_pos = target_pos, scale = 1.3, dialogue = false })

		if not self.is_play_auto_event then
			return
		end

		self.is_show_shout = true
	end

	local cur_index = 10
	local target_index = 1
	local time_passed = 0
	while self.is_play_auto_event do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		if time_passed > 5 then
			local invader = self.get_andras_invader(target_index)
			if cur_index == 10 then
				music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_sadness_02', play_pos = invader.Position })
			end
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(invader
			, { key = self.string_key .. cur_index, bubble_type = 'shout' })

			cur_index = cur_index == 10 and 11 or 10
			target_index = target_index == 1 and 3 or 1
			time_passed = 0
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:beheaded_invader_event()
	self.is_play_auto_event = false
	wait_for_sec(0.05)

	-- 스위치 누르면 흰색2,3,4(right, scared, jumpx1)
	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(self.get_andras_invader(1))

	local invader_count = 4
	for i = 2, invader_count do
		local invader = self.get_andras_invader(i)
		speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(invader)

		character_util.remove_anim(invader)
		character_util.set_emotion(invader, { name = 'scared' })

		character_util.normal_jump(invader, true)
		character_util.set_direction(invader, 'right')
	end
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	local andras = self.controller.get_andras()
	andras.OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance

	timeline_util.play_async('qs_main_s18_1', 'qs_main_s18_3')
end

function local_class:choose_kill_invader_routine()
	self.is_play_auto_event = false
	wait_for_sec(0.25)

	local invader_list = {}
	local invader_count = 5
	for i = 1, invader_count do
		local invader = self.get_andras_invader_2(i)
		table.insert(invader_list, invader)
	end

		, 1, nil, false, true)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_twohand_stomp_jump_01', loop = false, parent = andras })

function local_class:start_invader_conflict_auto_event(invader)
	if self.is_play_auto_event then
		return
	end

	-- 2초에 1타일씩 전진(최대 2타일)
	invader.CustomWalkAnimationName = 'walk4legs'
	character_util.remove_anim(invader)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	wp_util.move(invader, invader.Position + unity_class.vector3.right * 2, nil, 4
	, {
				callback = function()
					music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_hit_npc_01')
					character_util.shake(invader, 0.02, 99999)
					character_util.set_anim(invader, { name = 'prostrate' })
				end
			})

	self.is_play_auto_event = true
	local cur_index = 15
	local is_voice_available = music_player_util.is_voice_available()

	local time_passed = 0
	while self.is_play_auto_event do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		if time_passed > 3 then
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(invader, { key = self.string_key .. cur_index })
			cur_index = cur_index == 15 and 16 or 15

			-- 보이스가 있다면 2초 더 대기
			time_passed = is_voice_available and -2 or 0
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

	timeline_table.register_action('pause_leader_spine', function()
		user_party.Leader.SpineController.TimeScale = 0
	end, self)

	timeline_table.register_action('play_leader_spine', function()
		user_party.Leader.SpineController.TimeScale = 1
	end, self)

	timeline_table.register_action('broken_wall', function()
		self:broken_wall(true)
	end, self)

	-- 세팅
	self:pre_setting()

	-- 파이몬 벽 세팅
	self:broken_wall(false)

	-- 19섹션 연출용 문 닫히도록
	local door_name = 'ship_door_'
	local door_count = 2
	for i = 1, door_count do
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create(door_name .. i))
	end

	-- 고정식 화로 직접 관리하도록 변경
	for i = 1, 2 do
		local brazier = get_field_object('s19_brazier_' .. i)
		brazier.CombustibleBehaviour = CS.Oak.BrazierCombustibleBehaviour()
		brazier.CombustibleBehaviour.IsAffectedBurn = false
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create('s19_door_1'))
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.SwitchOnOffEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent))

	timeline_table.unregister_action('pause_leader_spine')
	timeline_table.unregister_action('play_leader_spine')
	timeline_table.unregister_action('broken_wall')

	quest_marker_util.remove(self.controller.quest_marker_name)

	-- 동적 생성 npc 제거
	if self.invader_npc_list ~= nil then
		for key in pairs(self.invader_npc_list) do
			timeline_util.clear_character_key(key)
		end

		load_util.dispose_dynamic_npcs(self.invader_npc_list)
		self.invader_npc_list = nil
	end

	self.pymon_waypoint_list = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 's19_one_line_event_1')
			and self.current_state < self.section_state.show_first_auto_event then
		-- 원라인 자동 이벤트 ( 스크린 샤우트 이벤트)
		self.current_state = self.section_state.show_first_auto_event
		start_coroutine(self.first_one_line_event, self)
		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 's19_one_line_event_2')
			and self.current_state < self.section_state.show_second_auto_event then
		-- 원라인 자동 이벤트 (npc 자동 이벤트)
		self.current_state = self.section_state.show_second_auto_event
		start_coroutine(self.second_one_line_event, self)
		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, self.pymon_event_zone_name .. 1)
			and self.current_state <= self.section_state.show_second_auto_event then
		-- 파이몬 퍼즐 이벤트 시작
		self.current_state = self.section_state.start_pymon_puzzle
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(self.start_pymon_puzzle_event, self)
		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, self.pymon_event_zone_name .. 2)
			and self.current_state <= self.section_state.move_on_next_area then
		-- 엔딩
		self.current_state = self.section_state.ending
		start_coroutine(self.move_next_area, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_switch_on_off_event(e)
	if self.current_state ~= self.section_state.start_pymon_puzzle then
		return false
	end

	if e.IsTurningOn and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.SwitchObject, self.get_switch(1))
			and self.get_switch(2).FieldObjectBehaviour.IsPressed then
		self.current_state = self.section_state.move_on_next_area
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.rock_break_event, self)
		return true
	elseif e.IsTurningOn and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.SwitchObject, self.get_switch(2))
			and self.get_switch(1).FieldObjectBehaviour.IsPressed then
		self.current_state = self.section_state.move_on_next_area
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.rock_break_event, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_stage_end_event(_)
	self.is_stage_end = true

	return false
end

-- 파이몬 벽 off로 변경
function local_class:broken_wall(is_broken)
	local broken_wall = self.get_pymon_broken_wall()

	local on_object = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(broken_wall.Transform, 'on')
	on_object.gameObject:SetActive(is_broken == false)

	local off_object = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(broken_wall.Transform, 'off')
	off_object.gameObject:SetActive(is_broken)
end

function local_class:pre_setting()
	-- 파이몬 세팅
	local pymon = self.controller.get_pymon()
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(pymon)
	character_util.set_direction(pymon, 'right')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(pymon, { name = 'cross_arm', loop = false }, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.set_position(pymon, field:GetMarker(self.pymon_pos_marker_name .. 1).position)
	character_util.set_active_state(pymon, 'enabled')

	-- 길막 바위 세팅
	local start_pos = field:GetMarker('s19_obstacle_pos').position
	local pos_list = { start_pos, start_pos + unity_class.vector3.back
	, start_pos + unity_class.vector3.back * 8, start_pos + unity_class.vector3.back * 9 }

	local directing_rock_count = 4
	for i = 1, directing_rock_count do
		local rock_fo = self.get_obstacle(i)
		rock_fo.Position = pos_list[i]
	end

	-- 마지막에 파이몬이 죽이는 인베이더들 비활성화
	local invader_count = 11
	for i = 1, invader_count do
		local invader = self.get_s19_last_action_invader(i)
		invader.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
	end

	-- 파이몬 돌아다니는 길 루트 캐싱
	self.pymon_waypoint_list = {}
	local waypoint_count = 6
	for i = 1, waypoint_count do
		local marker = self.get_pymon_waypoint_marker(i)
		table.insert(self.pymon_waypoint_list, marker.position)
	end

	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.controller.quest_marker_name
	, pymon.Position, true)
end

function local_class:first_one_line_event()
	local invader_list = {}
	local invader_count = 3

	for i = 1, invader_count do
		local invader = get_character('s19_one_line_invader_' .. i)
		invader.OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance
		table.insert(invader_list, invader)
	end

	-- 흰색3(right, scared, idle) : 이대론 다 죽을 거야…!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(invader_list[3], { key = self.string_key .. 1, lower_priority = true })
	if self.is_stage_end then
		return
	end

	-- 흰색2(left, scared, idle) : 방어선이고 뭐고 도망치자…!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(invader_list[2], { key = self.string_key .. 2, lower_priority = true })
	if self.is_stage_end then
		return
	end

	-- 인베이더 아래로 퇴장
	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(wp_util.move_async, invader_list[1], {
			invader_list[1].Position + unity_class.vector3.left * 4,
			invader_list[1].Position - vector(4, 0, 15)
		}, 12, nil, { run = true }),
		util.cs_generator(wp_util.move_async, invader_list[2], {
			invader_list[2].Position + unity_class.vector3.left * 4,
			invader_list[2].Position - vector(4, 0, 15)
		}, 12, nil, { run = true }),
		util.cs_generator(wp_util.move_async, invader_list[3], {
			invader_list[3].Position + unity_class.vector3.left * 4,
			invader_list[3].Position - vector(4, 0, 15)
		}, 12, nil, { run = true }),
		util.cs_generator(function()
			wait_for_sec(0.2)
			if self.is_stage_end then
				return
			end

			-- 아래 문열림
			message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('s19_door_1', false))
		end),
	})

	if self.is_stage_end then
		return
	end

	for i = 1, #invader_list do
		local invader = invader_list[i]
		invader.OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(invader)
		character_util.set_active_state(invader, 'disabled')
	end
end

function local_class:second_one_line_event()
	local invader_list = {}
	local invader_count = 6

	for i = 4, invader_count do
		local invader = get_character('s19_one_line_invader_' .. i)
		invader.OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')

	for i = 1, #invader_list do

			invader_list[2].Position + unity_class.vector3.right * 3,
			invader_list[2].Position + vector(3, 0, -15)
		}, 12, nil, { run = true }),
		util.cs_generator(wp_util.move_async, invader_list[3], {
			invader_list[3].Position + unity_class.vector3.right * 3,
			invader_list[3].Position + vector(3, 0, -15)
		}, 12, nil, { run = true })

	for i = 1, #invader_list do

		invader.OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(invader)
		character_util.set_active_state(invader, 'disabled')
	end

-- 파이몬 최초 지점으로 이동
function local_class:start_pymon_puzzle_event()
	local air_spin_invader = function(index)
		local invader = self.get_s19_invader(index)

		character_util.remove_emotion(invader)
		character_util.set_emotion(invader, { name = 'damaged' })
		character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(invader)
		character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(invader)

		self.get_fx_hit():Instantiate(invader.Position + vector(0, 0.1, 0))
		self.get_fx_lasthit():Instantiate(invader.Position + vector(-0.25, 0.1, 0.5))
		character_util.air_spin(invader)
	end

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5, 2)

	quest_marker_util.remove(self.controller.quest_marker_name)

	local pymon = self.controller.get_pymon()
	local leader = user_party.Leader
	local princess = get_character('little_princess')

	-- 기사, 공주 정렬
	local sort_pos = vector(86, 0, -76.5)

	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(function()
			wp_util.move_async(leader, sort_pos, nil, 0.75, { last_direction = 'down' })
		end, self),
		util.cs_generator(wp_util.move_async, princess, sort_pos + unity_class.vector3.left
		, nil, 0.75, { last_direction = 'down' }),
		util.cs_generator(camera_util.move_async, pymon.Position, 1, { end_target = pymon })
	})

	-- 파이몬(right, attack, cross_arm) : …아래로 가십시오…?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(pymon, { key = self.string_key .. 5, skip = true })

	-- 파이몬(right, attack, jumpx1) : 크하핫! 알겠다!
	character_util.normal_jump(pymon, true)
	character_util.remove_anim(pymon)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(pymon, { key = self.string_key .. 6, skip = true })

	-- 1번 점프타일로 이동
	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(wp_util.move_async, pymon, { self.pymon_waypoint_list[1]
		, self.pymon_waypoint_list[2], self.pymon_waypoint_list[3]
		}, 8, nil, { last_direction = 'left', run = true, play_sfx = true }),
		util.cs_generator(function()
			wait_for_sec(0.65)

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_rock_break_01')
			camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.3)
			self.get_fx_obj_smoke():Instantiate(self.get_obstacle(3).Position + vector(0, 0.1, -0.5))
			for i = 3, 4 do
				local obstacle = self.get_obstacle(i)
				obstacle.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
			end

			for i = 1, 2 do
				local invader = self.get_s19_invader(i)
				character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(invader, { name = 'embarrassed' }
				, { name = 'scared' })
			end

			wait_for_sec(0.4)
			camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.3)
			air_spin_invader(1)

			wait_for_sec(0.05)
			air_spin_invader(2)
		end),
	})

	-- 점프 타일 밟음
	yield_return_func(self.jump_tile_activate, self, 1, pymon)
	wait_for_sec(0.15)
	wp_util.move_async(pymon, pymon.Position + unity_class.vector3.back * 0.5
	, 4, nil)

	-- 1번 구역에 착지 후, 파이몬(left -> right) 순으로 두리번거리고
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_direction(pymon, 'right')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_direction(pymon, 'left')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_direction(pymon, 'right')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 파이몬(right, attack, cross_arm) : …위로 가십시오?
	character_util.set_anim(pymon, { name = 'cross_arm' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(pymon, { key = self.string_key .. 7, skip = true })

	-- 파이몬(right, attack, jumpx1) : 알겠다!
	character_util.normal_jump(pymon, true)
	character_util.remove_anim(pymon)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(pymon, { key = self.string_key .. 8, skip = true })

	-- 2번 점프타일로 이동
	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(wp_util.move_async, pymon, { self.pymon_waypoint_list[4]
		, self.pymon_waypoint_list[5], self.pymon_waypoint_list[6]
		}, 8, nil, { last_direction = 'left', run = true, play_sfx = true }),
		util.cs_generator(function()
			wait_for_sec(0.65)

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_rock_break_01')
			camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.3)
			self.get_fx_obj_smoke():Instantiate(self.get_obstacle(1).Position + vector(0, 0.1, -0.5))

		end),

	wait_for_sec(0.15)
	wp_util.move_async(pymon, pymon.Position + unity_class.vector3.forward * 0.5
	, 4, nil)

	character_util.set_direction(pymon, 'right')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_direction(pymon, 'left')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_direction(pymon, 'right')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

		character_util.set_direction(leader, 'left')
		character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'smile' })

		-- 공주(right, tired, idle) emoticon_bubble_silence

		character_util.set_emotion(princess, { name = 'tired' })
		character_util.set_direction(princess, 'right')
		character_util.show_emoticon_async(princess, nil, 'silence')
	else
		-- 가디언(left, tired, bomb_idle)

		character_util.set_direction(leader, 'left')
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(leader, { name = 'bomb_idle' }, { name = 'tired' })
		wait_for_sec(2)

		-- 공주(right, damage, jumpx1) : [small]드, 들리겠어. 기사!
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_player_jump_01', volume = 0.5, loop = false })
		camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.1)
		character_util.set_direction(princess, 'right')
		character_util.normal_jump(princess, true)
		character_util.play_speech_action(princess, nil, { name = 'damaged' }
		, { key = self.string_key .. '10_2', scale = 0.75, skip = true })
	end

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

	-- 공주(right, tired, idle) : 크로셀이 없으면 시간 낭비 할 거라는게 이런 뜻이었나봐…
	character_util.set_emotion(princess, { name = 'tired' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, { key = self.string_key .. '10_1', skip = true })

	-- 가디언(left, tired, nodx2)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'left')
	character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'tired' })
	character_util.nod_twice(leader)
	character_util.remove_emotion(leader)

	-- 공주(right, attack, jumpx1) : 안 되겠어! 우리가 좀 도와주자!
	character_util.set_emotion(princess, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.normal_jump(princess, true)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, { key = self.string_key .. '10_3', skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim(princess)

	-- 가디언(left, smile, victory_get)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_intro_jump_01')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(leader, { name = 'victory_get', loop = false }, { name = 'smile' })
	wait_for_sec(1.7)

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party[i])
		character_util.set_direction(user_party[i], 'down')
	end

function local_class:pymon_auto_play_jump_tile()
	wait_for_sec(0.25)

	local is_first = true
	local pymon = self.controller.get_pymon()
	pymon.OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance

	self.is_jumping_pymon = false
	while self.current_state == self.section_state.start_pymon_puzzle and not self.is_stage_end do
		self.is_jumping_pymon = true
		-- 파이몬 점프타일로 이동
		local start_index = is_first and 1 or 4
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(pymon)
		wp_util.move_async(pymon, { self.pymon_waypoint_list[start_index]
		, self.pymon_waypoint_list[start_index + 1], self.pymon_waypoint_list[start_index + 2]
		}, 10, nil, { last_direction = 'left', run = true, play_sfx = true })

		-- 점프타일 사용
		yield_return_func(self.jump_tile_activate, self, is_first and 1 or 2, pymon)
		wait_for_sec(0.15)
		if self.current_state ~= self.section_state.start_pymon_puzzle or self.is_stage_end then
			break
		end

		local add_pos = is_first and unity_class.vector3.back * 0.5 or unity_class.vector3.forward * 0.5
		wp_util.move_async(pymon, pymon.Position + add_pos
		, 4, nil)
		self.is_jumping_pymon = false

		if self.current_state ~= self.section_state.start_pymon_puzzle or self.is_stage_end then
			break
		end

		-- 주변 돌아보고
		local cur_dir = 'right'
		local look_around_count = 3
		for _ = 1, look_around_count do
			music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_swing_01', loop = false, parent = pymon })
			character_util.set_direction(pymon, cur_dir)
			wait_for_sec(0.5)

			if self.current_state ~= self.section_state.start_pymon_puzzle or self.is_stage_end then
				break
			end

			cur_dir = cur_dir == 'right' and 'left' or 'right'
		end

		-- emoticon_bubble_question 띄움
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(pymon, { name = 'question', loop = false }, { name = 'attack' })
		if self.current_state ~= self.section_state.start_pymon_puzzle or self.is_stage_end then
			break
		end

		is_first = is_first == false
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.is_jumping_pymon = false
	character_util.remove_anim(pymon)
	character_util.set_direction(pymon, 'right')
end

function local_class:jump_tile_activate(index, target)
	local jump_tile = get_field_object('s19_jump_tile_' .. index)
	local jump_tile_animator = jump_tile:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
	local jump_tile_data = jump_tile.FieldObjectBehaviour

	if not lua_helper.type_compare(jump_tile_data, CS.Oak.JumpTileBehaviour) then
		return
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_jumptile_01', loop = false, play_pos = jump_tile.Position })
	jump_tile_animator:Play('on')

	start_coroutine(function()
		wait_for_sec(0.5)
		if not self.is_stage_end then
			jump_tile_animator:Play('off')
		end
	end, self)

	local jump_dir = direction_util.to_vector3(jump_tile.Direction)
	local dir = jump_tile_data.HorizontalSpeed * jump_dir + jump_tile_data.JumpSpeed * unity_class.vector3.up

	local jumpInfo = CS.Oak.JumpInfo()
	jumpInfo.jumper = target
	jumpInfo.jumpSource = jump_tile
	jumpInfo.jumpType = CS.Oak.JumpType.JumpTileJump
	jumpInfo.speed = dir.magnitude
	jumpInfo.direction = dir.normalized
	jumpInfo.jumpStartPos = target.Position
	jumpInfo.jumpTimeScale = 1.75
	jumpInfo.gravity = CS.Oak.Constants.JumpGravity

	command_util.execute_jump(jumpInfo)

	coroutine.yield(nil)
	coroutine.yield(nil)

	while lua_helper.type_compare(target.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentState, CS.Oak.CharacterJumpState)
			and not self.is_stage_end do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:rock_break_event()
	local center_pos = field:GetMarker(self.pymon_pos_marker_name .. 1).position + vector(0, 0, 0.5)

	-- 카메라가 파이몬 지점으로 이동
	camera_util.move_async(center_pos, 1)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 화로 on
	for i = 1, 2 do
		local brazier = get_field_object('s19_brazier_' .. i)
		command_util.execute_burn(nil, brazier, false)
	end
	wait_for_sec(3)

	while not self.is_stage_end and self.is_jumping_pymon do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if self.is_stage_end then
		return
	end

	-- 파이몬이 다음 지역으로 이동
	yield_return_func(self.move_on_pymon_next_area_routine, self)
end

function local_class:move_on_pymon_next_area_routine()
	local center_pos = field:GetMarker(self.pymon_pos_marker_name .. 1).position + unity_class.vector3.forward * 0.5

	-- 파이몬이 길 열린거 확인
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_notice_01')
	local pymon = self.controller.get_pymon()
	character_util.set_direction(pymon, 'right')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(pymon)
	character_util.set_emotion(pymon, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.normal_jump(pymon, true)
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(pymon, nil, 'notice')

	-- 점프 타일로 이동
	wp_util.move_async(pymon, { center_pos, center_pos + unity_class.vector3.right * 2.5 }
	, 8, nil, { last_direction = 'right', run = true, play_sfx = true })

	-- 다음 지역으로 점프
	yield_return_func(self.jump_tile_activate, self, 3, pymon)

	-- 파이몬 세팅
	center_pos = field:GetMarker(self.pymon_pos_marker_name .. 2).position
	character_util.set_direction(pymon, 'up')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(pymon)
	character_util.set_position(pymon, center_pos)

	local invader_count = 11
	for i = 1, invader_count do
		local invader = self.get_s19_last_action_invader(i)
		invader.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')

		if i <= 6 then
			invader.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', 'rail_shot_rifle')
			invader.CustomIdleAnimationName = 'rifle_idle'
			character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(invader, { name = 'rifle_idle' }, { name = 'scared' })
		else
			character_util.add_color(invader, invader.Name, unity_class.color.black, 1, 0)
		end
	end

	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)
end

-- 섹션 마지막 연출
function local_class:move_next_area()
	local leader = user_party.Leader

	while lua_helper.type_compare(leader.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentState, CS.Oak.CharacterJumpState)
			and not self.is_stage_end do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if self.is_stage_end then
		return false
	end

	-- 엔딩 연출 시작
	sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(self.section_ending, self)
end

function local_class:section_ending()
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5, 2)

	quest_marker_util.remove(self.controller.quest_marker_name)

	-- 엔딩 연출 시작
	timeline_util.play_async('qs_main_s19_1', 'qs_main_s19_1')

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1, 2)

	-- 다음 섹션으로
	yield_return_func(quest_util.progress_section, self.controller)

return local_class

function local_class:invader_appear_battle()
	local battle_door_count = 6
	for i = 1, battle_door_count do
		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.BattleGateCloseEvent.Create('battle_gate_2_' .. i, false))
	end

	local alive_count = 1
	local civilian_count = 3
	for i = 1, civilian_count do
		-- 스테이지 컨트롤러에 있는 키와 동일
		local cur_value = quest_util.get_custom_state(self.quest_progress, 'stage1_civilian_' .. i)

		-- 살아 있는 시민이라면
		if cur_value == 1 then
			local civilian = self.get_civilian(i)
			local move_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s2_civilian_run_pos_' .. alive_count)

			character_util.convert_to_npc(civilian)
			civilian.OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
			character_util.shake(civilian, 0.03, 9999)
			scene_util.set_direction(civilian, 'right', false)
			scene_util.set_emotion_loop(civilian, 'scared')
			scene_util.set_anim_loop(civilian, 'cast', { upper = true })
			wp_util.move(civilian, move_pos, 7, nil, { last_direction = 'left', run = true })

			alive_count = alive_count + 1
		end
	end

	-- 6번 인베이더부터 10번 인베이더까지
	local invader_count = 5
	for i = 6, 5 + invader_count do
		local invader = self.get_invader(i)
		local appear_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s2_invader_pos_' .. i)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_invader_beam_01')
		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Event_InvaderBeam'):Instantiate(appear_pos)
		character_util.set_position(invader, appear_pos)
		character_util.set_direction(invader, 'right')

		wait_for_sec(0.2)
	end

	for i = 6, 5 + invader_count do
		local invader = self.get_invader(i)

		character_util.convert_to_monster(invader, 'invader_battle_2', 'BATTLE_2')
		command_util.execute_monster_notice(invader, user_party.Leader, 'battle')
	end
end

local local_class = newclass('QueenShipMainSection20')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = QueenShipMain @
		Comment = 5스테이지 안드라스 퍼즐 @
		Index = 19 @
		NextSections = 20 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	self.available_stage_name = 'queenship_1_5'

	self.section_state = {
		none = 1,
		show_andras_event = 2, -- 안드라스 등장 연출 보았는지?
		start_acting = 3,
		first_group_dead_invader = 4, -- 인베이더 5번 사망
		second_group_threaten = 5, -- 인베이더 2번 위협해서 옮겼을 때
		second_group_dead_invader = 6, -- 인베이더 2,3번 다 사망했을 때
		ending = 7,
	}
	self.current_state = self.section_state.none

	-- character
	self.get_invader = function(index) return get_character('s20_invader_' .. index) end

	-- effect
	self.get_fx_hit = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit') end
	self.get_fx_slash = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_event_demonslayer_dash_hit') end
	self.get_fx_erina_dash = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_event_demonslayer_dash') end
	self.get_fx_ice_flower = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_iceflower') end
	self.get_fx_last_hit = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_lasthit') end
	self.get_twinkle_effect = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Object_Twinkle') end

	self.twinkle_effect_list = nil

	-- 안드라스 어택레인지 반지름
	self.range_radius = 3.5

	-- 스트링 키
	self.string_key = 'qs_main_s20_'

	-- 안드라스 이동 지점들
	self.andras_move_point = nil

	-- 이동지점 인덱스
	self.cur_move_point = 1

	-- 안드라스 이동이 일시정지 되었는지
	self.is_pause_scout_around = false

	-- 스테이지가 종료 됐는지?
	self.is_stage_end = false

	self.touch_handler = nil

	self.game_pad_handler = nil
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	self.get_fx_hit()
	self.get_fx_slash()
	self.get_fx_erina_dash()
	self.get_fx_ice_flower()
	self.get_twinkle_effect()

	screen_util.preload_tutorial_spine()

	-- 타임라인 Playable Load
	timeline_util.load_playable('qs_main_s20_1', 'qs_main_s20_2')
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent), 'on_camera_grid_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), 'on_damage_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DoorOpenedEvent), 'on_door_opened_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent), 'on_stage_end_event')

	timeline_table.register_action('pause_leader_spine', function()
		user_party.Leader.SpineController.TimeScale = 0
	end, self)

	timeline_table.register_action('play_leader_spine', function()
		user_party.Leader.SpineController.TimeScale = 1
	end, self)
	timeline_table.register_action('close_link_door', function()
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.LinkDoorEvent.Create('pink', false, false))
	end, self)

	timeline_table.register_action('open_link_door', function()
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.LinkDoorEvent.Create('pink', true, false))
	end, self)

	timeline_table.register_action('convert_switch', function()
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.ConvertSwitchChangedEvent.Create())
	end, self)

	timeline_table.register_action('field_bgm_small_volume', function()
		music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5, 2)
	end, self)

	self:pre_setting()

	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.controller.quest_marker_name
	, vector(167.5, 0, -55), true)

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	self.andras_move_point = {}
	local move_point_count = 4
	for i = 1, move_point_count do
		table.insert(self.andras_move_point, field:GetMarker('s20_andras_pos_' .. i).position)
	end

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.LinkDoorEvent.Create('pink', true))
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DoorOpenedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent))

	-- 터치 이벤트 구독중이면 해지
	if self.touch_handler then
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self.touch_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
		self.touch_handler = nil
	end

	if self.game_pad_handler then
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self.game_pad_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadEvent))
		self.game_pad_handler = nil
	end

	self:dispose_twinkle_effect()

	self.is_stage_end = true

	quest_marker_util.remove(self.controller.quest_marker_name)

	timeline_table.unregister_action('pause_leader_spine')
	timeline_table.unregister_action('play_leader_spine')
	timeline_table.unregister_action('close_link_door')
	timeline_table.unregister_action('open_link_door')
	timeline_table.unregister_action('convert_switch')
	timeline_table.unregister_action('field_bgm_small_volume')
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

function local_class:dispose_twinkle_effect()
	if self.twinkle_effect_list ~= nil then
		for i = 1, #self.twinkle_effect_list do
			if self.twinkle_effect_list[i] ~= nil then
				self.twinkle_effect_list[i]:Dispose()
				self.twinkle_effect_list[i] = nil
			end
		end

		self.twinkle_effect_list = nil
	end
end

--region event

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_state ~= self.section_state.none then
		return false
	end

	if type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, 's20_event_grid') then
		self.current_state = self.section_state.show_andras_event
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(self.start_andras_event, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.section_state.none then
		if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 's20_event_zone_1') then
			self.current_state = self.section_state.show_andras_event
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.start_andras_event, self)
			return true
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.section_state.first_group_dead_invader then
		local start_invader_count = 2
		local end_invader_count = 3
		for i = start_invader_count, end_invader_count do
			local invader = self.get_invader(i)
			if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, invader, 's20_invader_kill_point_1') then
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.second_invader_kill, self, invader)
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_damage_event(e)
	if self.current_state ~= self.section_state.start_acting then
		return false
	end

	local info = e.Info
	local invader = self.get_invader(5)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(invader, info.target) then
		-- 폭탄 대미지를 받았을 때
		if info.type == CS.Oak.DamageType.Trap | CS.Oak.DamageType.Explosion | CS.Oak.DamageType.AffectGimmick then
			self.current_state = self.section_state.first_group_dead_invader
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(self.first_invader_kill, self)
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_door_opened_event(e)
	if self.current_state ~= self.section_state.second_group_dead_invader then
		return false
	end

	if e.DoorHandleName == 's20_door_1' then
		self.current_state = self.section_state.ending
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(self.ending, self)
		return true
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:on_stage_end_event(_)
	self.is_stage_end = true

	return false
end

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, { key = self.string_key .. 20, skip = true })
	character_util.remove_emotion(princess)

	--가디언(right, smile, victory_get)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_intro_jump_01')
	character_util.set_direction(leader, choose_result == 1 and 'left' or 'right')

	start_coroutine(self.scout_around_andras, self)
end

function local_class:jump_tile_activate(target)
	local jump_tile = get_field_object('s20_jump_tile_1')
	local jump_tile_animator = jump_tile:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
	local jump_tile_data = jump_tile.FieldObjectBehaviour

	if not lua_helper.type_compare(jump_tile_data, CS.Oak.JumpTileBehaviour) then
		return
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_jumptile_01')
	jump_tile_animator:Play('on')

	start_coroutine(function()
		wait_for_sec(0.5)
		if not self.is_stage_end then
			jump_tile_animator:Play('off')
		end
	end, self)

	local jump_dir = direction_util.to_vector3(jump_tile.Direction)
	local dir = jump_tile_data.HorizontalSpeed * jump_dir + jump_tile_data.JumpSpeed * unity_class.vector3.up

	local jumpInfo = CS.Oak.JumpInfo()
	jumpInfo.jumper = target
	jumpInfo.jumpSource = jump_tile
	jumpInfo.jumpType = CS.Oak.JumpType.JumpTileJump
	jumpInfo.speed = dir.magnitude
	jumpInfo.direction = dir.normalized
	jumpInfo.jumpStartPos = target.Position
	jumpInfo.jumpTimeScale = 1.75
	jumpInfo.gravity = CS.Oak.Constants.JumpGravity
	command_util.execute_jump(jumpInfo)

	coroutine.yield(nil)
	coroutine.yield(nil)

	while lua_helper.type_compare(target.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentState, CS.Oak.CharacterJumpState)
			and not self.is_stage_end do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:second_group_invader_kill()
	-- 푸쉬 블록
	local push_block_list = {}
	local push_block_count = 2
	for i = 1, push_block_count do
		local push_block = get_field_object('s20_push_block_' .. i)
		table.insert(push_block_list, push_block)
	end

	-- 인베이더 2,3번 캐싱
	local invader_list = {}
	local invader_count = 3
	for i = 2, invader_count do
		local invader = self.get_invader(i)
		table.insert(invader_list, invader)
	end

	local string_index = 21

	local run_count = 0
	while self.current_state == self.section_state.first_group_dead_invader
			and not self.is_stage_end do
		local diff = (invader_list[1].Bounds.center - push_block_list[1].Bounds.center).magnitude
		if diff < 2 then
			if run_count >= 2 then
				break
			else
				if run_count == 0 then
					music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
					character_util.set_locked_dir(invader_list[1], 'up')
					character_util.set_anim(invader_list[1], { name = 'embarrassed' })
				end

				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(invader_list[1], { key = self.string_key .. string_index })
				character_util.move_to_async(invader_list[1], invader_list[1].Position + unity_class.vector3.back
				, 0.5, nil, false, false)

				string_index = string_index + 1
				run_count = run_count + 1
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if self.is_stage_end then
		return
	end

	run_count = 0

	-- 인베이더 2번 3번 지역으로 이동
	self.current_state = self.section_state.second_group_threaten
	character_util.set_locked_dir(invader_list[1], 'none')
	character_util.remove_anim(invader_list[1])

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')
	character_util.set_anim(invader_list[1], { name = 'get', loop = false })
	character_util.jump_move(invader_list[1]
	, field:GetMarker('s20_hide_invader_3').position + vector(1, 0, -1), 7, 1.25
	, true, 'left')

	character_util.remove_anim(invader_list[1])
	wp_util.move_async(invader_list[1], field:GetMarker('s20_hide_invader_3').position + unity_class.vector3.right
	, 7, nil, { last_direction = 'right' })
	character_util.set_anim(invader_list[1], { name = 'cast' })

	while self.current_state == self.section_state.second_group_threaten and not self.is_stage_end do
		local diff = (invader_list[1].Bounds.center - push_block_list[2].Bounds.center).magnitude
		if diff < 2 then
			if run_count >= 1 then
				break
			else
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(invader_list[1], { key = self.string_key .. string_index
				, lower_priority = true })

				for i = 1, #invader_list do
					if run_count == 0 then
						music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_02')
						character_util.set_locked_dir(invader_list[i], 'up')
						character_util.set_anim(invader_list[i], { name = 'cliff' })
					end

					character_util.move_to(invader_list[i], invader_list[i].Position + unity_class.vector3.back
					, 0.5, nil, false, false)
				end
				wait_for_sec(0.5)

				string_index = string_index + 1
				run_count = run_count + 1
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(self.second_invader_kill, self, invader_list)
end

function local_class:second_invader_kill(invader_list)
	local andras = self.controller.get_andras()
	self.is_pause_scout_around = true
	coroutine.yield(nil)
	self.controller:talk_end_andras_host()

	self.current_state = self.section_state.second_group_dead_invader

	for i = 1, #invader_list do
		speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(invader_list[i])
		character_util.set_anim(invader_list[i], { name = 'cliff' })
	end

	-- 안드라스 위치로
	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(andras)
	character_util.set_direction(andras, 'up')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(andras)
	character_util.set_emotion(andras, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.set_position(andras, self.andras_move_point[1])

	-- 인베이더2에게 카메라 패닝
	camera_util.move_async(invader_list[2].Position, 1, { end_target = invader_list[2] })

	-- 인베이더3(up, cliff) : 자, 잠깐!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(invader_list[2], { key = self.string_key .. 25, skip = true })

	-- 인베이더2(up, cliff) : 떠, 떨어진…!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(invader_list[1], { key = self.string_key .. 26, skip = true })

	local push_block = get_field_object('s20_push_block_2')

	local leader = user_party.Leader
	character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'doyagao' })
	wp_util.move_async(leader, push_block.Position
			+ vector(0.5, 0, 0.7), 2.5, nil, { last_direction = 'down' })
	character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'push' })

	-- qte이벤트 출력 난타
	local tap_count = 0
	self.touch_handler = {
		callback = function(_, e)
			if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.Tap
					or e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.DoubleTap then
				tap_count = tap_count + 1
				return true
			end

			return false
		end
	}

	-- 터치 이벤트 구독
	message_system:Subscribe(self.touch_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'callback')

	-- 게임패드 연결중 일 경우 게임패드 이벤트도 구독
	if CS.Oak.Game.Instance.InputManager.GamepadEnabled then
		self.game_pad_handler = {
			callback = function(_, e)
				if e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.AButtonDown or
						e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.BButtonDown or
						e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.XButtonDown or
						e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.YButtonDown then
					message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.TouchEvent.Create(CS.Oak.TouchEventType.Tap, unity_class.vector2.zero))
					return true
				end
				return false
			end
		}

		message_system:Subscribe(self.game_pad_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadEvent), 'callback')
	end

	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowTurboTap(1)
	while tap_count <= 3 do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.CloseTutorialSpine()

	-- 구독 해지
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.touch_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
	self.touch_handler = nil
	if self.game_pad_handler then
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self.game_pad_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadEvent))
		self.game_pad_handler = nil
	end

	-- qte이벤트 성공 시, 하단으로 상자 한 칸 더 밀리면서 인베이더2,3이 1층으로 떨어짐
	-- 0.5초 동안 밈
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_push_rock_unit_01')
	start_coroutine(function()
		local time_passed = 0
		local duration = 0.5
		local move_speed = 1 / 0.5
		while time_passed < duration do
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			local add_pos = unity_class.vector3.back * (move_speed * unity_class.time.deltaTime)
			character_util.set_position(leader, leader.Position + add_pos)
			push_block.Position = push_block.Position + add_pos
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end)

	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

	-- 상단 대사 후 인베이더2,3이 1층으로 떨어짐
	character_util.set_locked_dir(invader_list[1], 'down')
	character_util.set_locked_dir(invader_list[2], 'down')
	character_util.jump_move(invader_list[1], invader_list[1].Position + vector(0, -1, -3)
	, 6, 1.5, false, 'right')
	character_util.jump_move(invader_list[2], invader_list[2].Position + vector(0, -1, -3)
	, 6, 1.5, true, 'left')
	coroutine.yield(nil)

	-- 인베이더 낙하
	camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.4)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_trip_01')
	for i = 1, #invader_list do
		character_util.stop_shake(invader_list[i])
		character_util.set_locked_dir(invader_list[i], 'none')
		character_util.set_direction(invader_list[i], i == 1 and 'right' or 'left')
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(invader_list[i])

		character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(invader_list[i])
		character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(invader_list[i])
		character_util.set_anim(invader_list[i], { name = 'prostrate' })
		self.get_fx_hit():Instantiate(invader_list[i].Position + vector(0, 0.1, 0))
	end
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 안드라스 접근
	wp_util.move_async(andras, {
		self.andras_move_point[2] + vector(0, 0, 1),
		self.andras_move_point[2] + vector(-4, 0, 1)
	}, 9, nil, { run = true })

	-- 안드라스 공격
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_twohand_stomp_jump_01')
	character_util.set_anim(andras, { name = 'twohand_attack', scale = 1, loop = false })
	character_util.jump_move(andras, andras.Position + vector(-2.5, 0, 0)
	, 6, 1.5, true, 'left')

	camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.3)

	for i = 1, #invader_list do
		character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(invader_list[i])
		character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(invader_list[i])
		character_util.normal_jump(invader_list[i])
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_ice_ridge_03')
	self.get_fx_ice_flower():Instantiate(andras.Position)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	wait_for_sec(1.2)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_break_window_01')
	wait_for_sec(0.8)

	local princess = get_character('little_princess')

	-- 인베이더들 들 수 있도록
	self.twinkle_effect_list = {}
	for i = 1, #invader_list do
		local invader = invader_list[i]
		character_util.remove_emotion(invader)

		local field_object_pair = CS.Oak.FieldObjectPair(princess, invader)
		field:AddIgnoreCrash(field_object_pair)

		invader.Holdable = CS.Oak.Holdable()
		invader.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.WallCrashBehaviour.Instance
		invader.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled
		invader.EntityGroup = CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle
		message_system:SendSync(invader, CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(CS.Oak.CharacterAnalogueState.Create(invader)))

		local state_change_event = CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(CS.Oak.CharacterIdleState.Create(invader))
		message_system:SendSync(invader.CharacterBehaviour, state_change_event)

		local twinkle_effect = self.get_twinkle_effect():Instantiate(invader.Position + vector(0, 0.1, 0),
				unity_class.quaternion.identity, invader.Transform)
		table.insert(self.twinkle_effect_list, twinkle_effect)
	end

	-- 원래 배회하는 자리로
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(andras)
	wp_util.move_async(andras, self.andras_move_point[3], 4, nil, { last_direction = 'down' })
	self.cur_move_point = 3

	-- 배회 다시 시작
	character_util.set_anim(andras, { name = 'staff_walk' })
	self.is_pause_scout_around = false
	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)
end

function local_class:scout_around_andras()
	local andras = self.controller.get_andras()

	character_util.set_anim(andras, { name = 'staff_walk' })
	local start_pos = andras.Position
	local target_pos = self.andras_move_point[self.cur_move_point]

	local dist = vector_util.get_x0z(target_pos - start_pos).magnitude
	local duration = dist / 1.5
	local dir = vector_util.to_direction(vector_util.get_x0z(target_pos - start_pos).normalized)
	character_util.set_direction(andras, dir)

	local time_passed = 0
	local move_way_point = function(delta_time)
		time_passed = time_passed + delta_time
		if time_passed >= duration then
			time_passed = 0

			-- 다음 목표 인덱스를 지정
			self.cur_move_point = self.cur_move_point + 1
			if self.cur_move_point > #self.andras_move_point then
				self.cur_move_point = 1
			end

			-- 포지션 세팅
			start_pos = andras.Position
			target_pos = self.andras_move_point[self.cur_move_point]

			-- 속도 및 캐릭터 방향 세팅
			dist = vector_util.get_x0z(target_pos - start_pos).magnitude
			duration = dist / 1.5
			dir = vector_util.to_direction(vector_util.get_x0z(target_pos - start_pos).normalized)
			character_util.set_direction(andras, dir)
		else
			-- 이동
			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(time_passed, 0, 1, duration))
			andras.Position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, target_pos, progress)
		end
	end

	local speech_bubble_time_passed = 0
	local speech_bubble_duration = 10
	local bubble_index = 10
	local show_speech_bubble = function(delta_time)
		speech_bubble_time_passed = speech_bubble_time_passed + delta_time

		if speech_bubble_time_passed >= speech_bubble_duration then
			speech_bubble_time_passed = 0
			local is_first_talk = bubble_index == 10
			start_coroutine(function()
				if not is_first_talk then
					self.controller:talk_andras_host()
				end

				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(andras, { key = self.string_key .. bubble_index
				, lower_priority = true })

				if not is_first_talk then
					self.controller:talk_end_andras_host()
				end
			end)
			bubble_index = is_first_talk and 11 or 10
		end
	end

	while self.current_state < self.section_state.ending and not self.is_stage_end do
		if not self.is_pause_scout_around then
			-- 이동 관련 로직
			local delta_time = unity_class.time.deltaTime
			move_way_point(delta_time)

			-- 스피치 버블 관련 로직
			show_speech_bubble(delta_time)
		else
			time_passed = duration
			speech_bubble_time_passed = 0
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.controller:talk_end_andras_host()
end

function local_class:ending()
	-- 안드라스 오른쪽 보도록
	local andras = self.controller.get_andras()
	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(andras)
	character_util.set_direction(andras, 'right')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(andras)

	self:dispose_twinkle_effect()

	-- 파티 정렬
	local directing_pos = field:GetMarker('s20_directing_point_1').position
	camera_util.move(directing_pos + unity_class.vector3.back * 2, 1)
	party_util.align_party(directing_pos + unity_class.vector3.back * 2.5, 'left', 1, 'linear')

	-- 안드라스는 다가감
	local way_point = {}
	if self.cur_move_point == 1 then
		way_point = { self.andras_move_point[1], self.andras_move_point[2] + unity_class.vector3.back }
	elseif self.cur_move_point == 2 then
		way_point = { self.andras_move_point[2] + unity_class.vector3.back }
	elseif self.cur_move_point == 3 then
		way_point = { self.andras_move_point[2], self.andras_move_point[2] + unity_class.vector3.back }
	elseif self.cur_move_point == 4 then
		way_point = { self.andras_move_point[3], self.andras_move_point[2], self.andras_move_point[2] + unity_class.vector3.back }
	end
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(andras, { name = 'staff_walk' }, { name = 'smile' })
	wp_util.move_async(andras, way_point, 2.5, nil)

	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(wp_util.move_async, andras, andras.Position + unity_class.vector3.right * 7, 2.5, nil),
		util.cs_generator(function()
			wait_for_sec(0.7)
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_impact_02')
			character_util.set_direction(self.get_invader(4), 'left')
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(andras, { key = self.string_key .. 27 })
		end),
	})

		s21_s1_run_invader_6 = first_point + vector(0.5, 0, -1),

		s21_s1_run_invader_7 = second_point + vector(0, 0, 0.5),
		s21_s1_run_invader_8 = second_point + vector(0, 0, -0.5),
		s21_s1_run_invader_9 = second_point + vector(-0.5, 0, 0.5),
		s21_s1_run_invader_10 = second_point + vector(-0.5, 0, -0.5),
		s21_s1_run_invader_11 = second_point + vector(-1, 0, 0.5),
		s21_s1_run_invader_12 = second_point + vector(-1, 0, -0.5),
	}

	local invader_count = 12
	for i = 1, invader_count do
		local key = 's21_s1_run_invader_' .. i
		timeline_util.set_character_key(key, key)

		local invader = self.s1_invader_list[key]
		invader.Name = key
		invader.OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance

		local dir = i < 7 and 'up' or 'right'
		character_util.set_direction(invader, dir)
		character_util.set_active_state(invader, 'enabled')
		character_util.set_position(invader, pos_list[key])

		invader.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', 'rail_shot_rifle')
		invader.CustomIdleAnimationName = 'rifle_idle'
	end

	local obstacle = self.get_s21_obstacle(2)
	local pos = field:GetMarker('s21_s1_pymon_1').position
	obstacle.Position = pos + vector(-0.5, 0, 2)
end

function local_class:s2_pre_setting()
	-- 인베이더들에게 무기 쥐어줌
	local ban_list = { 24, 29, 30, 31, 32, 35, 36 }
	local invader_count = 42
	for i = 1, invader_count do
		-- 벤 목록에 없으면 무기쥐어줌
		if not table_util.contain_value(ban_list, i) then
			local invader = self.get_s21_s2_acting_invader(i)
			invader.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', 'rail_shot_rifle')
			invader.CustomIdleAnimationName = 'rifle_idle'
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(invader)
			character_util.set_anim(invader, { name = 'rifle_idle' })
		end
	end

	local lever = get_field_object('s21_lever_1')
	self.lever_animator = lever:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))


	-- 연출중 자성 안띄도록
	local magnet = self.get_s21_magnet()
	magnet.Magnetizable = CS.Oak.NonMagnetizable.Instance
	magnet.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
	magnet.Holdable = CS.Oak.NonHoldable.Instance

	-- 어택레인지 생성
	self.attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(unity_class.vector3.zero, self.bullet_radius)
	self.attack_range:Hide()

	local wall = get_field_object('s21_pymonbroken_1')
	local on_object = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(wall.Transform, 'on')
	on_object.gameObject:SetActive(true)
	local off_object = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(wall.Transform, 'off')
	off_object.gameObject:SetActive(flase)
end

function local_class:show_auto_event(index)
	if index == 1 then
		-- 대사 연출
		start_coroutine(function()
			local talker = user_party.Leader

			-- 전 병력에게 알린다!
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
			camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.2)
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(talker, { key = self.string_key .. 1
			, scale = 1.3, bubble_type = 'shout', bubble_direction = 'ct', screen_pos = vector(-150, 350) })
			if self.is_stage_end then
				return
			end

			-- 현재 화물 창고에 최종 방어선 구축 중!
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(talker, { key = self.string_key .. 2
			, scale = 1.3, bubble_type = 'shout', bubble_direction = 'ct', screen_pos = vector(-150, 350) })
			if self.is_stage_end then
				return
			end

			-- 모든 병력은 방어선 뒤로 이동하라!
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(talker, { key = self.string_key .. 3
			, scale = 1.3, bubble_type = 'shout', bubble_direction = 'ct', screen_pos = vector(-150, 350) })
			if self.is_stage_end then
				return
			end

		end)
	elseif index == 2 then
		start_coroutine(function()
			local routine = {}

			local start_index = 7
			local end_index = 12
			for i = start_index, end_index do
				local invader = self.s1_invader_list['s21_s1_run_invader_' .. i]
				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(invader)
				table.insert(routine, util.cs_generator(wp_util.move_async, invader,
						invader.Position + unity_class.vector3.right * 25, nil, 3, { run = true }))
			end
			wait_all(routine)

			if self.is_stage_end then
				return
			end

			for i = start_index, end_index do
				local invader = self.s1_invader_list['s21_s1_run_invader_' .. i]
				character_util.set_active_state(invader, 'disabled')
			end
		end)
	end
end

function local_class:show_run_auto_event()
	local routine = {}

	local start_index = 1
	local end_index = 6
	for i = start_index, end_index do
		local invader = self.s1_invader_list['s21_s1_run_invader_' .. i]
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(invader)
		table.insert(routine, util.cs_generator(wp_util.move_async, invader,
				invader.Position + unity_class.vector3.forward * 16, 7, { run = true }))
	end
	wait_all(routine)

	if self.is_stage_end then
		return
	end

	for i = start_index, end_index do
		local invader = self.s1_invader_list['s21_s1_run_invader_' .. i]
		character_util.set_active_state(invader, 'disabled')
	end
end

function local_class:encounter_with_demons_event()
	-- 연출용 인베이터 세팅
	local invader_list = {}
	local invader_count = 6
	for i = 1, invader_count do
		local invader = self.get_s21_s1_invader(i)
		table.insert(invader_list, invader)
	end

	local pymon = self.controller.get_pymon()
	local andras = self.controller.get_andras()

	local leader = user_party.Leader
	local princess = get_character('little_princess')

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5, 2)

	-- 6번 인베이더는 오브젝트 미리 들고 있음
	local hold_obstacle = self.get_s21_obstacle(1)
	hold_obstacle.FieldObjectBehaviour = CS.Oak.HoldableObjectBehaviour()
	hold_obstacle.Holdable = CS.Oak.Holdable()
	command_util.execute_holdup(invader_list[6], hold_obstacle, invader_list[6].Position, 0, false)

	-- 트리거 존 진입 시, 가디언 상단 초록1 위치로 정렬, 이후 방 중앙으로 카메라 패닝

	camera_util.move(center_pos, 1)

	-- 흰색2(left, attack, eat) : 다른 방어선이 모두 뚫릴 줄이야…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_equipping_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(invader_list[2], { key = self.string_key .. 4, skip = true })

	-- 흰색2(left, attack, eat) : 이런 거로 그 괴물들을 막을 수 있는 거야…?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(invader_list[2], { key = self.string_key .. 5, skip = true })

	-- 흰색4(left, attack, release) : [shout]거기! 잔말 말고 하나라도 더 쌓아!
	camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.2)
	character_util.set_direction(invader_list[4], 'up')
	character_util.set_anim(invader_list[4], { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(invader_list[4], { key = self.string_key .. 6
	, bubble_type = 'shout', skip = true })

	-- 흰색4(right, attack, release) :[shout]여기 잔해 좀 더 가져와!
	character_util.set_direction(invader_list[4], 'right')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(invader_list[4], { key = self.string_key .. 7
	, bubble_type = 'shout', skip = true })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_equipping_01')
	character_util.set_direction(invader_list[4], 'left')
	character_util.set_anim(invader_list[4], { name = 'eat' })

	-- 상단 대사 종료 시, 흰색6 화면 우측에서 잔해 holdable로 들고 등장
	-- 흰색6 : 여기 있습니…

	wp_util.move_async(invader_list[6], invader_list[6].Position + unity_class.vector3.left * 6.5, 3.5
	, nil)

	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(invader_list[6])
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 흰색6(left, surprise, idle) : 치, 침…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.shake(invader_list[6], 0.02, 0.5)
	character_util.set_emotion(invader_list[6], { name = 'surprise' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(invader_list[6], { key = self.string_key .. 9, skip = true })

	-- 흰색4(left, surprise, jumpx1) : [shout] 치, 침입자다!!
	camera_util.shake(0.35, 0.25)
	character_util.normal_jump(invader_list[6], true)

	-- 이후 흰색1~5(left, surprise, jumpx1), 동시에 흰색4 shout 말풍선 출력
	local directing_invader_count = 5
	for i = 1, directing_invader_count do
		character_util.set_direction(invader_list[i], 'left')
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(invader_list[i])
		character_util.set_emotion(invader_list[i], { name = 'surprise' })
		character_util.normal_jump(invader_list[i], true)
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(invader_list[6], { key = self.string_key .. 10
	, bubble_type = 'shout', skip = true })

	-- 이후 흰색1~5 하단 위치로 달려서 이동, 흰색8은 들고 있던 잔해 던지고 이동
	character_util.set_direction(invader_list[6], 'right')
	command_util.execute_throw(invader_list[6], hold_obstacle, unity_class.vector3.right, invader_list[6].Position
	, 9, true)
	wait_for_sec(0.25)

	-- 상단 대사 시, 흰색1~5(left, attack, idle) 상태로 1초 대기
	for i = 1, #invader_list do
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(invader_list[i])
	end

	local run_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_dash_01', loop = true })

	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(wp_util.move_async, invader_list[1], {
			invader_list[1].Position + vector(0, 0, -2), invader_list[1].Position + vector(-0.5, 0, -2),
		}, 5, nil, { last_direction = 'left', run = true }),
		util.cs_generator(wp_util.move_async, invader_list[2], {
			invader_list[2].Position + vector(0, 0, -1.5), invader_list[2].Position + vector(-1.5, 0, -1.5),
		}, 5, nil, { last_direction = 'left', run = true }),
		util.cs_generator(wp_util.move_async, invader_list[3], {
			invader_list[3].Position + vector(0, 0, 1), invader_list[3].Position + vector(-2, 0, 1),
		}, 5, nil, { last_direction = 'left', run = true }),
		util.cs_generator(wp_util.move_async, invader_list[4], {
			invader_list[4].Position + vector(0, 0, -1), invader_list[4].Position + vector(-1, 0, -1),
		}, 5, nil, { last_direction = 'left', run = true }),
		util.cs_generator(wp_util.move_async, invader_list[5], {
			invader_list[5].Position + vector(0, 0, -0.5) }, 5, nil, { last_direction = 'left', run = true }),
		util.cs_generator(wp_util.move_async, invader_list[6], {
			invader_list[6].Position + vector(-2, -1, 0), invader_list[6].Position + vector(-3, -1, 0),
		}, 5, nil, { last_direction = 'left', run = true }),
	})

	run_sfx:Stop()
	run_sfx = nil

	hold_obstacle.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
	hold_obstacle.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--흰색2(right, attack, release) : 잠깐… 그, 근육 괴물은 안보이는데…?
	character_util.set_direction(invader_list[2], 'right')
	character_util.set_anim(invader_list[2], { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(invader_list[2], { key = self.string_key .. 11, skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim(invader_list[2])
	character_util.set_direction(invader_list[2], 'left')

	-- 흰색3 right -> left -> right 두리번거림
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_direction(invader_list[3], 'right')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_direction(invader_list[3], 'left')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_direction(invader_list[3], 'right')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_direction(invader_list[3], 'left')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--흰색3(right, attack, idle)  미친 살인마도 없는 거 같아…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(invader_list[3], { key = self.string_key .. 12, skip = true })

	for i = 1, #invader_list do
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(invader_list[i])
		character_util.set_emotion(invader_list[i], { name = 'attack' })
	end

	--흰색4(right, attack, idle) : 그럼… 혼자라는 거네?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(invader_list[4], { key = self.string_key .. 13, skip = true })

	-- 가디언 선택지 출력
	-- 선택지
	-- 1) 네, 아직 싱글이에요. / 2) 잔챙이들 따위 혼자서도 충분.
	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		{ self.string_key .. 15, 'mercy' }, { self.string_key .. 14, 'brutal' } })

	if choose_result == 1 then
		-- 가디언(right, blush. sing) 유지
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(leader, { name = 'sing' }, { name = 'blush' })

		--인베이더2,4,6(right, attack, idle) emoticon_bubble_silence
		local invader_emotion_index = { 2, 4, 6 }
		for i = 1, #invader_emotion_index - 1 do
			character_util.show_emoticon(invader_list[invader_emotion_index[i]], nil, 'silence')
		end
		character_util.show_emoticon_async(invader_list[6], nil, 'silence')
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

		character_util.set_emotion(princess, { name = 'tired' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, { key = self.string_key .. 16, scale = 0.75
		, skip = true })
		character_util.remove_emotion(princess)

		--가디언(left, attack, release) 후  (right, attack,  twohand_attack3) 하단 자세를 취하고 제자리 달리기 유지
		character_util.set_direction(leader, 'left')
		character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'attack' })
		scene_util.pointing_at(leader, 2)

		character_util.set_direction(leader, 'right')
		character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'twohand_attack3', loop = false, sfx_name = '02_normal_slash_01' })
	else
		-- 가디언(right, doyagao, gauntlet_combo_attack2) 이후 무기 꺼내서 victory_get
		character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'doyagao' })
		character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(leader, { name = 'gauntlet_combo_attack2'
		, count = 1, sfx = '01_swing_01' })

		character_util.hide_weapon(leader, false)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_intro_jump_01')
		character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'victory_get', loop = false })

		character_util.hide_weapon(leader, true)
		character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'twohand_attack3', loop = false, sfx_name = '02_normal_slash_01' })
	end

	-- 흰색4(right, attack, idle) : [shout] 괴물들만 없으면 할만 해!

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(invader_list[4], { key = self.string_key .. 17, bubble_type = 'shout'

	character_util.set_anim(invader_list[4], { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(invader_list[4], { key = self.string_key .. 18

	character_util.remove_anim(invader_list[4])

	wp_util.move(invader_list[3], invader_list[3].Position + vector(-1, 0, 0),
			nil, 0.25, { run = true })
	wp_util.move_async(invader_list[4], invader_list[4].Position + vector(-1, 0, 0),

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party[i])
		character_util.set_emotion(user_party[i], { name = 'surprise' })
		character_util.set_direction(user_party[i], 'down')
		character_util.normal_jump(user_party[i], true)
	end

	for i = 1, #invader_list do
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(invader_list[i])
		if i < 3 then
			character_util.set_direction(invader_list[i], 'up')
		else
			character_util.set_direction(invader_list[i], 'down')
			character_util.set_emotion(invader_list[i], { name = 'surprise' })
		end
		character_util.normal_jump(invader_list[i], true)
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.2)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(pymon, { key = self.string_key .. 19

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(andras, { key = self.string_key .. 20
	, bubble_type = 'shout', screen_pos = vector(-125, 375), skip = true, scale = 1.2, lower_priority = true })

	timeline_util.play_async(self.cur_directer_name .. 1, 'qs_main_s21_1')

	-- 파이몬 안드라스 따로 이동함
	start_coroutine(function()
		-- 안드라스 파이몬 EtherealCharacterCrashBehaviour로
		local andras = self.controller.get_andras()
		andras.OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance

		wp_util.move_async(andras, andras.Position + vector(3.5, 0, 0), 12, nil
		, { run = true })
		character_util.set_anim(andras, { name = 'get' })
		character_util.jump_move(andras, andras.Position + vector(3, 1, 0), 12, 1.25
		, true, 'right')
		character_util.remove_anim(andras)
		wp_util.move_async(andras, andras.Position + vector(8, 0, 0), 12, nil
		, { run = true, last_direction = 'right' })

		character_util.set_position(andras, field:GetMarker('s21_s2_andras_1').position)
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(andras, { name = 'cross_arm' }, { name = 'attack' })
	end)

	start_coroutine(function()
		-- 안드라스 파이몬 EtherealCharacterCrashBehaviour로
		local pymon = self.controller.get_pymon()
		pymon.OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance

		wp_util.move_async(pymon, pymon.Position + vector(3.5, 0, 0), 12, nil
		, { run = true })

			wait_for_sec_routine(0.27)

			end

			character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(invaders[1])
			self.get_fx_hit():Instantiate(invaders[1].Position + vector(0, 0.1, 0))

			if self.current_state ~= self.section_state.s2_part_1_acting or self.is_stage_end then
				break
			end

			pymon_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_hit_big_01', loop = false
			, play_pos = invaders[2].Position })
			character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(invaders[2])
			character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(invaders[2])
			self.get_fx_hit():Instantiate(invaders[2].Position + vector(0, 0.1, 0))

		end

	end, self)

		return
	end

		music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1, 0.25)

		wait_for_sec(0.25)
	end, self)

	-- 퀘스트 마커 제거
	quest_marker_util.remove(self.controller.quest_marker_name)

	-- 유저 무적 해제
	character_util.set_immortal(user_party.Leader, false)

	-- 전투 시작
	-- 파이몬 안드라스 아군으로
	local pymon = self.controller.get_pymon()
	character_util.set_active_state(pymon, 'enabled')
	character_util.convert_to_non_party_player(pymon)
	character_util.set_immortal(pymon, true)

	local andras = self.controller.get_andras()
	character_util.set_active_state(andras, 'enabled')
	character_util.convert_to_non_party_player(andras)
	character_util.set_immortal(andras, true)

	local leader = user_party.Leader
	local last_count = 12
	for i = 1, last_count do
		local invader = get_character('s21_s2_invader_' .. i)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(invader)
		character_util.convert_to_monster(invader, 's21_s2_battle', 's21_s2_battle_zone')
		command_util.execute_monster_notice(invader, leader, 'battle')
	end
end

	for i = 1, last_count do
		local invader = get_character('s21_s2_invader_' .. i)
		character_util.set_active_state(invader, 'disabled')
	end

function local_class:shoot_bullet_routine()
	local leader = user_party.Leader

	-- 총 쏘는 시간
	local shoot_duration = 0.25

	local shoot_routine = function(invader_index_list, pos)
		local time_passed = 0
		while time_passed < shoot_duration
				and self.current_state == self.section_state.s2_part_8_acting and not self.is_stage_end do
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

			for i = 1, #invader_index_list do
				local invader = get_character('s21_s2_acting_invader_' .. invader_index_list[i])
				local fx_gun_fire = self:get_fx_gun_fire():Instantiate(invader.Position + vector(-0.8, 1, -0.5))
				fx_gun_fire.transform.localScale = vector(-1, 1, 1)
			end

			self:instantiate_fx_bullet_effect(pos)
			wait_for_sec(0.03)
		end
	end

	local time_passed = 0
	local duration = 1
	local interval = 1.5
	local min_x = 241
	local shoot_invader_list = { 39, 40, 41, 42 }

	self.is_invader_shoot = true
	while self.is_invader_shoot do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		if leader.Position.x >= min_x and time_passed > duration then
			local x = math.max(min_x, CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(leader.Position.x - interval, leader.Position.x + interval))
			local z = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(leader.Position.z - interval, leader.Position.z + interval)
			local pos = vector(x, 0.1, z)

			attack_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range, pos + vector(0, 0.1, 0), 0)
			attack_range_util.show(self.attack_range, 0)

			local collide_objs = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(pos, self.bullet_radius)
			for i = 0, collide_objs.Count - 1 do
				local fo = collide_objs[i]
				if lua_helper.reference_equals(fo, user_party.Leader) then
					local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
					damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Explosion | CS.Oak.DamageType.AffectGimmick | CS.Oak.DamageType.Trap
					damage_info.sender = fo
					damage_info.target = fo
					damage_info.damage = math.floor(fo.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP * 0.1)
					command_util.execute_damage(damage_info)
				end
			end
			collide_objs:Dispose()

			-- 0.25초간 총 발사
			for i = 1, #shoot_invader_list do
				local invader = get_character('s21_s2_acting_invader_' .. shoot_invader_list[i])
				character_util.set_anim(invader, { name = 'rifle_shoot2' })
			end

			local shoot_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_gun_shoot_07', loop = true })
			shoot_routine(shoot_invader_list, pos)
			shoot_sfx:Stop()

			for i = 1, #shoot_invader_list do
				local invader = get_character('s21_s2_acting_invader_' .. shoot_invader_list[i])
				character_util.set_anim(invader, { name = 'rifle_idle' })
			end

			time_passed = 0
			self.attack_range:Hide()
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:instantiate_fx_bullet_effect(pos)
	local rad = math.pi * CS.UnityEngine.Random.value * 2
	local range = self.bullet_radius * 0.7

	local cur_x = math.cos(rad) * CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(0.15, range)
	local cur_z = math.sin(rad) * CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(0.15, range)

	-- 총알 이팩트
	self.get_fx_gunshot_ground_hit():Instantiate(pos + vector(cur_x, 0, cur_z))
end
function local_class:instantiate_gunshot_effec(shooter_pos)
	local rad = math.pi * CS.UnityEngine.Random.value * 2
	local range = self.bullet_radius * 0.7

	local cur_x = math.cos(rad) * CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(0.15, range)
	local cur_z = math.sin(rad) * CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(0.15, range)

	local fx_gun_fire = self:get_fx_gun_fire():Instantiate(shooter_pos + vector(-0.8, 1, -0.5))
	fx_gun_fire.transform.localScale = vector(-1, 1, 1)

	-- 총알 이팩트
	self.get_fx_gunshot_ground_hit():Instantiate(pos + vector(cur_x, 0, cur_z))
end

function local_class:shout_s2_invader()
	local invader_count = 4
	for i = 1, invader_count do
		local invader = self.get_s21_s2_acting_invader(i)
		character_util.set_anim(invader, { name = 'shoot' })
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.25)
	if self.current_state ~= self.section_state.show_s2_shout then
		return
	end

	-- npc가 죽고도 보이스가 나와야해서 따로 재생
	music_player:PlayDialogue(self.string_key .. 71)

	-- 흰색1(left, attack, shoot) : [shout]여긴 절대 못 뚫는다!
	camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.2)
	local invader = self.get_s21_s2_acting_invader(1)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(invader, { key = self.string_key .. 71
	, bubble_type = 'shout', dialogue = false })

	if self.current_state ~= self.section_state.show_s2_shout then
		return
	end

	-- 흰색2(left, attack, shoot) : [shout]한 명씩이라면 막을 만해!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(invader, { key = self.string_key .. 72, bubble_type = 'shout' })
end

end
