local local_class = newclass('QueenShipMainSection23')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = QueenShipMain @
		Comment = QueenShipMainSection23 @
		Index = 22 @
		NextSections = 23 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	self.progress_enum = {
		none = 1,
		enter_dump_zone = 2,
		enter_battle_zone = 3,
		clear_battle = 4,
		interact_broken_ammi = 5
	}

	self.current_progress = self.progress_enum.none

	-- character
	self.get_broken_ammi = function() return user_util.has_knight_male() and get_character('broken_ammi_male') or
			get_character('broken_ammi_female') end
	self.get_princess = function() return get_character('princess') end
	self.get_invader = function(num) return get_character('s23_invader_soldier_' .. num) end

	-- 쓰레기존 출구 엔터했는지
	self.is_enter_dump_exit_zone = false

	--region marker
	self.target_type = { character = 1, ifo = 2, marker = 3, cb = 4 }
	-- 그리드 진입 시 찍힐 퀘스트 마커 정보
	self.grid_table = {
		{ grid = 'chasing_grid', type = self.target_type.ifo, key = 'sailing_room_inner_1' },
		{ grid = 'dump_grid', type = self.target_type.cb, key = self.set_broken_ammi_marker }
	}
	--endregion

	self.available_stage_name = 'queenship_1_6'

	self.screw = nil

	self.bone_follower = nil
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	timeline_util.load_playable('qs_main_s23_1')
	timeline_util.load_playable('qs_main_s23_2')
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent), 'on_camera_grid_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_battle_group_eliminated_event')

	self:pre_setting()
	return true
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))

	timeline_table.unregister_action('china_hero_speech_bubble_1')
	timeline_table.unregister_action('china_hero_speech_bubble_2')
	timeline_table.unregister_action('china_hero_speech_bubble_3')
	timeline_table.unregister_action('set_bone_screw')
	timeline_table.unregister_action('invader_soldier_battle_zone_setting')
	timeline_util.clear_character_key('broken_ammi')
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_broken_ammi())
			and self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.clear_battle then
		self.current_progress = self.progress_enum.interact_broken_ammi
		start_coroutine(self.interact_broken_ammi, self)
	end
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 's23_dump_zone_1')
			and self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.none then
		self.current_progress = self.progress_enum.enter_dump_zone
		start_coroutine(self.enter_dump_zone, self)
		return true
	end

	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 's23_dump_zone_2')
			and not self.is_enter_dump_exit_zone then
		self.is_enter_dump_exit_zone = true
		start_coroutine(self.enter_dump_exit_zone, self)
		return true
	end

	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 's23_dump_zone_3')
			and self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.enter_dump_zone then
		self.current_progress = self.progress_enum.enter_battle_zone
		start_coroutine(self.enter_battle_zone, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	if e.BattleGroupName == 's23_battle'
			and self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.enter_battle_zone then
		self.current_progress = self.progress_enum.clear_battle
		character_util.add_listener(self.get_broken_ammi(), self.controller)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)
	self:checking_and_show_marker(e)
	return false
end
--endregion

function local_class:checking_and_show_marker(e)
	for i = 1, #self.grid_table do
		local g = self.grid_table[i]
		if type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, g.grid) then
			local target = nil
			if g.type == self.target_type.character then
				target = get_character(g.key)
				quest_marker_util.show(self, self.controller.quest_marker_name, target, true)
			elseif g.type == self.target_type.ifo then
				target = get_field_object(g.key)
				quest_marker_util.show(self, self.controller.quest_marker_name, target, true)
			elseif g.type == self.target_type.marker then
				target = field:GetMarker(g.key).position
				quest_marker_util.show(self, self.controller.quest_marker_name, target, true)
			elseif g.type == self.target_type.cb then
				start_coroutine(g.key, self)
			end
			return
		end
	end
end

function local_class:enter_dump_zone()
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5, 1)

	timeline_util.play_async('qs_main_s23_1', 'qs_main_s23_1')

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1, 1)
end

function local_class:enter_battle_zone()
	local invader_num = 5
	local detected_invader = self.get_invader(1)

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateCloseEvent.Create('s23_battlegate_1', false))
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateCloseEvent.Create('s23_battlegate_2', false))
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateCloseEvent.Create('s23_battlegate_3', false))
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateCloseEvent.Create('s23_battlegate_4', false))

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	-- 누, 누구냐!!!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(user_party.Leader, { key = 'qs_main_s23_5_12', type_speed = 0,
    	                                                           world_pos = self.get_invader(1).Position,
	                                                           bubble_type = 'shout' })

	character_util.set_emotion(detected_invader, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.set_direction(detected_invader, 'left')
	character_util.normal_jump(detected_invader, true)
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	for i = 1, invader_num do
		local invader = self.get_invader(i)
		character_util.convert_to_monster(invader, 's23_battle')
		command_util.execute_monster_notice(invader, user_party.Leader, 'battle')
		invader.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', 'basic_sword')
		character_util.set_anim(invader, { name = 'sword_idle' })
	end
end

function local_class:interact_broken_ammi()
	self.controller:remove_weapon()

	quest_marker_util.remove(self.controller.quest_marker_name)
	character_util.remove_relate_event(self.get_broken_ammi(), self.controller)
	timeline_util.play_async('qs_main_s23_1', 'qs_main_s23_2')
	yield_return_func(quest_util.progress_section, self.controller)

	self.controller:refresh_weapon()

	field_ui_manager:Show()
	user_party:ResetControllers()
end

function local_class:enter_dump_exit_zone()
	local princess = self.get_princess()

	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	character_util.look_at(user_party.Leader, princess)
	character_util.look_at(princess, user_party.Leader)
	-- 아래에 무언가 있어. 확인해보자!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, { key = 'qs_main_s23_6', skip = true })

	character_util.move_to(princess, princess.Position + vector(0, 0, -1.5),
			nil, 4, true, true)
	character_util.move_to_async(user_party.Leader, user_party.Leader.Position + vector(0, 0, -1.5),
			nil, 4, true, true)

	self.is_enter_dump_exit_zone = false

	field_ui_manager:Show()
	user_party:ResetControllers()
end

function local_class:china_hero_speech_bubble_1()
	local princess = self.get_princess()

	local speech_key = user_util.has_fei() and 'qs_main_s23_fei_1' or 'qs_main_s23_mei_1'
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, { key = speech_key, skip = true })
end

function local_class:china_hero_speech_bubble_2()
	local princess = self.get_princess()

	local speech_key = user_util.has_fei() and 'qs_main_s23_fei_2' or 'qs_main_s23_mei_2'
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, { key = speech_key, skip = true })
end

function local_class:china_hero_speech_bubble_3()
	local princess = self.get_princess()

	character_util.set_emotion(princess, { name = 'attack' })
	local speech_key = user_util.has_fei() and 'qs_main_s23_fei_3' or 'qs_main_s23_mei_3'
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, { key = speech_key, skip = true })
end

function local_class:set_bone_screw()
	local invader = self.get_invader(1)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_popup_01')

	local consume_screw = drop_item_util.create_item({ pos = invader.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0),
	                                             target = invader.Position + vector(-0.5, 0, 0),
	                                          itemid = 20729, notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
	                                          sprscale = 0.6, showoncharacter = true, skip_text = true })

											  itemid = 20729, notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
											  sprscale = 0.6, showoncharacter = true })

	self.bone_follower:SetBone('[base]weapon2_side')

	for i = 1, invader_num do

		character_util.set_direction(invader, marker.direction)
	end

function local_class:checking_and_show_marker(e)
	for i = 1, #self.grid_table do
		local g = self.grid_table[i]
		if type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, g.grid) then
			local target = nil
			if g.type == self.target_type.character then
				target = get_character(g.key)
				quest_marker_util.show(self, self.controller.quest_marker_name, target, true)
			elseif g.type == self.target_type.ifo then
				target = get_field_object(g.key)
				quest_marker_util.show(self, self.controller.quest_marker_name, target, true)
			elseif g.type == self.target_type.marker then
				target = field:GetMarker(g.key).position
				quest_marker_util.show(self, self.controller.quest_marker_name, target, true)
			elseif g.type == self.target_type.cb then
				start_coroutine(g.key, self)
			end
			return
		end
	end
end

	self.get_fx_dead()

	timeline_table.register_action('dispose_starpiece_effect', self.dispose_starpiece_effect, self)
	timeline_table.register_action('stop_conveyor_belt', self.stop_conveyor_belt, self)

	-- 고장난 AMMI 세팅

		self.controller:broken_ammi_setting()
	end
	character_util.add_listener(self.get_broken_ammi(), self.controller)

	-- 1구역 클리어 여부 체크

		self:area_1_pre_setting()

-- AMMI 수리
function local_class:mount_broken_ammi(need_align)
	local princess = self.get_princess()
	local broken_ammi = self.get_broken_ammi()
	local can_mount_left_leg = false
	local can_mount_right_arm = false

	self.controller:remove_weapon()

	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	-- 왼다리 획득 and 미장착
	if self.is_get_left_leg and not self.is_mount_left_leg then
		can_mount_left_leg = true
	end

	-- 오른팔 획득 and 미장착
	if self.is_get_right_arm and not self.is_mount_right_arm then
		can_mount_right_arm = true
	end

	-- 붙일 수 있는 부품이 없으면
	if not can_mount_left_leg and not can_mount_right_arm then
		-- 살짝 건드려봤지만 미동도 하지 않는다.
		field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'qs_main_s23_24' })
		-- 기체에 팔과 다리의 결합이 필요해 보인다.
		field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'qs_main_s23_25' })
		self.controller:refresh_weapon()
		field_ui_manager:Show()
		user_party:ResetControllers()
		return
	end

	if need_align then
		party_util.align_party(broken_ammi.Position + vector(-0.5, 0, 0), 'left', 1, 'linear')
	end

	local choose = 'back'
	local wait = true
	local branches = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.Oak.TalkBranch))
	if can_mount_left_leg then
		branches:Add({
			Text = game_string:GetString('qs_main_s24_ammi_talk_branch_1'),
			Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Normal,
			Callback = function()
				choose = 'left'
				wait = false
			end})
	end

	if can_mount_right_arm then
		branches:Add({
			Text = game_string:GetString('qs_main_s24_ammi_talk_branch_2'),
			Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Normal,
			Callback = function()
				choose = 'right'
				wait = false
			end})
	end

	branches:Add({
		Text = game_string:GetString('qs_main_s24_ammi_talk_branch_3'),
		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Normal,
		Callback = function()
			wait = false
		end})

	ui_overlay_util.push_overlay(user_party.Leader, branches)

	while wait do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if choose == 'left' then
		local eat_sound = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_clang_01', parent = user_party.Leader,
									 loop = true, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc', })
		character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'eat' })
		wait_for_sec(2)
		music_player_util.stop_sfx(eat_sound)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_explosion_01')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_walk_robot_03')

		self.get_fx_dead():Instantiate(broken_ammi.Position)
		wait_for_sec(0.1)
		self.is_mount_left_leg = true
		quest_util.set_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.mount_left_leg_key, 1)
		character_util.remove_anim(user_party.Leader)

		if self.is_mount_right_arm then
			character_util.set_anim(broken_ammi, { name = 'seat' })
			-- AMMI의 왼쪽 다리를 수리했다!
			field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'qs_main_s24_ammi_mount_left_leg_1' })
			--금방이라도 움직일 수 있을 것만 같다.
			field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'qs_main_s24_ammi_mount_clear' })
		else
			character_util.set_anim(broken_ammi, { name = 'unique/seat_leftarm' })
			-- AMMI의 왼쪽 다리를 수리했다!
			field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'qs_main_s24_ammi_mount_left_leg_1' })
			--이제 오른팔만 있으면 움직일 수 있을 것 같다.
			field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'qs_main_s24_ammi_mount_left_leg_2' })

			character_util.normal_jump(princess, true)

			--이제 오른팔만 장착시키면 돼!
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, { key = 'qs_main_s24_ammi_mount_left_leg_3', skip = true })

			-- 오른팔 있으면 바로 선택지 출력
			if can_mount_right_arm then
				self:mount_broken_ammi(false)
				return
			end
		end
	elseif choose == 'right' then
		local eat_sound = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_clang_01', parent = user_party.Leader,
													   loop = true, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc', })
		character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'eat' })
		wait_for_sec(2)
		music_player_util.stop_sfx(eat_sound)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_explosion_01')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_walk_robot_03')

		self.get_fx_dead():Instantiate(broken_ammi.Position)
		self.is_mount_right_arm = true
		quest_util.set_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.mount_right_arm_key, 1)
		character_util.remove_anim(user_party.Leader)

		if self.is_mount_left_leg then
			character_util.set_anim(broken_ammi, { name = 'seat' })
			--AMMI의 오른팔을 수리했다!
			field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'qs_main_s24_ammi_mount_right_arm_1' })
			--금방이라도 움직일 수 있을 것만 같다.
			field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'qs_main_s24_ammi_mount_clear' })
		else
			character_util.set_anim(broken_ammi, { name = 'unique/seat_rightleg' })
			--AMMI의 오른팔을 수리했다!
			field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'qs_main_s24_ammi_mount_right_arm_1' })
			--이제 오른팔만 있으면 움직일 수 있을 것 같다.
			field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'qs_main_s24_ammi_mount_right_arm_2' })

			character_util.normal_jump(princess, true)

			--이제 왼쪽 다리만 장착시키면 돼!
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, { key = 'qs_main_s24_ammi_mount_right_arm_3', skip = true })

			-- 왼쪽 다리 있으면 바로 선택지 출력
			if can_mount_left_leg then
				self:mount_broken_ammi(false)
				return
			end
		end
	end

	-- 모든 팔을 붙였으면 섹션 이동
	if self.is_mount_right_arm and self.is_mount_left_leg then
		local andras_invader_count = 10
		for i = 1, andras_invader_count do
			local invader = self.get_andras_invader(i)
			character_util.set_active_state(invader, 'disabled')
		end

		character_util.remove_relate_event(broken_ammi, self.controller)

		quest_marker_util.remove(self.controller.quest_marker_name)

		local broken_ammi_pos = field:GetMarker('broken_ammi_pos').position
		wp_util.move(user_party.Leader, broken_ammi_pos + vector(-1.5, 0, 0.5), nil,
				0.5, { last_direction = 'right' })
		wp_util.move_async(self.get_princess(), broken_ammi_pos + vector(-1.5, 0, 0), nil,
				0.5, { last_direction = 'right' })

		yield_return_func(quest_util.progress_section, self.controller)
	else
		self.controller:refresh_weapon()
		field_ui_manager:Show()
		user_party:ResetControllers()
	end
end

-- 왼다리 이동
function local_class:move_left_leg(skip_start)
	local speed = 2.5
	if not skip_start then
		drop_item_util.move_item_async(self.ammi_left_leg, field:GetMarker('s24_ammi_left_leg_pos_3').position,
				{ duration = unity_class.vector3.Distance(self.ammi_left_leg.Position,
						field:GetMarker('s24_ammi_left_leg_pos_3').position) / speed })
		drop_item_util.move_item_async(self.ammi_left_leg, field:GetMarker('s24_ammi_left_leg_pos_4').position,
				{ duration = unity_class.vector3.Distance(self.ammi_left_leg.Position,
						field:GetMarker('s24_ammi_left_leg_pos_4').position) / speed })
	end

	while self.left_leg_move_step < 1 do
		if self.stop_ammi_item then
			return
		end
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	drop_item_util.move_item_async(self.ammi_left_leg, field:GetMarker('s24_ammi_left_leg_pos_5').position,
			{ duration = unity_class.vector3.Distance(self.ammi_left_leg.Position,
					field:GetMarker('s24_ammi_left_leg_pos_5').position) / speed })
	drop_item_util.move_item_async(self.ammi_left_leg, field:GetMarker('s24_ammi_left_leg_pos_6').position,
			{ duration = unity_class.vector3.Distance(self.ammi_left_leg.Position,
					field:GetMarker('s24_ammi_left_leg_pos_6').position) / speed })

	while self.left_leg_move_step < 2 do
		if self.stop_ammi_item then
			return
		end
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	drop_item_util.move_item_async(self.ammi_left_leg, field:GetMarker('s24_ammi_left_leg_pos_7').position,
			{ duration = unity_class.vector3.Distance(self.ammi_left_leg.Position,
					field:GetMarker('s24_ammi_left_leg_pos_7').position) / speed })
	drop_item_util.move_item_async(self.ammi_left_leg, field:GetMarker('s24_ammi_left_leg_pos_8').position,
			{ duration = unity_class.vector3.Distance(self.ammi_left_leg.Position,
					field:GetMarker('s24_ammi_left_leg_pos_8').position) / speed })
	local ammi_left_leg_interact_obj = self.get_ammi_left_leg_interact_obj()

	ammi_left_leg_interact_obj.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(2, 1, 2))
	ammi_left_leg_interact_obj.Position = field:GetMarker('s24_ammi_left_leg_pos_8').position
	ammi_left_leg_interact_obj.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
end

-- 컨베이어 벨트 스타피스 움직임
function local_class:move_star_piece()
	local time_passed = 0
	local progress = 0
	local star_piece = self.get_star_piece()
	local start_pos = star_piece.Position
	local end_pos = field:GetMarker('s24_area_1_conveyor_end_pos_1').position
	local speed = 2.5
	local duration = (star_piece.Position - end_pos).magnitude / speed

	while progress < 1 do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		progress = time_passed / duration
		local pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress)
		star_piece.Position = pos
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	start_pos = star_piece.Position
	end_pos = field:GetMarker('s24_area_1_conveyor_land_pos_1').position

	duration = 0.1
	time_passed = 0
	progress = 0
	while time_passed < duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		progress = time_passed / duration
		local pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress)
		star_piece.Position = pos
		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

function local_class:enter_acting_zone()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.JumpStartEvent), 'on_jump_start_event')

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5, 1)

	self.siren_loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_siren_loop_07', loop = true,
								 type_priority = 'loop',
								 player_priority = 'default' })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	-- 웬 놈이냐!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.get_area_2_invader(3), { key = 'qs_main_s24_44', bubble_type = 'shout' })

	local rock = get_field_object('s24_rock_1')
	local block_pos = field:GetMarker('s24_area_2_acting_block_pos').position + vector(-0.5, 1, 0)
	rock.Position = block_pos + vector(0, 20,0)

	-- 길막용 돌 내려옴
	start_coroutine(function()
		local time_passed = 0
		local progress = 0
		while progress < 1 do
			progress = time_passed / 0.5

			local pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(block_pos + vector(0, 20, 0), block_pos, progress)
			rock.Position = pos

			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
		rock.Position = block_pos
	end)

	-- 필드 틴트 시작
	self:start_field_tint()

	-- 인베이더 재장전
	for i = 1, #self.area_2_acting_invader_list do
		local invader = self.area_2_acting_invader_list[i].npc
		character_util.set_direction(invader, 'left')
		character_util.set_anim(invader, { name = 'rifle_reload', sfx_name = '02_gun_reload_02',
										   loop = false, next_anim = 'rifle_idle' })
	end

	wait_for_sec(1.1)
	-- 인베이더 액팅 루틴 시작
	for i = 1, #self.area_2_acting_invader_list do
		local invader = self.area_2_acting_invader_list[i].npc
		character_util.look_at(invader, user_party.Leader)
		start_coroutine(self.invader_shoot_routine, self, self.area_2_acting_invader_list[i])
	end
end

function local_class:get_shoot_helper(invader)

	local pattern_Info = CS.Oak.ShootPatternInfo()
	pattern_Info.columns = 1
	pattern_Info.spreadDistance = 1
	pattern_Info.parallel = true

	local shooter = CS.Oak.LuaIProjectileShooter(self, invader)
	return CS.Oak.ShootHelper(CS.Oak.Projectile.MoveType.Directional,
			shooter, spec, pattern_Info, CS.Oak.ShootHelperShootEffectType.EachShoot, 0.8)

-- 인베이더 발사 행동 루틴
function local_class:invader_shoot_routine(data)
	local invader = data.npc
	local shoot_helper = data.shoot_helper
	local attack_range = data.attack_range
	local use_x_distance = data.use_x_distance
	local shoot_delay = 3
	local current_shoot_delay = 3
	local aiming_time = 1.5
	local aiming_lock_time = 1
	local current_aiming_time = 0
	local aiming_distance = 3.5
	local included_range = false
	local correction_value = vector(0, 0, -0.5)

	local shoot_state = {
		wait = 1,
		aiming = 2,
		shoot = 3,
	}

	local state = shoot_state.wait
	local shoot_dir = vector_util.get_x0z(user_party.Leader.Position - invader.Position).normalized
	while self.current_area_2_progress == self.area_2_progress_enum.enter_acting_zone do
		local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime
		if use_x_distance then
			included_range = math.abs(user_party.Leader.Position.x - invader.Position.x) <= aiming_distance
		else
			included_range = math.abs(user_party.Leader.Position.z - invader.Position.z) <= aiming_distance
		end

		if state == shoot_state.wait then
			if current_shoot_delay < shoot_delay then
				current_shoot_delay = current_shoot_delay + dt
			else
				-- 리셋 중이면 대기
				if not self.reset_area_2_acting and included_range then
					shoot_dir = vector_util.get_x0z(user_party.Leader.Position - invader.Position - correction_value).normalized

					attack_range_util.setup_by_direction(attack_range, invader.Position + correction_value, shoot_dir,
							invader.Position.y + 1)
					attack_range_util.show(attack_range, 0)

					state = shoot_state.aiming
				end
			end
		elseif state == shoot_state.aiming then
			-- 리셋 중이면 대기 상태로 변경
			if self.reset_area_2_acting then
				attack_range:Hide()
				current_aiming_time = 0
				state = shoot_state.wait
			else
				character_util.look_at(invader, user_party.Leader)
				if current_aiming_time < aiming_time then
					if included_range then
						shoot_dir = vector_util.get_x0z(user_party.Leader.Position - invader.Position - correction_value).normalized

						attack_range_util.setup_by_direction(attack_range, invader.Position + correction_value, shoot_dir,
								invader.Position.y + 1)
					end

					current_aiming_time = current_aiming_time + dt
				elseif current_aiming_time < aiming_time + aiming_lock_time then
					current_aiming_time = current_aiming_time + dt
				else
					state = shoot_state.shoot
					current_aiming_time = 0
					attack_range:Hide()
				end
			end
		elseif state == shoot_state.shoot then
			character_util.look_at(invader, user_party.Leader)
			current_shoot_delay = 0

			music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_gun_shoot_09', parent = invader,
										 type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc', })

			character_util.set_animation_n_times(invader, { name = 'rifle_shoot', count = 1,
															end_call_func = function()
																character_util.set_anim(invader, { name = 'rifle_idle' })
															end })
			shoot_helper:ShootDirectionAtPosition(invader.Position + correction_value + vector(0, 1, 0),
					shoot_dir, 999, -1, nil, false, 0)

			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(invader,
					{ key = 'qs_main_s24_acting_random_' .. random_util.get_random_int(1, 3), type_speed = 0 })
			state = shoot_state.wait
		end
		coroutine.yield()
	end
	character_util.remove_anim(user_party.Leader)
	attack_range:Hide()
end

	if self.current_area_2_progress >= self.area_2_progress_enum.acting_clear then
		return
	end

	if unity_class.time.time - self.area_2_acting_hit_time > self.area_2_acting_hit_delay then
		self.area_2_acting_hit_time = unity_class.time.time
	else
		return
	end

	if not self.reset_area_2_acting then
		character_util.spine_pulse_color(user_party.Leader, CS.Oak.Constants.DamageColor, 1, 1, 0.5)
		character_util.spine_damage_squish(user_party.Leader, 1.3, 0.7, 1, 0.2)

		local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
		damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Trap
		damage_info.sender = user_party.Leader
		damage_info.target = user_party.Leader
		damage_info.damage = math.floor(user_party.Leader.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP * 0.50)
		damage_info.notMortal = true
		command_util.execute_damage(damage_info)

		self.area_2_acting_hit_count = self.area_2_acting_hit_count + 1
		if self.area_2_acting_hit_count >= 2 then
			start_coroutine(self.reset_acting, self)

-- 필드 틴트 루틴
function local_class:field_tint_loop()
	local tint_color = unity_color({ 1, 0, 0, 1 })
	local tint_key = 's24_tint'
	local tint_period = 2

	while self.activate_field_tint do
		field:Tint(tint_key, tint_color, 0.5)

		local time_passed = 0
		while time_passed < tint_period / 2 do
			if not self.activate_field_tint then
				field:RemoveTint(tint_key, 0.5)
				return
			end
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			coroutine.yield()
		end
		field:RemoveTint(tint_key, 0.5)

		time_passed = 0
		while time_passed < tint_period / 2 do
			if not self.activate_field_tint then
				return
			end
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			coroutine.yield()
		end
	end
end

	end

	-- 배터리 기계
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_battery_machine()) then
		start_coroutine(self.interact_battery_machine, self)
		return
	end

	-- 인베이더 과학자
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_invader_scientist()) and not self.is_detected_by_scientist then
		start_coroutine(self.detected_by_scientist, self)
		return
	end

	-- 고장난 AMMI
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_broken_ammi()) then
		start_coroutine(self.interact_broken_ammi, self)
		return
	end
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 's25_magwi_zone')
			and self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.none then
		self.current_progress = self.progress_enum.enter_magwi_zome
		start_coroutine(self.enter_magwi_zome, self)
		return true
	end

	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 's25_capsule_zone_1')
			and self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.enter_magwi_zome then
		self.current_progress = self.progress_enum.enter_capsule_zone_1
		start_coroutine(self.enter_capsule_zone_1, self)
		return true
	end

	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 's25_capsule_zone_2')
			and self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.enter_capsule_zone_1 then
		self.current_progress = self.progress_enum.enter_capsule_zone_2
		start_coroutine(self.enter_capsule_zone_2, self)
		return true
	end

	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 's25_battery_zone_1')
			and self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.interact_prison_event then
		self.current_progress = self.progress_enum.enter_battery_zone_1
		start_coroutine(self.enter_battery_zone, self)
		return true
	end

	if (type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 's25_battery_zone_2') or
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 's25_battery_zone_3'))
			and self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.enter_battery_zone_1 then
		self.current_progress = self.progress_enum.enter_battery_zone_2
		start_coroutine(self.assassinate_invader_talk, self)
		return true
	end

	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 's25_scientist_zone')
			and self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.clear_battery_invader_battle then
		self.current_progress = self.progress_enum.assassin_invader_scientist
		start_coroutine(self.enter_invader_scientist_zone, self)
		return true
	end

	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 's25_battle_2')
			and self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.assassin_invader_scientist then
		self.current_progress = self.progress_enum.invader_elite_battle
		start_coroutine(self.invader_elite_battle, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_field_object_destroyed_event(e)
	-- 배터리존 전투이고 가장 첫번째로 죽은 배터리 인베이더인 경우
	if self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.attack_invader_soldier and self.dead_invader == nil then
		-- 해당 인베이더 배터리 재료로 캐싱하고 나머지는 airspin으로 바꿈
		for i = 2, 6 do
			local invader = self.get_battery_invader(i)
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, invader) then
				self.dead_invader = invader
				character_util.set_emotion(invader, { name = 'damaged' })
				for j = 2, 6 do
					if i ~= j then
						self.get_battery_invader(j).DamagedBehaviour.DeathType = CS.Oak.DeathType.AirSpin
					end
				end
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.get_invader_scientist()) then
		self:assassinate_invader_scientist()
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	if e.BattleGroupName == 's25_battle_1' then
		self.current_progress = self.progress_enum.clear_battery_invader_battle
		start_coroutine(self.clear_battery_invader_battle, self)
	end

	if e.BattleGroupName == 's25_battle_2' then
		self.current_progress = self.progress_enum.clear_elite_battle
		start_coroutine(self.clear_elite_battle, self)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if e:GetParamAt(0) == self.invader_scientist_detect_key and not self.is_detected_by_scientist then
		start_coroutine(self.detected_by_scientist, self)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)
	self:checking_and_show_marker(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_damage_event(e)
	local require_damage_type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Assassinate
	if self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.enter_battery_zone_1 or self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.enter_battery_zone_2 then
		for i = 2, 6 do
			-- 암살 공격을 했으면 암살 npc 제외하고 배틀 세팅, 일반 공격을 했으면 모든 인베이더 배틀 세팅
			local invader = self.get_battery_invader(i)
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, invader) and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.sender, user_party.Leader) then
				-- 암살 데미지 들어왔으면 암살 처리
				if e.Info.type & require_damage_type == require_damage_type then
					self.current_progress = self.progress_enum.attack_invader_soldier
					self.is_assassinate_battery_invader = true
					self.dead_invader = invader
					character_util.set_emotion(invader, { name = 'damaged' })
					self:assassinate_invader_battle_setting(invader)
				else
					-- 플레이어가 암살 상태면 무시
					if lua_helper.type_compare(user_party.Leader.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentState,
                       					CS.Oak.CharacterAssassinateState) then
						return true
					end
					self.current_progress = self.progress_enum.attack_invader_soldier
					self:attack_invader_battle_setting()
				end
				return true
			end
		end
	end
end
--endregion

function local_class:checking_and_show_marker(e)
	for i = 1, #self.grid_table do
		local g = self.grid_table[i]
		if type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, g.grid) then
			local target = nil
			if g.type == self.target_type.character then
				target = get_character(g.key)
				quest_marker_util.show(self, self.controller.quest_marker_name, target, true)
			elseif g.type == self.target_type.ifo then
				target = get_field_object(g.key)
				quest_marker_util.show(self, self.controller.quest_marker_name, target, true)
			elseif g.type == self.target_type.marker then
				target = field:GetMarker(g.key).position
				quest_marker_util.show(self, self.controller.quest_marker_name, target, true)
			elseif g.type == self.target_type.cb then
				start_coroutine(g.key, self)
			end
			return
		end
	end
end

	-- 이 놈은 얼마가 지나야 무르익으려나…?

-- 캡슐존 트리거 이벤트2

	-- 흐흐… 싱싱한 재료가 들어왔군.

-- 감옥존 엔터 이벤트
function local_class:prison_event()
	local princess = self.get_princess()
	local princess_pos = field:GetMarker('s25_prison_princess_pos').position
	local leader_pos = field:GetMarker('s25_prison_leader_pos').position
	local invader_list = { self.get_invader(11), self.get_invader(12),
	                       self.get_invader(13), self.get_invader(14)}
	local invader_pos = field:GetMarker('s25_invader_soldier_pos_11').position
	local invader_pos_list = { invader_pos + vector(-0.75, 0, 0), invader_pos + vector(0.75, 0, 0),
	                           invader_pos + vector(-0.75, 0, -1), invader_pos + vector(0.75, 0, -1)}
	local civil = self.get_civil(4)
	local door = get_field_object('s25_prison_door_1')

	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()
	self.controller:remove_weapon()

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5, 1)

	wp_util.move(user_party.Leader, leader_pos, nil, 0.5, { last_direction = 'up' })
	wp_util.move_async(princess, princess_pos, nil, 0.5, { last_direction = 'up' })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	character_util.normal_jump(princess, true)

	-- 사람이 쓰러져 있어!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, { key = 'qs_main_s25_18', skip = true })

	character_util.set_emotion(user_party.Leader, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.set_emotion(princess, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.set_direction(princess, 'left')
	character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'right')
	-- 얼른 구해야…!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, { key = 'qs_main_s25_19', skip = true })

	for i = 1, #invader_list do
		character_util.set_position(invader_list[i], invader_pos_list[i])
		character_util.set_direction(invader_list[i], 'up')
	end

	character_util.set_direction(princess, 'down')
	character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'down')
	character_util.normal_jump(princess, true)
	character_util.normal_jump(user_party.Leader, true)

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('area_3_door_3', false))
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('area_3_door_4', false))

	-- 다음 재료는 누구로 하지?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(invader_list[1], { key = 'qs_main_s25_20',
	                                                               screen_pos = vector(-100, -200), type_speed = 0 })

	wp_util.move(user_party.Leader, { user_party.Leader.Position + vector(4, 0, 0),
	                                  user_party.Leader.Position + vector(4, 0, 1.5) },
			nil, 0.7, { last_direction = 'left', run = true, play_sfx = true })
	wp_util.move_async(princess, { princess.Position + vector(3, 0, 0),
	                               princess.Position + vector(3, 0, 2.5) },
			nil, 0.7, { last_direction = 'left', run = true, play_sfx = true })

	for i = 1, #invader_list do
		wp_util.move(invader_list[i], invader_list[i].Position + vector(0, 0, 8), nil, 2)
	end
	wait_for_sec(2)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	scene_util.set_direction(invader_list[1], 'left', true)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	scene_util.set_direction(invader_list[1], 'right', true)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	scene_util.set_direction(invader_list[1], 'up', true)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 뭐야, 벌써 한개밖에 안 남았어?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(invader_list[1], { key = 'qs_main_s25_21', skip = true })

	character_util.set_anim(invader_list[3], { name = 'bomb_idle' })
	-- 최근에 배터리 생산을 좀 많이 하긴 했지.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(invader_list[3], { key = 'qs_main_s25_22', skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim(invader_list[3])

	-- 배터리들이 워낙 AMMI의 전력 소모량을 못 버텨내니 그렇지.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(invader_list[2], { key = 'qs_main_s25_23', skip = true })

	character_util.set_direction(invader_list[1], 'right')
	-- 재료들이 시원찮아서 그런가…?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(invader_list[1], { key = 'qs_main_s25_23_1', skip = true })

	scene_util.set_direction(invader_list[3], 'right', true)
	-- 너희들 여기 공장 근처 돌아다니는 AMMI 봤지?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(invader_list[3], { key = 'qs_main_s25_23_2', skip = true })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fade_out_03')
	scene_util.set_release_anim(invader_list[3], true)
	-- 그거… <b>단 한 명</b>으로 그 괴물의  전력을 계속 감당하고 있는 거야.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(invader_list[3], { key = 'qs_main_s25_23_3', skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim(invader_list[3])

	character_util.set_direction(invader_list[1], 'down')
	character_util.set_direction(invader_list[2], 'left')
	character_util.set_direction(invader_list[4], 'left')

	character_util.set_emotion(invader_list[1], { name = 'surprise' })
	character_util.set_emotion(invader_list[2], { name = 'surprise' })
	character_util.set_emotion(invader_list[4], { name = 'surprise' })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_jump_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_crowd_shout_05')
	character_util.normal_jump(invader_list[1], true)
	character_util.normal_jump(invader_list[2], true)
	character_util.normal_jump(invader_list[4], true)
	-- 뭐?!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(invader_list[2], { key = 'qs_main_s25_23_4', skip = true,
	                                                               bubble_type = 'shout', world_pos =
	                                                               invader_list[2].Position + vector(-1, 0, 0) })

	character_util.set_anim(invader_list[3], { name = 'bomb_idle' })
	-- 그 안에 어마무시한 생체 에너지를 가진 놈이 들어있다고.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(invader_list[3], { key = 'qs_main_s25_23_5', skip = true })

	scene_util.set_release_anim(invader_list[3], true)
	-- 그래서 배터리조차 넣을 필요가 없는 거지.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(invader_list[3], { key = 'qs_main_s25_23_6', skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim(invader_list[3])

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	character_util.set_anim(invader_list[2], { name = 'cast2' })
	-- 진짜?! 우리는 그런  재료 안 들어오나?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(invader_list[2], { key = 'qs_main_s25_23_7', skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim(invader_list[2])

	character_util.remove_emotion(invader_list[1])
	character_util.remove_emotion(invader_list[2])
	character_util.remove_emotion(invader_list[4])
	character_util.set_direction(invader_list[4], 'up')
	scene_util.set_release_anim(invader_list[4], true)
	-- 됐고 빨리 데려가자. 대장님이 기다리셔.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(invader_list[4], { key = 'qs_main_s25_24', skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim(invader_list[4])

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_costume_equip_01')
	character_util.set_direction(invader_list[1], 'up')
	character_util.set_direction(invader_list[2], 'up')
	character_util.set_direction(invader_list[3], 'up')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	wp_util.move_async(invader_list[1], invader_list[1].Position + vector(0, 0, 0.5),
			4, nil)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_small_key_01')
	character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(invader_list[1], { name = 'attack', count = 1 })

	local animator = door:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
	animator:Play('on')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_gimmick_door_down_03')
	door.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	wp_util.move_async(invader_list[1], invader_list[1].Position + vector(0, 0, 3),
			4, nil)

	-- 일어나!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(invader_list[1], { key = 'qs_main_s25_25', type_speed = 0 })

	character_util.set_direction(invader_list[1], 'right')
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(invader_list[1], { name = 'attack', count = 1 })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_big_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')

	self.get_hit_effect():Instantiate(civil.Position)
	self.get_lasthit_effect():Instantiate(civil.Position)

	character_util.spine_pulse_color(civil, CS.Oak.Constants.DamageColor, 1,
			1, 0.5)
	character_util.spine_damage_squish(civil, 1.3, 0.7, 1, 0.2)

	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.shake(civil, 0.04, 0.3)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.shake(civil, 0.04, 0.3)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(invader_list[1])
	character_util.remove_anim(civil)
	character_util.normal_jump(civil, '01_player_popup_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(civil, { name = 'surprise' })
	wait_for_sec(1)

	character_util.shake(civil, 0.04, 0.3)
	character_util.set_emotion(civil, { name = 'scared' })
	character_util.set_anim(civil, { name = 'cast' })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_01')
	-- 사, 살려 주십쇼…!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(civil, { key = 'qs_main_s25_25_1', skip = true })

	character_util.set_emotion(invader_list[1], { name = 'doyagao' })
	scene_util.set_release_anim(invader_list[1], true)
	-- 넌 머리에 총구멍 나서 죽든, 배터리 재료가 되든 둘 중 하나야.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(invader_list[1], { key = 'qs_main_s25_25_2', skip = true })

	character_util.set_emotion(invader_list[1], { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.set_anim(invader_list[1], { name = 'jingak', sfx_name = '03_mech_stomp_02' })
	-- 괜히 힘 빼지 말고 얻어 맞기 싫으면 얌전히 굴어!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(invader_list[1], { key = 'qs_main_s25_25_3', skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(invader_list[1])

	character_util.shake(civil, 0.04, 0.3)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')

	character_util.remove_anim(civil)
	character_util.set_emotion(civil, { name = 'tired' })
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	wp_util.move_async(civil, civil.Position + vector(0, 0, -4),
			3, nil)

	wp_util.move_async(invader_list[1], invader_list[1].Position + vector(0, 0, -3.5),
			4, nil)

	for i = 1, #invader_list do
		wp_util.move(invader_list[i], invader_list[i].Position + vector(0, 0, -8), nil, 2)
	end
	wp_util.move_async(civil, civil.Position + vector(0, 0, -8),
			nil, 2)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	for i = 1, #invader_list do
		character_util.set_position(invader_list[i], vector(999, 0, 999))
	end
	character_util.set_position(civil, vector(999, 0, 999))

	character_util.remove_emotion(user_party.Leader)
	character_util.remove_emotion(princess)

	quest_marker_util.show(self, self.controller.quest_marker_name, self.get_battery_machine(), true)

	self.controller:refresh_weapon()
	character_util.remove_anim(user_party.Leader)

	field_ui_manager:Show()
	user_party:ResetControllers()
end

-- 배터리존 첫 진입 이벤트
function local_class:enter_battery_zone()
	local elite = self.get_invader_elite()
	local kind_invader = self.get_battery_invader(1)
	local invader_list = { self.get_battery_invader(2), self.get_battery_invader(3), self.get_battery_invader(4),
	                       self.get_battery_invader(5), self.get_battery_invader(6) }
	local block_obj = self.get_battery_zone_block_obj()

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({name = 'ondemand/v2_15_demonworld/audio:bgm_demonworld_event_8', state = 'event', mix = 1})

	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()
	self.controller:remove_weapon()
	character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'idle' })

	local current_state = user_party.Leader.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentActionState
	if lua_helper.type_compare(current_state, CS.Oak.CharacterHoldUpState) then
		local hold_target = current_state.HoldTarget
		if hold_target ~= nil then
			command_util.execute_throw(user_party.Leader, hold_target, direction_util.to_vector3(user_party.Leader.Direction)
			, user_party.Leader.Position, 4, false)
		end
	end
	camera_util.move_async(elite.Position + vector(-2, 0 , 1), 1)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	character_util.set_direction(kind_invader, 'right')
	scene_util.set_release_anim(elite, true)
	-- 뭘 꾸물거려? 어서 잡아 처넣지 않고!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(elite, { key = 'qs_main_s25_26', skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim(elite)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.shake(kind_invader, 0.04, 0.3)
	-- 그… 그렇지만….
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(kind_invader, { key = 'qs_main_s25_27', skip = true })

	character_util.set_emotion(kind_invader, { name = 'scared' })
	-- 아무리 오염 생물이라 해도 아직 어린 아이고…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(kind_invader, { key = 'qs_main_s25_28', skip = true })
	-- 이미 너무 많은 에너지를 빨려서 기계에 넣는다 해도 무용지물입니다…!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(kind_invader, { key = 'qs_main_s25_28_1', skip = true })

	character_util.set_anim(elite, { name = 'bomb_idle' })
	-- 네놈은 돼지를 잡을 때 돼지의 기분까지 고려해주나?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(elite, { key = 'qs_main_s25_29', skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim(elite)

	-- …뭐 좋아. 그럼 대신 네가 희생하면 되겠군.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(elite, { key = 'qs_main_s25_30', skip = true })

	character_util.normal_jump(kind_invader, true)
	-- 네…? 그게 무슨…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(kind_invader, { key = 'qs_main_s25_31', skip = true })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_die_fat_ogre_01')
	scene_util.set_release_anim(elite, true)
	-- 배터리 재료로 처넣어버려!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(elite, { key = 'qs_main_s25_33', skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim(elite)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_crowd_shout_09')
	character_util.set_anim(invader_list[1], { name = 'salute', loop = false })
	character_util.set_anim(invader_list[2], { name = 'salute', loop = false })
	-- 예!!!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(invader_list[1], { key = 'qs_main_s25_34', skip = true,
	                                                         type_speed = 0, bubble_type = 'shout' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(invader_list[2], { key = 'qs_main_s25_34', skip = true,
	                                                               type_speed = 0, bubble_type = 'shout' })
	character_util.remove_anim(invader_list[1])
	character_util.remove_anim(invader_list[2])

	wp_util.move(invader_list[1], { vector(kind_invader.Position.x + 0.5, 0, invader_list[1].Position.z),
	                                kind_invader.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0.5) },
			4, nil, { last_direction = 'left' })
	wp_util.move_async(invader_list[2], { vector(kind_invader.Position.x + 0.5, 0, invader_list[2].Position.z),
	                                      kind_invader.Position + vector(0.5, 0, -0.5) },
			4, nil, { last_direction = 'left' })

	kind_invader.Holdable = CS.Oak.Holdable()
	command_util.execute_holdup(invader_list[2], kind_invader, invader_list[2].Position)
	character_util.set_anim(invader_list[1], { name = 'hold_loop' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
	character_util.set_anim(kind_invader, { name = 'embarrassed' })

	wait_for_sec(1)

	camera_util.move(elite.Position + vector(-2, 0 , 3.5), 1)
	wp_util.move(invader_list[1], { invader_list[1].Position + vector(0, 0, 1),
	                                invader_list[1].Position + vector(3, 0, 1),
	                                invader_list[1].Position + vector(3, 0, 2) },
			4, nil, { last_direction = 'left' })
	wp_util.move_async(invader_list[2], { invader_list[2].Position + vector(0, 0, 1),
	                                      invader_list[2].Position + vector(3, 0, 1),
	                                      invader_list[2].Position + vector(3, 0, 2) },
			4, nil, { last_direction = 'left' })

	wait_for_sec(1)
	command_util.execute_throw(invader_list[2], kind_invader, vector(-1, 0, 0), invader_list[2].Position,
			6, true)
	character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(invader_list[1], { name = 'throw', count = 1 })
	character_util.set_anim(kind_invader, { name = 'prostrate' })
	character_util.set_emotion(kind_invader, { name = 'damaged' })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_mech_stomp_01')
	self.get_hit_effect():Instantiate(kind_invader.Position)
	self.get_lasthit_effect():Instantiate(kind_invader.Position)

	wp_util.move_async(invader_list[1], invader_list[1].Position + vector(0, 0, 1), 4, nil, { last_direction = 'left' })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bounce_iron_03')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_elevator_01')

	character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(invader_list[1], { name = 'attack', count = 1 })

	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	self:activate_battery_machine({ kind_invader })

	camera_util.move_async(elite.Position + vector(-2, 0 , 1), 1)
	kind_invader.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance
	kind_invader.Interactable =  CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

	character_util.set_direction(elite, 'right')

	character_util.set_direction(invader_list[1], 'down')
	character_util.set_direction(invader_list[2], 'down')

	scene_util.set_release_anim(elite, true)
	-- 돌아오기 전까지 마귀 님께 드릴 배터리를 완성해 놓도록!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(elite, { key = 'qs_main_s25_35', skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim(elite)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_twohand_stomp_jump_01')
	for i = 1, #invader_list do
		character_util.set_anim(invader_list[i], { name = 'salute', loop = false })
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_crowd_shout_09')
	-- 예!!!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(invader_list[3], { key = 'qs_main_s25_36', skip = true,
	                                                               type_speed = 0, bubble_type = 'shout',
	                                                               world_pos = invader_list[3].Position + vector(-1, 0, 0) })

	for i = 1, #invader_list do
		character_util.remove_anim(invader_list[i])
	end

	local elite_pos = field:GetMarker('s25_battle_2_invader_elite_pos').position
	wp_util.move_async(elite, { vector(elite.Position.x, 0, elite_pos.z), elite_pos }, 5,
			nil, { last_direction = 'left' })

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create('area_3_door_7', false))

-- 인베이더 과학자 루틴
function local_class:invader_scientist_routine()
	local scientist = self.get_invader_scientist()
	local patrol_list = { field:GetMarker('s25_scientist_patrol_3'), field:GetMarker('s25_scientist_patrol_4'),
	                      field:GetMarker('s25_scientist_patrol_1'), field:GetMarker('s25_scientist_patrol_2') }

	local anim_duration = 3
	while not self.is_invader_scientist_dead and not self.is_detected_by_scientist do
		for i = 1, #patrol_list do
			-- 암살 가능 구간
			character_util.remove_relate_event(scientist, self.controller)
			scientist.FieldObjectController = CS.Oak.NPCCharacterController()
			stage.BattleManager:RemoveFromNoAssassination(scientist)
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(scientist, { key = 'qs_main_s25_56' })
			character_util.set_anim(scientist, { name = 'eat' })

			local cur_anim_duration = 0
			while cur_anim_duration < anim_duration do
				if self.is_detected_by_scientist or self.is_invader_scientist_dead then
					return
				end
				cur_anim_duration = cur_anim_duration + unity_class.time.deltaTime
				coroutine.yield()
			end

			-- 암살 상태면 진행하지 않고 대기함
			while lua_helper.type_compare(user_party.Leader.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentState,
					CS.Oak.CharacterAssassinateState) do
				coroutine.yield()
			end

			if self.is_detected_by_scientist or self.is_invader_scientist_dead then
				return
			end

			-- 이동 + 인터랙트 가능 + 암살 불가 구간
			character_util.add_listener(scientist, self.controller)
			character_util.remove_anim(scientist)
			stage.BattleManager:AddToNoAssassination(scientist)

			local look_dir = vector_util.to_direction(patrol_list[i].position - scientist.Position)
			scientist.Direction = look_dir == CS.Oak.Direction.None and fo.Direction or look_dir
			character_util.set_anim(scientist, { name = 'walk' })

			scientist.FieldObjectController = CS.Oak.WayPointGuardCharacterController.Create(
					scientist, self.invader_scientist_detect_key, 4, 60)

			local progress = 0
			local time_passed = 0
			local duration = 2
			local start_pos = scientist.Position
			while progress < 1 do
				if self.is_detected_by_scientist or self.is_invader_scientist_dead then
					return
				end

				progress = time_passed /duration

				local pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, patrol_list[i].position, progress)
				scientist.Position = pos

				time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end
			character_util.remove_anim(scientist)
			scientist.Position = patrol_list[i].position
			character_util.set_direction(scientist, patrol_list[i].direction)
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

-- 배터리 기계 인터랙트
function local_class:interact_battery_machine()
	local machine_pos = field:GetMarker('s25_battery_machine_center').position
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	if user_party.Leader.Position.x > machine_pos.x then
		party_util.align_party(machine_pos + vector(1.5, 0, 0), 'right', 1, 'linear')
	else
		party_util.align_party(machine_pos + vector(-1.5, 0, 0), 'left', 1, 'linear')
	end

	self.controller:remove_weapon()
	character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'idle' })

	local pass = false
	local wait = true
	local branches = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.Oak.TalkBranch))
	branches:Add({
		Text = game_string:GetString('qs_main_battery_machine_1'),
		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Mercy,
		Callback = function()
			pass = true
			wait = false
		end})

	branches:Add({
		Text = game_string:GetString('qs_main_battery_machine_2'),
		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Brutal,
		Callback = function()
			wait = false
		end})

	ui_overlay_util.push_overlay(user_party.Leader, branches)

	while wait do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if pass then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_elevator_01')
		self:check_battery_machine_zone()
	else
		self.controller:refresh_weapon()
		character_util.remove_anim(user_party.Leader)

		field_ui_manager:Show()
		user_party:ResetControllers()
	end
end

-- 배터리 기계존 체크
function local_class:check_battery_machine_zone()
	local invader_list = {}
	local is_contains_invader = false
	for i = 1, #self.battery_invader_list do
		local invader = get_character(self.battery_invader_list[i].name)
		if self.battery_machine_zone_fieldobj:Contains(invader) and self.battery_invader_list[i].useable then
			self.battery_invader_list[i].useable = false
			table.insert(invader_list, invader)
			is_contains_invader = true
		end
	end

	if is_contains_invader then
		self:activate_battery_machine(invader_list)
	else
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.get_battery_machine(),
				{ key = 'qs_main_battery_machine_3', skip = true })
	end
	self.controller:refresh_weapon()
	character_util.remove_anim(user_party.Leader)

	field_ui_manager:Show()
	user_party:ResetControllers()
end

-- 배터리 기계 활성화
function local_class:activate_battery_machine(invader_list)
	local battery_machine_pos = field:GetMarker('s25_battery_machine_center').position
	local battery_machine = self.get_battery_machine()
	local battery_machine_animator = battery_machine:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
	local battery = battery_machine.transform:Find('biological_battery_glow')
	local machine_duration = 4

	battery_machine_animator:Play('open')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_gimmick_door_up_03')

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_vacume_01')
	local wind_effect = self.get_wind_effect():Instantiate(battery_machine_pos + vector(0, 0, -1))
	wind_effect.transform.localScale = vector(0.5, 1, 0.5)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	for i = 1, #invader_list do
		character_util.move_to(invader_list[i], battery_machine_pos + self.battery_invader_consume_pos[i], nil, 8, false, false)
	end
	wait_for_sec(1)
	wind_effect:Dispose()
	wind_effect = nil
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	battery_machine_animator:Play('close')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_gimmick_door_up_03')

	wait_for_sec(1)

	battery_machine:Shake(0.04, machine_duration)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_interact_greenland_01', loop = true, parent = user_party.Leader,
								 type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc', duration = machine_duration })

	for i = 1, #invader_list do
		if invader_list[i].Name == 's25_invader_elite' or invader_list[i].Name == 's25_invader_scientist' then
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_victim_scream_02')
		else
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_villain_scream_01')
		end
	end

	-- 끄아아아악!!!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(battery_machine, { key = 'qs_main_battery_machine_5',
	                                                         type_speed = 0, bubble_type = 'shout', life_time = machine_duration, scale = 1.2 })

	for i = 1, #invader_list do
		invader_list[i].CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance
		character_util.add_color(invader_list[i], invader_list[i].Name, unity_class.color.black, 0.3, 0)
		character_util.set_emotion(invader_list[i], { name = 'confused' })
		character_util.shake(invader_list[i], 0.08, machine_duration)
	end

	local progress = 0
	local time_passed = 0
	local duration = machine_duration
	local start_scale = battery.transform.localScale.x
	local end_scale = battery.transform.localScale.x + #invader_list
	while progress < 1 do
		progress = time_passed / duration

		local scale = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(start_scale, end_scale, progress)
		battery.transform.localScale = vector(scale, 1, 1)

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_beep_01')

	battery_machine_animator:Play('open')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_gimmick_door_up_03')
	wait_for_sec(1)

	for i = 1, #invader_list do
		self.battery_count = self.battery_count + 1
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_air_spin_02')
		character_util.spine_rotate(invader_list[i], 720, 0.5)
		character_util.jump(invader_list[i], 1, 0.5)

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)

		start_coroutine(self.block_skip_china_hero, self, vector(0, 0, 1))
		return true

	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 's26_block_zone_2')

		start_coroutine(self.block_skip_china_hero, self, vector(1, 0, 0))
		return true
	end

	self:checking_and_show_marker(e)

function local_class:on_touch_event(e)
	if not self.is_qte_start then
		return false
	end

	if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.TouchDown then
		self.touch_count = self.touch_count + 1
	end

	if self.is_qte_start then
		if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeLeft then
			self.swipe_type = 'left'
			return true
		elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeRight then
			self.swipe_type = 'right'
			return true
		elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeUp then
			self.swipe_type = 'up'
			return true
		elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeDown then
			self.swipe_type = 'down'
			return true
		end
	end

	return true
end

--endregion

function local_class:checking_and_show_marker(e)
	for i = 1, #self.grid_table do
		local g = self.grid_table[i]
		if type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, g.grid) then
			local target = nil
			if g.type == self.target_type.character then
				target = get_character(g.key)
				quest_marker_util.show(self, self.controller.quest_marker_name, target, true)
			elseif g.type == self.target_type.ifo then
				target = get_field_object(g.key)
				quest_marker_util.show(self, self.controller.quest_marker_name, target, true)
			elseif g.type == self.target_type.marker then
				target = field:GetMarker(g.key).position
				quest_marker_util.show(self, self.controller.quest_marker_name, target, true)
			elseif g.type == self.target_type.cb then
				start_coroutine(g.key, self)
			end
			return
		end
	end
end

function local_class:qte_swipe(dir, duration, play_qte_complete)
	self.swipe_type = ''
	self.is_qte_start = true
	local time_passed = 0
	local pass = false
	local qte_complete = lua_helper.get_or_default(play_qte_complete, true)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_tap_guide_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_qte_action_wind_02')
	screen_util.qte_swipe(dir)

	if duration == nil then
		while self.swipe_type ~= dir do
			coroutine.yield()
		end

		if qte_complete then
			yield_return_func(CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.QTEComplete, 1)
		else
			screen_util.close_tutorial_spine()
		end
	else
		while time_passed < duration do
			coroutine.yield()
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			if self.swipe_type == dir then
				pass = true
				if qte_complete then
					yield_return_func(CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.QTEComplete, 1)
				end
				break
			end
		end

		if pass then
			if not qte_complete then
				screen_util.close_tutorial_spine()
			end
			wait_for_sec(0.5)
		else
			screen_util.close_tutorial_spine()
			wait_for_sec(0.5)
			self.fail_qte = true
		end
	end
	self.is_qte_start = false
end

	local ammi_head_pos = field:GetMarker('s26_champion_ammi_head_pos').position
	local ammi_head_id = 20752
	local door_pos = field:GetMarker('s26_door_pos').position

	self.is_clear_ammi_battle = true

	character_util.add_listener(china_hero, self.controller)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(princess)

	character_util.set_position(user_party.Leader, leader_pos)

	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(china_hero, { name = 'prostrate' }, { name = 'sleep_deep' })

	                                                        notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', skip_text = true })

	champion_ammi_head.ConsumeTarget = user_party.Leader

	camera_util.resize_to_default(0.5)

end

function local_class:ammi_hit_effect(pos)

end

function local_class:knockback_move(fo, duration, end_pos)
	local time_passed = 0
	local start_pos = fo.Position
	while time_passed <= duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutCirc(time_passed, 0, 1, duration))

		fo.Position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
	character_util.set_position(fo, end_pos)
end

function local_class:ammi_appear(appear_pos, dir)
	local champion_ammi = user_util.has_fei() and get_character('s26_champion_ammi_fei') or get_character('s26_champion_ammi_mei')
	local attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(unity_class.vector3.zero, self.constants_data.range_radius,
			CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
	attack_range:Hide()

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fall_down_01')

	local ceiling_dust_effect_pos = appear_pos + vector(0, 5, 0)
	local ceiling_dust = self.get_ceiling_dust_effect():Instantiate(ceiling_dust_effect_pos)
	ceiling_dust.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0.8

	character_util.set_direction(champion_ammi, dir)

	character_util.set_position(champion_ammi, appear_pos +
			vector(0, self.constants_data.state_data.appear.falling_height, 0))

	attack_range_util.show(attack_range, self.constants_data.state_data.appear.falling_duration / 2)
	attack_range_util.setup_by_position(attack_range, appear_pos, 0)

	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	character_util.set_anim(champion_ammi, { name = 'stomp_loop' })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_ammi_06')
	local falling_duration = self.constants_data.state_data.appear.falling_duration / 2
	local time_passed = 0
	local progress = 0
	while progress < 1 do
		progress = time_passed / falling_duration

		local pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(appear_pos +
				vector(0, self.constants_data.state_data.appear.falling_height, 0), appear_pos, progress)
		character_util.set_position(champion_ammi, pos)

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	attack_range:Hide()
	character_util.set_position(champion_ammi, appear_pos)
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(
			self.constants_data.effect.ground_dust):Instantiate(appear_pos)
	self.get_hit_effect():Instantiate(appear_pos)
	self.get_lasthit_effect():Instantiate(appear_pos)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_stomp_fire_02')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_stomp_robot_01')

	CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(attack_range)

	character_util.set_animation_n_times(champion_ammi, { name = 'stomp', count = 1 })
end

function local_class:set_broken_ammi_marker()
	quest_marker_util.show(self, self.controller.quest_marker_name, self.get_broken_ammi(), true)
end

return local_class

	self.grid_table = {
		{ grid = 'chasing_grid', type = self.target_type.ifo, key = 'sailing_room_inner_1' },
		{ grid = 'passage_grid', type = self.target_type.marker, key = 's27_display_pos' },
		{ grid = 'dump_grid', type = self.target_type.marker, key = 's27_display_pos' },
		{ grid = 'area_1_grid', type = self.target_type.ifo, key = 'area_1_outer_1' },
		{ grid = 'area_2_grid', type = self.target_type.ifo, key = 'area_2_outer_1' },

	}

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	timeline_util.load_playable('qs_main_s27_1')
end

function local_class:enter()
	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	self:pre_setting()
end

function local_class:exit()
	timeline_table.unregister_action('china_hero_talk_1')
	timeline_table.unregister_action('china_hero_talk_2')
	timeline_table.unregister_action('china_hero_talk_3')

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local display = self.get_display()

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, display) then
		display.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
		start_coroutine(self.interact_display_event, self)
	end
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)
	self:checking_and_show_marker(e)
	return false
end
--endregion

function local_class:checking_and_show_marker(e)
	for i = 1, #self.grid_table do
		local g = self.grid_table[i]
		if type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, g.grid) then
			local target = nil
			if g.type == self.target_type.character then
				target = get_character(g.key)
			elseif g.type == self.target_type.ifo then
				target = get_field_object(g.key)
			elseif g.type == self.target_type.marker then
				target = field:GetMarker(g.key).position
			end
			quest_marker_util.show(self, self.controller.quest_marker_name, target, true)
			return
		end
	end
end

	timeline_util.play_async('qs_main_s27_1', 'qs_main_s27_1')

	for i = 1, ammi_count do

	user_party:ResetControllers()

local local_class = newclass('QueenShipMainSection28')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = QueenShipMain @
		Comment = QueenShipMainSection28 @
		Index = 27 @
		NextSections = 28 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	self.stage_names = {
		stage_6 = 'queenship_1_6',
		stage_7 = 'queenship_1_7'
	}

	-- 이 섹션이 동작할 스테이지 이름
	self.available_stage_name = {
		self.stage_names.stage_6,
		self.stage_names.stage_7
	}

	-- 타임라인 어셋 이름
	self.timeline_asset_names = {
		rendezvous_with_crosselle = 'qs_main_s28_1'
	}

	-- 퀘스트 디렉터 이름
	self.main_director_name = 'qs_main_stage_7'


	--region stage 6
	self.target_type = {
		character = 1,
		ifo = 2,
		marker = 3
	}

	-- 그리드 진입 시 찍힐 퀘스트 마커 정보
	self.grid_table = {
		{
				grid = 'chasing_grid',
				type = self.target_type.ifo,
				key = 'sailing_room_inner_1'
			},
		{
				grid = 'sailing_room_grid',
				type = self.target_type.ifo,
				key = 'sailing_room_outer_2'
			},
		{
				grid = 'passage_grid',
				type = self.target_type.ifo,
				key = 'exit_queenship_1_6'
			},
		{
				grid = 'dump_grid',
				type = self.target_type.ifo,
				key = 'exit_queenship_1_6'
			},
		{
				grid = 'battery_factory_grid',
				type = self.target_type.ifo,
				key = 'area_3_outer_1'
			},
	}
	--endregion
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_names.stage_6 then
		timeline_util.load_playable(self.timeline_asset_names.rendezvous_with_crosselle)
	end
end

function local_class:enter()
	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_names.stage_6 then
		start_coroutine(self.co_magwi_narrative, self)
	else
		start_coroutine(self.set_stage_6_exit_marker, self)
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	if self.stage_names.stage_6 == stage.Name then
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent))
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)
	self:checking_and_show_marker(e)
	return false
end
--endregion

function local_class:co_magwi_narrative()
	party_util.align_party(field_util.get_marker_pos('default_start'), 'right', 0, 'linear')
	timeline_util.play_async(self.main_director_name, self.timeline_asset_names.rendezvous_with_crosselle)

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field' })

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.StageControlStartEvent.Instance)

	yield_return_func(quest_util.progress_section, self.controller)
end

--region stage 6
function local_class:set_stage_6_exit_marker()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent), 'on_camera_grid_enter_event')
	quest_marker_util.show(self, self.controller.quest_marker_name, get_field_object('exit_queenship_1_6'), true)
end

function local_class:checking_and_show_marker(e)
	for i = 1, #self.grid_table do
		local g = self.grid_table[i]
		if type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, g.grid) then
			local target = nil
			if g.type == self.target_type.character then
				target = get_character(g.key)
			elseif g.type == self.target_type.ifo then
				target = get_field_object(g.key)
			elseif g.type == self.target_type.marker then
				target = field:GetMarker(g.key).position
			end
			quest_marker_util.show(self, self.controller.quest_marker_name, target, true)
			return
		end
	end
end
--endregion

return local_class

		self.effect_names.hit_effect_preset,
		self.effect_names.impact_hit_effect_preset,
		self.effect_names.invader_missile_explosion,
		self.effect_names.jet_explosion,
		self.effect_names.jet_smoke,
		self.effect_names.pymon_lavabom
	)

		-- invader_flight_1 = 'boss_helicopter',
		-- invader_flight_2 = 'boss_helicopter',

		invader_flight_3 = 'qs_invader_fighter',

	-- 인베이더 미사일 프리로드
	self.res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()

	timeline_util.create_resource_storage(self.event_1_missile, timeline_resource_type.default,
		'ondemand/v2_49_queenship/tilesets', 'queenship_missile', 'queenship_missile')

	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
	self.res_holder, 'ondemand/v2_49_queenship/tilesets', 'queenship_missile', function(prefab)
		self.launching_missile_info.cached_invader_missile = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Instantiate(prefab)
		self.launching_missile_info.cached_invader_missile.transform.position = vector(999, 0, 999)
		self.launching_missile_info.cached_invader_missile:SetActive(false)
	end)

function local_class:enter()
	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupWaveClearEvent), 'on_battle_group_wave_clear_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_battle_group_eliminated_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent), 'on_camera_grid_enter_event')

	self.knight_crawling_event_qte_swipe_info.is_qte_event_finished = false
	self.knight_crawling_event_qte_swipe_info.is_qte_swipe_succeed = false

	-- 타임라인 매니저에 루아 함수 등록
	-- 정리 필요!
	timeline_table.register_action('start_pymon_japping', self.start_pymons_japping, self)
	timeline_table.register_action('stop_pymon_japping', self.stop_pymon_japping, self)

	timeline_table.register_action('start_invader_jet_fighter_4_down_scaling', self.start_invader_jet_fighter_4_down_scaling, self)
	timeline_table.register_action('init_invader_jet_fighter_4_scale', self.init_invader_jet_fighter_4_scale, self)

	-- 파이몬이 다른 캐릭터들을 드는 로직을 시작하는 액션
	timeline_table.register_action('start_pymon_holding_up', function(self)
		start_coroutine(function()
			message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MoveFieldObjectEvent), 'on_move_fo_event')

			self.keep_pymong_holding_up = true

			while self.keep_pymong_holding_up do
				coroutine.yield()
			end

			self.pymon_holding_list = nil
			self.pymon_holding_list = {}

			message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MoveFieldObjectEvent))
		end)
	end, self)

	-- 파이몬이 들고 다니는 캐릭터 추가
	timeline_table.register_action('add_pymong_holding', self.add_pymon_holding, self)

	-- 파이몬이 다른 캐릭터들을 드는 로직을 종료.
	timeline_table.register_action('stop_pymon_holding', function(self)
		self.keep_pymong_holding_up = false
	end, self)

	timeline_table.register_action('pymon_crossed_the_bridge', self.pymon_crossed_the_bridge, self)

	timeline_table.register_action('rotate_by_y_degree', function(self, jet, degree, duration)
		start_coroutine(self.co_rotate_by_y_degree, self, jet, degree, duration)
	end, self)

	timeline_table.register_action('rotate_jet_3', self.rotate_jet_3, self)
	timeline_table.register_action('rotate_jet_5', self.rotate_jet_5, self)

	timeline_table.register_action('rotate_jet_fighter_3', self.rotate_jet_fighter_3, self)

	timeline_table.register_action('start_croselle_punching', self.start_croselle_punching, self)
	timeline_table.register_action('stop_croselle_punching', self.stop_croselle_punching, self)

	--#region 이 아래는 현재 사용중인 녀석들

	--- 필드에 있는 모든 전투기들을 아래 방향을 바라보도록 함
	timeline_table.register_action('reset_all_jets_rotation', function()
		for i = 1, 8 do
			local jet = self.get_invader_jet_by_idx(i)

			if jet ~= nil then
				character_util.set_direction(jet, 'down')
			end
		end
	end)

	timeline_table.register_action('remove_rotation', self.remove_rotation, self)

	timeline_table.register_action('rotate_invader_jet_fighter_1_1', function()
		local jet = self.get_invader_jet_by_idx(1)

		if jet == nil then
			return
		end

		self:set_rotation(jet, unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 25, 0))
	end)

	timeline_table.register_action('remove_invader_jet_fighter_1_rotation', function()
		local jet = self.get_invader_jet_by_idx(1)

		if jet == nil then
			return
		end

		self:remove_rotation(jet)
	end)

	timeline_table.register_action('reset_jet_4_state', function()
		local jet = self.get_invader_jet_by_idx(4)

		if jet == nil then
			return
		end

		character_util.set_active_state(jet, 'disabled')
	end)

	--- 1번 전투기 총알 발사 액션 1
	timeline_table.register_action('invader_jet_1_fire_1', function()
		start_coroutine(self.fire_bullets_at_random_point, self, field_util.get_marker_pos('s29_event_1_pos'))
	end)

	--- 1번 전투기 총알 발사 액션 2
	timeline_table.register_action('invader_jet_1_fire_2', function()
		local invader_jet_1 = get_character('invader_flight_1')

		if invader_jet_1 == nil then
			return
		end

		start_coroutine(self.fire_bullets_at_random_point, self, invader_jet_1.Position + vector(0.3, 0, 0))
	end)

	--- 8번씬, 4번 전투기가 쓰러진 공주에게 기관포를 발사하는 액션
	timeline_table.register_action('invader_jet_4_first_at_princess', function()
		local princess = self.get_princess()

		if princess == nil then
			return
		end

		start_coroutine(self.fire_bullets_at_random_point, self, princess.Position + vector(4, 0, 0))
	end)

	timeline_table.register_action('attach_to_jet', function(self, character, jet)
		if character == nil or jet == nil then
			return
		end

		self:attach_character_to_flight(character, jet)
	end, self)

	timeline_table.register_action('reset_character_transform', function(self, character)
		if character == nil then
			return
		end

		if jet == nil then
			return
		end

		interval_til_spawn_effect = lua_helper.get_or_default(interval_til_spawn_effect, -1)

		local function co_shake_internal(transform)
			local timer = 0
			local original_rotation = transform.rotation
			local original_position = transform.position

			local has_jet_smoke_instantiated = false
			-- 전투기에 불타는 이펙트 적용

			local smoke_effect = nil

			while self.keep_jet_shaking do
				timer = timer + (unity_class.time.deltaTime * 4)

				if interval_til_spawn_effect > 0
				and timer > interval_til_spawn_effect
				and has_jet_smoke_instantiated == false then

					has_jet_smoke_instantiated = true
					local effect_spawn_pos_adj = vector(-0.25, 0.5, 0)
					local effect_spawn_pos = original_position + effect_spawn_pos_adj
					self.get_invader_jet_explosion():Instantiate(effect_spawn_pos)
					smoke_effect = self.get_invader_jet_smoke():Instantiate(effect_spawn_pos, original_rotation, transform)

				end

				local progress = math.pi * math.deg(math.sin(timer))
				local current_degree = progress * 0.1

				transform.rotation
				= original_rotation
					* unity_class.quaternion.Euler(1, current_degree, current_degree)

				transform.position = vector(
					transform.position.x,
						original_position.y + current_degree * 0.05,
						transform.position.z
					)

				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end

			-- 연기 이펙트 제거
			if smoke_effect ~= nil then
				smoke_effect:Dispose()
			end

			transform.rotation = original_rotation
		end

		self.keep_jet_shaking = true
		start_coroutine(co_shake_internal, jet.Transform)
	end, self)

				--local progress = math.pi * math.deg(math.sin(unity_class.time.deltaTime))
				local progress = math.deg(math.sin(unity_class.time.deltaTime))

				local current_degree = progress * 0.3

				transform.localPosition = vector(
					original_position.x,
					original_position.y,
					original_position.z + current_degree * 2
					)

			end
