--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.StageLoadedEvent) then
		local battle_manager = stage.BattleManager
		local battle_groups = battle_manager:GetBattleGroup('s29_event_wave')
		battle_groups.SpawnNextWaveAutomatically = false
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.event_zone_names.wave_battle) and
		self.current_section_state == self.section_state.section_entered then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.wave_battle_entered
		self:start_wave_battle()
		self:close_wave_battle_gates()

	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.event_zone_names.bombing_bridge_zone) and
		self.current_section_state == self.section_state.wave_battle_cleared then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.crossing_bridge
		start_coroutine(self.co_entered_bombing_bridge_zone, self)
	end
end

function local_class:on_touch_event(e)
	if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeDown then
		self.knight_crawling_event_qte_swipe_info.is_qte_event_finished = true
		self.knight_crawling_event_qte_swipe_info.is_qte_swipe_succeed = true

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_wave_clear_event(e)
	local current_wave = e.CurrentWave
	local max_wave = e.MaxWaveCount

	local has_next_wave = current_wave < max_wave

	-- 다음 웨이브가 있다면, 소환 후 탈출
	if has_next_wave then
		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.BattleGroupSpawnNextWaveEvent.Create('s29_event_wave'))
		self.current_wave = current_wave + 1
		self:start_wave_battle()
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	local battle_group_name = e.BattleGroupName

	if battle_group_name == self.wave_battle_group_name then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.wave_battle_cleared
		self:open_wave_battle_gates()
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, 'entrance') then
		quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.marker_key, get_field_object('zone_1_exit_1'), true)
	elseif type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, 'bridge_1') then
		quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.marker_key, get_field_object('zone_2_exit_2'), true)
	elseif type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, 'invader_beam_battle') then
		quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.marker_key, get_field_object('zone_3_enter_2'), true)

		quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.marker_key, get_field_object('zone_4_enter_2'), true)
	end

-- 웨이브 전투 시작 함수
function local_class:start_wave_battle()
	-- 웨이브 전투 몬스터 가져오기
	local function get_wave_monster(wave_idx, monster_idx)
		return get_character(self.wave_battle_monster_info.monster_name .. wave_idx .. '_' .. monster_idx)
	end

	-- 웨이브 전투 몬스터 초기화용 마커 정보(좌표, 방향) 가져오기
	local function get_wave_monster_spawn_pos_and_dir(monster_idx)
		local marker_name = self.marker_names.invader_wave_battle_spawn_pos .. monster_idx
		return field_util.get_marker_pos(marker_name), field_util.get_marker_dir(marker_name)
	end

	-- 몬스터를 소환 루틴
	local function spawn_monster(monster, spawn_pos, spanw_dir)
		screen_util.invader_transfer_async(spawn_pos, spanw_dir, monster)
		character_util.convert_to_monster(monster, self.wave_battle_group_name)
		command_util.execute_monster_notice(monster, user_party.Leader, 'battle')
	end

	for monster_idx = 1, self.wave_battle_monster_info.num_monsters_each_wave do
		local monster = get_wave_monster(self.current_wave, monster_idx)
		local spawn_pos, spawn_dir = get_wave_monster_spawn_pos_and_dir(monster_idx)

		character_util.set_position(monster, spawn_pos)
		character_util.set_direction(monster, spawn_dir)

		start_coroutine(spawn_monster, monster, spawn_pos, spawn_dir)
	end
end

-- 웨이브 전투용 배틀 게이트 염
function local_class:open_wave_battle_gates()
	for door_idx = 1, self.wave_battle_gate_info.num_battle_gates do
		local battle_gate_name = self.wave_battle_gate_info.battle_gate_name.. door_idx
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateOpenEvent.Create(battle_gate_name))

-- 웨이브 전투용 배틀 게이트 잠금

	for door_idx = 1, self.wave_battle_gate_info.num_battle_gates do
		local battle_gate_name = self.wave_battle_gate_info.battle_gate_name.. door_idx

function local_class:fire_bullets_at_random_point(target_pos)
	local jet_fighter_1 = get_character('invader_flight_1')
	local bullet_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_hit_loop_01', loop = true, parent = jet_fighter_1 })

	local attack_range_value = 1.25
	local time_passed = 0
	local random_range = attack_range_value * 0.5
	local bullet_effect_time = 0.4
	local effect_name = 'FX_GunShot_Groundhit'

	while time_passed < bullet_effect_time do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local rad = math.pi * CS.UnityEngine.Random.value * 2
		local x = math.cos(rad) * CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(0.1, random_range)
		local z = math.sin(rad) * CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(0.1, random_range)
		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(effect_name):Instantiate(target_pos + vector(x, 0, z))
		wait_for_sec(0.02)
	end

	self:stop_bullet_sfx(bullet_sfx)
end

function local_class:stop_bullet_sfx(bullet_sfx)
	if bullet_sfx == nil then
		return
	end

	bullet_sfx:FadeOut(0.5)
	bullet_sfx = nil
end

function local_class:launch_missile(shooter)
	if shooter == nil then
		return
	end

	-- 미사일을 발사할 거리
	local missile_move_dist_vec = vector(5.5, -1, 1.5)

	-- 미사일 발사, 이동 목표치
	local random_range = 0.75
	local random_x_adj = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(0, random_range) / 2
	local random_z_adj = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(-random_range, random_range) / 4

	local missile_start_pos = shooter.Position
	local missile_dest_pos = missile_start_pos + missile_move_dist_vec + vector(random_x_adj, 0, random_z_adj)

	-- 미사일 회전 각도 구해놓음
	local shooting_angle_radian = math.atan(
		missile_dest_pos.y - missile_start_pos.y,
		missile_dest_pos.x - missile_start_pos.x
	)
	local shooting_angle_degree = math.deg(shooting_angle_radian)

	-- 미사일 미리 돌려놓음
	self.launching_missile_info:rotate_missile(shooting_angle_degree)

	-- 미사일 발사!
	local move_duration = 0.3
	local move_timer = 0

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_missile_launch_01')
	self.launching_missile_info.keep_launching_missiles = true
	self.launching_missile_info.cached_invader_missile.transform.localPosition = missile_start_pos
	self.launching_missile_info.cached_invader_missile:SetActive(true)

	local cur_launcing = 0
	local max_launching = 4

	while self.launching_missile_info.keep_launching_missiles or (cur_launcing < max_launching) do
		move_timer = move_timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		-- 목표 지점까지 도달전까지 계속 이동
		local progress = move_timer / move_duration
		self.launching_missile_info:move_missile_by_progress(missile_start_pos, missile_dest_pos, progress)

		-- 이동 완료 시
		if (move_timer >= move_duration) then

			-- 미사일 숨김
			self.launching_missile_info.cached_invader_missile:SetActive(false)

			-- 이펙트 생성
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_stomp_fire_02')
			local effect_spawn_pos_adj = vector(0, 0, 0)
			self.get_invader_missile_explosion()
				:Instantiate(missile_dest_pos + effect_spawn_pos_adj
				+ vector(random_x_adj, -missile_dest_pos.y, random_z_adj))

			-- 카메라 흔듬
			camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.3)

			-- 간격
			wait_for_sec(0.2)

			-- 다음 발사를 위해 정보 갱신
			random_x_adj = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(0, random_range)
			random_z_adj = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(-random_range, random_range) / 2

			missile_start_pos = shooter.Position
			missile_dest_pos = missile_start_pos + missile_move_dist_vec + vector(random_x_adj, 0, random_z_adj)

			shooting_angle_radian = math.atan(
				missile_dest_pos.y - missile_start_pos.y,
				missile_dest_pos.x - missile_start_pos.x
			)

			shooting_angle_degree = math.deg(shooting_angle_radian)

			-- 미사일 미리 돌려놓음
			self.launching_missile_info:rotate_missile(shooting_angle_degree)

			coroutine.yield(nil)

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_missile_launch_01')
			self.launching_missile_info.cached_invader_missile:SetActive(true)

			-- 타이머 리셋
			move_timer = 0

			cur_launcing = cur_launcing + 1
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.launching_missile_info.cached_invader_missile:SetActive(false)
end

function local_class:launch_a_missile_at(shooter, move_dist_vec, move_duration)
	if shooter == nil or move_dist_vec == nil then
		return
	end

	local move_timer = 0

	local missile_start_pos = shooter.Position - vector(1, 0.75, 0)
	local missile_dest_pos = missile_start_pos + move_dist_vec

	-- 이번에는 왼쪽 방향으로 쏘니 미사일을 돌려놓는다.
	self.launching_missile_info.cached_invader_missile.transform.rotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 0, 108.5656)
	self.launching_missile_info.cached_invader_missile:SetActive(true)

	while move_timer < move_duration do
		move_timer = move_timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		-- 목표 지점까지 도달전까지 계속 이동
		local progress = move_timer / move_duration
		self.launching_missile_info:move_missile_by_progress(missile_start_pos, missile_dest_pos, progress)

		-- 이동 완료 시
		if (move_timer >= move_duration) then
			-- 이펙트 생성
			self.get_invader_missile_explosion():Instantiate(missile_dest_pos)

			-- 카메라 흔듬
			camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.3)

			-- 미사일 숨김
			self.launching_missile_info.cached_invader_missile:SetActive(false)
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end


	return false
end

function local_class:start_crawling_movement()
	local princess = self.get_princess()
	local jet_4 = self.get_invader_jet_by_idx(4)

	if princess == nil or jet_4 == nil then
		return true
	end

	local knight_move_info = {
		-- 기어가는 방향 벡터
		move_direction_vec
			= vector_util.normalized(princess.Position - vector(0.5, 0, 0) - user_party.Leader.Position),

		-- 기어가는 속도
		move_speed = 0.65,

		-- 기사가 기어가기 시작하기 전의 좌표
		original_pos = user_party.Leader.Position,

		-- 기사가 기어가는 최종 거리
		total_distance = 2.2,

		-- 현재 기사가 움직이고 있는 중인지
		is_moving = false,

		-- 기어가면서 재생할 애니메이션 이름
		anim_name = 'walk4legs',

		has_reached_to_dest = function(self)
			local current_moved_dist = vector_util.distance(self.original_pos, user_party.Leader.Position)
			return current_moved_dist >= self.total_distance
		end,

		get_progress = function(self)
			local current_moved_dist = vector_util.distance(self.original_pos, user_party.Leader.Position)
			return current_moved_dist / self.total_distance
		end
	}

	local crawling_routine_info = {
		-- 기어가는 연출을 실행해야 하는지?
		should_crawl = false,

		-- 기어가는 연출이 끝났는지?
		is_done = false,

		-- 기어가는 연출을 지속해야하는지 판단하는 간격
		check_interval = 0.2,

		-- 판단 타이머 (check_inverval 보다 높거나 같으면 판단 루틴 돔)
		check_timer = 0,

		-- 판단을 갱신하기 위해 리셋 해야하는지??
		is_time_to_reset = function(self)
			return self.check_timer >= self.check_interval
		end,

		on_touch_event = function(self, e)
			local input = e.TouchEventType

			if input == touch_event_type.tap
				or input == touch_event_type.double_tap
				or input == touch_event_type.touch_down then
				self.should_crawl = true
			end

			return true
		end
	}

	local reset_anim_routine_info = {
		waited = 0,
		waiting_duration = 0.25,

		is_time_to_reset = function(self)
			return self.waited >= self.waiting_duration
		end
	}

	-- 4번 전투기 등장 이벤트 정보
	local jet_4_emergence_event_info = {
		target_progress = 0.5,
		activated = false,
		action = function(self, section)
			self.activated = true

			local fo = section.get_invader_jet_by_idx(4)
			local princess = section.get_princess()

			if fo == nil or princess == nil then
				return
			end

			local initial_position = vector(-41.6, 2.25, 117.6)
			local initial_rotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(8.3, -151, -24)

			fo.Position = initial_position
			fo.Transform.rotation = initial_rotation

			character_util.set_active_state(fo, 'enabled')
			character_util.set_direction(fo, 'down')

			local dist_adj = vector(5, 4, 0)
			local dest = princess.Position + dist_adj
			local dist_vector = dest - initial_position
			local target_rotation = vector(0, -90, 0)
			local move_duration = 0.7

			wait_all({
				util.cs_generator(section.co_parabolic_move, section, fo, dist_vector, move_duration),
				util.cs_generator(section.rotate_to, section, fo, target_rotation, move_duration)
			})
		end
	}

	-- 전투기 4번이 등장한 상태에서 아무런 입력 없이 가만히 서있을 시, 공주를 공격하는 이벤트 정보
	local jet_4_attack_event_info = {
		waitied = 0,
		waiting_duration = 5,

		is_satistifed = function(self)
			return self.waitied >= self.waiting_duration
		end,

		action = function(self, section, jet_4, princess)
			if jet_4 == nil or princess == nil then
				return
			end

			-- 총알 세례 맞는 공주
			character_util.set_anim(princess, { name = 'dead', loop = false})

			-- 깜짝 놀라는 기사
			character_util.remove_emotion(user_party.Leader)
			character_util.set_emotion(user_party.Leader,{ name = 'suprise' })
			character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader,{ name = knight_move_info.anim_name, loop = false, scale = 0 })
			character_util.jump(user_party.Leader, 0.5, 0.3)

			section:fire_bullets_at_random_point(princess.Position)

			wait_for_sec(0.2)
		end
	}

	screen_util.show_turbo_tap(1)
	message_system:Subscribe(crawling_routine_info, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_touch_event')

	while not crawling_routine_info.is_done do
		if crawling_routine_info.should_crawl then
			knight_move_info.is_moving = true
		end

		local delta_time = unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if knight_move_info.is_moving then
			reset_anim_routine_info.waited = 0
			CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameStageLogic.ExecuteMove(
				user_party.Leader,
				knight_move_info.move_direction_vec,
				knight_move_info.move_speed * delta_time
			)

			character_util.shake(user_party.Leader, 0.02, delta_time)

			character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = knight_move_info.anim_name, loop = true, scale = 1 })
		else
			reset_anim_routine_info.waited = reset_anim_routine_info.waited + delta_time

			if reset_anim_routine_info:is_time_to_reset() then
				reset_anim_routine_info.waited = 0
				character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = knight_move_info.anim_name, loop = false, scale = 0 })
			end
		end

		-- 목적지에 도달했는지 체크
		if knight_move_info:has_reached_to_dest() then
			crawling_routine_info.is_done = true
		end

		crawling_routine_info.check_timer = crawling_routine_info.check_timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if crawling_routine_info:is_time_to_reset() then
			knight_move_info.is_moving = false
			crawling_routine_info.should_crawl = false
			crawling_routine_info.check_timer = 0
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(crawling_routine_info, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))

	-- 전투기 4번 등장한다
	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(function()
			character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = knight_move_info.anim_name, loop = true, scale = 1 })

			local princess = self.get_princess()
			local move_distance = 0.6
			local adj_princess_position = princess.Position + vector(-0.5, 0, 0.5)
			local move_vector = (adj_princess_position - user_party.Leader.Position).normalized
			local move_dist_vec = move_vector * move_distance
			local move_duration = 0.7
			character_util.move_distance_async(user_party.Leader, move_dist_vec, move_duration)
		end),
		util.cs_generator(jet_4_emergence_event_info.action, jet_4_emergence_event_info, self)
	})
	--jet_4_emergence_event_info:action(self)

	screen_util.close_tutorial_spine()

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_touch_event')


	-- 전투기 4번 미사일 쏜다
	start_coroutine(function()
		local result = self:launch_a_missile_at(jet_4, vector(-4.25, 0, 0), 0.7)

		if result == false then
			self.knight_crawling_event_qte_swipe_info.is_qte_event_finished = true
			self.knight_crawling_event_qte_swipe_info.is_qte_swipe_succeed = false
		end
	end)

	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	time_util.mod('crawling_missile', 0.1, true)

	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	self.knight_crawling_event_qte_swipe_info.is_qte_event_finished = false

	screen_util.qte_swipe('down')

	-- QTE 결과가 끝날때까지 기다리기

	while not self.knight_crawling_event_qte_swipe_info.is_qte_event_finished do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- 메시지 구독 해제 해줌.
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))

	-- QTE 결과
	screen_util.close_tutorial_spine()

	-- 실패 시
	if self.knight_crawling_event_qte_swipe_info.is_qte_swipe_succeed == false then
		local fade_duration = 0.5
		local target_restart_time = 1.05
		time_util.unmod('crawling_missile')

		camera_util.shake(0.5, 0.3)

		character_util.air_spin(user_party.Leader, { offset = vector(-1, 0, 0) })
		character_util.air_spin(princess, { offset = vector(-1, 0, 0) })

		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(fade_duration, interpolations_constants['linear'])

		-- 다음 플레이를 위해서 기록 리셋
		self.knight_crawling_event_qte_swipe_info.is_qte_event_finished = false

		timeline_util.jump(self.main_director_name, target_restart_time)

		return
	end

	self.knight_crawling_event_qte_swipe_info.is_qte_event_finished = false

	local dodge_dist = vector(0, 0, -1.75)
	camera_util.move(stage_camera.Transform.position + vector(0, 0, -0.5), 0.5)
	character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'prostrate', loop = true})
	character_util.spine_deviate_local(user_party.Leader, unity_class.vector3.right * 0.25, 0.5, 999999)
	character_util.spine_deviate_local_angle(user_party.Leader, 30, 0.5, 999999)
	character_util.jump_move(user_party.Leader, user_party.Leader.Position + dodge_dist, 4, 0.5, false, 'down')
	character_util.jump_move(princess, princess.Position + dodge_dist, 4, 0.5, false, 'down')

	wait_for_sec(0.25)

	time_util.unmod('crawling_missile')
	camera_util.shake(0.5, 0.3)
end

--#region FO 트랜스폼 관련 함수들
function local_class:co_resize_scale(fo, init_scale, target_scale, duration)
	if fo == nil then
		return
	end

	local timer = 0

	while timer < duration do
		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local progress = (timer / duration)

		self:scale_by_progress(fo, init_scale, target_scale, progress)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self:set_scale(fo, target_scale)
end

-- FO 트랜스폼 스케일 값 설정
function local_class:set_scale(fo, scale)
	fo.Transform.localScale = scale
end

-- 0~1 사이 진행도에 따른 트랜스폼 스케일 값 조절
function local_class:scale_by_progress(fo, init_scale, target_scale, progress)
	fo.Transform.localScale = vector_util.lerp(init_scale, target_scale, progress)
end

function local_class:co_rotate(fo, init_rotation, target_rotation, duration)
	if fo == nil then
		return
	end

	local timer = 0

	while timer < duration do
		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local progress = (timer / duration)

		self:rotate_by_progress(init_rotation, target_rotation, progress)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	fo.Transform.rotation = target_rotation
end

function local_class:co_rotate_by_y_degree(jet, rotating_degree, duration)
	if jet == nil then
		return
	end

	local timer = 0
	local initial_rotation = jet.Transform.rotation
	local target_rotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(
		jet.Transform.rotation.x,
		jet.Transform.rotation.y + rotating_degree,
		jet.Transform.rotation.z
	)

	while timer < duration do

function local_class:co_rotate_and_resize(fo, scale_params, rotation_params, duration)

	if fo == nil or scale_params == nil or rotation_params == nil then
		return
	end

	local timer = 0

	while timer < duration do
		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local progress = (timer / duration)

		self:scale_by_progress(fo, scale_params.init_scale, scale_params.target_scale, progress)
		self:rotate_by_progress(fo, rotation_params.init_rotation, rotation_params.target_rotation, progress)

	duration = lua_helper.get_or_default(duration, 1)

	local timer = 0
	local from = character.Transform.rotation
	local to = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(to_vec.x, to_vec.y, to_vec.z)

	-- 시간에 따라 점차적으로 로테이션
	while timer < duration do
		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local progress = timer / duration

		character.Transform.rotation = unity_class.quaternion.Lerp(from, to, progress)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	character.Transform.rotation = to
end

function local_class:co_parabolic_move(jet, dist_vector, duration)
	if jet == nil then
		return
	end

	local start = jet.Position
	local dest = start + vector(dist_vector.x, 0, dist_vector.z)
	local timer = 0
	local height = dist_vector.y

	while timer < duration do
		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local progress = timer / duration
		local lerp_pos = vector_util.lerp(start, dest, progress)
		local current_y_pos = math.sin(math.pi * progress) * height + lerp_pos.y
		local current_pos = vector(lerp_pos.x, current_y_pos, lerp_pos.z)

		jet.Position = current_pos

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	jet.Position = dest
end

function local_class:last_jets_align_arc()
	local control_point = field_util.get_marker_pos('s29_event_8_pos') + vector(0, 2, 0)
	local distance = 20
	local num_jets = 6
	local degree_interval = 30
	local initial_interval = 90 - degree_interval
	local next_degree = initial_interval

	local function calc_pos(distance, degree)
		local pos_x = distance * math.cos(degree * (math.pi / 180))
		local pos_z = distance * math.sin(degree * (math.pi / 180))

		return pos_x, pos_z
	end

	for jet_idx = 1, num_jets / 2 do
		local jet = self.get_invader_jet_by_idx(jet_idx)
		local pos_x, pos_z = calc_pos(distance, next_degree)
		character_util.set_direction(jet, 'up')

		jet.Position = vector(
			control_point.x + pos_x,
			control_point.y,
			control_point.z - pos_z)
		next_degree = next_degree + degree_interval
	end

	distance = distance + 5
	next_degree = initial_interval

	for jet_idx = (num_jets // 2) + 1, num_jets do
		local jet = self.get_invader_jet_by_idx(jet_idx)
		local pos_x, pos_z = calc_pos(distance, next_degree)
		character_util.set_direction(jet, 'up')

		jet.Position = vector(
			control_point.x + pos_x,
			control_point.y,
			control_point.z - pos_z)
		next_degree = next_degree + degree_interval

		-- local jet = self.get_invader_jet_by_idx(jet_idx)
		-- local pos_x, pos_z = calc_pos(distance, next_degree)
		-- jet.Position = vector(control_point.x + pos_x, control_point.y, control_point.z + pos_z)
		-- next_degree = next_degree + degree_interval
	end

	-- 위치 정렬 후, 로테이션 정렬

	for jet_idx = 1, num_jets do
		local jet = self.get_invader_jet_by_idx(jet_idx)
		local rad = math.atan(control_point.z - jet.Position.z,control_point.x - jet.Position.x)
		local deg = math.deg(rad)

		jet.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 90 - deg, 0)
	end
end

function local_class:get_jet_location_x_adj(jet_idx)
	if jet_idx == 2 or jet_idx == 5 then
		return 0
	end

	-- 딱 맞아 떨어지면 좌측
	if jet_idx % 3 == 0 then
		return 5
	else
		return -5
	end
end

function local_class:scene_10_jet_group_approach_arc(start_idx, end_idx, distance, duration)
	local num_jets = 6
	local moving_distance = distance
	local moving_duration = duration
	local target_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s29_event_8_pos') + vector(0, 2, 0)
	local timer = 0
	local from_positions = {}
	local to_positions = {}

	for jet_idx = 1, num_jets do
		local jet = self.get_invader_jet_by_idx(jet_idx)
		local dir_vec = (target_pos - jet.Position).normalized
		local distance_vec = dir_vec * moving_distance
		local dest = jet.Position + distance_vec
		from_positions[jet.Name] = jet.Position
		to_positions[jet.Name] = dest
	end

	while timer < moving_duration do
		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local progress = timer / moving_duration

		for jet_idx = start_idx, end_idx do
			local jet = self.get_invader_jet_by_idx(jet_idx)
			jet.Position = vector_util.lerp(from_positions[jet.Name], to_positions[jet.Name], progress)
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	for jet_idx = 1, num_jets do
		local jet = self.get_invader_jet_by_idx(jet_idx)
		jet.Position = to_positions[jet.Name]
	end
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')

	self:npc_setting()
	self:helicopter_zone_setting()

	-- 해당 섹션 벽 제거
	get_field_object('wall_block_3').ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
	get_field_object('wall_block_4').ActiveState = active_state('disabled')

	-- 4섹션 관련 벽 제거
	local wall_count = 21
	for i = 1, wall_count do
		self.get_wall_object(i).gameObject:SetActive(false)
	end

	self.get_rooftop_exit().Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

	-- 잉여 NPC를 사용해 헬기 3D 사운드 작업
	local princess = get_character('princess')
	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(princess, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(princess, 0, 0)

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller,
			self.quest_marker_name, self.get_rooftop_exit(), true)
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	if not is_unity_null(self.last_helicopter) then
		CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Destroy(self.last_helicopter)
	end
	self.last_helicopter = nil

	if self.res_holder ~= nil then
		self.res_holder:Dispose()
	end
	self.res_holder = nil

	load_util.dispose_dynamic_npcs(self.dynamic_npcs)
	self.dynamic_npcs = nil

	if self.helicopter_missile ~= nil then
		self.helicopter_missile:Dispose()
		self.helicopter_missile = nil
	end

	-- FieldObject 컴포넌트 파괴
	CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.helicopter_fo)

	if self.helicopter_sfx ~= nil then
		self.helicopter_sfx:Stop()
		self.helicopter_sfx = nil
	end

	-- exit 비활성화
	self.get_rooftop_exit().ActiveState = active_state('disabled')

	-- 해당 섹션 벽 복원
	get_field_object('wall_block_3').ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
	get_field_object('wall_block_4').ActiveState = active_state('enabled')

	-- 4섹션 관련 벽 복원
	local wall_count = 21
	for i = 1, wall_count do
		self.get_wall_object(i).gameObject:SetActive(true)
	end

	-- 옥상 위 NPC 제거
	character_util.set_active_state(get_character('rooftop_swat_1'), 'disabled')
	character_util.set_active_state(get_character('rooftop_swat_2'), 'disabled')
	character_util.set_active_state(get_character('rooftop_police_1'), 'disabled')
	character_util.set_active_state(get_character('rooftop_police_2'), 'disabled')

	quest_marker_util.remove(self.quest_marker_name)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 's3_invader_missile_zone_1')
			and self.current_section_state == self.section_state.none then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.invader_missile_first_attack
		start_coroutine(self.invader_missile_first_zone, self)

		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 's3_rooftop_move')
			and self.current_section_state == self.section_state.invader_missile_first_attack then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.rooftop_move

		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 's3_invader_missile_show_1')
			and self.current_section_state == self.section_state.rooftop_move then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.invader_missile_first_show
		self:invader_missile_shot(field_util.get_marker_pos('s3_invader_missile_pos_6'), 0)

		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 's3_invader_missile_show_2')
			and self.current_section_state == self.section_state.invader_missile_first_show then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.invader_missile_second_show
		self:invader_missile_shot(field_util.get_marker_pos('s3_invader_missile_pos_7'), 0)

		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 's3_invader_show')
			and self.current_section_state == self.section_state.invader_missile_second_show then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.invader_dead
		start_coroutine(self.invader_dead_event, self)

		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 's3_swat_show')
			and self.current_section_state == self.section_state.invader_dead then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.swat_show
		start_coroutine(self.swat_move_event, self)

		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 's3_invader_missile_zone_2')
			and self.current_section_state == self.section_state.swat_show then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.invader_missile_second_attack
		start_coroutine(self.invader_missile_second_zone, self)

		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 's3_invader_missile_zone_3')
			and self.current_section_state == self.section_state.invader_missile_second_attack then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.invader_missile_third_show
		start_coroutine(self.invader_missile_third_show_event, self)

		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 's3_helicopter_zone')
			and self.current_section_state == self.section_state.invader_missile_third_show then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.helicopter_destroy
		start_coroutine(self.helicopter_destroy_event, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_rooftop_exit()) then
		start_coroutine(self.rooftop_move_event, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:invader_dead_event()
	-- 배틀 게이트 닫아줌
	local battle_door_count = 4
	for i = 1, battle_door_count do
		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.BattleGateCloseEvent.Create('s3_battle_gate_' .. i, false))
	end

	local alive_count = 1
	local civilian_count = 5
	local civilians = {}
	for i = 1, civilian_count do
		-- 스테이지 컨트롤러에 있는 키와 동일
		local cur_value = quest_util.get_custom_state(self.quest_progress, 'stage1_civilian_' .. i)

		-- 살아 있는 시민이라면
		if cur_value == 1 then
			local civilian = self.get_civilian(i)
			local move_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s3_civilian_run_pos_' .. alive_count)

			character_util.convert_to_npc(civilian)
			civilian.OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
			character_util.shake(civilian, 0.03, 9999)
			scene_util.set_direction(civilian, 'right', false)
			if i ~= 5 then
				scene_util.set_emotion_loop(civilian, 'scared')
			else
				scene_util.set_emotion_loop(civilian, 'damaged')
			end
			scene_util.set_anim_loop(civilian, 'cast', { upper = true })
			wp_util.move(civilian, move_pos, 7, nil, { last_direction = 'left', run = true })

			alive_count = alive_count + 1

			table.insert(civilians, civilian)
		end
	end

	-- 몬스터 등장
	local invader = get_character('s3_battle_invader_1')
	local appear_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s3_invader_pos_1')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_invader_beam_01')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Event_InvaderBeam'):Instantiate(appear_pos)
	character_util.set_position(invader, appear_pos)
	character_util.set_direction(invader, 'right')

	character_util.convert_to_monster(invader, 'invader_battle_s3', 's3_battle')
	command_util.execute_monster_notice(invader, user_party.Leader, 'battle')

	-- 3초 후 미사일 발사
	wait_for_sec(3)

	self:helicopter_missile_move()

	timeline_util.play('qs_main_s5', 'qs_main_s3_1')

	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_jump_01')
	party_util.look_at(invader)
	party_util.set_emotion({ name = 'surprise' })
	party_util.jump(0.5, 0.3)

	for i, civilian in pairs(civilians) do
		character_util.stop_shake(civilian)
		scene_util.set_emotion_loop(civilian, 'surprise')
		character_util.normal_jump(civilian)
		civilian.OverrideCrashBehaviour = nil
	end

	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	-- 배틀 게이트 다시 오픈
	for i = 1, battle_door_count do
		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.BattleGateOpenEvent.Create('s3_battle_gate_' .. i, false))
	end

	party_util.remove_emotion()

	-- 시민 다시 세팅
	for i, civilian in pairs(civilians) do
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(civilian, true)
		character_util.convert_to_following_npc(civilian, user_party, true)
	end

	-- 전투 종료 처리
	stage.BattleManager:ForceEndBattles()

	field_ui_manager:Show()
	party_util.reset_controllers()
end

function local_class:helicopter_missile_move()
	local invader = get_character('s3_battle_invader_1')
	local start_pos = invader.Position + vector(30, 4, 0)
	self.helicopter_missile = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_IronMissile_Proj'):Instantiate(start_pos)

	local sfx_check = false
	local distance = 9999
	local hit_distance = 1
	local speed = 13
	while distance > hit_distance do
		local invader_pos = invader.Position + vector(0.3, 0.5, 0)
		local diff = invader_pos - self.helicopter_missile.transform.position
		local direction = diff.normalized
		local move_direction = direction * speed * unity_class.time.deltaTime
		self.helicopter_missile.transform.position = self.helicopter_missile.transform.position + move_direction

		local rot = unity_class.quaternion.FromToRotation(unity_class.vector3.forward, direction)
		self.helicopter_missile.transform.localRotation = rot
		coroutine.yield()

		if screen_util.is_fo_in_screen(self.helicopter_missile.transform.position) and not sfx_check then
			sfx_check = true
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_missile_launch_01')
		end

		distance = diff.magnitude
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_villain_explosion_02')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_die_fat_ogre_01')
	self.helicopter_missile:Dispose()
	self.helicopter_missile = nil
end

	party_util.align_party(align_pos, 'down', 1, 'arc')

	-- 기동대(down, idle, 점프 1회): 모두 헬기에 탑승하세요!
	character_util.normal_jump(swat, '01_jump_01')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(swat, 'qs_main_s3_3')

	-- 기동대(down, idle, release): 기동대가 적을 막는 동안 한시라도 빨리 여기서 빠져나가야 합니다.
	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(scene_util.pointing_at, swat),
		util.cs_generator(scene_util.show_normal_speech_async, swat, 'qs_main_s3_4')
	})

	-- 구출한 시민이 있을 경우
	if alive_count > 1 then
		scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'down')

		local civilian = civilian_group[#civilian_group]

		local add_string = ''
		local talk_string_check = {
			{ npc = get_character('s2_civilian_1'), str = '_alt_3' },
			{ npc = get_character('s2_civilian_2'), str = '' },
			{ npc = get_character('s2_civilian_3'), str = '_alt_2' },
			{ npc = get_character('s2_civilian_4'), str = '_alt' },
			{ npc = get_character('s2_civilian_5'), str = '_alt_4' }
		}

		for i = 1, #talk_string_check do
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(talk_string_check[i].npc, civilian_group[1]) then
				add_string = talk_string_check[i].str
				break
			end
		end

		local civilian_parent = civilian.Transform.parent
		-- 초록 선택지: 여러분 먼저 타세요.
		-- 빨간 선택지: 자, 이제 수금할 시간이군.
		local choose = choose_util.play_choose_event({
			{ 'qs_main_s3_7', 'mercy' }, { 'qs_main_s3_9', 'brutal' } })

		if choose == 1 then
			scene_util.nod_the_head(leader, 1)

			character_util.set_locked_dir(leader, 'right')
			character_util.set_locked_dir(sohee, 'left')
			character_util.set_locked_dir(princess, 'right')

			wp_util.move(leader, leader.Position - vector(1, 0, 0), 1)
			wp_util.move(sohee, sohee.Position + vector(1, 0, 0), 1)
			wp_util.move_async(princess, princess.Position - vector(1, 0, 0), 1)

			scene_util.pointing_at(leader)

			--시민(공통): 가, 감사합니다…!
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
			scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(civilian_group[1], 'qs_main_s3_8' .. add_string)

			start_coroutine(function()
				wait_for_sec(0.3)

				character_util.reset_locked_dir(leader)
				character_util.reset_locked_dir(sohee)
				character_util.reset_locked_dir(princess)

				character_util.set_group_direction({ leader, princess, sohee }, 'up')
			end)
		else
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_clap_01')
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gatcha_point_01')
			scene_util.set_emotion_loop(leader, 'doyagao')
			scene_util.set_anim_loop(leader, 'clap')
			character_util.show_emoticon_async(leader, nil, 'gold')

			character_util.remove_anim(leader)

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_camera_emphasize_01')
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_crowd_shout_07')
			camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.3)
			character_util.group_normal_jump(civilian_group, '01_player_jump_01')
			scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(civilian_group[1], 'qs_main_s3_11' .. add_string)

			character_util.set_locked_dir(sohee, 'left')
			character_util.set_locked_dir(princess, 'right')

			wp_util.move(sohee, sohee.Position + vector(1, 0, 0), 1)
			wp_util.move(princess, princess.Position - vector(1, 0, 0), 1)

			start_coroutine(function()
				wait_for_sec(0.3)
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_big_01')
				unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit'):Instantiate(leader.Position + vector(0.3, 0.3, 0))
				character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(leader)
				character_util.set_direction(leader, 'right', false)
				scene_util.set_emotion_loop(leader, 'damaged')
				scene_util.set_anim_non_loop(leader, 'damaged2')
				character_util.move_to_async(leader, leader.Position - vector(1, 0, 0), 0.3)

				character_util.remove_anim(leader)

				wait_for_sec(0.5)

				character_util.remove_emotion(leader)
				character_util.reset_locked_dir(sohee)
				character_util.reset_locked_dir(princess)

				character_util.set_group_direction({ leader, princess, sohee }, 'up')

				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_angry_01')
				character_util.show_emoticon_async(leader, nil, 'annoyed')
			end)
		end

		scene_util.set_direction(swat, 'right', false)
		self:ridding_helicopter(civilian_group)

		scene_util.pointing_at(swat, 2, '01_swing_01', true)

		start_coroutine(self.res_holder_rotate, self, self.last_helicopter, vector(0, 180, 10), 1)
		self:res_holder_move(self.last_helicopter,
				self.last_helicopter.transform.localPosition, vector(0, 0.5, 0.5), 1)

		self:res_holder_move(self.last_helicopter,
				self.last_helicopter.transform.localPosition, vector(30, 0, 0), 2)

		-- 시민 제외
		civilian.Transform:SetParent(civilian_parent)
		for i, civilian in pairs(civilian_group) do
			character_util.set_position(civilian, vector(999, 0, 999))
		end

		start_coroutine(self.res_holder_rotate, self, self.last_helicopter, vector(0, 180, 0), 0)
		-- 기동대(right, idle, idle): 곧 다음 헬기가 올 겁니다. 그걸 타고 대피하시죠.
		scene_util.set_direction(swat, 'down')
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(swat, 'qs_main_s3_12')

		scene_util.nod_the_head(leader, 1)

		self:res_holder_move(self.last_helicopter,
				field_util.get_marker_pos('s3_helicopter_pos_3') - vector(20, 0, 0),
				vector(20, 0, 0), 2)

		wait_for_sec(0.5)
	else
		-- 기동대(right, idle, idle): 생존자는 여러분이 다입니까….
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(swat, 'qs_main_s3_5')

		-- 기동대(right, idle, nod): …얼른 타시죠.
		wait_all({
			util.cs_generator(scene_util.nod_the_head, swat, 1),
			util.cs_generator(scene_util.show_normal_speech_async, swat, 'qs_main_s3_6')
		})

		scene_util.nod_the_head(leader, 1)
	end

	camera_util.move(align_pos + vector(0, 0, 3), 1.5)

	scene_util.set_direction(swat, 'right')
	self:ridding_helicopter({ leader, princess, sohee })

	while true do
		scene_util.pointing_at(swat, 2, '01_swing_01', true)

		camera_util.move(self.last_helicopter.transform.localPosition + vector(0, 3.5, 0), 1)
		local camera_pos = self.last_helicopter.transform.localPosition + vector(0, 3.5, 0)

		start_coroutine(self.res_holder_rotate, self, self.last_helicopter, vector(0, 180, 10), 1)
		self:res_holder_move(self.last_helicopter,
				self.last_helicopter.transform.localPosition, vector(0, 0.5, 0.5), 1)

		start_coroutine(function()
			wait_for_sec(1)

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(sohee, { key = 'qs_main_s3_13', skip = true })
			wait_for_sec(2)

			local missile_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(self.last_helicopter.transform.localPosition)
			self:invader_missile_shot(missile_pos, 0, 0.7, 0.25)
			wait_for_sec(0.2)

			missile_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(self.last_helicopter.transform.localPosition)
			self:invader_missile_shot(missile_pos + vector(8, 0, 3), 0, 0.7, 0.25)
			wait_for_sec(0.2)

			missile_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(self.last_helicopter.transform.localPosition)
			self:invader_missile_shot(missile_pos + vector(10, 0, 7), 0, 1, 0.25)
			wait_for_sec(0.3)

			scene_util.set_emotion_loop(sohee, 'surprise')
			wait_for_sec(1)

			missile_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(self.last_helicopter.transform.localPosition)
			self:invader_missile_shot(missile_pos + vector(10, 0, 7), 0, 0.7, 0.25)
			wait_for_sec(0.2)

			missile_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(self.last_helicopter.transform.localPosition)
			self:invader_missile_shot(missile_pos + vector(4, 0, 3), 0, 0.6, 0.25)
			wait_for_sec(0.2)

			missile_pos = self.last_helicopter.transform.localPosition
			self:invader_missile_shot(missile_pos + vector(-2, 3, 0.3), 0, 0.9)
		end)

		start_coroutine(function()
			wait_for_sec(4)
			self:res_holder_rotate(self.last_helicopter, vector(0, 180, 0), 1)
			self:res_holder_rotate(self.last_helicopter, vector(0, 180, 10), 1)
		end)

		camera_pos = camera_pos + vector(21, 3, 5)
		camera_util.move(camera_pos, 6)

		self:res_holder_move(self.last_helicopter,
				self.last_helicopter.transform.localPosition, vector(21, 3, 5), 6)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_event_qs_02')
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'event', name = 'bgm_thriller', mix = 1 })

		if self.helicopter_sfx ~= nil then
			self.helicopter_sfx:FadeOut()
			self.helicopter_sfx = nil
		end

		camera_util.shake(0.4, 0.5)
		self.get_explosion_effect():Instantiate(self.last_helicopter.transform.localPosition - vector(4, 0, 0))
		speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(sohee)
		fire_object:SetActive(true)

		-- 날개로 굴러 떨어지는 연출
		local wing_attach = function(character, transform, alpha)
			local move_time = 0.5

			if not alpha then
				character.Transform:SetParent(sohee_parent)
			else
				character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(character, 1, move_time)
			end
			character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(character)
			character_util.set_active_shadow(character, false)

			character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(character,
					{ name = 'prostrate' }, { name = 'damaged' })

			character_util.set_position(character, riding_transform.position)
			character_util.spine_rotate(character, 360, move_time)

			local time_passed = 0
			while time_passed < move_time do
				time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

				local cur_pos = vector_util.lerp(riding_transform.position, transform.position, time_passed / move_time)
				character_util.set_position(character, cur_pos)

				coroutine.yield()
			end

			character_util.set_position(transform.position)
			character.Transform:SetParent(transform)
			character_util.spine_rotate(character, 0, 0)
		end

		start_coroutine(wing_attach, sohee, wing_transform_1, false)


		animator:Play('helicopter_damaged')

		camera_pos = camera_pos + vector(-5, 0, 0)
		camera_util.move(camera_pos, 5)
		start_coroutine(self.res_holder_move, self, self.last_helicopter,
				self.last_helicopter.transform.localPosition, vector(-5, 0, 0), 5)
		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		camera_util.shake(0.05, 8.5)
		wait_for_sec(2.0)

		character_util.set_direction(leader, 'left')
		start_coroutine(wing_attach, leader, wing_transform_2, true)
		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		start_coroutine(wing_attach, princess, wing_transform_3, true)
		wait_for_sec(2)

		-- 으악!!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_linda_scream_01')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(sohee, { key = 'qs_main_s3_16', skip = true, bubble_type = 'shout'
				, scale = 2, offset = vector(0, 0, 0.5), bubble_direction = 'none' })

		-- 소히 날라감
		sohee.Transform:SetParent(sohee_parent)
		sohee.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.identity
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(sohee, { name = 'embarrassed' }, { name = 'damaged' })
		character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(sohee)
		character_util.spine_rotate(sohee, 720, 2.2)
		character_util.jump(sohee, 1.5, 2.2)
		character_util.spine_scale(sohee, unity_class.vector3.one * 10, 2.2)
		character_util.move_to(sohee, sohee.Position + vector(-20, 1.5, -10), 2.2)

		camera_pos = camera_pos + vector(-2, 0, 0)
		camera_util.move(camera_pos, 2)
		start_coroutine(self.res_holder_move, self, self.last_helicopter,
				self.last_helicopter.transform.localPosition, vector(-6, 0, 1), 4)
		wait_for_sec(0.25)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_slowmotion_01')
		time_util.mod('qte_action_mod', 0.1)
		wait_for_sec(0.15)

		time_util.unmod('qte_action_mod')
		wait_for_sec(1.8)

		-- 꼬마 공주 먼저 떨어짐
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_slide_01')
		princess.Transform:SetParent(princess_parent)
		princess.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.identity
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(princess, { name = 'embarrassed' }, { name = 'damaged' })
		character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(princess)
		character_util.spine_rotate(princess, 720, 2.5)
		character_util.move_to(princess, princess.Position + vector(5, 0, 0.25), 0.4)

		-- 기사 꼬마공주 바라봄
		time_util.mod('qte_action_mod', 0.3)
		wait_for_sec(0.15)

		time_util.unmod('qte_action_mod')
		character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'attack' })

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_qte_action_wind_02')
		local qte_success = qte_util.swipe('right', 0.25, 0.1, false)

		camera_pos = camera_pos + vector(5, 0, 0)
		camera_util.move(camera_pos, 1)

		-- qte 성공 시
		if qte_success then
			time_util.mod('qte_action_mod', 0.3)

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_twohand_stomp_jump_01')
			character_util.set_direction(leader, 'right')
			character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(leader, { name = 'get', loop = false }, { name = 'attack' })
			leader.Transform:SetParent(leader_parent)
			leader.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.identity
			stage.SmokeManager:SetDefaultSmokeOnce(leader.Position)

			character_util.move_to(princess, princess.Position + vector(2, -0.5, 0), 0.5)
			character_util.move_to_async(leader, princess.Position + vector(1.5, -0.5, 0), 0.5)

			time_util.unmod('qte_action_mod')

			music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fall_down_01')
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_stomp_fire_02')
			camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.5)
			local bomb_effect = self.get_explosion_effect():Instantiate(self.last_helicopter.transform.localPosition)
			bomb_effect.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 1.5

			character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(leader, { name = 'embarrassed' }, { name = 'damaged' })

			character_util.spine_rotate(leader, 720, 1)
			character_util.spine_rotate(princess, 1040, 1)

			character_util.jump(leader, 4, 1)
			character_util.jump(princess, 4, 1)
			character_util.move_to(leader, leader.Position + vector(8, -2, -2), 1)
			character_util.move_to(princess, princess.Position + vector(8, -1.5, -2), 1)

			screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

			character_util.convert_to_npc(sohee)
			character_util.set_position(sohee, vector(999, 0, 999))

			leader.Transform:SetParent(leader_parent)
			princess.Transform:SetParent(princess_parent)

			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

			princess.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.identity
			leader.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.identity
			character_util.spine_rotate(leader, 0, 0)
			character_util.spine_rotate(princess, 0, 0)

			leader:HideWeapon(false)
			sohee:HideWeapon(false)
			princess:HideWeapon(false)

			character_util.set_active_shadow(leader, true)
			character_util.set_active_shadow(princess, true)

			wait_for_sec(2)

			yield_return_func(quest_util.progress_section, self.controller)

			break
		else
			character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'damaged' })

			time_util.mod('qte_action_mod', 0.4)

			character_util.move_to(princess, princess.Position + vector(8, -2, -1), 1.5)
			wait_for_sec(0.2)

			time_util.unmod('qte_action_mod')

			music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_01')
			screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

			wait_for_sec(1)

			-- 핼기 초기화
			fire_object:SetActive(false)
			animator:Play('empty')
			self.last_helicopter.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(0, 180, 0))
			start_coroutine(self.res_holder_move, self, self.last_helicopter,
					field_util.get_marker_pos('s3_helicopter_pos_3'), vector(0, 0, 0), 1)

			-- 파티 상태 초기화
			party_util.remove_emotion()
			party_util.remove_animation()

			leader.Transform:SetParent(leader_parent)
			princess.Transform:SetParent(princess_parent)
			sohee.Transform:SetParent(sohee_parent)

			leader.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.identity
			princess.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.identity
			sohee.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.identity

			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(leader, 0, 0)
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(princess, 0, 0)
			character_util.spine_rotate(leader, 0, 0)
			character_util.spine_rotate(princess, 0, 0)
			character_util.spine_rotate(sohee, 0, 0)
			character_util.spine_scale(sohee, unity_class.vector3.one, 0)
			wait_for_sec(0.5)

			-- 소희 다시 앉힘
			character_util.move_to_async(sohee, riding_transform.position, 0)
			scene_util.set_anim_loop(sohee, 'seat')
			sohee.Transform:SetParent(riding_transform)

			camera_util.move(align_pos + vector(0, 0, 3), 0)

			music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field' })
			self.helicopter_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx(
					{ sfx_name = '01_aircraft_01', loop = true, parent = self.helicopter_fo,
					  type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc', max_distance = 10 })

			screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
		end
	end
end

function local_class:ridding_helicopter(character_list)
	local move_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('s3_helicopter_pos_2')
	local riding_transform = self.last_helicopter.transform:Find('demonworld_helicopter/Riding_Point').transform
	local helicopter_pos = riding_transform.position
	local start = 1

	for i = start, #character_list do
		wp_util.move(character_list[i], move_pos - vector(0, 0, 0.7 * (i - 1)),
				nil, 1)
	end

	wait_for_sec(1.2)

	-- 마지막 캐릭터 빼고 알파 적용
	while start < #character_list do
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')
		scene_util.set_anim_non_loop(character_list[start], 'get')
		character_util.jump(character_list[start], 1, 0.5)
		character_util.move_to_async(character_list[start], helicopter_pos - vector(0, 0, 1.5), 0.5)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_land_01')
		character_util.remove_anim(character_list[start])
		wp_util.move(character_list[start], helicopter_pos, nil, 0.6, { last_direction = 'right' })
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(character_list[start], 0, 0.6)
		start = start + 1

		wait_for_sec(0.6)

		local j = 1
		for i = start, #character_list do
			wp_util.move(character_list[i], move_pos - vector(0, 0, 0.7 * (j - 1)),
					nil, 0.45)
			j = j + 1
		end

		wait_for_sec(0.5)
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')
	scene_util.set_anim_non_loop(character_list[start], 'get')
	character_util.jump(character_list[start], 0.8, 0.5)
	character_util.move_to_async(character_list[start], helicopter_pos - vector(0, 0, 1.5), 0.5)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_land_01')
	character_util.remove_anim(character_list[start])
	wp_util.move_async(character_list[start], helicopter_pos, nil, 0.6, { last_direction = 'right' })

	scene_util.set_anim_loop(character_list[start], 'seat')
	character_list[start].Transform:SetParent(riding_transform)
end

function local_class:res_holder_move(object, start_pos, move_distance, duration)
	local end_pos = start_pos + move_distance
	local time_passed = 0

	while time_passed < duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		object.transform.localPosition = vector_util.lerp(start_pos, end_pos, time_passed / duration)

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	object.transform.localPosition = end_pos
end

function local_class:res_holder_rotate(object, target_rotation, duration)
	local time_passed = 0

	local start_rotation = object.transform.localRotation.eulerAngles
	local end_rotation = target_rotation

	while time_passed <= duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local cur_angle = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_rotation, end_rotation, time_passed / duration)
		object.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(cur_angle)

		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

function local_class:evaluate_direction_factor_by_position(position, center)
	if center == nil then
		return 0
	end

	-- 캐릭터가 맵 중앙 기준 오른쪽에 있음
	if position.x < center.x then
		return 1
	end

	-- 캐릭터가 맵 중앙 기준 왼쪽에 있음
	return -1
end


function local_class:guardian_jump_and_aim()
	local boss_phase_1 = self.get_boss_robot_by_phase(1)

	if boss_phase_1 == nil then
		return
	end

	local function convert_factor_to_opposite_direction(factor)
		if factor == 1 then
			return 'left'
		elseif factor == -1 then
			return 'right'
		else
			return 'none'
		end
	end

	local knight = user_party.Leader
	local center = boss_phase_1.Position - vector(0, 0, 2)
	local dir_vector = vector_util.get_x0z(knight.Position - center).normalized
	local dir_factor = self:evaluate_direction_factor_by_position(knight.Position, center)

	local move_info = {
		dest = center + vector(3.5 * dir_factor, 3, -1),
		duration = 0.5,
		speed = nil
	}

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_tap_guide_01')

	-- 방향에 따라서 qte 방향 조절
	if dir_factor == 1 then
		qte_util.swipe('right', nil, false, false, false)
	elseif dir_factor == -1 then
		qte_util.swipe('left', nil, false, false, false)
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_qte_action_wind_02')

	character_util.stop(knight)
	character_util.remove_anim(knight)
	character_util.spine_rotate(knight, -390 * dir_factor, move_info.duration)
	character_util.set_direction(knight, convert_factor_to_opposite_direction(dir_factor))

	character_util.set_emotion(knight, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.set_anim(knight, { name = 'bow_attack_ready_start', loop = true })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_lightning_strike_03')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_laser_build_up_03')

	-- 커스텀 이동 로직
	local knight_original_pos = user_party.Leader.Position
	local knight_shadow_transform = user_party.Leader.SpineController.ShadowTransform
	local knight_original_shadow_pos = knight_shadow_transform.position
	local timer = 0
	while timer < move_info.duration do

function local_class:co_update_charge_effect()

end

function local_class:co_update_projetile_move(dir_factor)
	local target = self.get_boss_robot_by_phase(1)

	if target == nil then
		return
	end

	local projectile_spawn_pos = user_party.Leader.Position + vector(0.5 * -dir_factor, -2.9, 2.6)
	local projectile_move_dist_vec = vector(2.3 * -dir_factor, 0, 0.8)
	local projectile_dest = projectile_spawn_pos + projectile_move_dist_vec

	local function rotate_projectile()
		local trail_spawn_pos = projectile_spawn_pos + vector(0, 0.1, 0)

		local projectile = self.get_knight_projectile():Instantiate(projectile_spawn_pos)
		local trail = self.get_knight_projectile_trail():Instantiate(trail_spawn_pos)

		if projectile ~= nil and trail ~= nil then
			projectile.transform.localRotation
				= unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 66 * -dir_factor , 0)
			trail.transform.localRotation
				= unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 0, (66 * dir_factor))
		end

		return projectile, trail
	end

	local function update_projectile(projectile, trail)
		local moving_duration = 1
		local timer = 0
		local original_pos = projectile.transform.position
		local is_duration_changed = false

		while timer < moving_duration do
			timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

			local progress = timer / moving_duration
			local current_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(original_pos, projectile_dest, progress)
			projectile.transform.position = current_pos
			trail.transform.position = current_pos

			if (progress > 0.2) and not is_duration_changed then
				-- 타임 모드를 품과 동시에 화살이 더 빨리 이동할 수 있도록 수치 조정 처리
				is_duration_changed = true
				time_util.unmod('action')
				original_pos = projectile.transform.position
				timer = 0
				moving_duration = 0.2
			end

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end

	local projectile, trail = rotate_projectile()

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_bow_shot_11')
	update_projectile(projectile, trail)

	projectile:Dispose()
	projectile = nil

	trail:Dispose()
	trail = nil
end

	local jump_height = lua_helper.get_or_default(data.jump_height, 0.2)
	local duration = lua_helper.get_or_default(data.duration, 0.3)
	local angle = lua_helper.get_or_default(data.angle, 8)

	if (shoot_dir.x > 0) then
		shoot_dir = shoot_dir * -1
	end

	CS.Oak.CharacterExtensions.RecoilType1(character, shoot_dir, deviate_dist, jump_height, duration, angle)
end

	end

	character_util.set_anim(magwi_b, { name = 'attack', loop = false, next_anim = 'idle'})
	wait_for_sec(0.15)

	local sine_move_data = {
		from = magwi_b.Position + vector(0.5, 1.5, 0),
		to = magwi_b.Position + vector(0.8, 0.1, 0),
		height = 0,
		duration = 0.1
	}

	local sprite = self.magwi_wig.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))

	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(function()
			sp_util.sine_move(self.magwi_wig, sine_move_data)
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_event_qs_07')

			sine_move_data = {
				from = sprite.Transform.position,
				to = sprite.Transform.position + vector(0.75, 0, 0),
				height = 0.5,
				duration = 0.4
			}

			sp_util.sine_move(self.magwi_wig, sine_move_data)
		end),
		util.cs_generator(function()
			local rotation_timer = 0
			while rotation_timer < 0.5 do
				rotation_timer = rotation_timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime
				local rotation_progress = rotation_timer / sine_move_data.duration
				sprite.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(240 * 4 * rotation_progress, unity_class.vector3.up)
				local current = sprite.Transform.localRotation.eulerAngles
				sprite.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, current.y, 0)
				coroutine.yield()
			end
		end),
	})

	-- drop_item_util.move_item_async(self.magwi_wig,
	-- self.magwi_wig.transform.position + vector(0.25, 0, -0.5), { duration = 0.5, angle = 420})


	local fade_duration = 1
	local timer = 0
	local cur_prog_color = sprite.TintColor

	while timer < fade_duration do
		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local progress = timer / fade_duration
		sprite.TintColor = cur_prog_color * (1 - progress)
		sprite:Rebuild()

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	sprite.TintColor = unity_class.color(0, 0, 0, 0)
	sprite:Rebuild()

	wait_for_sec(sine_move_data.duration)
end

	end

		start_coroutine(self.co_play_boss_clear_cut_scene, self)
	end, self)

	timeline_table.register_action('invader_14_police_8_pushing', function(self)
		start_coroutine(self.co_invader_14_police_8_pushing, self)
	end,self)

	timeline_table.register_action('reset', function(self)
		start_coroutine(function()
			self.is_section_ended = true

		end)
	end, self)

	end, self)

	sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(self.co_play_epilogue, self)

end

function local_class:set_dynamic_npcs()
	local invader_name = 'invader_'
	local police_name = 'police_'

	local invader_marker_name = 's31_invader_pos_'
	local police_marker_name = 's31_police_pos_'

	local num_invaders = 29
	local num_polices = 18

	local invader_init_ban_list = { 1, 2, 3, 4, 11, 17 }
	local police_init_ban_list = { 11 }

	local function table_contains(table, element)
		for _, value in ipairs(table) do
		  if value == element then
			return true
		  end
		end
		return false
	end

	for i = 1, num_invaders do
		if table_contains(invader_init_ban_list, i) == false then
			local invader = get_character(invader_name .. i)
			local marker_name = invader_marker_name .. i
			character_util.set_position_from_marker(invader, marker_name)
			character_util.set_direction(invader, field_util.get_marker_dir(marker_name))
			character_util.remove_color(invader, 'dead', 0)
			character_util.set_active_state(invader, 'enabled')
			character_util.remove_anim(invader)
		end
	end

	for i = 1, num_polices do
		if table_contains(police_init_ban_list, i ) == false then
			local police = get_character(police_name .. i)
			local marker_name = police_marker_name .. i
			character_util.set_position_from_marker(police, marker_name)
			character_util.set_direction(police, field_util.get_marker_dir(marker_name))
			character_util.spine_set_attachment(police, '[base]weapon1', 'basic_handgun')
			character_util.remove_color(police, 'dead', 0)
			character_util.set_anim(police, { name = 'handgun_idle', loop = true })
		end
	end
end

function local_class:co_invader_14_police_8_pushing()
	local invader_name = 'invader_'
	local police_name = 'police_'

	local invader = get_character(invader_name .. 14)
	local police = get_character(police_name .. 8)

	if invader == nil or police == nil then
		return
	end

	local original_police_position = police.Position
	local original_invader_position = invader.Position

	local timer = 0

	while self.is_section_ended == false do
		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local sin_move_vec = vector(0, 0, math.sin(timer) * 0.4)
		police.Position = original_police_position + sin_move_vec
		invader.Position = original_invader_position + sin_move_vec
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:co_regroup()
	local pymon, andras, crosselle = self.get_prime_demons()
	local princess = self.get_princess()
	local china_hero = self.get_pei_mei()
	local bolt = self.get_bolt_b_2legs()

	if pymon == nil or andras == nil or crosselle == nil or princess == nil or china_hero == nil or bolt == nil then
		return
	end

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 1 })
	local amb_ship_sound = music_player_util.play_sfx({
		sfx_name = '01_amb_ship_01', loop = true, parent = user_party.Leader,
		type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc', fade_in_time = 1
	})
	local bolt_shake_and_wake_up = function(bolt)
		-- 볼트 동력원 앞에 일어선다.
		-- walk4legs로 0.5초 떨고
		character_util.shake(bolt, 0.03, 1)
		wait_for_sec(1)

		-- eat scale 0으로 재생해서 0.3초 떨고
		scene_util.set_anim_non_loop(bolt, 'eat', { scale = 0 })
		character_util.shake(bolt, 0.03, 2)
		wait_for_sec(2)

		-- damaged2 재생하고 0.3초 떨고
		scene_util.set_anim_non_loop(bolt, 'damaged2', { scale = 0 })
		character_util.shake(bolt, 0.03, 1)
		wait_for_sec(1)

		--idle로 세우기.
		character_util.remove_anim(bolt)
	end

	local boss_phase_1 = self.get_boss_robot_by_phase(1)
	local boss_phase_2 = self.get_boss_robot_by_phase(2)

	if boss_phase_1 == nil or boss_phase_2 == nil then

-- 볼트 주기적으로 흔드는 루틴
function local_class:start_shaking_bolt(bolt)
	self.keep_shake_bolt = true

	local shake_magnitude = 0.04
	local shake_duration = 0.2
	local wait_duration = 0.45

	while self.keep_shake_bolt do
		character_util.shake(bolt, shake_magnitude, shake_duration)
		wait_for_sec(wait_duration)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:co_bolt_headbutting(pull_back_waiting_duration, resting_duration, use_hit_fx, shake_power_source, power_source)
	local bolt = self.get_bolt_b_2legs()

	if bolt == nil then
		return
	end

	shake_power_source = lua_helper.get_or_default(shake_power_source, false)
	power_source = lua_helper.get_or_default(power_source, nil)

	self.keep_headbutting = true
	self.pull_back_waiting_duration = pull_back_waiting_duration
	self.reseting_duration = resting_duration
	self.use_hit_fx = use_hit_fx

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(bolt)

	while self.keep_headbutting do
		character_util.shake(bolt, 0.05, 9999999999)
		character_util.set_anim(bolt, { name = 'bow_damaged', loop = false})
		character_util.spine_rotate(bolt, 15, 0.15)
		character_util.spine_deviate_local(bolt, vector(-0.1, 0, 0), 0.15, 999999)
		character_util.spine_deviate_local_angle(bolt, vector(-0.1, 0, 0), 0.15, 999999)
		scene_util.set_emotion_loop(bolt, 'damaged')

		wait_for_sec(self.pull_back_waiting_duration)

		if self.keep_headbutting == false then
			return
		end

		character_util.stop_shake(bolt)
		character_util.set_anim(bolt, { name = 'damaged2', loop = false})
		character_util.spine_rotate(bolt, -15, 0.15)
		character_util.spine_deviate_local(bolt, vector(0.1, 0, 0), 0.15, 999999)
		character_util.spine_deviate_local_angle(bolt, vector(0.1, 0, 0), 0.15, 999999)

		if self.use_hit_fx then
			unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit'):Instantiate(bolt.Position + vector(0.35, 0.1, 0.65))
		end

		if shake_power_source and power_source ~= nil then
			start_coroutine(self.shake_power_source_for_duration, self, power_source, 0.03, 0.2)
		end

		character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(bolt)
		character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(bolt)
		scene_util.set_emotion_loop(bolt, 'attack')

		wait_for_sec(self.reseting_duration)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:change_headbutting_param(pull_back_waiting_duration, resting_duration, use_hit_fx)
	self.pull_back_waiting_duration = pull_back_waiting_duration
	self.reseting_duration = resting_duration
	self.use_hit_fx = use_hit_fx
end

function local_class:stop_headbutting()
	self.keep_headbutting = false
end

function local_class:shake_power_source(power_source, magnitude)
	local base_position = power_source.SpriteTransform.position

	self.keep_shaking_power_source = true

	while self.keep_shaking_power_source do
		local cur_x = unity_class.random.Range(-magnitude, magnitude)
		local cur_z = unity_class.random.Range(-magnitude, magnitude)

		power_source.SpriteTransform.position = base_position + vector(cur_x, 0, cur_z)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end


-- 바닥에 깔려있는 줄 때문에 drop_item_util.shake를 사용할 수가 없어서 커스텀 하게 구현 ㅡ.ㅡ
function local_class:shake_power_source_for_duration(power_source, magnitude, duration)
	local base_position = power_source.SpriteTransform.position

	self.keep_shaking_power_source = true
	local timer = 0
	while timer < duration do
		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local cur_x = unity_class.random.Range(-magnitude, magnitude)
		local cur_z = unity_class.random.Range(-magnitude, magnitude)

		power_source.SpriteTransform.position = base_position + vector(cur_x, 0, cur_z)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	power_source.SpriteTransform.position = base_position
end

-- 화면을 붉게 점멸하는 코루틴
function local_class:start_red_tinting()
	local is_tint = false
	local tint_duration = 0.5
	local timer = tint_duration
	local tint_color = unity_class.color.red
	local tint_key = 'bolt_tinting'

	self.keep_red_tinting = true

	while self.keep_red_tinting do
		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if timer >= tint_duration then
			timer = 0

			if not is_tint then
				is_tint = true

				field_util.tint(tint_key, tint_color, tint_duration)
			else
				is_tint = false

				field_util.remove_tint(tint_key, tint_duration)
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if is_tint then
		field_util.remove_tint(tint_key, tint_duration / 3)
	end
end

function local_class:start_power_source_tinting(power_source)
	local tinting_duration = 0.3

	while self.keep_red_tinting do
		drop_item_util.add_color_async(power_source, unity_color({ 0.5, 0, 0, 1 }), tinting_duration)
		drop_item_util.add_color_async(power_source, unity_color({ 1, 1, 1, 1 }), tinting_duration)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end


return local_class

	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 's4_invader_appear')
			and self.current_section_state == self.section_state.none then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.battle_start
		start_coroutine(self.invader_appear_routine, self)

		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 's4_helicopter_zone')
			and self.current_section_state == self.section_state.battle_end then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.helicopter_zone
		start_coroutine(function()
			timeline_util.play_async('qs_main_s1', 'qs_main_s4_2')
		end)

		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 's4_missile_zone')
			and self.current_section_state == self.section_state.helicopter_zone then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.missile_zone
		start_coroutine(function()
			timeline_util.play_async('qs_main_s2_1', 'qs_main_s4_3')
		end)
		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 's4_qte_zone_1')
			and self.current_section_state == self.section_state.missile_zone then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.qte_zone_1
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(self.qte_zone_1_event, self)

		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 's4_event_1') and
			self.current_section_state == self.section_state.qte_zone_1_end then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.civilian_event
		start_coroutine(self.civilian_dead_event, self)

		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 's4_qte_zone_2')
			and self.current_section_state == self.section_state.civilian_event
			and self.npc_help_check[1] and self.npc_help_check[2] then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.qte_zone_2
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.qte_zone_2_event, self)

		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 's4_kid_girl_show')
			and self.current_section_state == self.section_state.qte_zone_2 then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.kid_girl_show
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.kid_girl_show, self)

		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 'BATTLE_4')
			and self.current_section_state == self.section_state.kid_girl_show then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.battle
		start_coroutine(self.battle_in, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	if e.BattleGroupName == 'battle_4' then
		start_coroutine(self.battle_after_event, self)

		return true
	elseif e.BattleGroupName == 'invader_battle_3' and
			self.current_section_state == self.section_state.battle_start then
		self.current_section_state = self.section_state.battle_end
		local battle_door_count = 12
		for i = 1, battle_door_count do
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateOpenEvent.Create('battle_gate_3_' .. i, false))
		end

		return true
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_damage_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.sender, user_party.Leader) and
			e.Info.type & (CS.Oak.DamageType.Trap | CS.Oak.DamageType.WallHit) == CS.Oak.DamageType.None then
		for i = 1, #self.battle_invader_list do
			local invader = self.get_invader(self.battle_invader_list[i])
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, invader) then
				local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()

				--- 유저의 영웅의 패시브 능력등을 추가로 발동시키지 않기 위해 패시브 플래그를 달아줌
				damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Trap | CS.Oak.DamageType.Passive
				damage_info.sender = user_party.Leader
				damage_info.target = invader
				damage_info.damage = invader.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP
				damage_info.direction = (invader.Position - user_party.Leader.Position).normalized

				command_util.execute_damage(damage_info)

				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_field_object_destroyed_event(e)
	for i = 1, #self.battle_invader_list do
		local invader = self.get_invader(self.battle_invader_list[i])
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, invader) then
			start_coroutine(self.npc_battle_end, self, i)
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_stage_end_event(e)
	self.npc_help_check[1] = true
	self.npc_help_check[2] = true
	self.npc_attack_routine_check = false

	return false
end

function local_class:npc_attack_routine()
	local invader_1 = self.get_invader(11)
	local invader_2 = self.get_invader(12)
	local invader_3 = self.get_invader(17)

	local civilian_1 = self.get_civilian(16)
	local civilian_2 = self.get_civilian(25)

	self.npc_attack_routine_check = true
	local time_passed = 0
	local time_count = 0
	while self.npc_attack_routine_check do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		if time_passed >= 0.1 then
			time_count = time_count + 1
			time_passed = 0
		end

		if time_passed == 0 and time_count == 1 then
			character_util.set_animation_n_times(invader_1, { name = 'attack', count = 1 })
			character_util.set_animation_n_times(invader_3, { name = 'attack', count = 1 })

		elseif time_passed == 0 and (time_count == 4 or time_count == 14) then
			character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(civilian_1)
			character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(civilian_1)

			character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(civilian_2)
			character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(civilian_2)

			if self.current_section_state ~= self.section_state.qte_zone_1 then
				music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_hit_big_01',
											 play_pos = civilian_1.Position + vector(0, 0.2, 0) })
				music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_hit_big_01',
											 play_pos = civilian_2.Position + vector(0, 0.2, 0) })
			end
			unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit'):Instantiate(civilian_1.Position + vector(0, 0.2, 0))
			unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit'):Instantiate(civilian_2.Position + vector(0, 0.2, 0))
		elseif time_passed == 0 and time_count == 10 then
			character_util.set_animation_n_times(invader_2, { name = 'attack', count = 1 })
			character_util.set_animation_n_times(invader_3, { name = 'attack', count = 1 })
		end

		time_count = time_count % 20

		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

function local_class:bomb_fall(target_pos, delay, move_time, radius, explosion_scale, sfx_play)
	local start_pos = target_pos + vector(0, 15, 0)

	local attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(unity_class.vector3.zero, radius)
	attack_range:Show()
	attack_range.transform.position = vector_util.get_x0z(target_pos, target_pos.y + 0.1)

	local time_passed = 0
	while time_passed < delay and not self.qte_routine_reset do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	time_passed = 0
	local missile_effect = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_DarkMagicMissile_Proj'):Instantiate(start_pos)
	missile_effect.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * explosion_scale
	if sfx_play then
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_dark_magician_shoot_01', play_pos = target_pos })
	end

	while time_passed < move_time and not self.qte_routine_reset do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / move_time)

		missile_effect.transform.position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, target_pos, progress)
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	missile_effect:Dispose()
	attack_range.gameObject:SetActive(false)
	CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(attack_range)

	if not self.qte_routine_reset then
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_hit_dark_01', play_pos = target_pos })
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_explosion_kick_02', play_pos = target_pos })

		local explosion_effect = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_DarkMagicMissile_Proj_Explosion'):Instantiate(target_pos)
		explosion_effect.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * explosion_scale
		camera_util.shake(0.15, 0.3)
	end
end

function local_class:car_rotation_move(car, target_pos, angle, duration)
	local start_rotation = car.transform.localRotation
	local end_rotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(angle)
	local start_position = car.Position

	local time_passed = 0
	while time_passed < duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local progress = (time_passed / duration)
		car.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Lerp(start_rotation, end_rotation, progress)
		car.Position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_position, target_pos, progress)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	car.transform.localRotation = end_rotation
	car.Position = target_pos
end

						self.get_civilian(31),

	local invader_group = {}
	local trailer_invader_count = 10
	for i = 1, trailer_invader_count do
		table.insert(invader_group, self.dynamic_npcs['trailer_move_invader_' .. i])
	end

	local push_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_rustle_01', loop = true })
	local qte_count = { 8, 16, 24 }
	local qte_success = { false, false }
	while tap_count < qte_count[#qte_count] do
		if tap_count >= qte_count[1] and not qte_success[1] then
			qte_success[1] = true

			camera_util.resize_by_ratio(3.5, 0.3)
			character_util.set_group_emotion(npc_group, { name = 'mad' })
			message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, { 'trailer_stop_shake' }))
			message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, { 'trailer_move', 2, 0.5, '0.3, 0, 0' }))
			character_util.move_group_distance(npc_group, vector(0.3, 0, 0),
					0.5, nil, false, false)
			character_util.move_group_distance_async(invader_group, vector(0.3, 0, 0),
					0.5, nil, false, true)

			message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, { 'trailer_shake' }))
		elseif tap_count >= qte_count[2] and not qte_success[2] then
			qte_success[2] = true

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_evolution_01')
			camera_util.resize_by_ratio(3, 0.3)
			character_util.set_group_emotion(npc_group, { name = 'burning' })
			message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, { 'trailer_stop_shake' }))
			message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, { 'trailer_move', 2, 0.5, '0.3, 0, 0' }))
			character_util.move_group_distance(npc_group, vector(0.3, 0, 0),
					0.5, nil, false, false)
			character_util.move_group_distance_async(invader_group, vector(0.3, 0, 0),
					0.5, nil, false, true)

			message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, { 'trailer_shake' }))
		end

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	push_sfx:Stop()

	screen_util.close_tutorial_spine()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(touch_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
end

function local_class:assassinate_routine(index, fo)
	while not self.npc_help_check[index] do
		self:able_to_assassinate(fo)
		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

--뒤통수 90도만 암살 가능
function local_class:able_to_assassinate(fo)
	local dir = vector_util.to_direction(fo.Position - user_party.Leader.Position)
	if dir == fo.Direction then
		self:remove_from_no_assassinate(fo)
	else
		self:add_to_assassinate(fo)
	end
end

--암살 불가 리스트 등록
function local_class:add_to_assassinate(fo)
	stage.BattleManager:AddToNoAssassination(fo)
end

--암살 불가 리스트 제거
function local_class:remove_from_no_assassinate(fo)
	stage.BattleManager:RemoveFromNoAssassination(fo)
end

function local_class:shake_sfx_end()
	if self.trailer_shake_sfx ~= nil then
		self.trailer_shake_sfx:Stop()
		self.trailer_shake_sfx = nil
	end
end

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('QueenShipMainSection6')

--[[QuestAttribute
