]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	self.available_stage_name = 'queenship_1_1'

	self.quest_marker_name = 'queenship_main'

	self.game_name = 'QSShootingGame'
	self.mini_game = nil
	self.game_constants_key = 'qs_shooting_game'

	-- gimmick
	self.get_shear_controller = function()
		return get_field_object('shear')
	end

	-- 변경하기 전 기존 shear
	self.origin_shear = nil
	self.shear_controller = nil

	-- 진행도
	self.section_state = {
		none = 1,
		interact_crosselle = 2,
	}

	self.current_section_state = self.section_state.none

	self.talk_npc_check = { false, false }

	-- 리소스 홀더
	self.res_holder = nil
	self.dragon_prefab = nil
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	self.res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent), 'on_mini_game_end_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.AnimationEvent), 'on_animation_event')

	get_character('pymon').Interactable.Talk = 'qs_main_s6_1'
	get_character('pymon').Interactable.TalkSfx = '01_evolution_01'
	get_character('andras').Interactable.Talk = 'qs_main_s6_2'
	get_character('andras').Interactable.TalkSfx = '01_fade_out_03'
	character_util.add_listener(get_character('crosselle'), self.controller)

	CS.UnityEngine.QualitySettings.skinWeights = CS.UnityEngine.SkinWeights.FourBones
	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller,
			self.quest_marker_name, get_character('crosselle'), true)
	--start_coroutine(self.start_game, self)
end

function local_class:exit()
	stage_camera:GetComponentInParent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.AudioListener)).enabled = true

	CS.UnityEngine.QualitySettings.skinWeights = CS.UnityEngine.SkinWeights.OneBone

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.AnimationEvent))

	if not is_unity_null(self.dragon_prefab) then
		CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Destroy(self.dragon_prefab)
	end
	self.dragon_prefab = nil

	if self.res_holder ~= nil then
		self.res_holder:Dispose()
	end
	self.res_holder = nil

	self.talk_npc_check = nil
	character_util.remove_relate_event(get_character('pymon'), self.controller)
	character_util.remove_relate_event(get_character('andras'), self.controller)
	character_util.remove_relate_event(get_character('crosselle'), self.controller)

	quest_marker_util.remove(self.quest_marker_name)
	quest_marker_util.remove(self.quest_marker_name .. 1)
	quest_marker_util.remove(self.quest_marker_name .. 2)

	if self.mini_game then
		mini_game_manager:DisposeMiniGame(self.game_name)
		self.mini_game = nil
	end

	self.shear_controller = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_mini_game_end_event(e)
	if e.Name == self.game_name then
		if e.Success then
			start_coroutine(self.stage_clear_routine, self)
			return true
		else
			start_coroutine(self.minigame_fail_routine, self)
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_character('crosselle')) then
		if self.current_section_state == self.section_state.none then
			self.current_section_state = self.section_state.interact_crosselle
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(self.crosselle_talk, self)
		else
			start_coroutine(self.crosselle_start_game, self)
		end

		return true
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_character('andras')) then
		if not self.talk_npc_check[1] then
			self.talk_npc_check[1] = true
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(self.andras_talk, self)
		else
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(self.andras_talk_second, self, false)
		end

		return true
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_character('pymon')) then
		if not self.talk_npc_check[2] then
			self.talk_npc_check[2] = true
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(self.pymon_talk, self)
		else
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(self.pymon_talk_second, self, false)
		end

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_animation_event(e)
	if e.EventName == 'wing_sfx' then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_wing_fire_02')
		return true
	end
	return false
end
--endregion

function local_class:crosselle_talk()
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5, 1)

	quest_marker_util.remove(self.quest_marker_name)

	local crosselle = get_character('crosselle')
	local pymon = get_character('pymon')
	local andras = get_character('andras')
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	self.controller:remove_weapon(crosselle)

	--크로셀과 상호작용 시 좌측에 정렬
	party_util.align_party(crosselle, 'left', 1, 'linear')

	--크로셀(left, idle, idle): 왔군요. 저는 이번 작전에서 오퍼레이팅을 맡은 크로셀이에요.
	scene_util.set_direction(crosselle, 'left')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(crosselle, 'idle')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(crosselle, 'qs_main_s6_3')

	--크로셀(left, idle, release): 임무를 무사히 완수하고 싶다면 제 말을 잘 따라주세요.
	character_util.play_speech_action(crosselle,
			{ name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' }, nil, 'qs_main_s6_4')

	--가디언 right, idle, nod 2회
	scene_util.nod_the_head(leader, 2)

	--크로셀(left, smile, idle): 좋아요. 말귀를 잘 알아듣는 인간이군요.
	character_util.play_speech_action(crosselle, nil, 'smile', 'qs_main_s6_5')

	--크로셀(left, idle, release): 함선 내부에 진입하면 전투는 저 둘이 맡을 거예요.
	character_util.play_speech_action(crosselle,
			{ name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' }, nil, 'qs_main_s6_6')

	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'left')
	wait_for_sec(0.7)

	scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'right')

	--크로셀(left, idle, idle): 출발하기 전에 간단하게 인사라도 하고 오시죠.
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(crosselle, 'qs_main_s6_7')

	--크로셀(left, smile, bomb_idle): 낯선 인간은 벌레랑 착각하기 쉬워서 실수로 죽일 수도 있거든요.
	character_util.play_speech_action(crosselle, 'bomb_idle', 'smile', 'qs_main_s6_8')

	--가디언, 공주 right, scared, idle shake 0.02 1초
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
	party_util.shake(0.02, 1)
	party_util.set_emotion({ name = 'scared' })
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--크로셀(right, idle): 그동안 저는 침투로를 확인하고 있을게요.
	party_util.remove_emotion()
	scene_util.set_direction(crosselle, 'right')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(crosselle, 'qs_main_s6_9')

	--대화 끝, 컨트롤 풀림, 파이몬과 안드라스 머리 위에 각각 마커.
	character_util.remove_relate_event(crosselle, self.controller)
	character_util.add_listener(pymon, self.controller)
	character_util.add_listener(andras, self.controller)

	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller,
			self.quest_marker_name .. 1, pymon, true)

	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller,
			self.quest_marker_name .. 2, andras, true)

	--이때 크로셀 인터렉트 시 마지막 대사 출력
	--그때까지 저는 침투 경로를 확인하고 있을게요.
	crosselle.Interactable.Talk = 'qs_main_s6_9'

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1, 1)
end

function local_class:pymon_talk()
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5, 1)

	quest_marker_util.remove(self.quest_marker_name .. 1)

	local pymon = get_character('pymon')
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	self.controller:remove_weapon(pymon)

	party_util.align_party(pymon, 'right', 1, 'linear')

	--파이몬(left, attack, cross_arm): 이상하군…! 예전엔 좀 더 힘이 넘치는 기분이었는데…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(pymon, 'cross_arm')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(pymon, 'qs_main_s6_10')

	--파이몬(left, attack, idle): 지금은 내 몸이 완전히 내 몸 같지가 않다!!
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(pymon, 'idle')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(pymon, 'qs_main_s6_11')

	--파이몬 숙주(left, tired, cast): …당연하잖아, 진짜 네 몸이 아니니까…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_unlock_03')

	scene_util.set_anim_loop(pymon, 'cast')

	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(pymon, 'qs_main_s6_13')

	--파이몬(down, idle, idle): 음… 그게 아니라 뭔가 부족한 느낌인데…
	self.controller:talk_end_pymon_host()
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(pymon, 'idle')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(pymon, 'idle')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(pymon, 'qs_main_s6_14')

	--파이몬(down, smile, victory_get): 뭐! 상관없겠지!!
	scene_util.set_direction(pymon, 'down')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(pymon, 'smile')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(pymon, 'qs_main_s6_15')

	--파이몬 숙주(down, tired, cast): 우으으… 이런 울퉁불퉁한 몸 정말 싫어….
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
	self.controller:talk_pymon_host()
	scene_util.set_direction(pymon, 'down')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(pymon, 'tired')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(pymon, 'cast')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(pymon, 'qs_main_s6_16')

	--파이몬(right, idle, idle): …?
	self.controller:talk_end_pymon_host()
	scene_util.set_direction(pymon, 'right')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(pymon, 'idle')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(pymon, 'idle')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(pymon, 'qs_main_s6_17')

	--파이몬(right, idle, cross_arm): 뭐냐, 네놈은? 처음 보는 얼굴이다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(pymon, 'cross_arm')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(pymon, 'qs_main_s6_18')

	--선택지 출력
	--초록: 방금 전에 봤는데?
	--노랑: 해리성 정체감 장애에 기억상실까지 앓고 있군요.
	local choose = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		{ 'qs_main_s6_18_1', 'mercy' }, { 'qs_main_s6_18_2', 'intellect' } })

	if choose == 1 then
		--파이몬 (right, idle, idle) emoticon_bubble_question
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_notice_01')
		scene_util.set_anim_loop(pymon, 'idle')
		character_util.show_emoticon_async(pymon, nil, 'question')

		--파이몬 (right, attack, release): 기억이 안 나는데 언제 봤다는 말이냐!!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
		character_util.play_speech_action(pymon,
				{ name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' }, 'attack', 'qs_main_s6_18_3')
	else
		--파이몬 (right, idle, idle) emoticon_bubble_silence
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		scene_util.set_anim_loop(pymon, 'idle')
		character_util.show_emoticon_async(pymon, nil, 'silence')

		--파이몬 (right, attack, release): 뭐냐! 네놈은! 처음 보는 얼굴이다!!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
		character_util.play_speech_action(pymon,
				{ name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' }, 'attack', 'qs_main_s6_18_4')
	end

	--파이몬 right, idle, idle

	--가디언 (left, tired, question) 1.2초 대기 (0.6초쯤 도중에 파이몬 틴트)
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(leader, 'tired')
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(leader, nil, 'silence')
	wait_for_sec(0.6)

			scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(pymon, 'qs_main_s6_18_11')

			scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(pymon, 'qs_main_s6_18_15')

			scene_util.set_direction(pymon, 'down')
			scene_util.set_anim_loop(pymon, 'idle')
			scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(pymon, 'qs_main_s6_18_16')

			scene_util.set_direction(pymon, 'right')
			scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(pymon, 'qs_main_s6_18_17')

			--파이몬 숙주 (right, idle, idle): 파이몬을 완전히 분리할 방법을 찾을 때까진 이렇게 지내야 한대요….

			scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(pymon, 'qs_main_s6_18_18')

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_02')

function local_class:npc_talk_success_check()

			field_ui_manager:Show()
			return
		else
			music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 2 })

			--크로셀(right, idle, idle): 그럼 올라탈 준비하세요.
			scene_util.set_direction(crosselle, 'right')
			scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(crosselle, 'qs_main_s6_31_5')

			--크로셀(right, idle, idle): 마룡으로 변하는 건 제한이 있어서 서둘러야 할 거예요.
			scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(crosselle, 'qs_main_s6_32')

			--0.5초간 화이트 아웃
			--0.7초 대기 (안드라스와 파이몬 안 보이게 제거)
			--1초간 화이트 인
			--화이트 인 시 크로셀(미니게임에 사용 중인 용 모습)이 옥상 우측에 날고 있음(옆모습)
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_dragon_01')
			crosselle.SpineController:AddFadeColor(crosselle.Name, CS.UnityEngine.Color(1, 1, 1, 1), 1, 1)
			--pymon.SpineController:AddFadeColor(pymon.Name, CS.UnityEngine.Color(1, 1, 1, 1), 1, 1)
			--andras.SpineController:AddFadeColor(andras.Name, CS.UnityEngine.Color(1, 1, 1, 1), 1, 1)
			screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.white, 'linear')

			self.controller:remove_weapon(leader)
			self.controller:remove_weapon(princess)
			character_util.set_position(crosselle, vector(999, 0, 999))

			party_util.align_party(vector(-15.9, 5, 62), 'left', 0.7, 'linear')
			character_util.set_position(andras, vector(-16.2, 5, 62))
			character_util.set_position(pymon, vector(-15.5, 5, 62))
			character_util.set_direction(andras, 'right')
			character_util.set_direction(pymon, 'right')

			camera_util.move_async(vector(-14.5, 5, 62), 0)

			self.dragon_prefab = load_util.load_prefab_async(self.res_holder,
					'ondemand/v2_49_queenship/theatres/airraid', 'airraid_dragon')

			self.dragon_prefab.transform.localPosition = vector(-11.5, 5.5, 63)
			self.dragon_prefab.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 90, 0)

			local animator = self.dragon_prefab:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
			animator:Play('map_idle')

			local skinned_mesh_renderer = self.dragon_prefab.transform:Find('Crosselle_andras_pymon'):GetComponent(
					typeof(CS.UnityEngine.SkinnedMeshRenderer))
			skinned_mesh_renderer.quality = CS.UnityEngine.SkinQuality.Bone4

			local leader_parent = leader.Transform.parent
			local princess_parent = princess.Transform.parent
			local pymon_parent = pymon.Transform.parent
			local ansras_parent = andras.Transform.parent
			local knight_transform = self.dragon_prefab.transform:Find('Bip001/Bip001 Pelvis/knight_pos')
			local princess_transform = self.dragon_prefab.transform:Find('Bip001/Bip001 Pelvis/princess_pos')
			local pymon_transform = self.dragon_prefab.transform:Find('Bip001/Bip001 Pelvis/pymon_pos')
			local andras_transform = self.dragon_prefab.transform:Find('Bip001/Bip001 Pelvis/andras_pos')

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_dragon_02')
			screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.white, 'linear')

			local tail_move = function(npc, transform)
				character_util.move_to_async(npc, vector(-15.5, 5, 62),
						nil, 3, false, true)

				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_twohand_stomp_jump_01')
				scene_util.set_anim_non_loop(npc, 'get')

				local start_pos = npc.Position
				local time_passed = 0
				local move_time = 1
				local height = 3
				while time_passed < move_time do
					time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
					local progress = time_passed / move_time
					npc.Position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, transform.transform.position, progress) +
							vector(0, unity_class.mathf.Sin(unity_class.mathf.PI * progress) * height, 0)
					coroutine.yield()
				end
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_hit_npc_01')

				scene_util.set_anim_loop(npc, 'push')

				npc.Transform:SetParent(transform)
				character_util.set_position(npc, vector(0, 0, 0))
			end

			start_coroutine(tail_move, pymon, pymon_transform)
			wait_for_sec(0.3)

			start_coroutine(tail_move, andras, andras_transform)
			wait_for_sec(0.3)

			start_coroutine(tail_move, leader, knight_transform)
			wait_for_sec(0.3)

			tail_move(princess, princess_transform)

			wait_for_sec(1)

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_event_qs_06')
			animator:Play('map_idle_fly')

			wait_for_sec(2)

			screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

			character_util.remove_anim(leader)
			character_util.remove_anim(princess)
			character_util.remove_anim(pymon)
			character_util.remove_anim(andras)

			user_party.Leader.Transform:SetParent(leader_parent)
			princess.Transform:SetParent(princess_parent)
			pymon.Transform:SetParent(pymon_parent)
			andras.Transform:SetParent(ansras_parent)

			princess.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.identity
			leader.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.identity
			pymon.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.identity
			andras.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.identity

			character_util.set_direction(leader, 'up')
			character_util.set_direction(princess, 'up')
			character_util.set_direction(pymon, 'up')
			character_util.set_direction(andras, 'up')

			self:start_game()
			return
		end
	end
end

function local_class:start_game()
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, { 'deactive_rain' }))

	-- 미니게임에서 shear 적용되지 않도록 처리
	if not self.shear_controller then
		self.shear_controller = self.get_shear_controller():GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.ShearController))
		self.origin_shear = self.shear_controller.Shear
	end

	self.shear_controller.Shear = 0

	if self.mini_game == nil then
		self.mini_game = mini_game_manager:GetOrCreate(self.game_name)
	end

	local is_mini_game_load_complete = false
	mini_game_manager:LoadResource(self.game_name, self.game_constants_key, function()
		is_mini_game_load_complete = true
	end)

	while not is_mini_game_load_complete do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	-- 스피치 버블 구간용
	local bubble_default_pos = vector(-297, -5, 10)
	local bubble_angle = vector(15, 0, 0)

	local crosselle = get_character('crosselle')
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(crosselle, 'qs_main_s6_33', true,
			{ world_pos = bubble_default_pos, euler_angle = bubble_angle, scale = 2 })

	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(crosselle, 'qs_main_s6_34', true,
			{ world_pos = bubble_default_pos, euler_angle = bubble_angle, scale = 2 })

	mini_game_manager:StartMiniGame(self.game_name)
end

function local_class:stage_clear_routine()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	if self.mini_game then
		mini_game_manager:DisposeMiniGame(self.game_name)
		self.mini_game = nil
	end

	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	self.shear_controller.Shear = self.origin_shear

	quest_util.progress_section(self.controller)

	CS.Oak.TeleportPartyStageLogic.Execute('exit_1', 'queenship_1_2', '', true, nil, true)
end

function local_class:minigame_fail_routine()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	if self.mini_game then
		mini_game_manager:DisposeMiniGame(self.game_name)
		self.mini_game = nil
	end

	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	self:start_game()
end

return local_class

			end)

	wait_for_sec(0.7)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_contact_01')

	music_player_util.play_stage_music(

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(crosselle,

	self.worldmap_controller:stage_marker('queenship_1_7')

	self.play_contact_sfx = true

	start_coroutine(self.play_contact_sfx_event, self)

	self.worldmap_controller:ruin_on()
	self.worldmap_controller:ev_on()

function local_class:play_contact_sfx_event()
	local timer = 1
	local duration = 1

		if timer >= duration then
			timer = 0

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_contact_01')
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.lower_marker_name = 'lobby_lower'
	self.left_marker_name = 'lobby_left'
	self.right_marker_name = 'lobby_right'

function local_class:on_pre_load()

	self.get_fx_gunshot()
	self.get_custom_sprite()

	yield_return(unity_object_pool, 'WaitAll')

	-- 총알 프리로드
	local res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()
	local custom_atlas
	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
			res_holder, 'spritesheets/projectiles', 'projectiles_custom', function(prefab)
				custom_atlas = prefab.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomAtlas))
				custom_atlas:Initialize()
			end)

		bullet_sprite.transform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.one * 999
		bullet_sprite.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 0, 0)
		bullet_sprite.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one

function local_class:enter()

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchControlModeChangeEvent), 'on_touch_control_mode_changed_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_custom_stage_event')

	for i = 1, self.lobby_invader_num do
		self.get_lobby_invader(i).SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', 'rail_shot_rifle')
	end

	local inner_patrol_invader_nums = { 1, 2, 3, 4 }
	local inner_patrol_start_num = 6

	for i = 1, #inner_patrol_invader_nums do
		for j = 1, inner_patrol_invader_nums[i] do
			local cur_invader = self.get_inner_patrol_invader(inner_patrol_start_num + i - 1, j)

			buff_manager:AddBuff(
					cur_invader, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None, cur_invader, 'speed_down_persistent', 50, false, false)

			cur_invader.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', 'rail_shot_rifle')
			cur_invader.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

			table.insert(self.inner_patrol_invaders, cur_invader)
		end
	end

	return true
end

	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller,
			self.quest_marker_name, field_util.get_marker_pos(self.center_marker_name), true)
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchControlModeChangeEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))

	timeline_table.unregister_action('play_loop_sound')
	
	self.inner_patrol_invaders = nil
	self.lobby_invader_reset_poses = nil

	if self.loop_sfx ~= nil then
		self.loop_sfx:Stop()
		self.loop_sfx = nil
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, get_party_leader()) then return end
	if not e.FullEnter then return end

	if not self.is_hide_event and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.event_zone_name) then
		self.is_hide_event = true
		self.hide_event_ing = false

		-- 잠입 이벤트
		start_coroutine(self.invader_appear_event, self)

		return true
	elseif self.hide_event_ing and
			type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), self.get_out_event_zone_name) then
		self.detected_event_ing = false
		self.hide_event_ing = false

		-- 종료 이벤트
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(self.ending_event, self)
	elseif string.find(e.Zone.Name, self.inner_patrol_zone_name) then
		local idx = tonumber(string.sub(e.Zone.Name, #e.Zone.Name, #e.Zone.Name))

		self:enter_inner_patrol_zone(idx)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, get_party_leader()) then return end
	if not e.FullLeave then return end

	if string.find(e.Zone.Name, self.inner_patrol_zone_name) then
		self:leave_inner_patrol_zone()
	end
end

function local_class:on_touch_control_mode_changed_event(e)
	if self.is_hide_button then
		self.is_hide_button = false

		start_coroutine(self.hide_button_when_mode_changed, self)
	end
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if not self.detected_event_ing and string.find(e:GetParamAt(0), self.detected_event_name) then
		local idx = tonumber(string.sub(e:GetParamAt(0), #e:GetParamAt(0), #e:GetParamAt(0)))

		self.detected_event_ing = true
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
				stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.detected_event, self, e.Sender, idx, e:GetParamAt(0)))

		return true
	end

	return false
end
--endregion

-- 인베이더들 등장하는 이벤트
function local_class:invader_appear_event()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	-- sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon을 사용하지 못하는 상황이라 복사해서 가져다 붙임
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.hide_weapon(user_party[i], true)
	end

	local cached_leader = user_party.Leader
	if cached_leader.CharacterStatsBehaviour ~= nil then
		cached_leader.CharacterStatsBehaviour:AddStatsOptionRequest(
				stage.StageGameObject, CS.Oak.CharacterStatsOptions.Invincible)
	end

	local current_state = cached_leader.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentActionState
	if lua_helper.type_compare(current_state, CS.Oak.CharacterHoldUpState) then
		local hold_target = current_state.HoldTarget
		if hold_target ~= nil then
			command_util.execute_throw(cached_leader, hold_target, direction_util.to_vector3(cached_leader.Direction)
			, cached_leader.Position, 4, false)
		end
	end

	quest_marker_util.remove(self.quest_marker_name)

	timeline_util.play_async('qs_main_s8', 'qs_main_s8_1')

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.set_anim(user_party[i], { name = 'walk4legs', scale = 0.5 })
	end

	for i = 1, self.lobby_invader_num do
		self.get_lobby_invader(i).CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

		table.insert(self.lobby_invader_reset_poses, self.get_lobby_invader(i).Position)
	end

	-- 걷기만 가능하도록 설정
	local manual_touch_state = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState.Create(get_party_leader(), false)
	manual_touch_state:DisableControls(CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(CS.Oak.DisabledControls.All)
			~ CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Move))

	local state_change_event = CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(manual_touch_state)
	message_system:SendSync(get_party_leader().FieldObjectController, state_change_event)

	buff_manager:RemoveBuff(get_party_leader(), CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None, get_party_leader(), 'speed_down_persistent')
	buff_manager:AddBuff(get_party_leader(), CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None,
			get_party_leader(), 'speed_down_persistent', 30, false, false)

	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.quest_marker_name,
			field_util.get_marker_pos(self.right_marker_name), true)

	self:invader_setting(false)

	party_util.reset_controllers()

	-- Reset이 바로 되지 않으므로 2프레임 대기
	coroutine.yield(nil)
	coroutine.yield(nil)

	self.is_hide_button = true

	-- 필요 없는 UI 제거
	field_ui_manager:Show()

	field_ui_manager:HideTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.SkillButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ClassButton |
			CS.Oak.FieldUiType.RoleButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton)
end

-- 인베이더들 설정
function local_class:invader_setting(is_reset)
	for i = 1, #self.inner_patrol_invaders do
		character_util.remove_anim(self.inner_patrol_invaders[i])
	end

	for i = 3, 6 do
		self:set_waypoint_guard_invader(self.get_lobby_invader(i), nil, is_reset, i)
	end

	self.hide_event_ing = true
end

-- 인베이더들 WayPointGuardCharacterController 설정
function local_class:set_waypoint_guard_invader(target, waypoint_list, is_reset, idx)
	buff_manager:RemoveBuff(target, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None, target, 'speed_down_persistent')
	buff_manager:AddBuff(target, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None, target, 'speed_down_persistent', 50, false, false)

	target.FieldObjectController = CS.Oak.WayPointGuardCharacterController.Create(
			target, self.detected_event_name..'_1', 4, 60, false, true)

	if waypoint_list ~= nil then
		character_util.set_anim(target, { name = 'rifle_walk' })
	else
		character_util.set_anim(target, { name = 'rifle_idle' })
	end

	if is_reset then
		target.Position = self.lobby_invader_reset_poses[idx]
	end
end

-- 내부 감시병 존 입장 카메라 처리
function local_class:enter_inner_patrol_zone(idx)
	stage_camera:CancelMove()
	stage_camera:CancelResizeTo()

	local cur_marker_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos(self.inner_patrol_marker_name..idx)

	camera_util.move(cur_marker_pos, 0.7, { ignoreCameraGrids = true })

	if idx == 1 then
		camera_util.resize_by_ratio(5.2, 0.7)
	else
		camera_util.resize_by_ratio(6, 0.7)
	end
end

-- 내부 감시병 존 퇴장 카메라 처리
function local_class:leave_inner_patrol_zone()
	stage_camera:CancelMove()
	stage_camera:CancelResizeTo()

	camera_util.move(get_party_leader().Position, 0.7,
			{ target = get_party_leader(), end_target = get_party_leader() })
	camera_util.resize_to_default(0.7)
end

-- 발각될 경우 발생하는 이벤트
function local_class:detected_event(shooter, idx, event_name)
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	local scared = function(fo, dir)
		character_util.stop(fo)
		character_util.set_direction(fo, dir)
		character_util.set_anim(fo, { name = 'embarrassed' })
		character_util.set_emotion(fo, { name = 'scared' })
		character_util.normal_jump(fo)
	end

	local dir = vector_util.to_direction(shooter.Position - get_party_leader().Position)

	for i = 1, self.lobby_invader_num do
		self.get_lobby_invader(i).FieldObjectController = CS.Oak.NPCCharacterController()
		character_util.stop(self.get_lobby_invader(i))
		character_util.remove_anim(self.get_lobby_invader(i))
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_gun_reload_01')

	scared(get_party_leader(), dir)
	scared(self.get_princess(), dir)

	character_util.set_anim(shooter, { name = 'rifle_reload', loop = false })

	wait_for_sec(1)

	coroutine.yield(self:simple_shoot(shooter, get_party_leader(), dir))

	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(1,'linear')

	-- 플레이어 파티 초기화
	local reset_marker_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos(self.reset_marker_name..idx)
	local reset_marker_dir = field_util.get_marker_dir(self.reset_marker_name..idx)

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.set_position(user_party[i],
				reset_marker_pos +
						direction_util.to_vector3(direction_util.get_opposite(reset_marker_dir)) *
								i * constants.dist_between_party_members)
		character_util.set_direction(user_party[i], reset_marker_dir)

		character_util.set_anim(user_party[i], { name = 'walk4legs', scale = 0.5 })
		character_util.remove_emotion(user_party[i])
	end

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	camera_util.resize_to_default(0)
	camera_util.move_async(get_party_leader().Position, 0, { end_target = get_party_leader() })

	-- 인베이더 초기화
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, { 'reset', event_name }))

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	self:invader_setting(true)

	self.detected_event_ing = false

	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(1, 'linear')

	-- Reset이 바로 되지 않으므로 2프레임 대기
	party_util.reset_controllers()

	coroutine.yield(nil)
	coroutine.yield(nil)

	-- 필요 없는 UI 제거
	field_ui_manager:Show()

	field_ui_manager:HideTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.SkillButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ClassButton |
			CS.Oak.FieldUiType.RoleButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton)
end

--region bullet

-- 탄환 가져옴
function local_class:get_bullet()
	for i = 1, #self.pooled_bullet do
		local bullet_sprite = self.pooled_bullet[i].transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
		if bullet_sprite.transform.localPosition == unity_class.vector3.one * 999 then
			return self.pooled_bullet[i]
		end
	end
end

-- 단순 탄환 발사 연출
function local_class:simple_shoot(shooter, target, dir, blacked)
	local vtr
	if dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Left then
		vtr = vector(1, 0, 0)
	elseif dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Right then
		vtr = vector(-1, 0, 0)
	elseif dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Down then
		vtr = vector(0, 0, 1)
	elseif dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Up then
		vtr = vector(0, 0, -1)
	end

	local is_black = lua_helper.get_or_default(blacked, false)

	character_util.stop(target)

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_gun_shoot_09')
	character_util.set_anim(shooter,
			{ name = 'rifle_shoot', loop = false, next_anim = 'rifle_idle', scale = 0.5 })

	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	self:fire_bullet_effect(self:get_bullet().transform,
			shooter.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.2), target.Position, 25)

	camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.2)

	self.get_fx_gunshot():Instantiate(target.Position + vector(0, 0.3, 0))

	music_player_util.play_sfx(
			{ sfx_name = '02_explosion_01', play_pos = target.Position,
			  type_priority = 'event', max_distance = 40, min_distance = 25 })

	character_util.set_direction(target, dir)

	if dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Down then
		character_util.set_anim(target, { name = 'dead3', loop = false })
	elseif dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Up then
		character_util.set_anim(target, { name = 'walk4legs', loop = false })
	else
		character_util.set_anim(target, { name = 'dead2', loop = false, scale = 3 })
	end

	character_util.set_emotion(target, { name = 'damaged' })

	local knock_back_info = character_util.knockback_info(
			'physics', true, vtr, 15000, 0.05,
			CS.Oak.Constants.DefaultFrictionCoefficient)

	local ckms = CS.Oak.CharacterKnockBackState.Create(target, knock_back_info)
	target.FieldObjectBehaviour:OnEvent(CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(ckms))

	if is_black then
		target.SpineController:AddColor(target.Name, unity_color({0.4, 0.4, 0.4, 1}), 1, 0.5)
	end
end

-- 탄환 발사 이펙트 처리
function local_class:fire_bullet_effect(bullet_sprite, sniper_pos, target_pos, speed)
	music_player_util.play_sfx(
			{ sfx_name = '02_gun_shoot_08',
			  parent = get_party_leader(), type_priority = 'event', max_distance = 8 })

	bullet_sprite.localPosition = sniper_pos

	local look_rotation = unity_class.quaternion.LookRotation(target_pos - sniper_pos)
	bullet_sprite.localRotation = look_rotation * unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 0, 0)

	yield_return_func(CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.MoveTo, bullet_sprite,
			bullet_sprite.localPosition, target_pos, -1, nil, speed, false)

	bullet_sprite.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.one * 999
end
--endregion

-- 탈출 완료하면 실행되는 이벤트
function local_class:ending_event()
	quest_marker_util.remove(self.quest_marker_name)

	local center_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos(self.center_marker_name)

	local cur_invader_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.Character)
	for i = 3, 6 do
		cur_invader_list:Add(self.get_lobby_invader(i))
	end

	for i = 0, cur_invader_list.Count - 1 do
		cur_invader_list[i].FieldObjectController = CS.Oak.NPCCharacterController()
	end

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1, 1)

	if self.loop_sfx ~= nil then
		self.loop_sfx:FadeOut(2)
		self.loop_sfx = nil
	end

	camera_util.move_async(center_pos + vector(0, 0, 1), 1.5)

	local talker = self.get_lobby_invader(1)
	talker.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', 'empty')
	character_util.set_position(talker, vector(center_pos.x - 1.5, 0, center_pos.z - 6.5))
	character_util.set_anim(talker, { name = 'run' })
	character_util.set_emotion(talker, { name = 'attack' })

	character_util.move_to_async(talker, talker.Position + vector(0, 0, 8),
			nil, 6, true, false, true)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')

	for i = 0, cur_invader_list.Count - 1 do
		cur_invader_list[i].SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', 'empty')
		character_util.look_at(cur_invader_list[i], talker)
		character_util.set_emotion(cur_invader_list[i], { name = 'attack' })
	end

	character_util.set_direction(talker, 'right')
	character_util.set_anim(talker, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(talker, { key = self.main_script..6, skip = true })

	character_util.remove_anim(talker)

	character_util.set_anim(cur_invader_list[1], { name = 'cast2' })

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(cur_invader_list[1], { key = self.main_script..7, skip = true })

	character_util.set_anim(talker, { name = 'shoot' })

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(talker, { key = self.main_script..8, skip = true })

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create(self.lobby_bulkhead_door_name, false))

	for i = 0, cur_invader_list.Count - 1 do
		character_util.set_anim(cur_invader_list[i], { name = 'run' })

		local cur_pos = cur_invader_list[i].Position
		local waypoint_list = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)

		waypoint_list:Add(vector(cur_pos.x - 6, 0, cur_pos.z))
		waypoint_list:Add(vector(cur_pos.x - 6, 0, center_pos.z))
		waypoint_list:Add(vector(cur_pos.x - 12, 0, center_pos.z))

		character_util.move_waypoint(cur_invader_list[i], waypoint_list, 6,
				true, 'stop', 'floor', 'left')
	end

	local waypoint_list = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)

	waypoint_list:Add(talker.Position + vector(-6, 0, 0))
	waypoint_list:Add(talker.Position + vector(-6, 0, -1.5))
	waypoint_list:Add(talker.Position + vector(-10, 0, -1.5))

	character_util.set_anim(talker, { name = 'run' })
	character_util.move_waypoint(talker, waypoint_list, 6,
			true, 'stop', 'floor', 'left', true)

	while true do
		if talker.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentAction == CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.Stopped then
			break
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- 내부 순찰 인베이더 숨김
	local inner_patrol_invader_nums = { 1, 2, 3, 4 }
	local inner_patrol_start_num = 6

	for i = 1, #inner_patrol_invader_nums do
		for j = 1, inner_patrol_invader_nums[i] do
			local cur_invader = self.get_inner_patrol_invader(inner_patrol_start_num + i - 1, j)

			cur_invader.FieldObjectController = CS.Oak.NPCCharacterController()
			character_util.set_active_state(cur_invader, 'disabled')
		end
	end

	camera_util.move_async(get_party_leader().Position, 1, { end_target = get_party_leader() })

	for i = 0, cur_invader_list.Count - 1 do
		character_util.set_position(cur_invader_list[i], vector(999, 0, 999))
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(cur_invader_list[i])
	end

	character_util.set_position(talker, vector(999, 0, 999))
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(talker)

	buff_manager:RemoveBuff(get_party_leader(), CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None, get_party_leader(), 'speed_down_persistent')

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.remove_anim(user_party[i])
	end

	-- 공격, 필살기 키 원상복구
	local manual_touch_state = get_party_leader().FieldObjectController.CurrentState
	if manual_touch_state ~= nil and
			lua_helper.type_compare(manual_touch_state, CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState) then
		manual_touch_state:RemoveDisableControl(get_party_leader())
	end

	self.is_hide_button = false

	-- 제거된 UI 다시 표시
	field_ui_manager:HideTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.SkillButton |
			CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ClassButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.RoleButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton)

	-- 다음 섹션으로
	yield_return_func(quest_util.progress_section, self.controller)
end

-- 루프 사운드 실행
function local_class:play_loop_sound()
	self.loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx(
			{ sfx_name = "01_siren_loop_07", fade_in_time = 2, loop = true, type_priority = 'loop' })
end

-- TouchControlModeChangeEvent를 받았을 경우, 버튼이 초기화되어서 비활성화된 버튼도 보이는 문제가 있음
-- 따라서 버튼이 변경될 때까지 1프레임 기다린 뒤, 다시 버튼을 비활성화
function local_class:hide_button_when_mode_changed()
	coroutine.yield(nil)

	-- 필요 없는 UI 제거
	field_ui_manager:Show()

	field_ui_manager:HideTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.SkillButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ClassButton |
			CS.Oak.FieldUiType.RoleButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton)

	self.is_hide_button = true
end

return local_class

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	timeline_util.load_playable('qs_main_s9_1')
	timeline_util.load_playable('qs_main_s9_2')

	self.res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()

	yield_return_func(CS.ScreenPlay.QueenShipOperatorUIExtensions.LoadOperatorUI, function(operator_ui)
		self.operator_ui_controller = operator_ui
		-- GT-1333 아랍어 대응
		if game_string.IsRTL and self.operator_ui_controller.operatorLabel.transform.localScale.x > 0 then
			local scale = self.operator_ui_controller.operatorLabel.transform.localScale
			scale.x = -scale.x

			self.operator_ui_controller.operatorLabel.transform.localScale = scale
			self.operator_ui_controller.operatorLabel.alignment = CS.TMPro.TextAlignmentOptions.TopRight
		end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TeslaCoilOnOffEvent), 'on_tesla_coil_on_off_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), 'on_field_object_destroyed_event')

	local plasma_bomber = get_character(self.plasma_bomber_name)
	plasma_bomber.FieldObjectController = CS.Oak.NPCCharacterController()

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.FieldUITopHPBarIgnoreTargetEvent.Create(plasma_bomber, true))

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TeslaCoilOnOffEvent))

	return false

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, get_party_leader()) then return end
	if not e.FullEnter then return end

	if not self.is_enter_event_zone and e.Zone.Name == self.event_zone_name then
		self.is_enter_event_zone = true

		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(self.plasma_bomb_tutorial_event, self)
	end
end

	if not self.is_finished_magnet_tutorial then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(get_field_object(self.tutorial_magnet_name), e.CoilObject) then
			quest_marker_util.remove(self.quest_marker_name)

			quest_marker_util.show(self.controller,
					self.quest_marker_name, field_util.get_marker_pos(self.center_marker_name), true)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_field_object_destroyed_event(e)

		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(self.eliminate_plasma_bomb_event, self)
	end
end

-- 플라즈마 폭탄 튜토리얼 이벤트
function local_class:plasma_bomb_tutorial_event()
	quest_marker_util.remove(self.quest_marker_name)

	timeline_util.play_async('qs_main_s9', 'qs_main_s9_1')

	-- 플라즈마 폭탄병 세팅
	local waypoint_list = create_generic_list(CS.System.String)
	waypoint_list:Add('1, 3')
	waypoint_list:Add('0, 2')
	waypoint_list:Add('1, 3')
	waypoint_list:Add('0, 2')

	local plasma_bomber = get_character(self.plasma_bomber_name)
	plasma_bomber.FieldObjectController = CS.Oak.FugitiveCharacterController.Create(waypoint_list, 4, 10, nil)

	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller,
			self.quest_marker_name, plasma_bomber, true)
end

-- 크로셀 홀로그램 이벤트
function local_class:crosselle_show_hologram()
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	yield_return_func(self.operator_ui_controller.InitPortrait, self.operator_ui_controller, 'demon_operator')

	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
			self.res_holder, 'ondemand/v2_49_queenship/worldmap/chapter_15', 'worldmap', function(prefab)
				local worldmap_prefab = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Instantiate(prefab)
				self.worldmap_controller = worldmap_prefab:GetComponent(
						typeof(CS.Oak.UI.QueenShipWorldMapController)).GetControllerLuaTable
			end)

	self.worldmap_controller:init_controller()
	self.worldmap_controller:stage_marker('queenship_1_2')

	camera_util.move_async(vector(-100, 0, 0), 0)

	wait_for_sec(0.7)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_contact_01')

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	yield_return_func(self.operator_ui_controller.SetLabelKeyAsync, self.operator_ui_controller,
			self.main_script..3, -1, 0.05, 1, nil, true, self.main_script..3, true, nil, true, true)

	self.worldmap_controller:ruin_on()

	wait_for_sec(1)

	yield_return_func(self.operator_ui_controller.SetLabelKeyAsync, self.operator_ui_controller,
			self.main_script..4, -1, 0.05, 1, nil, true, self.main_script..4, true, nil, true, true)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	self.worldmap_controller:end_controller()

	camera_util.move_async(
			field_util.get_marker_pos('plasma_tutorial_event_center') +
					vector(6, 0, 0), 0)

	wait_for_sec(0.7)

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
end

-- 플라즈마 폭탄 제거 이벤트
function local_class:eliminate_plasma_bomb_event()
	local custom_keys = require('Quest/Main/QueenShip/Common/CustomDataKeyConstants.lua')
	local common_keys = custom_keys.common

	-- 플라즈마 폭탄병 처치 여부, 폭탄 수 저장용 커스텀 데이터 키
	local plasma_bomber_dead_custom_key = common_keys.bomber_dead_default
	local plasma_bomb_count_custom_key = common_keys.bomb_count

	if stage_progress_util.get_custom_data_int(plasma_bomber_dead_custom_key, 0) == 0 then
		stage_progress_util.set_custom_data_async(plasma_bomber_dead_custom_key, 1)

		local bomb_count = stage_progress_util.get_custom_data_int(plasma_bomb_count_custom_key, 0)
		stage_progress_util.set_custom_data_async(plasma_bomb_count_custom_key, bomb_count + 1)

		-- UI 갱신 하도록 이벤트 보냄
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, {'refresh_resource_ui'}))
	end

	quest_marker_util.remove(self.quest_marker_name)

	timeline_util.play_async('qs_main_s9', 'qs_main_s9_2')

	-- 다음 섹션으로
	yield_return_func(quest_util.progress_section, self.controller)
end

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('MissingBethSection1')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = MissingBeth @
		Comment = MissingBeth 퀘스트/이벤트 섹션 @
		Index = 0 @
		NextSections = 1 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	self.carpenter_1_name = 'missingbeth_demon_carpenter_1'
	self.carpenter_2_name = 'missingbeth_demon_carpenter_2'

	self.carpenter_1_pos = vector(-1, 0, 30)
	self.carpenter_2_pos = vector(-1, 0, 29)

	self.get_carpenter_1 = function() return get_character('missingbeth_demon_carpenter_1') end
	self.get_carpenter_2 = function() return get_character('missingbeth_demon_carpenter_2') end
	self.get_star_piece = function() return get_field_object('missingbeth_star_piece_1') end
	self.get_fx_star_piece = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_starpiece_in_character') end

	self.section_states = { started = 1, ending = 2 }
	self.current_state = self.section_states.started
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	self.get_fx_star_piece()
end

function local_class:enter()
	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	self.missingbeth_escape_pos_1 = field:GetMarker('missingbeth_escape_pos_1').position
	self.missingbeth_escape_pos_2 = field:GetMarker('missingbeth_escape_pos_2').position

	local carpenter_1 = self.get_carpenter_1()
	local carpenter_2 = self.get_carpenter_2()

	-- 스타피스 비활성화 해두기
	self.get_star_piece().ActiveState = active_state('disabled')

	-- 여기서 선행 퀘스트 여부에 따라 셋팅도 조금 달라진다.
	-- 인부1 좌표 (-1, 0, 30) (down, idle, idle)
	character_util.set_position(carpenter_1, self.carpenter_1_pos)
	character_util.set_direction(carpenter_1, 'down')
	-- 인부2 좌표 (-1, 0, 29) (up, idle)
	character_util.set_position(carpenter_2, self.carpenter_2_pos)
	character_util.set_direction(carpenter_2, 'up')

	character_util.set_active_state(carpenter_1, 'enabled')
	character_util.set_active_state(carpenter_2, 'enabled')

	-- 선행 퀘스트(264 : 베스 퀘스트) 진행도 검사
	if self:quest_checker(264) then
		character_util.add_listener(carpenter_1, self.controller)
		character_util.add_listener(carpenter_2, self.controller)
	else
		carpenter_1.Interactable.Talk = 'qs_missingbeth_talk_1'
		carpenter_2.Interactable.Talk = 'qs_missingbeth_talk_2'

		self.fx_star_piece = self.get_fx_star_piece():Instantiate(carpenter_2.Position, unity_class.quaternion.identity, carpenter_2.Transform)
	end
end

function local_class:quest_checker(i)
	local qid = i
	local qp = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(qid)
	if qp == nil or not qp.IsComplete then
		return false
	end
	return true
end

function local_class:exit()
	local carpenter_1 = self.get_carpenter_1()
	local carpenter_2 = self.get_carpenter_2()

	character_util.remove_relate_event(carpenter_1, self.controller)
	character_util.remove_relate_event(carpenter_2, self.controller)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	if self.fx_star_piece ~= nil then
		self.fx_star_piece:Dispose()
		self.fx_star_piece = nil
	end

	self.section_states = nil
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()
	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	-- 추후에 선행 퀘스트 검사를 넣어야함
	if self.current_state == self.section_states.started then
		-- 인부1,2 중 하나 상호작용 시 인부 이벤트 시작.
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_carpenter_1()) or
				lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_carpenter_2()) then

			self.current_state = self.section_states.ending
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon(self.event_scene, self)
		end
	end

	return false
end
--endregion

function local_class:reset_carpenters()
	local carpenter_1 = self.get_carpenter_1()
	local carpenter_2 = self.get_carpenter_2()

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(carpenter_1)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(carpenter_2)

	character_util.set_direction(carpenter_1, 'down')
	character_util.set_direction(carpenter_2, 'up')
end

function local_class:event_scene()
	local carpenter_1 = self.get_carpenter_1()
	local carpenter_2 = self.get_carpenter_2()
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	-- 선행 퀘스트 클리어 했을 경우
	-- 인부1,2 중 하나 상호작용 시 (0.5, 0, 29.5) 에 정렬, 인부 이벤트 시작.
	party_util.align_party(vector(0.5 - 1, 0, 29.5), 'right', 1)

	-- 정렬 후 하단 인부 대사 출력
	-- 인부1(down, idle, idle): 이 아가씨가 갑자기 어디로 사라진 거지…?
	character_util.set_direction(carpenter_1, 'down')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(carpenter_1, { key = 'qs_missingbeth_talk_1', skip = true })

	-- 인부2(up, idle): 빨리 찾아서 도망가야 하는데 말이야….
	character_util.set_direction(carpenter_2, 'up')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(carpenter_2, { key = 'qs_missingbeth_talk_2', skip = true })

	-- 인부 1,2 right, idle, idle
	character_util.set_direction(carpenter_1, 'right')
	character_util.set_direction(carpenter_2, 'right')
	-- 인부1(right, idle, idle): …응? 자네는?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(carpenter_1, { key = 'qs_missingbeth_talk_3', skip = true })
	-- 인부2(right, idle, question): 낯이 익은데… 분명 그 아가씨의…
	character_util.set_anim(carpenter_2, { name = 'question', loop = false })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(carpenter_2, { key = 'qs_missingbeth_talk_4', skip = true })

	-- 1분기 선택지 3개 출력 (붉은 선택지는 실패하여 이벤트 처음부터 재시작)
	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		{ 'qs_missingbeth_talk_5', 'brutal' },
		{ 'qs_missingbeth_talk_27', 'intellect' },
		{ 'qs_missingbeth_talk_6', 'mercy' },
	})

	local star_piece = self.get_star_piece()

	-- 유저가 선택지 선택하면 인부2 애니메이션 초기화
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(carpenter_2)

	if choose_result == 1 then
		-- 붉은 선택지: 숙적입니다.
		-- 인부1(right, attack, release): 예끼! 이 사람아! 지금 그런 농담을 할 땐가?!
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(carpenter_1, { name = 'release', loop = true, sfx_name = '01_swing_01' }, { name = 'attack' })
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(carpenter_1, { key = 'qs_missingbeth_talk_7', skip = true })
		character_util.remove_anim(carpenter_1)
		character_util.set_anim(carpenter_1, { name = 'release', loop = true })

		--character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(carpenter_1)
		-- 인부2(right, attack, idle): 아무래도 상관없는 사람이었나 보구먼!
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(carpenter_2, { name = 'idle' }, { name = 'attack' })
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(carpenter_2, { key = 'qs_missingbeth_talk_8', skip = true })
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(carpenter_2)
		-- 인부2(right, idle, idle): 헛소리하지 말고 얼른 도망이나 가게!
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(carpenter_2, { key = 'qs_missingbeth_talk_9', skip = true })
		-- 대화 종료 후 인부1(down, idle, idle), 인부2(up, idle) 컨트롤 풀림.
		self:reset_carpenters()
		-- 인부1or2 상호작용 시 이벤트 재시작.
		self.current_state = self.section_states.started
	elseif choose_result == 2 then
		-- 노랑 선택지: 조금 아는 사이입니다.
		-- 인부1(right, idle, idle): …표정을 보니 썩 좋은 관계는 아닌가 보네.
		character_util.remove_anim(carpenter_1)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(carpenter_1, { key = 'qs_missingbeth_talk_28', skip = true })
		-- 인부2(right, sleep_deep, cross_arm): 하긴 그 아가씨… 소싯적 사고 많이 치고 다녔을 거 같긴 했지….
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(carpenter_2, { name = 'cross_arm' }, { name = 'sleep_deep' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(carpenter_2, { key = 'qs_missingbeth_talk_29', skip = true })
		-- 인부2(right, idle, release): 그래도 요즘은 술도 줄이고, 착실하게 살려고 얼마나 노력한다고.
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(carpenter_2, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' }, { name = 'idle' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(carpenter_2, { key = 'qs_missingbeth_talk_30', skip = true })
		character_util.remove_anim(carpenter_2)
		-- 인부1(right, idle, nod 2회): 맞아, 자네도 아가씨와 안 좋은 일이 있다면 이만 잘 풀어보는 게 어떤가?
		character_util.remove_anim(carpenter_1)
		character_util.set_animation_n_times(carpenter_1, { name = 'nod', count = 2 })
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(carpenter_1, { key = 'qs_missingbeth_talk_31', skip = true })
	else
		-- 초록 선택지: 전 애인입니다.
		-- 인부1(right, surprise, cast): 어…어…? 그러고 보니…
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(carpenter_1, { name = 'cast' }, { name = 'surprise' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(carpenter_1, { key = 'qs_missingbeth_talk_10', skip = true })
		--character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(carpenter_1)

		-- 인부2(right, idle, nod 2회): 맞아… 그때 다시 잘해보라고도 하고 그랬었지.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		character_util.set_emotion(carpenter_2, 'idle')
		character_util.set_animation_n_times(carpenter_2, { name = 'nod', count = 2 })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(carpenter_2, { key = 'qs_missingbeth_talk_11', skip = true })

		-- 인부1(right, smile, clap): 이제 기억나는구먼!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_clap_01')
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(carpenter_1, { name = 'clap' }, { name = 'smile' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(carpenter_1, { key = 'qs_missingbeth_talk_12', skip = true })
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(carpenter_1)

		-- 인부2(right, tired, cross_arm): …아직 전 애인이라는 걸 보니, 그 뒤로 잘 되진 않았나 봐…?
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(carpenter_2, { name = 'cross_arm' }, { name = 'tired' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(carpenter_2, { key = 'qs_missingbeth_talk_13', skip = true })
		--character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(carpenter_2)
	end

	if choose_result ~= 1 then
		-- 2분기 선택지 2개 출력 (둘 다 스타피스 획득 엔딩.)
		choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
			{ 'qs_missingbeth_talk_14', 'intellect' },
			{ 'qs_missingbeth_talk_15', 'forced' }
		})

		if choose_result == 1 then
			-- 노란 선택지: 시간이 더 필요할 것 같아요.
			-- 가디언 (left, sleep_deep, idle) emoticon_bubble_silence
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
			character_util.set_direction(leader, 'left')
			character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(leader, { name = 'idle' }, { name = 'sleep_deep' })
			character_util.show_emoticon_async(leader, nil, 'silence')
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

			-- 인부1 (right, idle, idle): …뭐, 인생이 원래 그런 거지, 너무 급하게 생각하지 말게.
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(carpenter_1)
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(carpenter_1, { key = 'qs_missingbeth_talk_16', skip = true })

			-- 인부2 (right, sleep_deep, nod 2회): 맞아, 급할수록 돌아가야 한다는 말도 있잖나.
			character_util.set_emotion(carpenter_2, { name = 'sleep_deep' })
			character_util.set_animation_n_times(carpenter_2, { name = 'nod', count = 2 })
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(carpenter_2, { key = 'qs_missingbeth_talk_17', skip = true })
			character_util.remove_emotion(carpenter_2)

			-- 인부1 (left, idle, idle): 지금은 어디로 사라졌는지 그 아가씨가 안 보이지만…
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(carpenter_1)
			character_util.set_direction(carpenter_1, 'left')
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(carpenter_1, { key = 'qs_missingbeth_talk_18', skip = true })

			-- 인부1 (right, idle, idle): 다시 만나면 천천히 잘 얘기해 보라고.
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
			character_util.set_direction(carpenter_1, 'right')
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(carpenter_1, { key = 'qs_missingbeth_talk_19', skip = true })

			-- 인부2 (right, idle, idle): 이건 둘의 재회를 응원하는 선물이라 생각하고 받아주게.
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(carpenter_2)
			character_util.set_direction(carpenter_2, 'right')
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(carpenter_2, { key = 'qs_missingbeth_talk_20', skip = true })

		else
			-- 보라 선택지: 이참에 숨통을 끊어버리려구요.
			-- 가디언 (left, attack, shoot) emoticon_bubble_angry
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_angry_01')
			character_util.set_direction(leader, 'left')
			character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(leader, { name = 'shoot' }, { name = 'attack' })
			character_util.show_emoticon_async(leader, nil, 'angry')
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

			-- 인부1(down, idle, idle) 인부2(up, idle) 하여 서로 마주봄 emoticon_bubble_silence
			self:reset_carpenters()
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
			character_util.show_emoticon(carpenter_1, nil, 'silence')
			character_util.show_emoticon_async(carpenter_2, nil, 'silence')
			-- 인부1(down, idle, idle): [small] 아가씨랑 사이가 완전히 틀어졌나 보구먼…
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(carpenter_1)
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(carpenter_1, { key = 'qs_missingbeth_talk_25', skip = true, scale = 0.85 })

			-- 인부2(up, idle): [small] 이럴 땐 잘 말해서 돌려보내야겠지…?
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(carpenter_2)
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(carpenter_2, { key = 'qs_missingbeth_talk_26', skip = true, scale = 0.85 })
			-- 인부 1,2 마주본 상태에서 nod 2회 후 right, idle, idle
			character_util.set_animation_n_times(carpenter_1, { name = 'nod', count = 2 })
			character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(carpenter_2, { name = 'nod', count = 2 })

			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(carpenter_1)
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(carpenter_2)
			character_util.set_direction(carpenter_1, 'right')
			character_util.set_direction(carpenter_2, 'right')
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')

			-- 인부1 (right, idle, idle): 인간관계라는 게… 원래 그렇다네. 마음대로 되는 게 없지.
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(carpenter_1, { key = 'qs_missingbeth_talk_22', skip = true })

			-- 인부2 (right, idle, release): 자네도 그 아가씨는 잊고, 새로운 사람을 만나보는 게 좋아.
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
			character_util.set_anim(carpenter_2, { name = 'release' })
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(carpenter_2, { key = 'qs_missingbeth_talk_23', skip = true })

			-- 인부2 (right, idle, idle): 이건 새 출발을 응원하는 선물이라 생각하고 받아주게.
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(carpenter_2)
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(carpenter_2, { key = 'qs_missingbeth_talk_24', skip = true })
		end

		-- 여기서 공용 연출
		-- 인부2 get 자세, 스타피스나와서 아래에 떨굼
		character_util.set_anim(carpenter_2, { name = 'get' })
		wait_for_sec(0.2)
		star_piece.FieldObjectBehaviour.IsHidden = true
		star_piece_util.appear(star_piece, carpenter_2.Position + vector(0, 1.5, 0))
		wait_for_sec(3)

		-- 인부1 (right, idle, idle): 힘내라고. 젊은 친구.
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(carpenter_2)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(carpenter_1)
		character_util.set_direction(carpenter_1, 'right')
		character_util.set_anim(carpenter_1, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(carpenter_1, { key = 'qs_missingbeth_talk_21', skip = true })
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(carpenter_1)

		-- 인부 1,2 화면 밖으로 걸어서 퇴장
		local escape_end_pos = self.missingbeth_escape_pos_2 + vector(3, 0, 0)
		character_util.move_waypoint(carpenter_1, { carpenter_1.Position + vector(0, 0, 1), carpenter_1.Position + vector(13, 0, 1) }, 7, true, 'stop', 'floor', 'right', true)
		character_util.move_waypoint_async(carpenter_2, { carpenter_2.Position + vector(0, 0, 1), carpenter_2.Position + vector(13, 0, 1) }, 7, true, 'stop', 'floor', 'right', true)

		character_util.set_active_state(carpenter_1, 'disabled')
		character_util.set_active_state(carpenter_2, 'disabled')
		-- 스타피스 이벤트 종료.

		character_util.remove_relate_event(carpenter_1, self.controller)
		character_util.remove_relate_event(carpenter_2, self.controller)

		quest_util.complete_quest(self.controller, 0, false, false)
	end
end

return local_class

				self.is_enter_enter_zone_1 == false then
			self.is_enter_enter_zone_1 = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.enter_enter_zone_1, self))
		end
		if e.Zone.Name == self.enter_zone_2 and
				self.is_enter_enter_zone_2 == false then
			self.is_enter_enter_zone_2 = true
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.enter_enter_zone_2, self)

function local_class:enter_enter_zone_1()
	--인베이더 1,2가 하단의 대사를 하며 위쪽 길로 지나감.
	--인베이더1 (up, idle, walk) : 배고파 죽겠네. 어서 가서 카레 먹어야지!
	timeline_util.play_async(self.director_name, 'qs_mister_chief_s1_1')
end

function local_class:enter_enter_zone_2()
	--인베이더2 (up, idle, release) : 취사 장교님! 저녁 식사는 대체 언제 할 수 있는 겁니까!
	--인베이더5 (up, idle, release) : 오늘 저녁으로 카레라이스가 나온다고 해서 계속 기다렸단 말입니다!
	--주방장 인베이더 (down, idle, cast) : 제군들, 조금만 더 기다려주게나!
	--주방장 인베이더 (down, idle, cast2) : 곧 카레를 요리해 주실 전설의 ‘마스터 셰프’ 원사님께서 오실 거라네!
	--대기 0.5초
	--주방장 인베이더 (left, idle, release) : 이봐, 취사병…! 모셔오라 했던 마스터 셰프 원사님은 대체 언제 오는 겐가…!
	--요리사3 인베이더 (right, idle, question) : 이상하네… 곧 오실 때가 됐지 말입니다…
	--대기 0.5초. 이후 요리사 인베이더 left 방향 보며 동시에 머리 위로 (notice) 출력.
	--요리사3 인베이더 (left, idle, jump 1회) : 아! 마침 저기 오십니다!
	--요리사 NPC가 루트를 따라 왼쪽으로 이동한다.
	--
	--미스터 치프 NPC는 검게 틴트 다운 되어 있는 상태.
	--요리사 NPC 뒤로 미스터 치프 NPC가 붙어서 따라오며 두 NPC는 각각 지정된 타일에 위치한다.
	--요리사3 NPC ■타일에 서서 left 방향 바라봄.
	--미스터 치프 NPC ■타일에 서서 down 방향 바라봄.
	--요리사1 NPC는 right 방향 / 요리사2 NPC는 left 방향 바라봄.

	end

	self.current_progress = self.progress_state.boss_battle
end

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(mother_computer_gimmick, { key = 'qs_passage_2_mc_15', skip = true,

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(mother_computer_gimmick, { key = 'qs_passage_2_mc_16', skip = true,
	                                                                       offset = vector(1.55, 4, 0), bubble_direction = 'ct' })

	--qs_passage_2_mc_16, C.E.S 구역 내 인원들은 위험한 오염 생물들을 피해 안전한 장소로 대피 부탁드립니다.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(mother_computer_gimmick, { key = 'qs_passage_2_mc_17', skip = true,

	wait_for_sec(2.0)

	--파티 리더 기준으로 재정렬
	camera_util.return_to_leader(1.0)

	party_util.reset_controllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()

	self.current_progress = self.progress_state.ending

	for i = 1, 2 do
		self.get_computer(i).Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
	end
	yield_return_func(quest_util.complete_quest, self.controller, 0)

	if self.twinkle_fx ~= nil then
		for i = 1, 2 do

			if self.twinkle_fx[i] ~= nil then
				self.twinkle_fx[i]:Dispose()
				self.twinkle_fx[i] = nil
			end
		end

	end

function local_class:start_red_alert()
	local tint_duration = 0.5
	local timer = tint_duration
	local is_tint = false

	self.siren_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx(
			{ sfx_name = "01_siren_oneshot_04", loop = true, fade_in_time = 0, type_priority = 'loop' })

	while self.is_red_alert do
		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if timer >= tint_duration then
			timer = 0

			if is_tint then
				is_tint = false

				field:RemoveTint(self.siren_tint_key, tint_duration)
			else
				is_tint = true

				field:Tint(self.siren_tint_key, unity_color({ 1, 0, 0, 0.8 }), tint_duration)
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if self.siren_sfx ~= nil then
		self.siren_sfx:FadeOut()
		self.siren_sfx = nil
	end

	if not self.is_red_alert and is_tint then
		field:RemoveTint(self.siren_tint_key, tint_duration)
	end
end

function local_class:dispose_amb_loop_sfx()
	if self.amb_loop_sfx ~= nil then
		self.amb_loop_sfx:Stop()
		self.amb_loop_sfx = nil
	end
end

return local_class
